  • Growth & Business Development: Mitentwicklung unserer Go to Market Strategie, Erschließung erster Kundengruppen und Validierung unseres Geschäftsmodells.

Die genaue Aufgabenverteilung möchten wir gemeinsam und abhängig von deinen bisherigen Erfahrungen und Interessen entwickeln.

Als drittes Gründungsmitglied bist du darüber hinaus an der strategischen und unternehmerischen Entwicklung des Vorhabens beteiligt.

Wen wir suchen

Wir suchen eine kommunikative und eigenständig arbeitende Person, die gerne mit Menschen in Kontakt tritt und Interesse daran hat, ein technologisches Produkt von der frühen Entwicklung bis zum Markteintritt zu begleiten.

Idealerweise bringst du Folgendes mit:

  • Erfahrung in einem kommunikationsorientierten Bereich, beispielsweise PR, Marketing, Community Management, Customer Success, Sales, Account Management oder Business Development.

  • Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Ideen verständlich zu kommunizieren und unterschiedliche Zielgruppen anzusprechen.

  • Freude am Aufbau und an der Pflege von Kontakten und langfristigen Beziehungen.

  • Eigeninitiative, organisatorische Fähigkeiten und die Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

  • Interesse an digitalen Produkten, Technologie und kreativen Arbeitsprozessen.

  • Interesse an der gemeinsamen Gründung und langfristigen Entwicklung eines Unternehmens.

Nice to have, aber keine Voraussetzung:

  • Erfahrung in der Musikindustrie oder Kontakte zu Musikproduzenten, Studios, Labels oder Artists.

  • Erfahrung mit Startups, Software Produkten oder dem Aufbau von Communities.

  • Eigene Erfahrung oder Interesse im Bereich Musikproduktion.

Ein bestimmter beruflicher Hintergrund ist für uns nicht ausschlaggebend. Entscheidend sind die Bereitschaft, sich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten, eigenständig Verantwortung zu übernehmen und die fachliche sowie persönliche Ergänzung innerhalb unseres Gründungsteams.

EXIST Förderung & Compensation

Wir bereiten aktuell unseren Antrag für das EXIST Gründungsstipendium vor. Das Förderprogramm unterstützt Gründungsteams über einen Zeitraum von zwölf Monaten bei der Entwicklung und Validierung ihres Gründungsvorhabens.

Während der Förderung erhält jedes Teammitglied abhängig von der Qualifikation ein monatliches Stipendium:

  • 2.500 € pro Monat mit Hochschulabschluss

  • 3.000 € pro Monat mit Promotion

  • 2.000 € pro Monat mit anerkanntem Berufsabschluss

  • 1.000 € pro Monat als Student oder Studentin

Das Stipendium dient der Sicherung des Lebensunterhalts und ist kein reguläres Angestelltengehalt. Die Förderung steht unter dem Vorbehalt der Bewilligung unseres EXIST Antrags.

Voraussetzungen für die EXIST Förderung:

  • Ein Hochschulabschluss, der in der Regel nicht länger als fünf Jahre zurückliegt, oder eine andere nach EXIST zulässige Qualifikation. Für eine Person im Gründungsteam sind Ausnahmen möglich.

  • Ein Wohnsitz in Deutschland beziehungsweise die Möglichkeit, während der Förderung in Deutschland zu leben und sich hier anzumelden.

  • Die Bereitschaft, sich während der Förderphase in Vollzeit dem Gründungsvorhaben zu widmen.

Weitere Informationen zum Förderprogramm findest du auf der offiziellen EXIST Website.

Wir suchen ausdrücklich ein langfristiges Gründungsmitglied und keine befristete Anstellung. Wir streben eine weitgehend gleichberechtigte Beteiligung am zukünftigen Unternehmen an. Die konkrete Ausgestaltung möchten wir gemeinsam besprechen.

Zusammenarbeit

Wir sind derzeit in München und Berlin ansässig. Für die Gründungsphase möchten wir das Team in München zusammenbringen, um die Produktentwicklung und den Unternehmensaufbau gemeinsam vor Ort voranzutreiben.

Daher suchen wir jemanden, der bereits in München lebt oder bereit ist, für die gemeinsame Gründungsphase nach München zu ziehen.

Da wir uns noch in einer frühen Entwicklungsphase befinden, sind viele Aspekte der späteren Unternehmensstruktur und Aufgabenverteilung noch offen. Diese möchten wir gemeinsam als Gründungsteam gestalten.

Interesse?

Weitere Informationen zum Produkt, unserer bisherigen Forschung und dem geplanten Gründungsvorhaben teilen wir gerne in einem persönlichen Gespräch.

title: Senior People Operations Manager (f/m/d)
description:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.


Your Role

bunch is around 155 people across Berlin, London, and Amsterdam, and Luxembourg, on the way to roughly 200 in 2027. That means four legal entities, four payroll providers, different sets of people systems to reconcile, different compliance environments.

Right now our People operations run 50% on effort. We want them to run mostly on systems. We also want our people data to be trustworthy enough that headcount, attrition, and hiring numbers are the same in every room they're quoted in.

This person will own the operational and data backbone that the rest of the People function depends on.

Your role

  • Take full, end-to-end ownership of core People Operations topics — including onboarding, offboarding, contracts, leaves, absence, payroll, immigration cases and documentation — from decision-making through execution.

  • Design, build, and roll out automated, AI-supported workflows and integrations across our tools — including Personio (HRIS) and Notion — to eliminate manual work and connect our systems.

  • Coordinate monthly payroll across Germany, the UK and the Netherlands and in the near future, Luxembourg, with our external providers. You own data accuracy, deadlines and the provider relationships — the providers own the processing.

  • Maintain the compliance calendar and the documentation behind it, working with external counsel where local employment law is involved.

  • Manage and support our full workforce across multiple contract types and locations, ensuring correct setup, documentation, and ongoing administration for each.

  • Be the first line for employee questions on policy, contracts, leave and benefits — and steadily reduce that volume by making the answers self-serve in our handbook.

  • Own the documentation and record-keeping behind employee relations cases: case files, timelines, correspondence.

  • Proactively identify gaps and inefficiencies in our People Operations processes, and independently drive improvement projects from idea through implementation.

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date HRIS data as a reliable single source of truth, and support strategic reporting and people analytics to inform business decisions.

About You

  • 5+ years of experience in People Operations or HR administration, ideally in a fast-paced, international or scaling startup environment

  • Proven end-to-end ownership of operational topics across the employee journey

  • A strong track record in automation, including designing and implementing workflow integrations or AI-supported solutions in an HR or operations context

  • Strong data literacy: you can build reliable reports, spot inconsistencies and investigate until the numbers are trustworthy

  • Experience supporting a varied, international workforce across different contract types, legal entities, locations and working models

  • Knowledge of German employment law and compliance requirements; UK or Luxembourgish employment law is a plus

  • Payroll coordination experience with external providers in at least one European country, owning accurate inputs, deadlines and provider relationships

  • Hands-on ownership of an HRIS — Personio ideally, or a comparable system you have configured and maintained — plus confidence connecting tools such as Notion to build efficient workflows

  • Excellent judgment and communication skills, with the ability to act as a trusted advisor to employees, managers and senior stakeholders

  • Fluency in English; German is a plus.

Your mindset

  • Own it: You take responsibility for outcomes, manage competing priorities and keep your work, decisions and commitments clearly documented and on track

  • Aim for impact: You look beyond the immediate request, prioritise what moves the needle and remove recurring work through better processes, automation and self-service

  • Empower others: You are professional yet personable, a trusted, approachable partner who communicates clearly, protects confidentiality and holds boundaries with care

  • Always be curious: You question inefficient ways of working, think through edge cases and keep learning across systems, data and changing compliance requirements

  • Enjoy the ride: You bring warmth, resilience and positive energy, helping people feel supported even when the topic is stressful or sensitive

  • Detail-obsessed, in a good way: You get genuine satisfaction from accurate records, correctly filed documents and carefully tracked deadlines, because you know that is where compliance and trust are won or lost.

Workplace & benefits

  • Customizable benefits package covering wellbeing, sport, mobility, food and more

  • 28 days of vacation, plus two company days and local public holidays

  • Remote-flexible hybrid work with three days per week in the office

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks per year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 150+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Interview process

  1. Intro call (30 min) — Senior People Business Partner. Your background, the role, mutual fit

  2. Hiring manager interview (60 min) — Joana, People Lead. Scope, experience, how you work

  3. Practical Case (90 min) — a real problem from our stack, discussed together with a white board

  4. Final Round: Stakeholder conversations (2x30 min) — Finance & Legal and Co-Founder

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

Backed by leading investors including a16z and Y Combinator, we're growing fast and tackling some of the most complex challenges in enterprise AI.

We're looking for people who want to take ownership, solve hard problems, and build technology that delivers real business impact.

The Role

We're looking for a Product Manager – Pre-Sales & Go-to-Market who can bridge the gap between what enterprise customers need, what our engineers build, and how we bring our products to market.

At Lio, product decisions don't happen in isolation. Every customer conversation, sales cycle, and implementation reveals new opportunities to make our AI agents more valuable.

Your mission is to turn those insights into action.

You'll work directly with our Sales, Engineering, Marketing, and Implementation teams to understand customer needs, shape product positioning, strengthen our go-to-market strategy, and identify opportunities that drive revenue.

You'll be deeply involved in enterprise sales cycles, helping our teams communicate the value of our AI agents, build compelling business cases, and win customers.

This isn't traditional Product Management.

Our engineers own their features and make most product decisions. You won't manage a backlog or spend your time writing detailed specifications.

Instead, you'll provide the customer context, commercial insights, and clear recommendations that help our engineers build the right things and our Sales team sell them effectively.

We care about real customer value and commercial outcomes, not features that look impressive but never get used.

What You'll Do

  • Connect product and go-to-market: Work across Sales, Engineering, Marketing, and Implementation to align customer needs, product capabilities, and commercial opportunities.

  • Get close to customers: Participate in enterprise discovery calls, demos, workshops, and sales conversations to understand buying criteria, pain points, and emerging use cases.

  • Own product knowledge: Build and maintain the product and go-to-market knowledge base used by our teams and internal AI systems, ensuring capabilities, use cases, and proof points stay accurate.

description:

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

We offer a highly competitive compensation package with On-Target Earnings (OTE), designed to reward high performance and results. Building on this performance-driven culture, not every candidate ticks every box — and that’s why we value individuals with a growth mindset who bring potential, initiative, and a willingness to learn.

We are looking to add a Senior Mechanical Engineer to our Mechanical Engineering team. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing space hardware for leading-edge communications satellites, we would like to hear from you. 

In this position, you will be responsible for mechanical design aspects of Cesium phased array antennas, subsystems, and interfaces through all phases of the development process. The ideal candidate will be versatile and proficient in mechanical analysis, electronics packaging, computer-aided design (CAD), mechanical interfaces, thermal architecture, spacecraft propulsion, deployable and actuated structures, and environmental qualification of spacecraft antennas and payloads. You will be responsible for mechanical designs from concept through space flight including requirements definition, architecture trades and block diagrams, analysis, manufacturing, testing, qualification, and in-orbit support. 

The successful candidate will also present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team, as well as participate in proposal-writing efforts. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required. 


JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor of Science (BS) in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering from an accredited university or institution 
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in space antenna and payload mechanical engineering to include electronics packaging, thermal, shock, vibration, stress dynamics, and cost. A Master's degree may count as two years of experience. 
  • Experience in conducting architectural trade studies including parametric and first-order cost and physical analysis 
  • Experience with professional mechanical and FEA CAD tools, such as Ansys Mechanical, SolidWorks Simulation, and Thermal Desktop 
  • Experience with CNC manufacturing and GD&T 
  • Experience with advanced aerospace manufacturing and materials including sandwich panels and carbon composites, OR experience with high-reliability deployment mechanisms for space applications (including deployment, HDRMs, power delivery, etc.).
  • Proficiency in detailed mechanical design (3D CAD, drawings, etc.) 
  • Experience designing and manufacturing mechanisms and mechanical actuators 
  • Experience with EMI/EMC mitigation techniques 
  • Familiarity with satellite thermal architectures including heat pipes, phase change materials, contact resistance, and surface finishes as well as fundamental understandings of orbital thermal control in a LEO environment. 
  • Familiarity with launch and LEO environments (thermal, shock, vibe, radiation, etc) 
  • Familiarity with design for test, manufacturability, assembly, and reliability 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills 

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
  • Python, C++, or other programming languages 
  • Experience with large, deployable antenna arrays which drive your vision for the next generation of on-orbit communications and sensor arrays.
  • Robotics and control systems experience 
  • PCBA experience.

We are Emma – The Sleep Company. Founded in 2015, we have grown into the world’s largest direct-to-consumer (D2C) sleep brand, with a presence in over 20 markets and more than 35 Emma stores across Europe. 

Our mission is simple: to develop sleep comfort products that empower our customers to awaken their best every day. Today, our products are trusted by millions and recommended by leading consumer associations worldwide. 

It’s our people who bring this mission to life. At Emma, you’ll join a driven, international team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous knowledge sharing. With colleagues from over 70 nationalities, we combine diverse perspectives with a shared ambition to learn, grow, and create lasting impact, together. 

Ready to awaken your best with us? 

 

What you'll do:
  • Own category management and product development: range architecture, category prioritisation, lifecycle management, and pricing logic
  • Build and lead a high-performing, cross-functional product organisation (6 direct reports, 65 Emmies across two topics - category management and product development)
  • Build and execute a product strategy to make Emma the global leader in sleep across online and offline
  • Lead physical product development -materials, manufacturing, supplier relationships, and cost structures
  • Ground all product decisions in deep consumer understanding to drive satisfaction, brand preference, and word-of-mouth
  • Design a product architecture that balances global ambition with meaningful local differences
  • Act as a co-owner at Senior Leadership level - You will be directly reporting to the CEO and Co-founder Dennis and contributing to company strategy and cross-functional decisions
  • Think in P&L - defend margin, manage complexity, and prevent range proliferation
  • Build the processes and accountability structures that make the product org predictable and high-performing
  • Develop a strong layer of senior product leaders and invest in succession and capability-building

    • Who we are looking for:
  • 15+ years of relevant experience, with at least 3–4 years in a senior leadership role leading other team leaders
  • Deep expertise in category management - assortment strategy, range architecture, pricing logic, and portfolio decision-making
  • Hands-on experience in physical product development - materials, manufacturing, supplier relationships, cost structures
  • Background in branded consumer goods with proprietary R&D (not retail-only or pure trading)
  • Operationally deep - comfortable leading through doing, not just directing
  • Proven decision-maker under ambiguity, with the ability to give clarity when stakeholders pull in different directions
  • Experience at scale - 1,000+ people, multi-market, multi-category organisations
  • 12+ years of relevant experience, with at least 3–4 years in a senior leadership role leading other team leaders
  • Strong cross-functional collaborator who sees product as a platform for company-wide impact

    • What we offer:
  • The opportunity to create real impact, take ownership and accountability, and drive meaningful change.
  • Continuous learning and development through hands-on experience, mentoring, formal training, and access to tools such as our Learning Hub and Nilo.
  • A collaborative community of smart, driven people where you learn, contribute, and connect, every day and through team events.
  • A global environment, working daily with diverse perspectives across 4 offices and 70+ nationalities. 25 vacations days per year, with 1 extra day per year worked (until a limit of 30 days per year).
  • A flexible hybrid setup with up to 22 remote days per quarter, and offices in Gutleutviertel - Frankfurt. 
    • Become an Emmie

    We are on a mission to become No.1 in the world of sleep, and we’re looking for driven, ambitious people to help us shape what’s next. If you’re curious, hands-on, and ready to challenge the status quo, you’ll find the space here to make things happen and create real impact.  

    We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace. We celebrate diversity and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or age. 

    Our aim is to get back to you within a few days. Due to the high volume of applications, there may be slight delays, but we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

title: Account Executive (DACH) - German Speaking
description:
Siteimprove is a global leader in digital accessibility, content optimization, and web governance, empowering organizations to deliver inclusive, high-performing digital experiences. With the launch of Siteimprove.ai, the only enterprise platform unifying content compliance and content performance, we are leading the way in the AI era—where content must perform for both humans and AI.

From accessibility and SEO/AIO to analytics and content intelligence, our Agentic Content Intelligence Platform enables organizations to create, govern, and optimize digital content that is compliant, discoverable, and effective at scale.

We are seeking a high-performing Account Executive to join our EMEA Enterprise Sales team, covering the DACH region. In this quota-carrying role, you will drive new business growth across strategic enterprise accounts, partnering with organizations typically ranging from 250M–5B+ in revenue.

You will engage senior stakeholders across Marketing, Digital, Communications, IT, Accessibility, and Procurement to uncover business challenges and deliver measurable outcomes through Siteimprove’s SaaS and AI-powered platform. This is a full-cycle sales role where you will lead everything from prospecting and discovery through to solution alignment, negotiation, and close.

A strong command of German is required, as you will be working closely with customers and prospects across the DACH region. This is a high-impact role within a fast-growing international organization, offering the opportunity to shape how leading enterprises approach accessibility, content performance, and AI-driven digital governance.

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply—even if they don’t meet every requirement. If you are motivated by impact, growth, and working at the intersection of AI, content, and digital experience, we want to hear from you.


What you will be doing
  • Own the full sales cycle for named enterprise accounts, driving both new logo acquisition and expansion opportunities within your territory
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior decision-makers across Marketing, Digital, Communications, IT, Accessibility, and Procurement
  • Execute a multi-threaded sales approach to navigate complex enterprise buying processes and long sales cycles
  • Identify customer challenges and align Siteimprove’s accessibility, analytics, SEO, and content intelligence solutions to business outcomes
  • Partner closely with internal teams including Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Value Consulting, and Customer Success to deliver tailored, high-impact customer engagements
  • Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline management in Salesforce, ensuring disciplined opportunity progression
  • Stay informed on EU and DACH digital accessibility regulations, AI governance trends, and enterprise compliance requirements
  • Represent Siteimprove at industry events, conferences, and regional customer forums across EMEA
  • Contribute to a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and knowledge sharing across the sales organization
    •  

     


    What we will require of you
    • 5+ years of SaaS sales experience with a strong track record in new business and/or account growth
    • Experience selling Martech, digital experience, or related enterprise software (e.g., Adobe, Oracle, Demandbase, Amplitude, Braze, 6sense)
    • Fluency in German (written and spoken), with experience selling into the DACH market strongly preferred
    • Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles
    • Experience engaging senior and executive stakeholders (CMO, CDO, CIO, and equivalent roles)
    • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to build, forecast, and close large, strategic deals
    • Collaborative mindset with a strong bias for action, learning, and cross-functional partnership
    • High resilience, adaptability, and performance orientation in a fast-paced environment

    What we will love about you
  • Experience selling into regulated or highly governed industries such as financial services, insurance, or public sector
  • Passion for digital accessibility, inclusive design, ESG, or responsible AI
  • Familiarity with value-based selling methodologies (MEDDICC or similar) and consultative enterprise sales approaches

    • What you'll love about us
    We’re building the next generation of AI-powered content intelligence, helping organizations unify accessibility, SEO/AEO, analytics, and content performance into one platform. If you’re energized by solving complex problems, working cross-functionally, and contributing to a product with real-world impact, we’d love to connect.

    In addition, we hope you will appreciate:

    At Siteimprove, we're committed to supporting your wellbeing both at work and beyond. Our Germany benefits are designed to provide financial security, flexibility, and support for everyday life. 

    Rest and relaxation: 30 days of annual leave, plus paid volunteer time to support causes that matter to you.

    Comprehensive benefits: Statutory health coverage, digital meal vouchers, workplace glasses support, and monthly work-from-home and mobile phone allowances. 

    Prepare for the future: Participation in Germany's statutory pension system, helping support your long-term financial wellbeing.

    All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or other legally protected status.

Please note that personal information may be transferred, accessed, and stored globally as necessary for the uses and disclosures stated in accordance with our Privacy Policy at https://siteimprove.com/en/privacy/.

description:

Unzer is a leading European fintech company with a mission to simplify international payments for e-commerce and retail businesses. Our brand was formed from 13 companies that now contribute to building a unique product covering the entire payment flow.

Our offices
We are based across Austria, Denmark, Germany and Luxembourg with a HQ in Berlin.

The Foundations group is focused on delivering core platform software products. Starting from gateways, through merchant onboarding and offboarding reaching the billing systems and debtor management solutions of Unzer.

- Design, build, test, and operate cloud-based microservices (Java/Spring Boot, Kafka)
- Write automated tests (unit, integration, and end-to-end) as an integral part of your daily work
- Contribute to product design by writing technical specifications – clear enough to
  guide both engineers and AI agents

  in your daily work and help us evolve how we use it
- Work with the Unzer Tech standards and processes and help us improve them
- Be actively involved in team and organizational knowledge-sharing

What you need to be successful in this role:
- 5+ years of experience with Java 21+ and Spring Boot
- Solid knowledge of data structures, algorithms, operating systems and distributed systems
- Experience with SQL databases (schema design, migrations); NoSQL is a plus
- Experience with microservices, event-driven messaging (Kafka, Avro) and
  Git-based workflows (feature branches, pull requests, code review)
- You diligently test (ideally test-first/TDD) and document your deliveries
- Experience in architecture design (e.g. Domain-Driven Design) and common design patterns
- Experience with observability tools such as Coralogix or OpenTelemetry
- Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants/agents (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot):
  you use them productively and critically review, test and own the code they produce
- Hands-on mentality
 
Nice to have:
- Frontend experience with Angular
- Know-how in delivering software to the AWS cloud platform
- Experience with Docker, Kubernetes and GitOps (e.g. Argo CD)
- Experience building agentic workflows (MCP integrations, custom agent skills,
  AI steps in CI such as automated PR review)
- Experience in regulated environments (payments, PCI-DSS, GDPR)

What’s next?
  • Does it sound exciting? -  Apply with your CV in English. Please don’t shy away if you don’t meet all the requirements! We’re looking forward to meeting you.  
  • We will get back to you within 7 days of receiving your application.   
  • The interview process includes a 30-minute intro call with a TA Partner, a 45-minute conversation with the Hiring Manager, and a technical interview with the team (60- 90 mins). Please note the process might alter depending on our team’s availability.

    More than a workplace. A place to grow. 🌍 

    At Unzer, colleagues from 50+ nationalities across four countries work together to create better outcomes for our merchants. We take ownership, move with pace, and keep raising the bar—as one team. 

    We set high expectations and give you the flexibility, learning opportunities and practical support to do your best work, grow your impact, and build a sustainable career.

title: (Senior) Software Engineer - Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Azure (m/f/d)
description:
ABOUT US
 
Unzer is a leading European fintech company with a mission to simplify international payments for e-commerce and retail businesses. Our brand was formed from 13 companies that now contribute to building a unique product covering the entire payment flow.  
 
At Unzer, we are driven by the belief that customers should enjoy a seamless shopping experience, no matter where they choose to shop. We are a team of over 700 experts of 55 different nationalities, dedicated to creating a state-of-the-art unified commerce platform. Our goal is to enable businesses to delight their customers with a seamless payment experience.  
 
Whether you're a tech enthusiast, payment expert, or a dedicated support professional, we are looking for individuals who are passionate about making a difference.  
 
Our offices: We are based across Austria, Denmark, Germany and Luxembourg, with a HQ in Berlin.
 
ABOUT THE TEAM

Help us connect Microsoft Dynamics 365 with our wider technology platform. As part of a cross-functional team, you will work with product managers, business stakeholders and engineers to turn business needs into reliable software. Your work will combine Dynamics 365 and Power Platform development with Azure services, secure APIs and event-driven integrations, taking solutions from design through deployment and operation. .

 


What your work will look like:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Dynamics 365 CRM solutions on Dataverse, including data models, plug-ins, custom APIs, model-driven Power Apps, and Power Automate flows. Choose configuration or custom code according to maintainability, performance, and business needs. 

  • Build Azure applications and integration services using C# and .NET, with services such as Azure Functions, App Service, and API Management to connect Dynamics 365 with the wider platform. 

  • Develop and consume REST APIs, Dataverse Web API and OData endpoints, and GraphQL APIs. Define clear contracts, validation, versioning, and error handling with the teams that own connected systems. 

  • Connect Dynamics 365 and Azure services to Apache Kafka through integration services and event producers and consumers. Design for retries, duplicate messages, schema evolution and reliable data synchronisation. 

  • Implement secure service-to-service access using OAuth 2.0 and Microsoft Entra ID, including app registrations, permissions and managed identities where appropriate. Protect credentials and secrets with Azure Key Vault. 

  • Build and improve CI/CD for Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure applications. Use Git and Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions to automate builds, tests and deployments, including solution packaging, managed solutions, environment variables and connection references. 

  • Own quality and operability through automated unit, integration and API contract tests, code reviews, monitoring and troubleshooting: document technical decisions and support releases and production incidents. 

  • Work closely with business and engineering colleagues to clarify requirements, agree acceptance criteria and deliver usable solutions in small increments. 


What you need to be successful in this role:

  • Professional software engineering experience, including hands-on delivery of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM and Dataverse solutions in production. 

  • Strong C# and .NET skills, plus JavaScript or TypeScript for Dynamics 365 customisation. Practical experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, plug-ins, Dataverse data modelling and security roles. 

  • Experience developing and operating applications on Azure, with an understanding of cloud security, configuration, logging, monitoring and application performance. 

  • Practical experience with REST, GraphQL and OAuth 2.0, and the ability to design, implement and troubleshoot integrations across system boundaries. 

  • Experience with Apache Kafka and event-driven integration, including producers and consumers, consumer groups, delivery semantics and idempotent processing. 

  • Hands-on experience with Git, automated testing, and CI/CD, particularly application lifecycle management for Dynamics 365 and Power Platform, and deploying Azure applications. 

  • Sound judgement about software architecture, data consistency and maintainability. You can explain technical trade-offs clearly and collaborate across engineering and business functions. 

  • A degree in computer science, business informatics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

    Nice to have :

    • AI-assisted development using tools such as GitHub Copilot or coding agents to support implementation, test creation, debugging, and documentation. You review generated code critically and protect confidential data when using these tools. 

    • Infrastructure as code with Bicep or Terraform, custom Power Apps components using PCF, or integration with Microsoft 365 services through Microsoft Graph. 

     


What's next ?
  • Does it sound exciting? -  Apply with your CV in English. Please don’t shy away if you don’t meet all the requirements! We’re looking forward to meeting you.  
  • The interview process includes: a 30min intro call with a TA Partner, a 45-min Hiring Manager interview, a 60-90 min skills assessment call with the team. Please note the process might alter depending on our team’s availability. 

    • WHAT WE OFFER 

    More than a workplace. A place to grow. 🌍 

    At Unzer, colleagues from 50+ nationalities across four countries work together to create better outcomes for our merchants. We take ownership, move with pace and keep raising the bar—as one team. 

    We set high expectations and give you the flexibility, learning opportunities and practical support to do your best work, grow your impact, and build a sustainable career. 

    🏡 Flexibility that works 
    Combine focused time at home with connection and collaboration in the office. Our hybrid setup includes two office days per week. 

    🚲 Your commute, your choice 
    Choose the mobility benefit that works for you: bike leasing or a Deutschlandticket.  

    🏖️ Work from anywhere in the EU 
    Change your perspective and work from another EU country for up to 15 days per year. 

    📗 Keep raising the bar 
    Use an annual learning budget of €1,000 for courses, conferences, certifications and other development opportunities that help you grow and increase your impact.

title: Management Consultant - Senior Consultant - Germany
description:
At Efficio, we're not just a consulting firm; we're a team of dedicated experts committed to transforming procurement and supply chain functions. Our mission is to drive sustainable, measurable value for our clients through innovative solutions and deep industry insights. Join us and be part of a dynamic environment where your skills and ideas make a real impact.
 
Efficio is the world’s largest specialist procurement and supply chain consultancy, with offices across Europe, North America, and the Middle East. We’re a diverse team of over 1,000 individuals, representing more than 60 different nationalities and speaking 40+ languages – and we’re continuing to grow rapidly!
We are recruiting for our Dusseldorf Office where you'll be joining a growing team of over 50 people.
 
Consultants based in Dusseldorf will support clients in Germany and across Europe with opportunity to travel globally. Our consultants provide flexible support to clients whether it is a rapid assessment, short term savings realisation or embedding in a long-term partnership to deliver lasting and measurable value to clients.

As a Senior Consultant (SC), you will have complete ownership of complex workstreams or several smaller workstreams and be supported by junior resources. You should be deemed as a subject matter expert (SME) both internally and by clients and you will be responsible for the following:
  • Managing complex workstreams or multiple smaller workstreams. Often supported by junior resources
  • Managing more junior consultants on projects, making sure Efficio methodologies and processes are followed
  • Driving complex analysis where data is hard to access and using expertise to creatively develop conclusions and recommended solutions
  • Playing a role in advising clients and designing solutions that address complex needs, achieve sustainable results, and demonstrate real impact
  • Effectively managing and owning the relationship with senior stakeholders
  • Planning and preparing documentation for own workstream
  • Taking part in the recruitment process of potential junior consultants
    • Our collaborative and inclusive culture is what makes us stand out. At Efficio, colleagues with diverse backgrounds, ideas, and viewpoints come together to identify innovative solutions for our clients - and so we're looking for our new team members to bring strong communication, empathy, and relationship-building skills to maintain this culture as we grow.
     
    We encourage our teams to proactively innovate and challenge the status-quo, backed by strong analytical thinking and creative problem-solving abilities alongside comfortable proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint. We're looking for team members who enjoy and have experience of digging into complex challenges at a leading management consultancy or in a relevant industry position.
     
    Strong opportunities for career growth are an important part of our offering; as such, we love seeing ambition and a proactive approach to shaping your career to your goals and interests.
     
    To meet client needs, we look for flexibility to travel; you can give us a heads-up on your preferences when applying.
     
    We'd love to hear about any additional skills or experiences you bring to the table. We're particularly interested in:
    • Fluency in German and English
    • Management consulting experience within a leading consultancy, ideally within procurement and/or supply chain
    • Experience (or an interest) in strategic sourcing, procurement transformation, supply chain, operations, infrastructure, or capital projects
    • Proven track record of working closely with senior client stakeholders
    • Deep analytical skills and problem-solving skills, with the ability to isolate key issues and draw sound conclusions
    • Strong grasp of detail and a 'hands-on' approach
    • Excellent interpersonal and leadership skills
    • Ability to confidently improve existing ways of working, recognize opportunities and identify innovative solutions that add real value to clients

title: Sales Manager
description:
Win new restaurants across Germany and help build one of our fastest-growing markets from the ground up.

Full-time

About SOUS

SOUS exists to give independent restaurants the same acquisition-to-retention infrastructure that only chains and delivery platforms could previously afford. We build it as one connected data layer, replacing the fragmented stack most restaurants run today: a listings tool here, a separate storefront there, and no CRM at all.

Spotlight owns discovery, as search shifts from Google links to AI assistants recommending where to eat. Commerce owns the transaction and, critically, the guest relationship that marketplaces have been extracting for a decade. Every order through that owned channel generates data that sharpens the next cycle of visibility, personalisation and retention, compounding in the restaurant's favour instead of the platform's.

Our long-term bet is simple. As AI becomes the default interface for "where should I eat", the restaurants that own their guest data and their presence in that layer will keep the margin, and the ones still renting both from marketplaces will not. We are building the infrastructure to make the first outcome the default, not the exception.

We are a team of 27, working from our headquarters on the Vijzelstraat in Amsterdam city centre, and we are growing fast across the Netherlands, Germany and South Africa.

About the role

SOUS helps independent food and beverage entrepreneurs grow by building what we believe will be the last employee a restaurant owner ever has to hire that touches a screen. After a strong start in the Netherlands, Germany is now one of our most important growth markets, and we are scaling our team there quickly.

As Sales Manager Germany you bring SOUS to independent restaurants across the country. You are one of the first people building our German sales team, which means real ownership, a big market to win and a fast track to grow with it.

title: Account Executive (m/w/d) Legal Tech – DACH
description:
Where Legal Leads. 

Drei Worte. Eine Überzeugung. Rechtsabteilungen sind nicht länger die Bremse im Unternehmen – sie sind der Hebel. Bei DiliTrust geben wir ihnen die Plattform, die diesem Anspruch gerecht wird: Verträge, Beteiligungen, Vorstandsarbeit und Legal AI – eine integrierte Suite für die gesamte Rechtsfunktion. Im Einsatz bei mehr als 3.000 Unternehmen in 64 Ländern, darunter führende Konzerne in Europa, Nordamerika und MEA. 

DACH ist unser nächster großer Wachstumsmarkt. Die Basis steht, jetzt skalieren wir. Du übernimmst ein eigenes Territory, baust deine Strategie eigenständig auf und entscheidest, wo du wachsen willst – unterstützt von einem Team aus Solution Consultants, BDR, Marketing und Customer Success, das in DACH bereits liefert. 

Der Legal-Tech-Markt ist über 16 Milliarden Dollar schwer und wächst jedes Jahr zweistellig. In zwei Jahren wirst du auf diesen Moment zurückblicken. 

Die Frage ist nur: Warst du dabei? 


Deine Rolle 
 

Du verantwortest ein eigenes Vertical in DACH, z.B. Financial Services, Energy, Manufacturing oder Pharma. Dein Fokus liegt auf Neukundengewinnung und gezieltem Cross-Sell in deinem bestehenden Portfolio. 

  • Du identifizierst und qualifizierst neue Opportunities, gemeinsam mit deinem BDR, über Anfragen, Marketing und gezielte Ansprache. 

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, nicht aus dem Bauch. Du baust deinen Territory Plan auf, entwickelst Account Plans für deine Top-Targets und treibst gemeinsam mit deinem BDR fokussierte Pod Sprints in deinem Vertical. 

  • Deine Deals liegen typischerweise zwischen 50.000 € und 200.000 € Jahresvolumen. Sales-Cycles dauern 4–9 Monate. Pro Deal sprichst du mit 4–7 Entscheidern: Legal, IT, Einkauf, Finance, manchmal Vorstand. 

  • Du verkaufst eine Plattform, kein Einzelprodukt. Erstgespräche führen oft Legal Ops Manager oder General Counsel. Deals über mehrere Module sind bei uns die Regel. 

  • Du repräsentierst DiliTrust auf den wichtigen Branchen-Events wie z.B. Legal Revolution oder LegalTech. Du führst dort die Gespräche, die später zu Pipeline werden. 


Must-have

  • 4+ Jahre Erfahrung im quotaverantwortlichen B2B-Software-Vertrieb, idealerweise im SaaS-Umfeld. 

  • Erfahrung in komplexen Sales-Cycles mit mehreren Entscheidern aus Legal, IT, Finance oder Procurement. 

  • Methodisches Arbeiten: Du qualifizierst sauber (z. B. mit MEDDPICC) und führst belastbare Forecasts. 

  • Erfahrung im Verkauf an C-Level-Entscheider. 

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachen-Niveau, sehr gutes Englisch – unsere Unternehmenssprache ist Englisch. 


Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung im Verkauf an Rechts-, Governance- oder Compliance-Funktionen. 

  • Du kennst die Welt regulierter Branchen - Financial Services, Energy, Healthcare oder Pharma. 

  • Du hast bereits eigenständig ein Territory aufgebaut – mit klarer Account-Strategie und nachhaltigem Pipeline-Aufbau. 

  • Du interessierst dich für KI im Unternehmenskontext  und kannst Kunden den Unterschied zwischen Hype und echtem Mehrwert erklären. 


Was wir dir bieten

  • Remote-First. Du arbeitest von zuhause oder in unseren Offices in München und Berlin - regelmäßige Team-Events bringen uns offline zusammen. 

  • Onboarding und Ramp-Up, das zu einem komplexen Produkt passt. Produkt, Branche und Methodik step by step - mit erfahrenen Teamkollegen, die dich auf Tempo bringen. 

  • Ehrliches Coaching, präsenter Sales Manager. Wir sind 7 Leute im DACH-Sales, keine Nummer in einer großen Maschine. Regelmäßige Einzelgespräche, gemeinsame Deal-Reviews. Wenn du gut bist, wird das gesehen. Wenn etwas hakt, wird darüber gesprochen. 

  • Karriereperspektive in einer Wachstumsregion. Senior AE, Enterprise AE, Team Lead DACH: wir bauen die Region aktiv aus, nicht ab. 

  • Internationales Setup, lokaler Fokus. Dein Spielfeld ist DACH, aber wenn dich die Lust auf Mailand, Madrid oder Mexico City packt, kannst du auch von dort arbeiten. 

  • 30 Tage Urlaub, Zulage für Heimarbeit und weitere Vorteile folgen in Kürze! 


Dein Weg zu uns

  1. Erstgespräch mit dem Recruiting-Team (30 Min, auf Englisch) – wir lernen uns kennen, klären gegenseitige Erwartungen. 

  1. Interview mit dem Sales Manager DACH (45 Min) – Deep Dive in deine Erfahrung, deine Methodik und Fit für die Rolle. 

  1. Interview mit dem Global Chief Sales Officer (45 Min) – Strategie, Karriereperspektive, Final-Check. 

  1. Kurzes Rollenspiel (45 Min) – eine realistische Sales-Situation, an der wir sehen, wie du arbeitest. Du bekommst Briefing und Vorbereitungszeit. 

Bist du bereit, bei uns einzusteigen?

Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf – wenn möglich auf Englisch – ein Anschreiben ist nicht erforderlich. Wenn du vorab Fragen hast: ----- oder sende eine LinkedIn-Nachricht an Fabian Pohl.

Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von allen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Identität oder Behinderung.

Hinweis: Wir nutzen KI-gestützte Tools zur Vorauswahl von Bewerbungen. Die endgültige Entscheidung trifft immer ein Mensch.

title: Senior AV Field Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Mobileye changes the way we drive, from preventing accidents to semi and fully autonomous vehicles. If you are an excellent, bright, hands-on person with a passion to make a difference come to lead the revolution!
Mobileye’s AV group is transforming mobility both by bringing cutting-edge, safe-by-design premium ADAS and self-driving technology as well as a complete, modular solution with flexible business models to the market; and creating an accessible, safe, environmentally-friendly, and affordable experience for passengers based on our self-driving technology.
Mobileye field engineer is the connecting link between Mobileye and its customers, the car manufacturer (OEM) and the integration partner (Tier 1). As such, the field engineer provides the first line of technical support, analysis, and integration in the development of next-generation semi-autonomous driving systems.
 

What will you do?
  • The field engineer will work alongside the development teams of a leading international automotive company.
  • The field engineer will Be the liaison between Mobileye and the customer and hold a key role in Mobileye's development projects providing the customer with direct technical support.
  • As such, the field engineer will have an influence on the design and application of advanced vision based semi-autonomous driving systems, eventually installed in millions of cars worldwide

    • What will your job look like?
  • Ability to understand operate and debug the entire Mobileye system and solve the customer problems.
  • Installing various Mobileye evaluation systems on prototype vehicles: mechanical assembly, electrical connections, network configuration, operating systems, version deployments etc.
  • Debugging multidisciplinary system failures.
  • Performing and supervising test drives on an open road and test tracks
  • The position includes office work, support at vehicle production lines and integration facilities.
  • Tasks also include long test drives and travel to additional local cities and abroad projects from time to time.
  • Close collaboration with the AV development, validation, and algorithm teams
  • Testing and validating end-to-end AV functionality and provide expert reports.
  • Representing the company in customer demonstrations

  • B.Sc. in Electrical engineering /exact science or similar field
  • Valid driving license and Advanced driving courses (for test vehicles)
  • Linux experience

  • Various "Hands On" experience with installation (e.g. assembling, wiring, soldering)
  • Experience with configuring/troubleshooting computers, Operating-Systems, protocol-based devices.
  • Testing tools Experience: OBD2, Multi-meter (Fluke), Scope, Battery Analyzer, Sniffers etc.

  • Willingness to work in a dynamic environment.
  • Independent, self-disciplined, and self-contained
  • Highly motivated and self-management skills
  • Great interpersonal skills, customer facing.
  • Fluent German and English skills both verbal and writing
  • Abroad travels to support remote projects (3-4 times per year)

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI/ML Engineer based in Germany.

Join a mission-driven engineering team developing practical AI systems that address real-world challenges in healthcare, agriculture, education, and international development. As an AI/ML Engineer, you will design, build, evaluate, deploy, and continuously improve AI-powered applications used by nonprofit organizations and their communities. You will work on solutions ranging from clinical copilots and AI coaching tools to agricultural advisory chatbots and evaluation infrastructure. Collaborating with behavioral scientists, researchers, and embedded engineers, you will translate applied AI research into reliable, scalable products and reusable technical resources. You will also help partner organizations strengthen their own AI capabilities through mentorship, open-source contributions, and knowledge sharing. This fully remote role offers substantial technical ownership and the opportunity to apply advanced AI engineering to initiatives that can improve outcomes for millions of people.


Accountabilities:

title: Publishing Product Director
description:
As Publishing Product Director, you are the creative custodian of one of Crytek’s games, embedded inside the game team, accountable for protecting the creative vision and translating the promise of the game into work that the publishing team can execute with conviction. The success of a great game depends on the work that surrounds it landing as truthfully as the game itself, and closing that gap is what this role exists to do. You make sure that what reaches players is authentic, aspirational, tells the story the game deserves, and delights the players who play it. 

The game in your remit is an unannounced project in the Crytek portfolio. The work focuses on shaping the project’s player promise from the inside out, defining the publishing narrative for its eventual reveal, and carrying its creative vision through to launch and into ongoing releases. 

You sit inside the game team, working shoulder-to-shoulder with game leadership every day. You partner directly with the Chief Publishing Officer and Brand & Marketing Director to support both the game and the business as one connected effort. You are the direct line between the game team and the publishing organization, the person who protects the north star on both ends, and the person both sides trust to tell them the truth. 

This role demands creative conviction, drive, and the kind of experience that only comes from working shoulder-to-shoulder with game teams. You will protect the team from noise so they can build the game, and you will give the publishing team the clarity, player insight, and creative truth they need to land it well. It is one of the most consequential seats at Crytek, and one of the most rewarding. 


What You'll Do
  • Be the custodian of the game’s creative vision, tone, and player promise, and translate it into work that publishing can execute with conviction
  • Sit embedded inside the game team and act as the daily bridge between game leadership and the publishing organisation  
  • Serve as the source of truth on what the game is, what is coming next, and what it means for players, across Marketing, Comms, Community, and Commercial  
  • Brief and review every major marketing, comms, and community output for creative authenticity, ensuring it tells the right player story  
  • Partner with the Chief Publishing Officer and Brand & Marketing Director to shape go-to-market plans that serve the game and the business in equal measure  
  • Drive franchise narrative, player promise, and creative direction across reveals, beats, and post-launch moments  
  • Protect the game team from operational noise so they can focus on building, while translating publishing priorities into work the team can act on  
  • Keep the north star intact on both ends, keeping publishing grounded in the game’s vision, and the game team grounded in player and market reality  

    • What You Bring
  • 8+ years working at the seam between game development and publishing or marketing, with significant time embedded inside game teams
  • Proven ability to translate creative vision into commercial activation without compromising either side, with strong creative judgement and editorial instinct you can defend under pressure  
  • Fluency across business models (premium, live service, DLC, F2P) and multi-year roadmap strategy, and how the two shape the player promise  
  • Cross-functional leadership and the ability to influence without authority across game and publishing teams  
  • Strong player insight, audience segmentation, and community fluency  
  • Drive and operating range, comfortable moving from creative critique in the morning to commercial trade-offs in the afternoon  
  • Experience supporting or launching at least one major game or live-service title from inside the game team  
  • Track record of being trusted by both game leadership and publishing leadership  

    • What you can expect from us

    Career Path 
    Your professional development is important to us, so we have laid out a career plan to help you progress towards your goals and objectives. 
     
    Relocation Support 
    We offer a relocation budget and full coverage of flights to Frankfurt for you and your family. 
    You can expect extensive assistance with visa, work permits, and communication with authorities during the relocation process, as well as help settling into Germany (e.g. setting up appointments with banks, government agencies, schools, landlords, finding apartments etc.).

    Gym Card 
    A healthy body is a healthy mind. We offer a membership at the premium gym chain Fitness First in Germany. Work out, join group fitness classes, or relax in the wellness facilities.
     
    State-of-the-art Office
    We’ve recently moved into a brand-new, modern office located in the heart of Frankfurt. Our new workspace is designed to inspire creativity and collaboration, with open areas, quiet zones, and top-tier facilities — all just steps away from public transport, restaurants, bars and cultural hotspots.
     
    Hybrid Working
    We believe in the value of in-person collaboration while also supporting flexibility. Our hybrid working model includes three days per week in the office and the option to work remotely up to two days per week, unless role-specific requirements or business needs require you to be on site.

title: Staff Backend Engineer - Platform  (f/m/d)
description:
Staff Backend Engineer – Platform 

Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech 

Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay. 

If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you. 

 

About the role 

You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor working closely with our Principal Engineer, who leads Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering org, so this is a high-ownership seat: you'll take on large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives and drive them from first analysis through to completion, with real autonomy over how you get there. 

We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a big topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role; if you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in. 

 

What you'll be up to 

  • Architecting and developing scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems. 
  • Self-identifying and scoping problems and initiatives, not just executing assigned tickets: assessing impact, prioritisation and timing independently. 
  • Leading architectural decisions and design discussions with cross-team alignment. 
  • Driving large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, including coordination with multiple stakeholders. 
  • Mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence. 
  • Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that empower teams to deliver faster and more reliably. 
  • Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available. 
  • Participating in on-call rotations and stepping in as a reliable problem solver during incidents. 
  • Proactively spotting where AI and automation can drive technical improvement. 

 

Some of the challenges waiting for you 

  • Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database (we already scale reads horizontally). 
  • Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery. 
  • Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform, including the ability to recreate an Apaleo environment from scratch. 
  • Extracting and reworking common services (like shared schedulers) to get us ready for our next scale level. 

 

What you'll bring to the team 

  • 8+ years of backend development experience, including several years in a staff-level or technical leadership role. 
  • Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms: we care more about how you think than which stack you've used. 
  • A track record of owning large technical initiatives from ambiguity through to completion, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team. 
  • Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals with genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well). 
  • Comfortable working with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack). 
  • Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests: we don't have a dedicated QA function. 
  • Fluent English. 

Nice to have 

  • Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS/Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong. 
  • Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other IaC approaches (like CloudFormation). 
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus experience is a good transferable equivalent). 
  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement. 
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, particularly for introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams. 

 

What we offer 

Culture and growth 

  • A diverse and international team: work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities. 
  • Growth and development: 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and an evolving career framework. 
  • Autonomy and ownership: we empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly in an environment built on trust and transparency. 
  • Shape the future of hospitality tech: your work drives real impact from day one, at a fast-growing scale-up. 
  • Competitive and fair compensation, guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. 

 

Perks and lifestyle 

  • Flexible and remote work options: office, home or hybrid, based on what works for your role and team. 
  • A fully covered Deutschland Ticket for free public transport across Germany. 
  • Regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties and other offsite events. 
  • 30 days of paid holiday to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired. 
  • An EGYM Wellpass membership giving access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options. 

 

Where you'll work from 

This role is based in Munich, with hybrid working from our office there. We're also open to remote within Germany, or remote via an Employer of Record for candidates based outside in the EU/ Europe.

 

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

Joining Apaleo means more than taking on a role.   • Run the full enterprise sales cycle, from pipeline generation to deal closure, across a territory with massive potential and that has considerable inbound interest.

  • Completed Elliptic's product certifications and onboarding processes.

  • Progressed at least 2 opportunities to late-stage negotiation and closed your first deal, demonstrating you can manage the full enterprise cycle from initial engagement through legal and procurement.

  • Built multi-threaded relationships across your strategic accounts - compliance, risk, and C-suite - not just a single champion per account.

  • Earned a reputation internally with your SE, CS, marketing, and partner team as a well-prepared, collaborative account owner who closes the loop and uses internal resources without wasting them.

 

You will be a great fit here if you are:

  • A driven, tenacious “hunter” who thrives on owning their number and finding creative ways to exceed it.

  • Experienced in B2B enterprise SaaS and/or DaaS sales within RegTech, FinTech, and/or Crypto.

  • A proven track record of consistently closing successful enterprise deals across multiple years and companies.

  • Comfortable leading complex, long-cycle and large deals involving multiple stakeholders, but also agile enough to take on quick-close 5-figure deals.

  • Commercially curious, you ask smart questions, seek to understand the "why" behind a customer’s problems, and use those insights to tailor impactful solutions.

  • Confident, consultative, and persuasive, able to build strong stakeholder relationships at all levels, from mid-level managers to C-suites.

  • A collaborative team player, independent yet never a “lone wolf.” You value and engage support from your pack.

  • Agile, resourceful, and fearless, you see opportunity where others see blockers and know how to create inroads where none appear to exist.

  • Willingness to travel to customers and industry events and conduct business face to face.

 

Our ideal candidate has:

  • Fluency in Turkish (written and spoken) is essential, along with professional proficiency in English.

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills and the ability to establish meaningful relationships with C-suite and executive stakeholders.

  • Technical acumen with the ability to establish credibility with technical decision makers.

  • Driven and solutions-oriented: you know how to navigate roadblocks and keep deals moving forward.

  • Familiarity with the MEDDPPICC methodology and Value Based Selling.

  • Proficiency in CRM systems (HubSpot or similar), LLMs and other AI-driven prospecting and work efficiency tools.

  • Passionate about generative AI and excited to help customers navigate a rapidly evolving industry.

 

Bonus Points for:

  • An existing network of connections across the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) space.

  • Additional languages beyond Turkish and English such as fluency in French, Spanish, or Italian.

  • A proven use case and understanding of agentic AI is a strong plus.

 

Ultimately we are looking to hire those who want to be the future leaders in the industry, super intrigued by Crypto and have an awesome mindset to learn so if you don’t meet all the criteria still do apply!

title: Data Engineer
description:
Help us make a big green dent in the universe. We're on a mission to drive the global renewable energy revolution, and we need many more people to help us make our vision a reality.
 
Octopus Energy Generation (OEGEN) is a leader in sourcing, investing in, and managing a wide range of utility-scale renewable energy assets. As we continue to expand our investment base, we are dedicated to building a diverse team that reflects the communities we serve. Currently, we manage a global portfolio of over £8 billion in renewable energy assets.
 
We are committed to delivering best-in-class responsible investment activity, offering like-minded investors the means and products to invest their capital sustainably. It is our ambition to change the entire energy lifecycle and make every green electron matter, delivering the best outcomes for customers, investors, the environment and society, accelerating the transition to net zero.

OEGEN Data, Tech & Transformation Team 

We are embarking on a comprehensive transformation program designed to drive significant advancements in our business operations and technology landscape. Our primary goal is to transition from our current reliance on legacy systems and specialized off-the-shelf tools to a more integrated, AI-driven, and data-centric operational model. 

Leveraging insights and guidance from our other technically mature entities like Kraken and OE, we plan to adopt cutting-edge tools and capabilities, particularly in AI and Python-driven solutions. 

By investing in a diverse range of skills, we aim to create a hybrid team capable of operating in both our legacy and future environments, ultimately transforming OEGEN into an efficient, data-driven organization.

About the role

We’re looking for a Data Engineer who can own the journey of data from source systems to decision-ready outputs. You’ll build and maintain pipelines, model data, stand up dashboards, and integrate systems via APIs. In a team this size, you’ll also get involved in application development - building internal tools with Streamlit, FastAPI, or HTMX that put data directly in the hands of our investment and asset management teams. 

In your first 3 months you’ll have taken ownership of at least one critical pipeline from an external system into Databricks, and built or materially improved a reporting layer used by Fund Management or Asset Management. 


What you'll do
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines in Databricks, ensuring data is reliable, timely, and well-documented.
  • Own and evolve our Databricks models - define schemas, enforce testing, and keep the warehouse clean.
  • Automate manual data processes using Python, replacing spreadsheets and ad-hoc workflows with robust, repeatable jobs.
  • Build performance dashboards and reports in Streamlit and HTMX (FastAPI) that Finance, Asset Management, and Fund Management actually use.
  • Integrate internal and third-party systems via REST APIs, improving data accessibility across the business.
  • Champion data quality - implement validation, monitoring, and governance practices that give stakeholders confidence in the numbers.
  • Collaborate directly with non-technical teams to understand their problems and translate them into data solutions.

  • Strong SQL and Python skills, used daily for pipeline development, data modelling, and automation.
  • Experience with modern data stack tooling: a cloud data platform (Databricks preferred), and version control (Git/GitHub).
  • A solid understanding of data modelling, warehousing patterns, and ETL/ELT design.
  • To be comfortable working with Postgres or similar relational databases.
  • Clear communication - you can explain a data model to a fund manager and discuss trade-offs with an engineer.
