title: Defect Inspection Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Your Role

As a Defect Inspection Engineer/Expert, you will be responsible for ensuring the defect-free quality of semiconductor wafers using Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) systems and unpatterned wafer inspection.

You will detect defects such as particles, scratches, haze, and surface roughness that could impact the yield of our integrated graphene photonics process flow. Working in a cleanroom environment, you will collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams to set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve defect detection and classification.

What You’ll Do

  • Perform AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection on materials such as bare silicon, epitaxial layers and polished wafers

  • Set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes

  • Fine-tune inspection tool and recipe parameters to improve defect-detection sensitivity, inspection quality, repeatability and overall performance

  • Analyze defect data to identify trends, root causes and potential process excursions

  • Interpret defect data and translate findings into actionable insights for process teams

  • Generate defect maps, Pareto charts and reports to communicate findings

  • Participate in Design of Experiments (DOE) to optimize inspection parameters

  • Troubleshoot inspection-related issues and support continuous improvement in defect detection and classification

  • Collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams

What You Bring

  • A bachelor’s degree or above in electrical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field

  • 5+ years of experience in semiconductor inspection, with a focus on AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection

  • Hands-on experience with unpatterned wafer inspection systems, such as SPx, and AOI tools such as Eagle or Dragonfly

  • Understanding of semiconductor process flows, including polishing, epitaxy and cleaning

  • Familiarity with defect classification, SEM review and Statistical Process Control (SPC)

  • Proficiency in AOI and defect-review software, such as KLA Klarity and Camtek Inspecta

  • Ability to optimize inspection tools and recipe parameters for sensitivity, inspection quality and repeatability

  • Ability to interpret defect data and identify relevant trends and improvement opportunities

  • Proficiency in JMP for statistical analysis, data visualization and DOE

  • Familiarity with MATLAB or Python is an advantage

  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work on defect inspection for an integrated graphene photonics process flow

  • A cleanroom-based role with close collaboration across process, equipment and integration teams

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key-we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

title: System Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Wir bauen IT-Infrastruktur, die bei unseren Kunden einfach läuft, statt Umgebungen, die bei jedem Update zittern. Kein Ticket-Fließband, keine endlosen Abstimmungsrunden. Saubere Konzepte, schnelle Umsetzung, und am Ende läuft das Ding auch wirklich.

Ob du schon Senior bist oder gerade richtig Fahrt aufnimmst, ist uns ehrlich gesagt zweitrangig. Bei uns zählt, was du baust und wie du an Probleme rangehst. Du bekommst echte Verantwortung, einen kurzen Draht zur Geschäftsführung und die Möglichkeit, dich so schnell weiterzuentwickeln, wie du selbst Gas gibst.

Aufgaben

  • Du planst, baust und betreibst Server- und Netzwerkumgebungen bei unseren Kunden und in unserer eigenen Cloud

  • Du betreibst unsere Cloud-Plattformen in deutschen Rechenzentren, von der Bereitstellung über Backup bis zum Monitoring

  • Du kümmerst dich um Firewalls, VPN und Netzwerk, damit alles sicher und sauber miteinander spricht

  • Du migrierst Kunden nach Microsoft 365 und richtest die Umgebungen so ein, dass sie auch in zwei Jahren noch sauber sind

  • Du betreust unsere Kundenumgebungen zentral, von Patching und Monitoring bis Endpoint-Security und Backup

  • Du baust Server und Workstations zusammen, prüfst sie auf Herz und Nieren und lieferst sie beim Kunden aus

  • Du bist Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden, wenn etwas hakt, vom kurzen Anruf bis zur kniffligen Störung, und dokumentierst Lösungen so, dass auch der nächste durchblickt

  • Du redest bei Standards, Tooling und unseren Abläufen aktiv mit und automatisierst, was sich wiederholt

  • Du sprichst direkt mit Kunden, wenn es um Anforderungen, Konzepte und Lösungen geht

Wir wollen wachsen und unsere Infrastruktur-Standards mit uns. Wenn du Lust hast, am Fundament mitzubauen, bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Und keine Sorge, du sitzt mit deinen Problemen nicht allein da. Egal ob hartnäckige Störung, Architekturentscheidung, die du hinterfragen willst, oder einfach mal kurz Gedanken sortieren: Es ist immer jemand da, der mit dir draufschaut.

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung mit Windows Server, Virtualisierung und Netzwerken

  • Du fühlst dich in Microsoft 365 wohl

  • Firewalls, VPN und Routing sind für dich keine Fremdworte

  • Du hast Bock auf Linux und Skripting

  • Du schraubst gern selbst an Hardware und baust Server lieber auf, als sie nur auszupacken

  • Du telefonierst gern mit Kunden und erklärst Technik so, dass sie am anderen Ende auch ankommt

  • Du lernst gern dazu, packst Dinge selbst an und bleibst auch dran, wenn es mal hakt

  • Herausforderungen schrecken dich nicht ab, sondern reizen dich eher

  • Du übernimmst gern Verantwortung und triffst Entscheidungen, statt auf Ansagen zu warten

  • Teamgeist ist für dich kein Buzzword, sondern Alltag

  • Du bist ehrlich und sagst, was du denkst

  • Führerschein Klasse B und Reisebereitschaft, weil unsere Kunden nicht nur um die Ecke sitzen und du regelmäßig vor Ort bist

Für uns zählen Persönlichkeit, Motivation und Potenzial mehr als ein dicker Stapel Zertifikate. Ob Junior oder Senior: Wichtig ist, dass du sauber baust und Lust hast, besser zu werden.

Benefits

Hardware, die Spaß macht. Leistungsstarke Workstations, ein eigenes Lab und lokale KI-Power statt Standard-Office-Laptop. Dazu ein voll ausgestatteter Firmenbulli für Einsätze vor Ort.

Moderne Tooling-Kultur. Aktueller Stack, KI-gestütztes Arbeiten (unter anderem mit Claude) und kein Altlast-Ballast, der dich ausbremst.

Zertifizierungen auf uns. Wer sich bei unseren Herstellern zertifizieren will, bekommt Zeit und Budget dafür.

Wellpass oder Streaming-Abo. Sport in tausenden Studios deutschlandweit oder Spotify bzw. Netflix auf uns. Such dir aus, was zu dir passt.

30 Tage Urlaub. Volle 30 Tage, ohne Diskussion. Erholung gehört genauso dazu wie gute Arbeit.

Bildungsurlaub ist willkommen. Kein unangenehmes Gespräch, kein schlechtes Gewissen. Wer sich weiterbilden will, hat unsere volle Unterstützung.

Start-up-Flair. Kurze Entscheidungswege, echte Eigenverantwortung und eine Atmosphäre, in der Ideen mehr zählen als Hierarchien.

Flexible Arbeitszeiten. Leben und Arbeit muss man manchmal jonglieren. Dafür hast du bei uns Verständnis und Spielraum.

Home-Office. Nach der Einarbeitung arbeitest du da, wo du am produktivsten bist. Ob zu Hause oder im Büro, das entscheidest du.

Wenn du Teil eines Unternehmens sein möchtest, das nicht nur Wert auf technische Exzellenz legt, sondern auch auf deine persönliche Entwicklung, dann gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der IT!

title: Senior Manager Business Ethics, Speak-up & Investigations (m/f/d)
description:
At Quantum Systems, we develop advanced autonomous systems for defense and security across multiple domains, combining unmanned platforms with integrated software and AI. As Senior Manager Business Ethics, Speak-up & Investigations, you will play a key role in building and strengthening Quantum Systems’ Group Ethics & Compliance programme. You will take end-to-end functional ownership for Business Ethics, Anti-Bribery & Corruption, Speak-up and Internal Investigations.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with clear functional ownership and no direct people-management responsibility at present. As part of the integrated Governance, Risk & Compliance organization, you will work across Risk Governance, Ethics & Compliance, ESG and Group Assurance to help establish effective and scalable governance.

You will independently develop, implement and manage the assigned programmes, frameworks and processes, translating the Group Integrity Framework into practical standards, controls and guidance. Working closely with relevant corporate functions, you will help prevent misconduct, respond credibly to potential violations and build a risk-based, scalable Compliance Management System for our growing international defense-technology business.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Own and continuously enhance the Group Business Ethics & Integrity Program, covering the Code of Conduct, Anti-Bribery & Corruption, Conflicts of Interest, Gifts & Hospitality, Donations and Sponsorships, ethical decision-making and non-retaliation.

  • Establish and implement policies, standards, guidance and processes, supported by risk-based training, communications and advice that enable practical application across the Group.

  • Manage the Group Speak-up & Whistleblowing Framework, including reporting channels, intake, triage, confidentiality, non-retaliation safeguards, case routing and effectiveness monitoring.

  • Lead sensitive and complex internal investigations and maintain the related case management framework, ensuring fair, objective, timely and confidential processes, robust investigation mandates, planning, interviews, evidence handling, documentation, escalation, reporting, data protection and retention.

  • Translate findings into sustainable improvement by identifying root causes and control weaknesses, agreeing corrective and preventive actions with accountable owners, and monitoring implementation and effectiveness.

  • Advise management and coordinate with relevant functions, providing concise reporting on material cases, trends, risks and remediation.



What you bring to the team:

  • Relevant experience in Business Ethics, Compliance, Corporate Investigations, white-collar crime or criminal law, with demonstrated experience leading complex international investigations.

  • A relevant degree or professional qualification and experience building effective ethics, anti-bribery, speak-up or investigations programmes.

  • Strong investigation skills, from interviews and evidence assessment to root-cause analysis, remediation and prevention.

  • Sound knowledge of business ethics, anti-bribery, whistleblower protection, data protection and employment law; defense, aerospace or government-contracting experience is a strong advantage.

  • Sound judgment, discretion and independence, combined with strong analytical, communication and stakeholder-management skills.

  • Fluent English; very good German is a strong advantage.

Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop, produce and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions designed for mission-critical operations in complex environments.

Our systems combine autonomous platforms, advanced sensors, secure communications, mission software and AI to deliver actionable information, enable faster decision-making and support operations across domains – from the air to the ground and at sea.

description:
Accountant

Permanent employee · Full-time · Berlin (HQ)

Our Mission For You

Help us build an in-house accounting function from the ground up. trawa is bringing its bookkeeping in-house, and you'll be one of the people who makes that work: clean books, on time, every month.

trawa enables mid-sized companies to access green, intelligent energy. We're a hyper-growth energy-tech company with strong team growth, backed by Balderton Capital, Speedinvest and Headline. Our business model sits at the intersection of energy, tech, and finance, which makes our accounting more complex and more interesting than a typical start-up ledger.

You'll start hands-on with day-to-day accounting and keep the books clean as volumes grow. At the same time, you'll spot the manual steps in your work and get room to automate them. You'll also be part of our ERP rollout. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to own their area, not just process it.

What You'll Own

Accounts Payable

  • Process, check, and post incoming invoices from Moss into DATEV, including correct VAT treatment

  • Handle expenses and credit card bookings

  • Maintain vendor master data and keep supplier accounts reconciled

  • Prepare payment runs

Month-End Support

  • Reconcile bank transactions

  • Prepare accruals and reconciliations for your areas

  • Support the monthly close and year-end, working with our auditors

  • Keep documentation GoBD-compliant and audit-ready

  • Partner with Ops, Procurement and budget owners to resolve invoice and cost questions

Build & Improve

  • Spot manual steps in your processes and automate them

  • Contribute to our ERP rollout



Who You Are

Must-haves

  • 2 to 4 years of hands-on bookkeeping experience, ideally in accounts payable

  • Comfortable when processes don't exist yet. You help create them instead of waiting for them

  • Solid understanding of German GAAP (HGB) and VAT basics

  • Precise and fast. You care about getting it right and getting it done

  • Analytical and confident in Excel or Google Sheets for reconciliations

  • Fluent in English

Nice-to-haves

  • German is a strong plus (B1 or better): most of our vendor invoices and much of our supplier communication are in German

  • Experience in a fast-growing company (start-up or scale-up), or at a tax firm serving start-up clients

  • Hands-on with DATEV Rechnungswesen and DATEV Unternehmen online (DUO)

  • Training as Steuerfachangestellte/r or Kaufmann/-frau

  • Experience with Moss or similar spend management tools

  • Automation experience or strong tech curiosity: you've built workflows with n8n, Zapier, or Make, or used Claude Code or similar AI tools

Your First 90 Days

Month 1: Learn

  • Understand our business model, our accounting setup, and our tools (Moss, DATEV). Take over your first recurring bookings.

Month 2: Own

  • Run accounts payable and bank postings independently. Support your first month-end close.

Month 3: Improve

  • Deliver your areas on time each month. Propose and ship your first automation or process improvement.

The Team

You'll join a fast-growing Finance team of around ten people across Accounting, Billing, Collections, FP&A, Treasury, and Strategic Finance. You'll work closely with colleagues across these areas and see how your bookings flow into cash and planning. You'll also work cross-functionally with Business Operations, Energy, and other departments.

Why trawa?

  • Real ownership from day one. You build the accounting function from the start, not just maintain one

  • Learn fast from an experienced Senior Accountant, with direct contact to our hands-on Finance leadership team

  • A uniquely complex problem space at the intersection of energy, tech, and finance, plus a PwC audit and an ERP rollout

  • An AI-first Finance team that embraces new tools and ways of working

  • Clear growth path within our career framework: grow towards Senior Accountant, or specialise in revenue accounting or finance systems as we scale

  • Flexible working, 30 vacation days, L&D budget, competitive compensation, VSOPs (share package), meal vouchers, Urban Sports membership, and a vibrant office culture

Diversity at trawa

Everyone is welcome here. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace that values diversity, and we encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of origin, gender, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, physical or neurodiverse background.

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We value ownership, learning speed, and hunger over a perfect CV.

title: GTM Enablement - Global Onboarding & Operations
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

As the Global Onboarding & Enablement Operations Program Manager at ElevenLabs, you’ll help keep our global GTM onboarding and enablement programmes running smoothly as we grow. You’ll lead the day-to-day delivery of onboarding, making sure every new GTM hire gets a consistent, engaging start, while building the structure and processes that help the wider Enablement team work more effectively and scale its impact.

You’ll bring structure to how we plan, deliver and measure enablement, from tracking OKRs and roadmaps to coordinating the enablement calendar, launches and certifications. You’ll also help keep the team aligned on priorities, manage cross-functional dependencies and use reporting to understand what’s working and where we can improve. Working closely with the Sales Enablement lead and partners across GTM, RevOps, Product Marketing and People, you’ll help turn priorities into well-run programmes that meet the needs of the business.

This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys bringing order to complex projects, delivering engaging training and finding practical, creative ways to solve problems.

  • Own GTM onboarding: Manage onboarding cohorts end to end, from scheduling and communications to facilitating live sessions, coordinating speakers and gathering feedback. Ensure new hires across regions have a consistent, engaging experience.

  • Develop and maintain learning content: Create training materials and e-learning modules, and keep existing content across WorkRamp and Enablement OS accurate, relevant and easy to navigate. Work with subject matter experts to turn complex topics into practical learning experiences.

  • Coordinate certifications and enablement launches: Own the launch and certification calendar, keeping new programmes, certifications and learning initiatives moving and tracking milestones, completion and follow-up actions.

  • Measure programme performance: Maintain dashboards and reporting on onboarding, certifications, ramp metrics and team OKRs. Use the data to highlight progress, identify gaps and help the team understand where to focus.

  • Own Enablement operations: Run OKR and roadmap tracking, the enablement calendar, and the team’s operating rhythms (planning, check-ins and reviews). Track dependencies across RevOps, Product Marketing, People and Product, flag risks early, and keep clear ownership, timelines and follow-through on every workstream.

  • Support major enablement events: Help plan and deliver events such as Sales Kick-Off (SKO), including session coordination, timelines and the run of show.

Requirements

  • Experience running onboarding, training or enablement programmes in a fast-moving GTM, sales or commercial environment.

  • Strong facilitation and presentation skills, with the confidence to lead live sessions, engage different audiences and make complex topics clear and actionable.

  • Experience developing training materials and e-learning content that help people understand and apply new skills.

  • Experience building and running team operations, such as OKR and roadmap tracking, and operating rhythms, with the ability to coordinate dependencies across teams and keep many stakeholders aligned..

  • Experience building or maintaining dashboards, trackers and reporting processes, with the ability to use data to measure progress and inform decisions.

  • Familiarity with learning management systems (LMS), such as WorkRamp, and an understanding of how to manage learning content and track completion.

  • A strong passion for using AI tools and agents, with hands-on experience applying them to automate repetitive tasks, improve processes and find smarter ways to work.

  • A creative, curious approach to problem-solving, with the initiative to question existing ways of working and explore better solutions.

Bonus

  • Experience supporting a company-wide event, such as Sales Kick-Off.

  • Experience working at a high-growth technology or AI company.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Gong or other GTM reporting tools.

Growth Potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Leading Enablement operations and onboarding as the team and the number of regions grow.

  • Moving into a broader Revenue Operations, program management or enablement strategy role.

Location

This role is remote-first and ideally based on the East Coast of the US. The ability to operate in US Eastern (GMT-5, GMT-4) timezones is required. If you prefer, you can work from our office in New York.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

As a Partner Enablement Program Manager, you'll build and run the ElevenLabs partner academy for systems integrators, hyperscalers and technology partners. You'll create curricula across sales, pre-sales and technical implementation, starting with ElevenAgents and expanding across ElevenCreative and ElevenAPI. You'll work closely with our regional Forward Deployed Engineers, who bring the technical expertise and set the technical quality bar. Your mission is to grow the program to 10,000+ certified partner professionals by the end of 2027, and to make the ElevenLabs certification a credential the tech ecosystem respects.

As a Partner Enablement Program Manager, you can expect to:

  • Build curricula for partner sellers, pre-sales and implementation engineers: courses, hands-on labs and assessments.

  • Turn expert knowledge from our FDEs, sales and product teams into a world-class online academy.

  • Run the certification program end to end, from submissions and review workflows to certificates, with FDEs making the technical call.

  • Scale the program through automation, from automated agent review to bots and emails that support learners.

  • Deliver training online and in person, including sales and technical sessions at our partner hackathons.

  • Run program administration: the learning platform, partner onboarding tracks, reporting and learner feedback.

We're looking for an enablement builder who is comfortable with both commercial and technical topics. You don't need to be the deepest expert in the room, but you need enough depth to work with senior engineers and sellers as subject matter experts and turn their knowledge into great learning. You'll thrive with us if you:

  • Are passionate about AI, technology and ElevenLabs products.

  • Have built enablement or training programs at scale for partners, sellers or technical teams.

  • Learn technical products quickly and can explain them to both technical and commercial audiences.

  • Can run a program end to end: learning platforms, timelines, stakeholders and reporting.

  • Can lead a session or workshop in front of sellers and engineers.

  • Have strong instructional design skills: you can turn expert content into clear courses, labs and assessments.

  • Enjoy turning repeat work into automations, tools and agents.

  • Have excellent communication skills and can adapt your message to different audiences.

Bonus:

  • Experience as a forward deployed engineer, solutions engineer or in professional services for a frontier AI product.

  • Hands-on experience building LLM applications or voice and chat agents, and reviewing whether they are ready for production.

  • Familiarity with Python or TypeScript, APIs, webhooks and common integration patterns.

  • Telephony experience, such as SIP, Twilio or contact center platforms.

  • Experience at a systems integrator, hyperscaler or technology partner.

  • Experience with learning platforms such as WorkRamp.

title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator
description:
Let’s transform banking forever

ClearBank is built on the belief that banking infrastructure shouldn’t slow down progress. Quite the opposite. Speed it up and that’s when you unlock potential. When you really start to innovate.

That spirit and ‘can-do’ attitude is why our clients – from FinTech's and crypto platforms, to banks and credit unions – choose to use our API to power their banking infrastructure.

But it’s our people who are the stars here. They power that innovation, push harder to break boundaries. They make coming to work (or working from home) fun. They’re the ones we trust to catapult our clients to success. Just as they trust us to build a business that’s always striding forward.

What you can expect:

As our Talent Acquisition Coordinator, you’ll play an important role in creating a seamless and welcoming experience for candidates and keeping our Talent Acquisition operations running smoothly. You’ll coordinate interviews, maintain accurate information in Ashby and support the production of regular Talent Acquisition reporting. You’ll also work with colleagues across Talent to support supplier administration and help organise our monthly induction for new joiners.

This role is suited to someone who enjoys bringing structure to a busy environment, cares about getting the details right and wants every interaction with ClearBank to leave a positive impression.

Your role includes:

  • Complete the day-to-day administration of Ashby, maintaining accurate and complete candidate, vacancy and recruitment information to support reliable reporting and compliant hiring processes.

  • Coordinate interviews across multiple time zones, managing candidate and interviewer communication and availability to create a timely, organised and professional experience.

  • Welcome and support candidates attending interviews at the ClearBank office, particularly senior candidates, creating a positive and professional first impression.

  • Monitor recruitment activity and data quality in Ashby, identifying missing, inaccurate or outdated information and working with recruiters to resolve issues promptly.

  • Produce accurate weekly Talent Acquisition dashboards and insights, providing clear visibility of recruitment activity and data to the Talent Acquisition Lead.

  • Support wider Talent operations, including supplier onboarding and offboarding for the Head of Talent and the organisation of monthly new-joiner induction with the Talent Development Manager.

  • Identify opportunities to improve Talent Acquisition coordination and administration, suggesting practical ways to make processes simpler, clearer and more effective.

What does success in this role look like:

  • Ashby contains accurate, complete and dependable recruitment information that the Talent Acquisition team can confidently use for reporting and decision-making.

  • Candidates experience organised, timely and thoughtful communication throughout interview coordination and when visiting the ClearBank office.

  • Interviews are coordinated effectively across stakeholders and time zones, with scheduling problems identified and resolved promptly.

  • Weekly Talent Acquisition dashboards are produced accurately and consistently, giving the Talent Acquisition Lead clear visibility of recruitment activity.

  • Supplier administration and monthly induction coordination are organised and reliable, with the relevant stakeholders kept informed.

What you’ll bring:

To excel in this role, you’ll also need:

  • Previous experience in a Talent Acquisition, recruitment coordination or similar role, with hands-on experience supporting interview scheduling, candidate administration and day-to-day recruitment processes.

  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple interviews, activities and competing priorities.

  • Excellent attention to detail, particularly when working with recruitment systems, schedules, reports and confidential information.

  • Confidence communicating with candidates and colleagues at different levels of seniority.

  • The ability to use digital systems effectively and learn new technology and processes quickly.

  • A methodical approach to maintaining accurate records and identifying missing or inconsistent information.

  • The ability to take ownership of assigned tasks, follow agreed processes and ask for support when needed.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time.  

We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully.  

We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon!  

Equal Opportunities

ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. 

ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation. 

As part of the Company’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable adjustments, to candidates during the recruitment process, including to individuals with disabilities. We want to create a safe space that welcomes everyone so please let us know how we can accommodate you. In case you have any accessibility requirements you can share that with our Talent Acquisition team prior to your interview stage, if applicable. 

The legal bit

By submitting your CV to ClearBank Limited you are providing your consent for us to use the information you provide for recruitment purposes. For more information on how we manage your data go and check out our Candidate Privacy Notice on the ClearBank website to see how we process, manage and look after your data. You are also allowing us to communicate with you by email and telephone for recruitment purposes.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

About the role

The Partner Engagements Manager, Compliance Strategy will lead Checkout’s external-facing compliance strategy across banking, scheme and other strategic partner relationships.

You will own the operating model and delivery of compliance-related partner engagements, including annual reviews, periodic due diligence, requests for information, licensing and scheme initiatives, and readiness for product or geographic expansion. You will ensure that Checkout presents a consistent, accurate and well-evidenced view of its compliance framework, while converting external expectations into practical improvements to our roadmap, controls, processes and operating model.

The role combines strategic ownership, senior stakeholder management and hands-on delivery. You will lead complex engagements, advise Compliance leadership, build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, and develop the partner-engagement capability of the team, including managing and coaching Senior Analyst(s) as the structure is established.

What you will do

  • Own the Compliance Strategy partner-engagement portfolio, prioritising work across banking partners, schemes and other strategic external stakeholders.

  • Establish and continuously improve the operating model for partner engagements, including governance, roles and responsibilities, service standards, evidence expectations, response libraries, escalation routes and management information.

  • Lead annual KYC AML partner compliance reviews, partner onboarding or refreshes, complex RFIs and other material external engagements from planning through to closure.

  • Act as a senior Compliance representative in partner meetings, with high level input around Checkout’s compliance framework, risk management approach, policies, controls, governance and improvement plans with clarity and confidence.

  • Provide oversight and challenge to response packs, control narratives, policy summaries, presentations and supporting evidence, ensuring consistency, accuracy and appropriate ownership.

  • Lead compliance support for scheme, product-launch and geographic-expansion initiatives, ensuring external partner obligations and readiness requirements are identified, tracked and addressed.

  • Translate partner feedback, requests and emerging expectations into strategic recommendations, roadmap priorities, control enhancements and process improvements.

  • Build strong working relationships across Compliance, Legal, Risk, Product, Operations, Commercial, Finance, Technology and regional teams to align delivery and resolve dependencies.

  • Maintain clear governance over engagement risks, issues, decisions, action plans and remediation, escalating material matters to the Head of Compliance Strategy and relevant governance forums.

  • Produce concise and decision-useful updates for Compliance leadership, senior management and governance committees, including themes, trends, risks, commitments and delivery status.

  • Partner with relevant second-line teams to ensure external engagement activity is consistent with the Compliance framework, risk appetite, regulatory obligations and the responsibilities of the three lines of defence.

  • Coach, develop and set clear expectations for Senior Analyst(s).

  • Create and implement a high-quality, scalable and collaborative partner-engagement framework.

  • Identify opportunities to use better data, tooling, workflow design and documentation to improve response quality, reduce duplication and increase the resilience of the Compliance operating model.

  • Represent Compliance Strategy in cross-functional strategic initiatives and take on other priorities that support long-term capability maturation.

What you will need to be successful

  • Typically 3–5 years of experience in a similar role within compliance, regulatory compliance, risk, audit, legal or a related function in payments, fintech, banking or another regulated financial-services environment.

  • Demonstrable experience leading external partner, banking, scheme, audit, regulatory or due-diligence engagements.

  • Experience translating regulatory or partner expectations into practical requirements, delivery plans, governance and measurable improvements.

  • Experience leading complex, cross-functional workstreams with multiple stakeholders, dependencies and deadlines.

  • Experience coaching or managing people, setting priorities, giving feedback and creating clarity in a fast-moving environment.

  • Strong understanding of the payments ecosystem and the compliance expectations relevant to banking partners, payment schemes and regulated financial institutions.

  • Working knowledge of relevant compliance domains such as AML/CTF, sanctions, KYC/CDD/EDD, licensing, safeguarding, operational resilience, regulatory change or control assurance.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to present complex issues, defend recommendations and influence senior stakeholders.

  • Strong judgement and the confidence to challenge constructively, distinguish material from non-material issues and escalate appropriately.

  • Strong organisational, analytical and project-management skills, with a track record of delivering high-quality outcomes under pressure.

  • ICA, ACAMS or another relevant professional qualification is desirable.

How you will work at Checkout

  • Be The Owner: Set direction, create accountability and ensure commitments are delivered.

  • Talk Straight: Give clear, evidence-led advice and communicate difficult messages respectfully and early.

  • One Team: Build alignment across functions and regions, sharing context and bringing people with you.

  • No Room for Approximation: Set a high bar for accuracy, evidence, consistency and regulatory defensibility.

  • Athlete Mindset: Plan rigorously, raise the standard and keep improving the capability of the function.

  • Better Every Day: Turn recurring engagement friction into scalable processes, tools and operating-model improvements.

  • Pace Matters: Balance urgency with thoughtful risk judgement and disciplined execution.

  • Fundamentally Positive: Lead with trust, humility and a practical, solution-oriented approach.

What success looks like

  • Partner engagement framework is clearly documented with detailed SLAs and communicated to all relevant stakeholders.

  • Partner engagements are planned, governed and delivered consistently across the portfolio.

  • Checkout is represented externally through clear, accurate, credible and coherent compliance narratives.

  • Material risks, gaps and commitments are visible to the right stakeholders and managed through to resolution.

  • Scheme, product and geographic-expansion initiatives receive timely and practical Compliance Strategy support.

  • Partner feedback is converted into measurable improvements in processes, documentation, monitoring, tooling and capability.

  • The Senior Analyst(s) and wider stakeholder network have clear priorities, effective ways of working and opportunities to grow.

  • Compliance leadership has reliable management information to understand engagement themes, risks, capacity and progress.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

title: Dental Field Trainer - Birmingham
description:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

About the Role:

We’re looking for a highly consultative Field Trainer in Birmingham to lead impactful, in-person training that accelerates early clinical success with Dandy’s digital dentistry solutions. This role is field-based, with up to 80% travel, and is focused on helping dental practices adopt intraoral scanning and digital workflows with confidence.

You’ll serve as a trusted clinical advisor to dentists, practice managers, and operational leaders—helping teams adopt new technology, digital workflows, improve clinical performance, and accelerate early success. This role combines clinical training expertise with operational execution and post-training insight to deliver measurable value at the intersection of training, technology, and practice growth. Success in this role comes from your ability to earn clinical trust and turn that trust into action — helping practices move from curiosity to confidence.

What You’ll Do:

Training Delivery & Clinical Coaching

  • Lead high-touch, in-person trainings to support dentists and staff in adopting intraoral scanning and digital workflows.

  • Coach teams based on live observation, reinforcing best practices and adapting in real time to meet the practice’s goals and maturity level.

  • Take ownership of each practice’s success, driving early case submission by removing blockers, reinforcing clinical urgency, and building confidence during and immediately after training.

Clinical Advisory & Post-Training Analysis

  • Partner with clinicians and practice leaders to reinforce scanning habits and support early adoption.

  • Monitor outcomes in the first 30 days and surface targeted coaching opportunities to accelerate success.

  • Share field insights to inform scalable resources, improve onboarding, and strengthen future trainings.

Practice Readiness & Operational Alignment

  • Assess readiness across clinical workflows, team structure, and equipment to proactively surface blockers or risks.

  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure the right resources, messaging, and tools are in place before training day.

  • Customize training strategies based on practice size, complexity, and clinical goals.

The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial recruiter screen — 25 mins

  • Competency Interviews — Programming and technical domain (2 hours)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews — Programming, software design, and hiring-manager/team fit (3 hours)

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

The cybersecurity team includes Red/Purple/Blue teamers and risk & compliance oriented profiles, all working together to fix security weaknesses with innovative solutions, adapted to business needs. A Bug Bounty program, an authenticated program on our partner-facing platforms, an annual external Red Team engagement and recurring compliance assessments keep us honest, and our radar sharp.

Our threat detection & incident response runs fully in-house, nothing is outsourced: you can touch everything, from detection engineering, case management and response, threat intelligence and the vulnerability lifecycle to the AI agents orchestrated on top of it all. Automation and AI are at the core of everything (who doesn't?): agents triage our alerts 24/7 so humans focus on what matters, an LLM pipeline audits our code, and every confirmed finding feeds a remediation loop with product teams.


Responsibilities

  • Attack Veepee's perimeter the way a real adversary would: red team, penetration tests (grey/black/white/AI box), Active Directory attack paths, phishing campaigns and the business web based processes themselves (member journeys, seller flows, payment chains), hunting for logic flaws no scanner will ever find.

  • Put our risk register and threat intelligence to the test: take a stated risk or an emerging threat and confirm it, or refute it, with a working attack scenario.

  • Qualify what comes in from the outside: Bug Bounty reports (public and authenticated programs) and alerts escalated by our RAG agents during the cyber-watching rotation.

  • Convert every confirmed attack path into something that runs without you: a detection rule, a hunting query, an automated control. If a bot can do it, we automate it.

  • Build and improve the team's tooling: AI-assisted code audit, password auditing, secret hunting, attack-surface monitoring.

  • Carry your findings through to remediation: explain the impact to product and infra teams, propose the fix, track it through our vulnerability-management lifecycle, and re-attack to prove it's closed.

  • Share your discoveries with technical and business teams and spread security culture in accordance with day-to-day constraints.

  • Solid offensive skills: web and API penetration testing (OWASP), Active Directory attack techniques, and a taste for business-logic abuse beyond the technical stack.

  • Investigation fundamentals: comfortable digging through EDR, logs and network data to reach a verdict, and turning attacker behavior into detection logic or solid on the offensive side with a strong will to grow there.

  • Scripting and automation (Python, Bash, PowerShell); interest in AI-assisted security tooling (LLM-based code audit, agentic workflows) is a strong plus.

  • You document what you do and make it reproducible.

title: Senior Financial Accountant H/F
description:
Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech.

On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques.




Pourquoi ce poste ?

Octopus Energy France connaît une forte croissance sur ses segments B2C, B2B et B2G, et sa fonction Finance se structure en parallèle : migration récente d’Odoo vers NetSuite, automatisation de la chaîne fournisseurs, interfaçage avec les plateformes de facturation, harmonisation avec les standards du groupe au Royaume-Uni. Nous cherchons un·e Senior Financial Accountant (comptable senior) capable de prendre en main un périmètre critique (marge brute et fiscalité énergie), de le fiabiliser et de le faire évoluer. Plus qu’un·e exécutant·e, tu seras celui ou celle qui identifie les problèmes, en comprend la cause et met en place des solutions durables.

Tes missions
Gross margin et comptabilité énergie
  • Piloter la comptabilisation mensuelle des flux de marge brute (achats d’énergie, acheminement, ventes facturées et non facturées) et en produire une analyse critique : variations, écarts, leviers
  • Fiabiliser le cut-off et les estimations de fin de mois (factures à établir, énergie livrée non facturée, provisions), en lien avec les équipes opérationnelles et facturation
  • Justifier et documenter les comptes de ton périmètre, et traiter les anomalies jusqu’à leur résolution définitive
    • Fiscalité énergie et TVA
  • Établir, contrôler et déposer les déclarations de TVA (CA3) ainsi que les accises sur l’électricité et le gaz naturel et la CTA
  • Établir les déclarations d’échanges de biens (EMEBI) sur les flux intra-UE
  • Être l’interlocuteur·trice de référence sur les questions fiscales du périmètre : analyser les cas nouveaux (offres commerciales, programmes de fidélité, nouveaux produits), formaliser une position et la challenger avec nos conseils externes
  • Contribuer à la mise en conformité avec la réforme de la facturation électronique et du e-reporting
    • Supervision et contrôle
  • Superviser et contrôler les opérations de la comptabilité fournisseurs, et contribuer à l’amélioration de la chaîne d’automatisation (NetSuite, Rossum)
  • Être l’interlocuteur·trice des commissaires aux comptes et des auditeurs sur ton périmètre : préparation des justificatifs, réponses aux demandes, suivi des recommandations
    • Structuration et amélioration continue
  • Identifier les points de friction dans les clôtures et les process, proposer des solutions et les mettre en œuvre
  • Raccourcir et fiabiliser les clôtures mensuelles post-migration NetSuite
  • Rédiger et maintenir la documentation des process et des contrôles
  • Être moteur·trice dans le déploiement de l’IA et de l’automatisation au sein de la Finance

    • Ce que l'on attend de toi
    De ton arrivée à 3 mois :
  • Prendre en main NetSuite, Rossum et comprendre les flux entre l’ERP et les systèmes de facturation et de back-office
  • Comprendre les mécanismes du marché de l’énergie et la construction de la gross margin
  • Réaliser tes premières clôtures et déclarations en binôme, et livrer un premier diagnostic des fragilités de ton périmètre
    • De 4 à 6 mois :
  • Être pleinement autonome sur les clôtures, l’analyse de marge et l’ensemble des déclarations fiscales
  • Être l’interlocuteur·trice de référence sur la fiscalité énergie, en interne comme vis-à-vis des CAC et conseils
  • Avoir porté au moins une amélioration concrète et mesurable (process, contrôle, automatisation)
    • Au-delà de 6 mois :
  • Être force de proposition sur la feuille de route Finance et accompagner la montée en compétences de l’équipe sur ton périmètre

    • Ce poste est fait pour toi si
  • Tu es diplômé·e d’un DSCG, DCG, d’un master CCA ou équivalent, avec 4 à 7 ans d’expérience en comptabilité et fiscalité, idéalement avec un passage en cabinet d’audit ou d’expertise suivi d’une expérience en entreprise
  • Tu as une solide maîtrise de la TVA et, idéalement, des accises énergétiques ; une expérience dans l’énergie, les utilities ou un secteur à fort volume de facturation est un vrai plus
  • Tu es habitué·e aux clôtures mensuelles exigeantes et aux échanges avec les commissaires aux comptes
  • Tu es très à l’aise avec la donnée : Excel avancé (TCD, XLOOKUP, Power Query), analyse de gros volumes ; une appétence pour l’automatisation et les outils d’IA est appréciée
  • Tu as une bonne connaissance des ERP (NetSuite apprécié) et l'expérience d’un projet de migration ou de refonte de process souhaitée
  • Tu maitrises le Français et l'Anglais professionnel (niveau B2-C1): tu échangeras régulièrement avec les équipes du groupe au Royaume-Uni
    • Ce qui fera la différence :
  • Tu es un·e vrai problem solver : face à un écart inexpliqué, tu ne te contentes pas de le corriger, tu remontes à la cause et tu fais en sorte qu’il ne se reproduise pas
  • Tu es à l’aise dans un environnement en construction, où tout n’est pas encore documenté, et tu aimes structurer
  • Tu es autonome, rigoureux·se et capable de prioriser dans un contexte qui bouge vite
  • Tu sais vulgariser des sujets techniques et travailler avec des interlocuteurs non financiers (opérations, facturation, IT)

    Tu as vu le salaire ou la fourchette prévu·e pour ce poste mais tu aimerais en discuter ? Demande-le nous ! Lors de notre premier contact, c’est un point que nous abordons toujours, car même si nous prenons soin de définir des grilles les plus justes possibles, il nous semble également important de faire correspondre ton expérience au bon salaire. title: Comptable général sénior H/F
description:
Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech.
 
Comment on fait ?  On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer.

On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques.




Pourquoi ce poste ?

Octopus Energy France connaît une forte croissance sur ses segments B2C, B2B et B2G, et sa fonction Finance se structure en parallèle : migration récente d’Odoo vers NetSuite, automatisation de la chaîne fournisseurs, interfaçage avec les plateformes de facturation, harmonisation avec les standards du groupe au Royaume-Uni. Nous cherchons un·e comptable général senior capable de prendre en main un périmètre critique (marge brute et fiscalité énergie), de le fiabiliser et de le faire évoluer. Plus qu’un·e exécutant·e, tu seras celui ou celle qui identifie les problèmes, en comprend la cause et met en place des solutions durables.

Tes missions
Gross margin et comptabilité énergie
  • Piloter la comptabilisation mensuelle des flux de marge brute (achats d’énergie, acheminement, ventes facturées et non facturées) et en produire une analyse critique : variations, écarts, leviers
  • Fiabiliser le cut-off et les estimations de fin de mois (factures à établir, énergie livrée non facturée, provisions), en lien avec les équipes opérationnelles et facturation
  • Justifier et documenter les comptes de ton périmètre, et traiter les anomalies jusqu’à leur résolution définitive
    • Fiscalité énergie et TVA
  • Établir, contrôler et déposer les déclarations de TVA (CA3) ainsi que les accises sur l’électricité et le gaz naturel et la CTA
  • Établir les déclarations d’échanges de biens (EMEBI) sur les flux intra-UE
  • Être l’interlocuteur·trice de référence sur les questions fiscales du périmètre : analyser les cas nouveaux (offres commerciales, programmes de fidélité, nouveaux produits), formaliser une position et la challenger avec nos conseils externes
  • Contribuer à la mise en conformité avec la réforme de la facturation électronique et du e-reporting
    • Supervision et contrôle
  • Superviser et contrôler les opérations de la comptabilité fournisseurs, et contribuer à l’amélioration de la chaîne d’automatisation (NetSuite, Rossum)
  • Être l’interlocuteur·trice des commissaires aux comptes et des auditeurs sur ton périmètre : préparation des justificatifs, réponses aux demandes, suivi des recommandations
    • Structuration et amélioration continue
  • Identifier les points de friction dans les clôtures et les process, proposer des solutions et les mettre en œuvre
  • Raccourcir et fiabiliser les clôtures mensuelles post-migration NetSuite
  • Rédiger et maintenir la documentation des process et des contrôles
  • Être moteur·trice dans le déploiement de l’IA et de l’automatisation au sein de la Finance

    • Ce que l'on attend de toi
    De ton arrivée à 3 mois :
  • Prendre en main NetSuite, Rossum et comprendre les flux entre l’ERP et les systèmes de facturation et de back-office
  • Comprendre les mécanismes du marché de l’énergie et la construction de la gross margin
  • Réaliser tes premières clôtures et déclarations en binôme, et livrer un premier diagnostic des fragilités de ton périmètre
    • De 4 à 6 mois :
  • Être pleinement autonome sur les clôtures, l’analyse de marge et l’ensemble des déclarations fiscales
  • Être l’interlocuteur·trice de référence sur la fiscalité énergie, en interne comme vis-à-vis des CAC et conseils
  • Avoir porté au moins une amélioration concrète et mesurable (process, contrôle, automatisation)
    • Au-delà de 6 mois :
  • Être force de proposition sur la feuille de route Finance et accompagner la montée en compétences de l’équipe sur ton périmètre

    • Ce poste est fait pour toi si
  • Tu es diplômé·e d’un DSCG, DCG, d’un master CCA ou équivalent, avec 4 à 7 ans d’expérience en comptabilité et fiscalité, idéalement avec un passage en cabinet d’audit ou d’expertise suivi d’une expérience en entreprise
  • Tu as une solide maîtrise de la TVA et, idéalement, des accises énergétiques ; une expérience dans l’énergie, les utilities ou un secteur à fort volume de facturation est un vrai plus
  • Tu es habitué·e aux clôtures mensuelles exigeantes et aux échanges avec les commissaires aux comptes
  • Tu es très à l’aise avec la donnée : Excel avancé (TCD, XLOOKUP, Power Query), analyse de gros volumes ; une appétence pour l’automatisation et les outils d’IA est appréciée
  • Tu as une bonne connaissance des ERP (NetSuite apprécié) et l'expérience d’un projet de migration ou de refonte de process souhaitée
  • Tu maitrises le Français et l'Anglais professionnel (niveau B2-C1): tu échangeras régulièrement avec les équipes du groupe au Royaume-Uni
    • Ce qui fera la différence :
  • Tu es un·e vrai problem solver : face à un écart inexpliqué, tu ne te contentes pas de le corriger, tu remontes à la cause et tu fais en sorte qu’il ne se reproduise pas
  • Tu es à l’aise dans un environnement en construction, où tout n’est pas encore documenté, et tu aimes structurer
  • Tu es autonome, rigoureux·se et capable de prioriser dans un contexte qui bouge vite
  • Tu sais vulgariser des sujets techniques et travailler avec des interlocuteurs non financiers (opérations, facturation, IT)

    • Pourquoi tu vas adorer travailer chez nous ? 

    Tu as vu le salaire ou la fourchette prévu·e pour ce poste mais tu aimerais en discuter ? Demande-le nous ! Lors de notre premier contact, c’est un point que nous abordons toujours, car même si nous prenons soin de définir des grilles les plus justes possibles, il nous semble également important de faire correspondre ton expérience au bon salaire. Nous aurons l’occasion de t’en dire plus sur la manière dont nous avons défini le salaire et sur les autres avantages dont tu pourras bénéficier si tu nous rejoins ! Sache enfin que nous pouvons avoir un certain degré de flexibilité, car nous ne voudrions jamais que le salaire soit une raison pour laquelle quelqu’un·e ne postule pas chez Octopus - ce qui est le plus important pour nous est de trouver le bon Octofit !

    Certifiée depuis 2024 et 4e en 2025, Octopus Energy France est classée 1ère sur plus de 200 entreprises au classement Great Place to Work 2026 ! Cela reflète bien notre engagement pour un environnement de travail épanouissant !

    Nous sommes une organisation où les gens apprennent, décident et construisent plus rapidement. Où ils travaillent de manière autonome, avec des gens extraordinaires, sur des projets qui innovent. Intéressement au capital, flex-office, excellente mutuelle, forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge d’une partie de ton titre de transport au-delà du minimum légal, et même des jours de congés spéciaux pour t’investir dans un projet associatif qui te tient à coeur… Nous voulons que ton investissement soit récompensé par des avantages auxquels tu tiens vraiment !

    Chez Octopus, nous cherchons des personnes foncièrement bienveillantes et empathiques. L’égalité des chances nous tient à cœur et nous veillons à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et équitable. Nous t’invitons à postuler, quels que soient ton âge, genre, vie conjugale, couleur, handicap, grossesse ou parentalité, origine, convictions religieuses ou orientation sexuelle.

title: Senior Engineering Manager - Payment
description:
🪐 Discover our galaxy
 
Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:
 
- A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries
- A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth
- Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI
- A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently
 
Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐

Explore your future career  🔭

As our Senior Engineering Manager - Payment, your mission is to own the payment strategy for the product engineering team. You are taking care of the performance, productivity, and innovation in this scope. You are a hands-on manager; you are close to the topics your teams are handling, iterate on your scope with your team and challenge them to always optimize user experience and deliver value.
Furthermore, you are someone energized by removing obstacles, streamlining processes, and enabling your team to deliver exceptional results while supporting their professional growth and overall well-being.






Key responsibilities ✨
  • Lead and inspire a high-performing team
    You’ll manage 1 product squad (6 to 10 engineers), creating the conditions for them to thrive: clear direction, strong rituals, and a collaborative culture. You foster alignment through regular team moments, stand-ups, retros, and workshops and care deeply about team morale and engagement.

  • Co-build product and technical strategy
    You’ll help craft the vision and strategy for the Payment & Cash Advance domain, ensuring your teams are fully aligned on goals and the path to get there. You’ll translate high-level objectives into actionable plans, and keep everyone focused on what matters most: delivering value to users.

  • Raise the bar on delivery and engineering excellence
    You’ll set and track the right KPIs to measure impact, velocity, and quality and ensure that delivery is predictable and transparent. As part of Malt’s Engineering Manager Guild, you’ll also help scale what works across the org by contributing to shared rituals, tooling, and process improvements.

  • Own our payments and financing ecosystem
    You’ll be the primary tech point of contact for our external financial partners, from PSPs to cash advance providers. You’ll ensure smooth integration, operational reliability, and long-term scalability in this core part of Malt’s product.

    • About you 🧑‍🚀
  • You’re comfortable navigating fast-paced, evolving environments. Whether it’s managing technical migrations, shifting team structures, or aligning business and tech priorities.
  • You’ve mastered agile methodologies, and you know how to build high-performing product teams. You’ve worked in a scale-up or hyper-growth environment, and you understand how to balance speed, scalability, and quality.
  • A significant experience as a senior individual contributor as backend/fullstack (ideally in java/Kotlin) You enjoy being part of code review, MR, architecture discussion, and technical quality.
  • You have an expertise in payment systems at scale. You understand the constraints and opportunities that come with building for this domain.
  • You’re someone who doesn’t wait for instructions; you act. You identify problems, propose solutions, and rally the right people to move forward. 
  • Fluent in written and spoken English (French is a plus)
  • You’re able to explain complex technical or strategic topics to a range of audiences. You know that communication is what makes good teams great.
  • You keep an eye on emerging tech, especially around AI. You don’t need to be an expert, but you’re eager to explore how it can help your team deliver more value, faster.

    • How to join the mission? 🚀

  • First call with Alex, our Talent Acquisition Business Partner, to better understand your background, aspirations, and answer any questions you may have. (45 minutes)

  • Interview with Claire (CTO) to delve into your experience and the specifics of the role. (60 minutes)

  • Product case and debrief with our engineering management team to explore how you collaborate with stakeholders, manage conflicts, delivery, and innovation

  • Technical case and debrief with staff engineers to validate your mastery of technical and architectural subjects

  • Final interview with Caroline (CFO) to discuss Malt’s long-term vision (interview at the Paris office)

    •  

    Malt is the perfect space to thrive personally and professionally 💫
     
    - Onboarding: Before easing into your new role, you’ll spend your first week learning about our culture, products, and services with other new joiners at our office in Paris
    - Equity: Every Malter is entitled to stock options 
    - Malt sabbatical: Every three years, all Malters are entitled to a one month fully paid sabbatical leave
    - Free books: If you’re interested in learning more about any topic relevant to Malt’s business, just tell us the books you’d like to read, and we’ll order them for you—without any questions asked or approval processes to follow
    - Team building events organized every year

We recruit based on skills, experience, and potential, without any form of discrimination related to age, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, or disability. title: Product Manager
description:
Ready to be part of the Legal Tech revolution?  

As the leading SaaS publisher in Europe, Dilitrust is transforming legal departments worldwide with cutting-edge technology.  

Our Impact: From General Meeting reports to AI-assisted contract life management, our teams across France, Spain, Italy, Canada, Mexico, and MEA are the driving force behind our global success. We are pleased to provide daily support to 2,400 customers in 64 countries, with 80% of major listed companies in major markets like Europe, North America and the middle East.   

Our Ambition: To be the first French legal tech to achieve Unicorn status, with a valuation surpassing €1 billion.  

Our Recognition: Dilitrust has been recognized for offering a positive and stimulating work environment. We are proud to have been awarded the "Happy at Work" and “Tech at Work” label since 2019.  

 

Your tasks :  

We are currently growing our Product team, adding a Product Manager to consolidate and structure our amazing product. 
 
As Product Manager at Dilitrust, you will report directly to the Chief Product Officer or the Head of Product and work closely with our Developers and Product Designers to design the future of legal software. 

What you will do:  

  • Be the voice of our users – You are passionate about understanding customer needs and believe that talking with users is at the core of a Product Manager’s role. You thrive on identifying key pain points and turning them into impactful product solutions.  

  • Drive meaningful impact – You focus on delivering real value to our customers by solving the right problems, using both qualitative insights and data-driven approaches.  
      

  • Shape the product vision: Advocate for user needs during the definition of new features, ensuring that our product remains aligned with customer expectations and business goals. Become an expert in our business domains to anticipate and analyse market trends.  

  • Collaborate effectively inside and outside your squad: Work hand in hand with developers, product designer and other stakeholders to build the best possible solutions. You facilitate discussions around product impact and ensure incremental delivery of features.  

  • Mesure, observe, iterate: Continuously engage with our users to refine the product, lead discovery discussions, and guide the team in prioritizing the most impactful improvements.  

Profile required:  

Ideally, you have :  

  • Customer-first mindset : You are obsessed with user experience and love talking to customers. You have a strong ability to put yourself in their shoes, understand their challenges, and empathize with their needs.

title: Senior SRE
description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team - from Finance to HR - to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake or Siemens, use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

The opportunity

 

We are looking for a Senior SRE profile who will design and implement the Pigment infrastructure for tomorrow. Pigment is a technically challenging platform. It calculates and synchronizes large datasets that must be updated in real-time. Data comes from client models that can be up to billions of rows. This data can be pivoted, transformed, and aggregated on-demand through our formula engine while rendering live on our front end.

Here are the challenges to be tackled as an SRE :

  • Define and build the infrastructure needed to answer our performance challenges, automate it, and make it scalable. In particular, ensure that the infrastructure scales in and out according to the platform usage.
  • Secure high availability and redundancy of the Pigment platform.
  • Ensure that the platform’s performance and correctness are monitored accordingly, spread observability best practices across the engineering team.
  • Participate in incident response.
  • Accompany Pigment geographical expansion as the company grows and we sign clients overseas.
  • Work with our security team on the implementation of their roadmap when related to infrastructure and development pipelines (code repository, credentials management, ...)
  • Continuously chase inefficiencies within our development practices and pipelines. Seek improvement and automation wherever possible. Drive change across the software engineering team.

In addition to SRE responsibilities, we expect you to contribute to software development activities. We believe SRE engineers should collaborate closely with software engineers, fostering a shared understanding of day-to-day challenges, rather than operating in separate teams. Last but not least, you will not be alone! You will be part of an SRE team.

 

Our Engineering team

Our Engineering team is responsible for developing our SaaS platform and building a comprehensive and user-friendly product.

Pigment engineers participate in the entire application development lifecycle, focusing on design, coding, and keeping the production platform up and running. They can be specialized, but there is no strict separation between the infrastructure, backend, and the frontend.

 

We value user-centricity and pragmatism: we choose the most relevant tools for the problem we have to solve, understanding the strengths and constraints of each technology.

Our engineering culture also values curiosity, humility, trust, ownership and team spirit.

 

Technical stack:

  • Kubernetes (GKE, hosted on Google Cloud Platform): hosting all our infrastructure components except some PostgreSQL hosts, hosted on Google Cloud SQL
  • Terraform: all our infrastructure is managed via this infrastructure as code (creation of GKE clusters, Google Cloud SQL databases, GCS buckets, IAM permissions...)
  • Databases: PostgreSQL (CloudSQL and CloudNativePG), SingleStore, ElasticSearch
  • RabbitMQ: queuing system
  • Temporal.io: workflow automation platform
  • Others: ArgoCD, Istio, Vault, Github, Docker (for local development)
  • Backend: Microservices written in C# ASP.NET Core 8 (running exclusively on Linux) & Golang
  • Frontend: React + Typescript, Jest, Cypress, Vite...

 

Who you are

 

More than knowledge of a specific cloud provider, language, or automation framework, we are looking for great engineering skills: the ability to translate product requirements into an elegant and simple architecture, and then make sure our product runs well on it.

We are also looking for engineers who understand the product and the customer's needs in detail and can suggest innovative ideas: in the end, it's all about delivering value to end-users.

 

In any case, you have:

  • Experience as a software engineer & DevOps / SRE
  • Experience with a container orchestration platform (Kubernetes is a plus)
  • Experience with a public cloud provider, GCP is a plus
  • Proven experience in software developments with languages such as C#, Java, C++, Golang, Rust, JavaScript, Python, or Ruby (this list is not exhaustive).
  • Experience with observability tools (e.g. Datadog, Prometheus, ELK, Jaeger...)
  • Great team spirit with a problem-solving attitude.
  • A good dose of humility and the willingness to grow (no matter your seniority!).
  • Fluency in English
