title: Productowner
description:
Als Product Owner vertaal je visie naar concrete acties en zorg je dat multidisciplinaire (Business en IT) teams maximale waarde leveren voor klant en organisatie. Je ontwikkelt een krachtige productvisie die naadloos aansluit bij onze strategie en zorgt dat deze daadwerkelijkheid gerealiseerd wordt.

Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

Je bent het gezicht van de business, bouwt sterke relaties met interne en externe stakeholders en neemt beslissingen met mandaat. Je opereert op het snijvlak van Business en IT en stuurt een Agile Business Team aan dat vraagstukken vertaalt naar waardevolle Epics en Features.

Onze strategie is gericht op continue verbetering van Operational Excellence, altijd vanuit klantwaarde, waarbij we processen expliciet koppelen aan de bovenliggende klantreis. Met jouw scherpe prioritering houd je de backlog overzichtelijk, definieer je features en stories en bewaak je de kwaliteit volgens de hoogste standaarden en de Definition of Done.

Met jouw scherpe prioriteitenbeheer houd je de backlog overzichtelijk, definieer je features en stories en bewaak je de kwaliteit van opgeleverde producten, altijd volgens de hoogste standaarden en de Definition of Done. Binnen het team breng je focus, stimuleer je samenwerking en zorg je voor energie tijdens demo's en retrospectives.

Je brengt focus in het team, stimuleert samenwerking en zorgt voor energie tijdens demo's en retrospectives. Tegelijk bewaak je de functionele (klantwaarde, wetgeving, processen) én technische integriteit van oplossingen. Je stuurt actief op KPI's en bent een aanjager van innovatie en optimalisatie.

Daarnaast zorg je ervoor dat nieuwe vereisten en proposities tijdig en correct worden doorgevoerd in alle relevante systemen, van administratie tot klantcommunicatie, zodat de klantreis over alle kanalen consistent en effectief is ingericht. We werken in een professionele, resultaatgerichte omgeving met veel aandacht voor samenwerking, eigenaarschap en kwaliteit, en schakelen continu tussen business, IT en compliance.

#LI-DNI


Wat vragen we van jou?

  • Hbo+/wo werk- en denkniveau met analytisch vermogen om complexe processen snel te doorgronden

  • Passie voor de Pensioen Business en affiniteit met domeinkennis (o.a. WTP en keuzebegeleiding is een pré)

  • Ervaring met Agile/SAFe-principes en het werken in multidisciplinaire teams

  • Sterke focus op klanttevredenheid en het vermogen om klantbehoeften te vertalen naar waardevolle oplossingen

  • Organisatorisch talent: je bent aantoonbaar sterk in plannen, structureren en het aanbrengen van prioriteiten

  • Communicatieve kracht: je onderhoudt relaties met stakeholders en weet te overtuigen op basis van argumenten en persoonlijkheid

  • Je beweegt comfortabel op het snijvlak van business en IT en weet verschillende disciplines effectief te verbinden

  • Probleemoplossend vermogen en besluitvaardigheid: je durft keuzes te maken en neemt verantwoordelijkheid

  • Talenkennis: uitstekende beheersing van zowel Nederlands als Engels in woord en geschrift

  • Het is een pré als je werkervaring hebt als Product Owner en in het bezit bent van WFT-certificaten (Basis, Vermogen, Pensioen)


We zoeken iemand die niet alleen inhoudelijk sterk is, maar ook persoonlijk leiderschap toont en écht verschil maakt. Jij hebt een duidelijke visie op producten, diensten en onze marktpositie en weet deze overtuigend over te brengen op stakeholders. Je neemt eigenaarschap, voelt je verantwoordelijk en stuurt actief op het behalen van doelen.

Besluitvaardigheid is jouw tweede natuur: je durft keuzes te maken en staat achter de gevolgen. Je begrijpt hoe jouw beslissingen de organisatie raken en handelt met organisatiesensitiviteit. En bovenal: je bent een inspirerend voorbeeld voor collega's, toont initiatief en overtuigt met krachtig persoonlijk leiderschap.

Wat krijg je van ons?

Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega's die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag.


Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten.


In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten.


Salaris per maand:
Op basis van cao schaal 17 HAY is de range € 5.991,23 tot € 7.988,31 op basis van 36 uur.

title: City Launcher, Groningen
description:
Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour.

We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from companies like Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta and Google DeepMind. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you’ll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural.

Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with an fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house - hardware and software, we're explicitly not a hybrid or remote-first company - you can't build robots or walls from home, so we're onsite five days a week.

 

Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision and company. You might enjoy our YouTube Channel, Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage, or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like.


About the role

Over the last few years, Monumental has gone from developing a product that works and delivering our first pilots to building at scale - a fleet of 150+ robots that have laid bricks for 90+ homes, a school, a community centre, a hotel, and 150+ m of canal walls.

We're taking on more construction projects - "deployments" - every month, with more robots, more people, and now in new markets as we scale from the Netherlands into the UK and US.

As Hub Lead, you’ll stand up our first hub outside HQ, in the north of the Netherlands. You’ll start by running our largest deployment to date, then build the team and operations around it as the project pipeline ramps up behind you.

We're hiring versatile operators who want to run a deployment as if it were their own business. Behind every one of these projects is a Deployment Manager who owns it end to end. In practice this is five jobs in one: site foreman, operations manager, account executive, analyst, and project manager. You make the build plan, deploy yourself with your team on site as a subcontractor, manage the contractor relationship, and take responsibility for delivering quality walls, finished on time - in construction, one of the most chaotic industries there is. Your goal will be to run multiple deployments in parallel, overseeing complex and high stakes projects.

One day you're up at dawn, travelling to site, cutting bricks, running the schedule, working with the general contractor and watching your build plan go up brick by brick. The next you'll be at our facility analysing your deployment's P&L and building the systems that improve your margin on the next deployment. You’ll own delivery and translating friction you observe on-site to our R&D team.

This is hard, on-site operations, and some of the most rewarding work you'll find. Robots break, weather turns, the contractor changes the plan, and it's on you to keep the build moving.
You'll have an extraordinary amount of autonomy. It's an excellent fit if you've founded a company before, or if you're looking for an entrepreneurial role where you can make outsized impact.

What you’ll do

  • Plan the logistics of a deployment: decide how many and which robots and humans to send, coordinate with other subcontractors, and make both a day-to-day operational plan while also thinking about the bigger picture and how your decisions impact our unit economics.

  • Spend time on the construction site, overseeing, managing, and motivating the team; liaising with the general contractors and other stakeholders; and generally representing the company and selling our story. You’re comfortable speaking with the guys building scaffolds, the CEOs of the biggest general contractors, and our engineers, all on the same day.

  • Build the operational systems that make each deployment run better than the last - spotting inefficiencies, fixing processes, improving margin

  • Work with our existing customer base and drive growth of new construction projects and, in the future, adjacent product lines beyond bricklaying.

  • Own the P&L of your deployment and propose ways to continuously improve our unit economics.

  • Support hiring and interviewing additional robot and deployment operators.

What we’re looking for

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in management as a startup founder, GM, in operations, strategy, business development or a similar area.

  • Given the local nature of the construction industry, this role requires you to be a native Dutch speaker.

  • You generally need to be an excellent communicator and be comfortable speaking with a broad range of personas.

  • You don’t mind getting your hands (literally) dirty to get the job done.

  • A strong bias-to-action and getting-shit-done mentality with the required tenacity and speed. The emphasis of this role is execution, not analysis.

  • You’re comfortable in a high-stress environment. Things constantly go wrong at construction sites, the stakes are high, and we’re introducing new technology with novel failure modes.

  • Raw intellectual horsepower and eagerness to learn. We expect this role to have a steep learning curve whatever your background, and this role might in practice feel like a completely new job every 3-6 months. You’ll learn a lot about construction, robotics, and being part of a high-growth, hard-tech company.

  • Experience and ability to manage, lead, and motivate a (small) team.

  • Strong operational and analytical skills. You can build a spreadsheet with a clear operational plan, or present a P&L and model various scenarios and drivers. You’re a strong project manager.

Why Monumental?

Joining Monumental means being at the forefront of a movement aimed at making significant strides in the construction industry. Here, your work has the potential to impact not just the company but the future of how we build. If you're driven by innovation, eager to tackle complex challenges, and ready to make a tangible difference, we want to hear from you.

 

For open applications (where you don’t see an exact role match), please reach out to us at: ----- - share with us the most interesting or challenging project you’ve worked on, why you want to join and your CV or portfolio.

 

Unfortunately we do not currently support internships.

 

If you don’t meet all the qualifications here but are excited about Monumental and feel you’d still be able to help us solve difficult problems, do get in touch. We welcome generalists who focus on outcomes and are eager to learn on the job.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer (Kubernetes)
description:
We're a SaaS company innovating at the intersection of AI and scalable cloud infrastructure. Our platform empowers thousands of users daily, and we're scaling rapidly. As we grow, we are investing deeply into developer enablement, infrastructure automation, and reliability to support both velocity and resilience.

About Trengo

Welcome to the forefront of AI-driven communication. At Trengo, we’re redefining the industry by replacing repetitive work with meaningful conversations through our AI-powered customer engagement platform. We unify communication channels and leverage agentic AI to deliver proactive, human-like service, boosting efficiency for thousands of businesses worldwide.

As a fast-moving Dutch scale-up, backed by a $36M Series A and an official WhatsApp Business Solutions Provider, we thrive on acceleration. Your expertise will drive growth: you’ll make a strategic impact, champion AI innovation, and help shape the product roadmap. You’ll do this alongside an international team guided by our Dynamic pace, Future-proof mindset, Ownership, and Open culture.

The opportunity

You'll work on the Kubernetes platform behind Trengo's customer engagement and AI products: EKS clusters managed through GitOps, plus the migration of our EC2-based workloads onto it. This is a platform engineering role within our cloud team. You'll work closely with the product and AI teams and the rest of the cloud team, so developers can ship safely and on their own. A big part of the role is bringing people along: helping developers understand and adopt the platform, and sharing what you know with the team.

Our stack

  • Kubernetes and GitOps: EKS, Karpenter, FluxCD, KCL, kro, Envoy Gateway (Gateway API)

  • Cloud and IaC: AWS across multiple accounts (EC2, Lambda, ECR, Bedrock), Terraform, GitHub Actions

  • Data: PlanetScale (MySQL), Aurora PostgreSQL, MongoDB Atlas, ElastiCache (Valkey/Redis), Elastic Cloud, S3, SQS, MSK (Kafka)

  • Networking and security: VPC, PrivateLink, Route 53, ALB, CloudFront, Cloudflare, IAM, KMS, external-secrets

  • Observability: Grafana Cloud, VictoriaMetrics, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry

What your role looks like

  • Work on our EKS clusters and GitOps platform: upgrades, security, autoscaling and the core platform components.

  • Improve how teams deploy to Kubernetes: the GitOps workflows, CI/CD pipelines and self-service templates developers use to ship their apps.

  • Help migrate our core Laravel application from EC2 to Kubernetes, while keeping the existing EC2 fleet healthy.

  • Manage AWS infrastructure with Terraform, and improve observability, alerting, security and cost across the platform.

  • Bring engineers along: mentor them, pair on platform changes, write clear docs and help define our engineering standards.

What you’ll bring

We’d love to meet you if have:

  • Production experience running Kubernetes and Docker-based workloads, including cluster upgrades, autoscaling and troubleshooting.

  • Hands-on experience deploying to Kubernetes with GitOps and CI/CD pipelines (we use FluxCD and GitHub Actions).

  • 5+ years in Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering or DevOps roles, with deep AWS experience (EKS, EC2, IAM, VPC networking).

  • Strong Terraform and Linux skills, and a solid understanding of observability, secrets management and least-privilege access.

  • Excellent communication skills and experience mentoring engineers and bringing teams along when tools or ways of working change.

Nice to have

  • Experience with FluxCD, Envoy Gateway, Karpenter, kro, KCL or Kubernetes operators

  • Migrating a monolith from VMs to Kubernetes

  • Managed databases and search in production (MySQL/PlanetScale, PostgreSQL, MongoDB Atlas, Elasticsearch)

  • Multi-account AWS, Kafka, Cloudflare or AI/LLM workloads in production

  • A background in security, compliance (e.g. GDPR) or incident response

⚙️ Our tech & AI mindset

AI is not a buzzword at Trengo. It is part of how we build and operate. You’ll work with AI-driven features, automation, data, or tools that help us move faster and smarter. We value thoughtful use of AI that creates real value for customers and teams.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Team Agent
description:
About the role

Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Agent team.

We are building a platform for creating, publishing, and executing AI-powered agents that help teams automate complex workflows in financial services. The Agents team owns the agent execution runtime, tool orchestration, and platform infrastructure that makes this possible, including the conversational copilot experiences built on top of it across the product.

We are hiring a Full-Stack Engineer to help build and ship production features across this entire stack, from the agent runtime and tool orchestration layer in the backend, to the conversational copilot experiences users interact with every day. You'll work alongside experienced engineers, contribute to real product impact from day one, and grow your skills in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment.

What You'll Do

  • Build and ship features end-to-end for Taktile's AI agent platform: backend in Python (FastAPI) on AWS serverless infrastructure, and frontend in React and TypeScript.

  • Build conversational copilot experiences end to end: chat UI components, streaming responses, rich in-chat interactions, and human-in-the-loop approvals.

  • Improve how agents run, how they connect to external tools, and how they behave when something goes wrong.

  • Own your work end-to-end: collaborate on scope, implement, test, release, and iterate based on real usage and customer feedback.

  • Use leading-edge AI tools (e.g. Claude) on a daily basis to move faster, improve quality, and build AI-native capabilities where it makes sense.

  • Review pull requests with depth, improve test coverage and CI/CD, and raise the bar on reliability and engineering excellence.

  • Engage actively in team rituals such as daily syncs, planning sessions, demos, and technical deep-dive discussions.

  • Grow as an individual and accelerate your career by learning from experienced team members, contributing to a foundational layer of the product, and joining cross-team learning groups.

  • For career growth at Taktile, this role will involve daytime ops duty and at some point joining an on-call rotation, so you need to have passion for owning systems end to end and grow your DevSecOps skills as well.

Team's tech stack

  • Backend: Python (FastAPI, Pydantic)

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript

  • Data: DynamoDB, Postgres

  • Cloud: AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway)

  • AI: LLM orchestration, tool-use frameworks, streaming execution

Requirements

  • Strong engineering fundamentals with a passion for simplicity and precision.

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is essential as we operate in an hybrid environment requiring clear and effective communication. Strong English skills are also crucial to efficiently interacting with AI.

  • Prior industry experience building full-stack web applications (this is not an entry-level position).

  • Proficiency with React and TypeScript, and experience building rich, interactive user interfaces.

  • Experience with Python back-end development, building and operating RESTful APIs, and working with databases.

  • Experience integrating into AWS or similar cloud providers.

Nice but not required

  • Experience building chat or conversational UIs, real-time/streaming interfaces, or data visualization.

  • FastAPI and Pydantic experience.

  • DynamoDB or Postgres, SQLAlchemy.

  • Exposure to LLM application development, agent frameworks, MCP, or building developer tools.

  • Prior ops or on-call experience.

  • Experience with distributed systems, async task processing, or observability tooling (tracing, metrics, logging).

Our Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

  • Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.

  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package.

  • Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.

  • Receive a new Apple MacBook Pro, as well as meaningful home office set-up.

 

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply.

  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears.

 

About Us

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents.

With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding.

Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo.

With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com.

description:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

Role summary

You own the marketing-technology layer behind Taxfix's growth: the conversion signals that tell ad networks who converted, the customer data that powers CRM, the consent flows that decide what we may share and with whom, and the referral program, one of the growth mechanics the team owns end to end. This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports. You set direction for a small engineering team (a tech lead plus 3–4 engineers, two-week sprints) that supports four products across three markets, with Paid Acquisition, CRM, Brand and Creative as internal customers. A typical week mixes debugging a missing ad-network event, scoping a referral reward, settling a data-sharing question with Legal, and explaining trade-offs to leadership. All work, including across markets, happens in English; German is not required.

What you'll do

  • Own conversion-signal engineering for paid acquisition: client-side and server-to-server events into Singular, Firebase/GA4, Google Ads and TikTok, including synthetic events, revenue values and predicted-LTV signals.

  • Run the referral program as a product: reward mechanics, eligibility and fraud rules, voucher infrastructure (Voucherify), the in-app voucher wallet, entry points, and the experiments that tune them.

  • Grow push and marketing-consent opt-in through permission primers, iOS/Android OS permission flows and notification preferences.

  • Keep CRM data trustworthy: Braze attributes and events, Snowflake-to-Braze syncs, event-loss monitoring, and moving legacy messaging (SendGrid, Firebase) onto Braze.

  • Turn consent and privacy requirements into product behaviour, and work with Legal on what data can go to which partner.

  • Adapt tracking, CRM attributes and attribution to company launches, such as new subscription pricing tiers, without breaking downstream campaigns or reporting.

  • Turn stakeholder requests, support escalations and spike findings into tickets engineers can start on, and decide what goes into the sprint.

  • Weigh roadmap work against platform upkeep: pipeline migrations, security fixes, end-of-life SDKs.

  • Design A/B tests (Eppo) and read the results for marketing and consent opt-s, and referral changes.

  • Report progress, risks and trade-offs in writing to marketing leadership, including VP and C-level.

Must-have skills and experience

  • Several years as a product manager owning martech, growth infrastructure or data products, setting your own roadmap with senior stakeholders.

  • Hands-on mobile and web attribution: an MMP (Singular or comparable), server-to-server events, and ad-network conversion setups (Google Ads, TikTok).

  • Event-tracking depth: you can define an event schema, write a tracking spec, and trace a missing or duplicated event through Segment, Google Tag Manager and the receiving platform.

  • CRM data platforms, ideally Braze: custom attributes, event-triggered segmentation, data ingestion and sync quality.

  • Working knowledge of EU consent and privacy: GDPR, consent mode, iOS App Tracking Transparency, and how push permissions behave on iOS and Android.

  • Experimentation: framing hypotheses, choosing and configuring metrics, judging when a result is real.

  • Precise writing: specs that engineers (and AI coding agents) can start on without a meeting, and concise updates and decision memos for leadership.

  • Enough technical fluency to work through trade-offs with engineers across mobile apps (React Native), backend services and data pipelines, and to triage production incidents.

Nice to have

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
About Peec AI

Peec AI is the analytics platform for AI search. People increasingly discover products and make buying decisions through ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews instead of traditional search, and most brands have no idea where they show up in those answers. Peec gives marketing, SEO, and growth teams the data to see exactly that: how visible their brand is across AI platforms, how they compare to competitors, and where to win.

We are defining this category, and the market is moving with us. Peec is a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, that went from $0 to $15M ARR in 18 months, with a 100+ person team across our Berlin HQ and our New York office.

About the role

Peec AI is building the data plane for AI visibility: millions of chats, scrapes, citations, sources, model responses, and customer-facing insights running through a fast-moving backend.

This role is for an engineer who wants to own the systems behind that. You will not just add endpoints or close tickets. You will make our scraping, chat-processing, source-ingestion, and analytics infrastructure more reliable, cheaper, faster, and easier for the rest of the team to reason about.

The best fit looks like someone who can debug a provider outage in the morning, design a better queueing model before lunch, ship a TypeScript service change in the afternoon, and write the postmortem or follow-up ticket clearly enough that the next engineer immediately knows what to do.

We are especially interested in people who have built or operated systems with real constraints: rate limits, flaky third-party APIs, queues, webhooks, retries, distributed locks, data migrations, observability gaps, customer pressure, and cost ceilings.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of backend, platform, infrastructure, or distributed systems engineering experience in a production environment.

  • Deep hands-on TypeScript experience. We run TypeScript services on Bun, and we care about people who can design clean, reliable backend systems rather than only write application code.

  • Strong understanding of queues, workers, retries, rate limits, idempotency, distributed locks, webhooks, and failure handling.

  • Experience operating systems under real production pressure: incidents, provider outages, customer escalations, noisy alerts, slow dependencies, and incomplete data.

  • Comfort with cloud-native infrastructure. Our stack includes GCP, Kubernetes, Cloud Tasks, Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ, Redis, Postgres, Firestore, ClickHouse, Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.

  • Ability to debug across layers: application code, logs, metrics, queues, provider APIs, databases, network behaviour, and deployment state.

  • Product-minded judgement. You can separate internal detail from customer-safe explanation, and you understand when a “small infra change” has customer, security, or cost implications.

  • High ownership and low ego. We want people who take responsibility for ambiguous systems, ask sharp questions, and make the team better through clear thinking and kindness.

  • A bias toward durable fixes. You do not stop at “restart the pod” if the real issue is retry amplification, missing backpressure, an unsafe parser assumption, or a provider limit we do not model.

Tech stack

  • Languages: TypeScript, Python

  • Runtime/frameworks: Bun, Elysia, Node-compatible services

  • Cloud/infrastructure: GCP, Kubernetes, Cloud Tasks, Pub/Sub, Firebase/Firestore, Postgres, ClickHouse, Redis, RabbitMQ

  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, structured logging

  • Product/data domain: LLM chats, AI search, source scraping, citation extraction, provider integrations, customer-facing analytics

  • AI/model providers: OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode / AI Overview, plus scraping/provider APIs around them

title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager
description:

  • Markt & Wettbewerb: Du beobachtest den Robotik-, Automatisierungs- und Deep-Tech-Markt, erkennst Lücken in der Positionierung und bringst sie in Strategie und Produkt ein.

  • Marketing-KPIs: Du definierst, misst und berichtest die Kennzahlen, die zählen: Pipeline-Beitrag, Conversion, Cost per Lead und Funnel-Entwicklung. Daraus leitest du Entscheidungen ab, statt nur Reports zu verwalten.

  • Sales Enablement: In enger Abstimmung mit den Gründer:innen unterstützt du Vertrieb und Business Development mit Pitch-Material, Use Cases, Case Studies und Produktkommunikation für konkrete Verkaufssituationen.

  • Investorenkommunikation: Du verfasst regelmäßige Investor-Updates und gestaltest die Storyline unseres Pitch Decks mit.

  • Erfahrung: Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre im Marketing gearbeitet, davon einen Teil in einem Startup oder Scale-up, in dem du Marketing mit aufgebaut hast. Du hast mindestens einen größeren Produktlaunch begleitet und kannst erzählen, was funktioniert hat und was nicht.

  • Neugier: Interesse an komplexen Technologien und die Motivation, tief in die Robotik einzutauchen, technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und verständlich zu vermitteln.

  • Zahlen: Du setzt dir messbare Ziele und weißt, wie du sie nachhältst. Google Analytics, CRM-Software und A/B-Tests gehören zu deinem Arbeitsalltag, nicht in fremde Hände.

  • Verhandlung auf Augenhöhe: Du bist sicher im Gespräch mit potenziellen Partnern und Kunden. Du findest heraus, was sie brauchen, und schätzt ein, ob ein Lead es wert ist, weiterverfolgt zu werden.

  • Arbeitsweise: Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und arbeitest gleichzeitig eng mit anderen zusammen. Du wechselst zwischen Strategie und Umsetzung, ohne eines von beidem aus dem Blick zu verlieren.

  • Schreiben: Du schreibst gut und gerne selbst. Aus einem technischen Gespräch mit einem Engineer machst du eine Case Study oder Website-Copy, die Einkäufer:innen in der Industrie verstehen.

  • Sprachen: Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher.

Vorteile

  • Marketing von Grund auf: Es gibt kein Playbook und keine Altlasten. Du gestaltest gemeinsam mit den Gründern, wie Cell Labs an den Markt geht, und siehst die Wirkung deiner Arbeit direkt in der Pipeline.

  • Alles unter einem Dach: Büro, Werkstatt und Teststände liegen im selben Gebäude in Kreuzberg. Wenn du eine Story für eine Case Study brauchst oder den Roboter in Aktion sehen willst, ist der Engineer ein paar Schritte entfernt, kein Ticket.

  • Room to Fail & Grow: Bezahlte Lernzeit mit persönlichem Budget für Kurse, Marketing-Konferenzen und die Tools, die du brauchst. Du bekommst Raum, Neues auszuprobieren, und bringst ein Produkt an den Markt, das bisher kaum jemand gesehen hat.

  • Benefits: Ein Leistungspaket, das du dir selbst zusammenstellst und das Mobilität, Gesundheit, Ernährung oder Fitness abdeckt. Dazu gibt’s einen zusätzlichen bezahlten freien Tag im Jahr für ehrenamtliches Engagement oder ein Projekt, das dir am Herzen liegt.

Bewerbung

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Zeilen zu einer Kampagne oder einem Launch, den du verantwortet hast. Was war das Ziel, was hast du getan, was kam dabei heraus? Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

Der Prozess: Intro Call, Deep Dive in deine bisherige Arbeit, Besuch bei uns mit einer kleinen Case Study, Angebot.

Wir bauen Roboter für alle, deshalb wollen wir ein Team, das das abbildet. Wir stellen nach Fähigkeiten ein und freuen uns ausdrücklich über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die in Marketing und Tech unterrepräsentiert sind. Wenn du nicht jeden Punkt erfüllst, aber denkst, das ist dein Job: bewirb dich.

title: iOS Engineer - Design System
description:
About the team:

As an iOS Engineer on the Design System team, you'll translate SumUp's design language into a reusable, easy-to-use library of UI components and experience patterns — empowering product teams to build cohesive, accessible user experiences at scale.

The Design System team works hand-in-hand with the Mobile Platform team to set standards and provide guidance across all product teams at SumUp. As we expand our ecosystem of merchant and consumer-facing products, this role offers a rare opportunity to shape the foundation that helps developers build faster and ship higher-quality experiences to millions of users worldwide.

 

What you'll do:

  • Shape the core experience for both users and developers interacting with SumUp's iOS ecosystem
  • Collaborate closely with product and design teams to build components that are maintainable, consistent, and beautiful
  • Embed accessibility best practices into every component — from content descriptions and touch target sizing to color contrast and dynamic type
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance to product teams to deliver on company priorities, including the upcoming support for landscape orientation
  • Review code contributions, enforce design system conventions, and mentor engineers on best practices for reusable UI development
  • Lead the migration of legacy UIKit-based components to SwiftUI while maintaining system stability
  • Proactively identify and address technical debt to uphold a high bar for engineering excellence and codebase health

 

You'll be a great fit for this role if you:

  • Bring 3+ years of professional iOS development experience, ideally on large-scale or consumer-facing applications
  • Are fluent in Swift, with deep hands-on knowledge of both SwiftUI and UIKit — and a clear view on when and how to use each
  • Bring experience building or contributing to a design system, component library, or shared UI framework, and understand what it takes to make components truly reusable and scalable
  • Take pride in crafting accessible user experiences — you know your way around VoiceOver, dynamic type, color contrast, and touch target standards, and treat accessibility as a first-class concern, not an afterthought
  • Bring a strong grasp of testing best practices for UI components, including unit tests, snapshot tests, and UI automation
  • Are comfortable reviewing code and mentoring peers — you enjoy sharing knowledge, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team
  • Are self-motivated and structured in your working style — you manage your own priorities, communicate clearly in English, and thrive in a cross-functional, collaborative environment
  • Stay genuinely curious about the iOS ecosystem — you follow Apple's releases closely, experiment with new APIs, and are excited to bring fresh ideas back to the team

Why you should join SumUp:

🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which you can be used to attend conferences and/or advancing your career through further education

💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

🏖️ Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days

🚵🏾‍♂️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

 

About SumUp

We believe in the everyday hero.

Small business owners are at the heart of all we do, so we're creating tools that help them run their businesses. With a founder's mentality and a 'team-first' attitude, our diverse teams across Europe, South America and the United States work together to ensure that the small business owners we partner with can be successful doing what they love. 

SumUp is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. SumUp does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. SumUp also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind.

SumUp will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate

description:
DACH Enterprise Account Executive – SAP Ecosystem & Digital Transformation (m/f/d)

Position Summary: 

We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive, reporting to the VP of Global GTM. We are seeking an elite, high-performing Enterprise Account Executive to drive new business acquisition across top-tier accounts. Combining large-enterprise sophistication with an aggressive, entrepreneurial hunting mindset, you will architect transformational security deals, engage C-level stakeholders, and position business resilience for the world's most mission-critical ERP environments.

 

Key Responsibilities

Drive Strategic Revenue: Own the full sales lifecycle for Global 2000 accounts, positioning the Onapsis Platform as the essential security layer for SAP and Business Critical Applications. 

 

The SAP "Triple Threat": 

  1. Direct Sales: Manage complex, high-value "land and expand" cycles.
  2. SAP Co-Sell: Partner with SAP Account Executives (AEs) and Enterprise Architects  to attach Onapsis to S/4HANA and RISE migrations.
  3. GSI Alignment: Orchestrate go-to-market strategies with Global Systems Integrators (Accenture, Deloitte, IBM, PwC) who are leading the world's largest SAP transformations.

 

C-Suite Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to CISOs and CIOs, translating technical vulnerabilities into business risks (e.g., SOX compliance, financial downtime, and data integrity).

 

Territory Orchestration: Develop and execute an annual territory plan focused on "White Space" analysis within the SAP installed base.

 

Forecast Accuracy: Maintain a high level of "Sales Hygiene" within CRM, delivering predictable weekly and monthly forecasts aligned with SAP's rigorous reporting standards.

 

Required Skills/Experience:

 

  • Proven Enterprise Track Record: 7–10+ years of enterprise software sales experience, with a proven history of selling complex software solutions within the SAP ecosystem (either at SAP or a top-tier partner).
  • Cloud Transformation Expert: Deep understanding of the RISE with SAP framework, Clean Core strategy, and the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).
  • Consistent High Achiever: Consistent record of quota over-achievement, regularly closing seven-figure ARR deals across Global 2000 accounts with complex buying committees.
  • Alliance Savvy: Demonstrated success in "partner-first" selling, particularly with GSIs and SAP's regional field teams.
  • Communication: Exceptional executive presence; ability to move seamlessly from a technical discussion with a Basis Lead to a strategic ROI pitch with a CFO.
  • Ability to travel: We believe that our business is a people business and that trust is built in person. Between 25-50% travel required. 

Entrepreneurial Mindset: Proactive self-starter with the drive to build a territory from scratch and take full ownership of business growth.Languages: Professional fluency in both German and English (written and spoken).

What You will get: 

  • You can expect a job with responsible tasks and creative opportunities, an attractive salary and extensive benefits (including JobRad, Focus Friday and much more).
  • You have flexible working hours with us. In addition, you can work remotely from other EU countries by arrangement.
  • We support our employees with 5 fully paid sick days per child and subsidize childcare up to primary school age.
  • In addition to an individual onboarding and buddy program, we offer comprehensive training opportunities and english language classes.
  • We offer 30 days of paid vacation per year (based on a 5-day workweek) for optimal work-life balance.
  • Furthermore, you can expect an innovative and attractive workplace with flat hierarchies and respectful and solution-oriented communication.
  • Equity in a late-stage, high-growth leader backed by top-tier VC/PE firms.
  • The chance to represent the only cybersecurity solution endorsed by SAP.

 

About Onapsis:

Onapsis protects the business applications that run the global economy. The Onapsis Platform delivers vulnerability management, change assurance, and continuous compliance for business applications from leading vendors such as SAP, Oracle, and others. The Onapsis Platform is powered by the Onapsis Research Labs, the team responsible for the discovery and mitigation of more than 1,000 zero-day vulnerabilities in business applications.

 

Onapsis is headquartered in Boston, MA, with offices in Dallas, TX, Heidelberg, Germany, Bucharest, Romania, and Buenos Aires, Argentina, and proudly serves hundreds of the world's leading brands, including close to 30% of the Forbes Global 100, six of the top 10 automotive companies, five of the top 10 chemical companies, four of the top 10 technology companies, and three of the top 10 oil and gas companies.

description:

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM helps governments and financial institutions detect and disrupt illicit finance, and this role brings that mission to central banks, financial regulators and financial intelligence units across EMEA. You will own the relationships and the revenue in a territory where digital asset supervision is growing fast, setting account strategy and closing six- and seven-figure deals with institutions that have long, careful buying processes. What makes this seat unusual is the chance to shape how TRM serves supervisors as MiCA and the EU AML package reshape their work.

The impact you will have:

  • Map your territory’s central banks, supervisors and FIUs, using AI tools to identify budget holders, decision-makers, champions and regulatory triggers so your first outreach reaches the right person.

  • Win six- and seven-figure deals by turning each institution’s supervisory and enforcement challenges into a clear business case, with AI-drafted account plans that you sharpen with your own judgment.

  • Build and maintain 3x qualified pipeline through targeted outreach, regional events and campaigns with Marketing, and measure what converts.

  • Navigate tenders, frameworks and call-offs with Solutions Architecture, Legal and Deal Desk, so each response is accurate and on time.

  • Grow live customers through renewals, expansion and referrals, using AI summaries of usage and call notes to spot expansion signals early.

  • Bring supervisory and customer insight back to Policy, Product and Marketing so the next release reflects how regulators in your region work.

What we’re looking for:

  • 6+ years selling SaaS, data intelligence or investigative solutions into central banks, financial regulators, FIUs or comparable government accounts in EMEA.

  • A record of closing six- and seven-figure deals and meeting quota across long, multi-stakeholder cycles.

  • Existing relationships within EMEA central banks, supervisors or FIUs, and credibility with senior officials.

  • Working knowledge of MiCA, the EU AML framework and how public sector buyers procure.

  • Hands-on use of AI for account research, planning and call preparation, with clear examples of time or revenue gained.

  • Credible, clear communication with senior executives, in person and virtually, and a knack for storytelling.

  • Fluent English; additional European languages are a plus.

  • Based in France, Belgium, Spain, Netherlands, willingness to travel regularly across the region.

About the Team:

  • TRM’s EMEA Sales team gives each Account Director real ownership of a territory and the room to choose how to win it.

  • The team is fast-paced, positive and collaborative, with shared pipeline insight and open sharing of what works.

  • The work is hard in a useful way: senior public sector buyers, several countries, long procurement cycles, and a category that is new to many supervisors.

  • You will work with Partnerships, Legal, Marketing, Policy and Product, who move quickly to back your deals.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within your first 30 days, you profile and stack-rank every central bank, regulator and FIU in your territory and start outreach to the top tier, so pipeline grows before onboarding ends.

  • When a regulator sends an urgent request late on a Friday for a same-day conversation and demo, you and TRM’s Solutions team make it happen that day.

  • When a government RFx lands with only a few days to respond, you rally Solutions Architecture and Deal Desk to deliver a high-quality response on time.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Distributed, not distant: the team works across UK and CET time zones, with occasional later calls for US-EMEA opportunities.

  • Schedule: UK and CET core hours, with flexibility for occasional US-EMEA calls.

  • Increase speed and leverage

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

title: Account Director, Private Sector (CEE & Central Asia)
description:

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM helps financial institutions detect and stop illicit finance, and this role brings that mission to private sector clients including banks, payment providers, crypto natives and fintechs across Central & Eastern Europe and Central Asia. You will own the Private Sector business in a territory where TRM is building coverage, setting account strategy and strategic deals with compliance and risk leaders. What makes this seat unusual is a large greenfield territory plus the freedom to shape your own go-to-market with local partners and AI-assisted research.

The impact you will have:

  • Open new private sector accounts across CEE and Central Asia. Working with internal and external stakeholders to build effective networks to deliver commercial execution of TRM’s services to leading private sector organisations across the region.

  • Win a mixture of high velocity and larger more strategic engagements, by turning AML and fraud pain points into a clear business case, with AI-drafted account plans and proposals that you sharpen with your own market judgment.

  • Own and define the model to build a 3x qualified pipeline each quarter through targeted campaigns, using AI-assisted segmentation and local-language messaging, and measure what converts.

  • Decide how TRM enters each market, choosing between direct selling, resellers, and regional partners, and back each choice with AI-assisted analysis of account data.

  • Grow strategic existing customers engagements through renewals, upsells, and new use cases.

  • Bring customer and regulatory insight back to Product and Marketing so the next release matches how banks in your region actually work.

What we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years selling SaaS or data products into banks, payment firms, crypto or fintechs in CEE or Central Asia, or 4+ years with deep AML and financial crime expertise, plus experience using AI tools to research and prioritize accounts.

  • A record of closing a mixture of quick deal cycle and strategic longer term, higher value engagements and meeting quota, with AI-supported forecasting and pipeline reviews.

  • Working knowledge of regional AML and sanctions frameworks and how compliance, risk, and procurement teams buy.

  • Hands-on use of AI for prospecting, account planning, and call preparation, with clear examples of time or revenue gained.

  • Experience building pipeline in a new territory, forming human lead networks and AI-assisted tools to test and measure what works.

  • Credible, clear communication with senior compliance and risk executives, in person and virtually, including AI-assisted preparation for each meeting.

  • Fluent English; Russian or a CEE relevant language is a strong plus.

  • Based in Poland and willingness to travel regularly across the region.

About the Team:

  • TRM’s EMEA Sales team gives each Account Director full ownership of a territory and the room to choose how to win it.

  • The team collaborates closely and supports one another through shared pipeline insight, deal reviews, and open sharing of what works.

  • The work is hard in a useful way: regulated buyers, several countries, long procurement cycles, and a product category that is still new to many banks.

  • You will work with RevOps, Marketing, Legal, Product, and Solutions Architecture, who move quickly to back your deals.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within your first 30 days, you rank every target bank and fintech in your territory and start outreach to the top tier, so pipeline grows before onboarding ends.

  • When a compliance leader asks for a demo late on a Friday, you and TRM’s Solutions team deliver it that day, turning a warm inquiry into a scheduled evaluation by Monday.

  • Within 90 days, you build qualified pipeline worth at least 3x your quota, backed by an account plan for every Tier 1 target.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Distributed, not distant: the team works across UK and CET time zones, with flexibility for Central Asia hours and occasional US calls on complex deals.

  • Slack is the center of day-to-day communication. @mention colleagues for timely responses.

  • Weekly 1:1 with your manager, a weekly team call, a weekly pipeline call, a weekly forecast call, and regular pod calls.

  • Company-wide all-hands and founder Q&A sessions keep everyone connected to the mission.

Required online and collaboration hours:

  • Schedule: Core hours overlapping CET, with flexibility for Central Asia hours and occasional US calls.

title: IT Cloud Administrator (f/m/d)
description:
About Munich Electrification

Munich Electrification is an innovative company founded with the aim of accelerating the transition to electric and connected mobility. We develop innovative electronic control units for electric vehicles and stationary storage systems for our global customers. Our international team is composed of highly motivated and exceptional engineers. As a small and specialized team we are well-aware of the importance of each individual colleague and support and promote each employee according to their abilities and needs. Our office with adjacent prototype and testing lab is located in the heart of Munich at the Heimeranplatz.

This is what we stand for:

- Technological Leadership: We challenge norms, innovate quickly, and anticipate future needs. We take smart risks and learn from outcomes to stay ahead.

- Sustainability: We actively drive change for a sustainable future, aware of our impact and inspiring others to build a better world.

- Team Culture: We believe work should be enjoyable, fostering a spirit of inspiration, celebration, and teamwork across the globe.

- Entrepreneurial Spirit: We embrace change, think big, and push limits with passion.


Your Role:

Your primary mission is to own and evolve our Digital Ecosystem, ensuring our cloud-first infrastructure is as innovative and high-performing as our battery technology. You will ensure that our core platforms (Google Workspace and the Atlassian) function as a seamless, interconnected network that empowers our company. Acting as the vital bridge between business requirements and technical execution, you will master the configuration of existing solutions and be the technical lead for new application/service implementations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • SaaS & Cloud Governance: Act as the Platform Owner for Google Workspace and Atlassian, managing configurations, security, and permissions.

  • Business Process Evolution: Work with department heads to translate business needs into scalable digital workflows.

  • Vendor & Stakeholder Contact: Coordinate with external consultants and developers.

  • Documentation & Training: Maintain high-quality documentation of our application landscape and lead training sessions for power users.


Your Profile:

  • Education: Degree in Business Informatics, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Experience: Min. 3-5 years of experience as a Full-time Cloud/IT Administrator. Proven track record in Application Management, specifically with MDM systems and Cloud/SaaS environments.

  • Technical Expertise: Good knowledge of Atlassian and Google Workspace administration.

  • Analytical Mindset: You enjoy mapping complex business processes into clean, digital solutions.

  • Communication: Fluent in English; German is a plus; Ability to explain technical concepts to non-IT stakeholders.

Optional:

  • Experience with AWS.

  • Experience with Google Cloud Identity & SSO integrations.

  • Certification in ITIL

  • SAP Knowledge: Practical experience with SAP (ByDesign or S/4HANA).

Our Offer & Benefits

The chance to be part of a highly innovative, agile, and unique team with prestigious customers in the automotive and battery storage sector. You will gain a deeper knowledge around connected & electric vehicle batteries, battery management and electronics development and strive in an exciting work environment

Benefits (Full-time Employees):

- Trust-based working hours and hybrid work

- Adequate and competitive compensation

- Pension Plan/Bonus

- Free access to the fitness center right next to us or subsidized EGYM Wellpass

- Free snacks, coffee, drinks and lunch (freshly cooked by our chef) every day

- Public transport ticket

- Bike-Leasing via Business Bike

- Experience various inspiring and fun team events

- ME-branded clothing

- Option to "work from anywhere" (6 weeks/year)

title: Staff Product Manager - Platform
description:
We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to take on the hardest problems in the data and integration platform that everything at Nelly runs on: how practice data gets into Nelly from dozens of practice management systems, how partners connect to us, and how that data becomes something every product can depend on. At Staff level, your scope follows the problem, across teams and over time into product-wide questions.

The problem space: Every Nelly product, from documentation to billing to payments, depends on data that lives in a practice's management system. There are dozens of them, each with its own data model and interfaces.

How many practices we can serve, how much of their work we can automate, and how much they trust the result come down to four questions: can we connect, can we read and write deeply enough, is the data any good once it arrives, and can every product and team inside Nelly easily build on it?

About Nelly

We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.

Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.

What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI is an essential part of how we work at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.

Joining us, you will:

  • Own the strategy, metrics and roadmap for hard data and integration problems, from how data leaves a practice's system, through ingestion and modelling, to the products that rely on it, tied to real practice value and to how Nelly makes money

  • Shape how partners connect to Nelly through our External API, so we can serve practices on any system and open new markets beyond Germany

  • Define the core data every product relies on: what a patient, an appointment, a treatment plan or an invoice means, who owns it, and how fresh and reliable it is, with GDPR and health-data regulation built in from the start

  • Make data and integration quality measurable and visible, and move it, because practices feel a silent failure long before we do

  • Hold an end-to-end model of the platform and be a credible partner to engineering on architecture and trade-offs

What you'll bring:

  • Agency. You go after the problems that matter most, including well beyond your immediate scope, rather than waiting for a roadmap to land on your desk

  • Comfort in a high-velocity environment. You move fast, make bold but reversible calls, and challenge early and directly, including upward

  • Business-outcome orientation. You're genuinely data-driven: you can name the metric each project moves and let evidence, not gut feel, drive prioritisation

  • Technical fluency. You reason confidently about APIs, data models, data flows and how systems fit together, and you're a credible partner to senior engineers

  • You build with AI. You use AI to move faster: prototyping to pressure-test an idea, taking a first pass on the analysis or the spec yourself, shipping the small things directly, so your time goes to judgment and the decisions that move the product

  • 7+ years of product management experience

Even better if you have:

  • Built and shipped AI products

  • Worked on data platforms or data products

  • Built B2B SaaS in healthcare or another regulated industry

  • Professional German language knowledge

Our Interview Process:

  • Introduction to Nelly with TA

  • Product craft interview with our Product manager

  • Case study interview with Director of Product

  • Onsite interview with hiring manager and stakeholders

What we offer:

  • The people you get to work with. You will work alongside the brightest minds we could find, on hard problems, as a team. We take on challenges together and we never forget to have fun doing it.

  • Room to grow faster than almost anywhere else. New challenges, more scope, real ownership from day one. We trust you to own it and to speak up when something is wrong. Just do not expect to stand still.

  • A yearly learning and development budget, plus the coaching, feedback and internal knowledge that actually move you forward. Real investment in your learning.

  • A front row seat while we build something big. We are building the financial operating system for European healthcare, with AI woven into how we build, sell and support. Real scope, real impact.

  • Deutschlandticket or Swapfiets membership, so you get around the city fast.

  • Urban Sports Club membership, for sport and balance.

  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid setup.

  • Up to 4 weeks of workation.

  • A dog friendly office with great vibes and a team that is fun to work with.

We welcome applications from people of all genders and backgrounds, regardless of origin or age. If you're convinced you're the right fit for this role - even if your CV doesn't match the requirements 100% - tell us why.

title: Staff Engineer
description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

title: Growth Consultant | Deutsch C2
description:
Growth Consultant (m/w/d), Account Management für 30 bis 40 B2B Tech Kunden in Berlin

Die meisten Account-Management-Jobs heißen Beratung und bestehen am Ende aus Reporting-Decks und Ticket-Pingpong. Hier ist es umgekehrt: Die Umsetzung macht das Team, du berätst.

Unser Kunde ist eine AI-first GTM Agentur aus Berlin Mitte. Seit 2024 auf über 5 Mio. EUR ARR und 30+ Leute gewachsen, mit 200+ B2B Tech Kunden, von der Mobility-App über einen Schweizer Telko-Konzern bis zum Bildungsverlag. Zuletzt kam in einem einzigen Monat über 1 Mio. EUR neuer ARR dazu.

Jeder dieser Kunden braucht jemanden, der ihn hält und ausbaut. Genau dafür ist dieser Seat da.

Das Paket: 50 bis 70k EUR Fix plus 12,5% Provision auf Upsell und Retention, Berlin Mitte, 3 Tage Office und 2 Tage remote.

Tasks

  • Du führst dein eigenes Portfolio aus ca. 30 bis 40 Accounts und sitzt alle zwei Wochen mit Geschäftsführern und Entscheidern im Termin.

  • Deine Kunden sind B2B Software- und Tech-Firmen, die über Google, LinkedIn, Meta und signalbasiertes Outbound ihre Pipeline aufbauen. Insgesamt laufen jeden Monat sechsstellige Budgets in Paid Search und Paid Social über die Agentur.

  • Der typische Moment: Ein Geschäftsführer, der viel Geld in Ads und Outbound steckt, fragt dich, warum seine Leads teurer geworden sind und ob er das Budget kürzen soll. Du hast die Antwort und den nächsten Schritt.

  • Beratung statt Operatives: Kampagnen bauen die GTM- und Performance-Marketing-Teams. Du entscheidest mit dem Kunden, was als Nächstes gebaut wird.

  • Upsell und Retention sind dein Hebel: neuer Kanal, mehr Budget, Verlängerung. Dein Spielfeld ist das bestehende Portfolio.

  • Du liest die Zahlen deiner Accounts (Leads, Cost per Lead, Pipeline) und siehst ein Abwanderungsrisiko, bevor der Kunde es ausspricht.

Requirements

  • Ein paar Jahre B2B mit echter, eigener Kundenverantwortung. Ob als Account Manager, BDM, kommerzielles Customer Success, AE mit Bestandskunden oder Founder’s Associate, der Titel ist egal. Interne Koordination oder reines Projektmanagement zählt hier nicht.

  • Du erzählst deinen Track Record in Zahlen: wie viele Accounts, welche Retention, wie viel Upsell-Volumen.

  • Wenn dir ein Geschäftsführer im Call sagt, die Leads taugen nichts und er überlegt zu kündigen, gehst du in die Daten statt in die Defensive und kommst mit einem Plan raus.

  • Du hältst 30+ Kunden parallel auf dem Schirm, ohne dass einer durchrutscht, und baust dir dafür dein eigenes System.

  • Du brauchst niemanden, der dir den Tag plant. Du siehst die Lücke und schließt sie.

  • Idealerweise hast du Outbound, Lead Gen oder B2B-Akquise schon selbst gemacht. Pluspunkte: Google oder LinkedIn Ads, CRM, Agentur-, Consulting- oder Startup-Background.

  • Fix: Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, gutes Englisch, Festanstellung in Vollzeit, 3 Tage pro Woche im Berliner Office (der erste Monat komplett vor Ort).

  • Early Career bis Mid. Gesucht ist Hunger, nicht Seniorität: Wer seit Jahren Senior Advisory macht, wird hier nicht glücklich. Ein Abschluss oder ein großes Logo im Lebenslauf sind nicht das Tor, deine Zahlen schon.

Benefits

  • 50 bis 70k EUR Fix plus 12,5% Provision auf Upsell und Retention. Du verdienst also auch daran, dass Kunden bleiben, nicht nur an neuen Deals.

  • Perspektive: Die Agentur sucht explizit Leute, die Experten- oder Führungsverantwortung übernehmen wollen.

  • Lernkurve: Alle zwei Wochen sitzt du mit Geschäftsführern aus 30 bis 40 verschiedenen B2B Tech Firmen am Tisch. Nach 12 Monaten kannst du einem GF sagen, welcher Kanal sich für sein Geschäftsmodell rechnet und welcher nicht.

  • 1:1 Coaching mit erfahrenen Leuten ab Tag 1.

  • Office in Berlin Mitte, 3 Tage vor Ort und 2 remote, MacBook und eigener Platz mit Bildschirm.

  • Deutschlandticket, Urban Sports Club M, regelmäßige Team-Abende.

  • Start: ASAP

Closing

Klingt nach dir? Die Bewerbung dauert zwei Minuten, kein Motivationsschreiben.

So läuft’s: Bewerbung ➝ Talent Call mit uns ➝ 10 Min Kennenlernen beim Kunden ➝ 30 bis 45 Min Deep Dive ➝ ca. 90 Min vor Ort mit den Gründern und dem Team ➝ Rückmeldung innerhalb von 2 Tagen.

Warum über GENZ4GTM: Vor jedem Kundengespräch bekommst du von uns ein Cheatsheet, nach jeder Runde ehrliches Feedback, und mit einer Bewerbung matchen wir dich auf mehrere passende Rollen.

title: Robotics Engineer - Integration & Control (m/f/d)
description:
About Prefiro

Asparagus cost up to 25 euros per kilo this season! That’s because, like most of the produce on the shelf, it’s harvested exclusively by hand. Here at Prefiro, we’re the first to automate these processes! We use artificial intelligence, and robotics to bring next-generation agricultural equipment to the field.

Are you excited about applying new technologies in real-world conditions, solving interesting and varied problems, and seeing firsthand the impact your ideas have?

Then join our growing team and help us deliver the first autonomous asparagus harvester to farms.

Your responsibilities

  • Integrate robots and IO into the robotics stack – from startup and service to error handling and recovery.

  • Work on MPC-based trajectory planning and optimal control: from approach to implementation on the robot in real time.

  • Help optimize cycle times in real-world applications

  • Scale the stack from one robot module to several per machine: networking, robot setup and calibration.

  • Tune the robot computers for real-time control: Docker, CPU pinning, ROS 2 scheduling and multithreading.

  • Build remote access, data collection and robotics CI/CD (e.g. rosbag-playback tests) to improve the robots with real field data.

  • Review code, contribute to architecture decisions and debug the stack as a team.

  • Run the robots during pre-season field tests and the harvest season.

What you bring

  • Master's Degree in robotics, mechatronics, mechanical engineering, computer science, or a related technical field.

  • At least 2 years of professional experience in robotics, including hands-on work with real robots (not only simulation).

  • Strong modern C++ (C++17) and Python 3.

  • Hands-on experience with ROS 2 (ideally Jazzy): nodes, lifecycle nodes, executors, QoS, launch files.

  • Experience with trajectory controllers and trajectory planning.

  • Solid grounding in robot kinematics and dynamics (URDF, Pinocchio or similar).

  • Proven experience with optimal control and model predictive control for trajectory planning; reinforcement learning is a plus.

  • Comfortable with CMake/colcon builds and Git on Linux.

  • Experience with real-time robot control and an understanding of soft real-time constraints on Linux (scheduling, latency, threading).

  • Fluent English, our working language.

Nice to have

  • Industrial arms, especially Denso SCARA (b-CAP, RC8) or Universal Robots.

  • Optimal-control frameworks such as acados or CasADi; control barrier functions.

  • MoveIt 2 or Ruckig for motion planning.

  • Docker, GitLab CI and automated testing (GoogleTest, launch_testing).

  • DDS or Zenoh tuning and multi-robot setups.

  • Debugging tools such as RViz, Foxglove, PlotJuggler or Nsight Systems.

  • Field deployment with systemd, tmux and shell scripting.

  • Basic German.

What we offer

  • Real fields from your first season. Your code runs on our machines on farms in Germany.

  • Short way from code to robot. New ideas usually run on the real machine within a few days.

  • A problem worth solving. Green asparagus is still harvested entirely by hand.

  • A small, motivated team that gets a lot done together. When you join, we're 8 full-time, plus 2 interns and a working student.

  • Open culture, flat hierarchies. We are still early, so your opinion counts in technical decisions.

  • Lunch and coffee together in the kitchen in our hall.

  • Employee stock options.

How to apply

Send your CV and a few lines on a robotics project you built on real hardware (links to code welcome) via the "Apply now" button. Please include your earliest start date, salary expectations and vegetable you want to automate next.

description:

We are looking for a Data Scientist to own one question for the team: can we trust this map, and if not, where in the chain did it go wrong? Every measurement, in our lab or at a customer, gets a verdict and a reason. You build the checks that produce it, keep the catalogue of known artifacts and reference measurements behind it, and make it automatic for the routine cases so that your judgement goes to the hard ones. When a check fails, you trace it to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not. Our Applications engineers, who run the customer projects, rely on your verdict for what reaches the customer. A senior data scientist on the team backs you on the hard calls at the start; the aim is that you become the owner of this question.

This is a hands-on analysis role, not a research position: the data is real, the chain is in daily use, and every improvement you make shows up in the next measurement. Your background does not need to be in quantum sensing or semiconductors: if you have learned to tell signal from noise, calibration errors and artifacts in another demanding measurement system, we want to hear from you.

 

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

What will you do

  • Build the checks, from raw quantum sensor signal to field map, that tell a trustworthy measurement from a measurement or reconstruction artifact, on lab and customer data alike.

  • Trace a failed check to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not.

  • Keep the catalogue of known artifacts and the set of reference measurements that make every new verdict faster and more defensible.

  • Validate the team's evaluation methods against simulation and reference measurements before they go into daily use.

  • Give our Applications Engineers and the team a clear verdict on each measurement, and feed what breaks back into the next generation of the QDm.

 

What is expected of you

  • 3+ years of professional experience outside academia applying data science to measurement or imaging data from physical instruments.

  • A degree in physics, electrical engineering, applied mathematics or a related discipline; a PhD is welcome, not required.

  • Solid statistics and signal or image processing: you ask where a signal comes from, tell it from noise and systematics, and show it with numbers.

  • Fluency in Python and the scientific stack, with version control and tests as a habit.

  • AI coding agents are part of how you work, and you check their output the way you check your own.

Experience with magnetic or electromagnetic measurements or semiconductor failure analysis is a plus. What we cannot teach on the job is rigor with real measurement data and the habit of turning one analysis into a method the team can reuse, and that is exactly what we want you to bring.

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing.
