title: Finance Manager (w/d/m)
description:
Finance Manager (m/w/d)

Berlin · Vor Ort · Unbefristet · So bald wie möglich

About

LIFTED is a strength training company from Berlin. We operate several studios across the city and are opening in Munich, Hamburg, Cologne, and Düsseldorf next. We’re set to become the largest fitness company in Europe. The founding team has built and scaled a fitness company before, and we run this one owner-led, with decisions made quickly and close to the work. If that sounds like your kind of place, we’d like to meet you.

Über die Rolle

Du wirst die erste Person bei LIFTED, die sich voll um Finance kümmert. Bisher macht das Carl, Co-Founder und Geschäftsführer, neben allem anderen. Ab jetzt baust du den Bereich mit ihm auf.

Heute haben wir sechs Studios, bis Ende 2027 werden es rund 20, in mehreren Städten. Jede Eröffnung bringt einen Business Case, ein Budget, eine Finanzierung und neue Zahlen im Monatsabschluss. Weil du direkt mit Carl arbeitest, siehst du all das aus erster Hand.

Du startest im Tagesgeschäft: Zahlungsverkehr, Monatsabschluss, Liquidität, Planung. Sobald das sauber läuft, übernimmst du mehr, bis hin zu FP&A, Business Cases für neue Studios und Finanzierung.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Steuerbüro, unserem Admin-Team, dem Expansion-Team und den City Managern zusammen.

Aufgaben

Finance Operations
Du verantwortest den Zahlungsverkehr inklusive Gehaltslauf, Leasing und Kautionen. Die Vorkontierung macht unser Admin-Team nach klaren Regeln. Du kennst die Logik dahinter, prüfst Stichproben, klärst neue Fälle und entwickelst die Regeln in Moss weiter.

Monatsabschluss & Reporting
Du bereitest den Monatsabschluss mit unserem Steuerbüro vor, grenzt Umsätze von Partnern wie Urban Sports Club und Trainerkosten ab und prüfst die BWA. Daraus erstellst du in Helu ein monatliches Reporting pro Studio und gleichst Plan und Ist ab.

Planung & Liquidität
Du pflegst unsere Planung, die nach BWA-Konten und Kostenstellen aufgebaut ist, und hältst sie bei neuen Studios und Änderungen aktuell. Du planst die Liquidität rollierend und bereitest die Unterlagen für Banken und Partner vor.

HR-Administration
Vorerst kümmerst du dich auch um Personalstammdaten, Arbeitsverträge und die Vorbereitung der Payroll.

Was du Schritt für Schritt übernimmst
Mit wachsender Erfahrung übernimmst du FP&A: Budget, Forecast und Szenarien, etwa wenn sich bei einem neuen Studio Miete oder Eröffnungstermin ändern. Du rechnest Business Cases für neue Standorte, bevor wir unterschreiben. Du bereitest Finanzierungsgespräche vor und führst sie zunehmend mit.

Qualifikation

  • Ausbildung: Abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL, VWL, Finance oder einem ähnlichen Fach.

  • Berufserfahrung: 2–4 Jahre in Finance, idealerweise in einem Startup oder schnell wachsenden Unternehmen.

  • Antrieb: Du willst schneller lernen, als es dein bisheriger Job zulässt, und übernimmst Verantwortung, bevor dich jemand darum bittet.

  • Setup: Du kennst das Zusammenspiel aus vorbereitender Buchhaltung, externem Steuerbüro und DATEV und hast schon mit SKR03 oder SKR04 gearbeitet.

  • Tools: Du arbeitest sicher in Excel. Erfahrung mit Moss, Helu oder ähnlichen Tools ist ein Plus.

  • Hands-on: Du packst operative Themen selbst an und baust Abläufe so, dass sie ohne dich laufen.

  • Business-Interesse: Du willst verstehen, warum eine Zahl so ist, wie sie ist.

  • Sprachen: Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch (C2) und sicher Englisch.

  • Standort: Du lebst in Berlin (oder bist bereit umzuziehen).

Benefits

  • Direkt mit den Foundern: Du reportest direkt an Carl und bist seine rechte Hand bei allen Finance-Themen, mit voller Transparenz über die Zahlen. Du bekommst so viel Verantwortung, wie du übernehmen kannst, und wie weit das geht, liegt an dir.

  • Steile Lernkurve: Du lernst alle Bereiche von Finance kennen, vom Zahlungsverkehr über FP&A bis zur Finanzierung.

  • Coaching: Du lernst von einem Gründerteam, das schon einmal ein Fitnessunternehmen aufgebaut hat, und direkt von Carl. Wir setzen auf dich, fordern dich und helfen dir, schnell besser zu werden.

  • Solides Fundament: Ein profitables Geschäft, das schnell wächst.

  • Berlin HQ: Unser Büro im Prenzlauer Berg (Senefelder Platz).

  • Becoming Stronger: Eine kostenlose, unbegrenzte Mitgliedschaft für alle LIFTED Studios.

  • Team Spirit: Regelmäßige Teamevents wie Padel, BBQs und Trainer-Partys.


Wir schätzen deine Zeit. Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns deinen CV und eine kurze Notiz (3–5 Sätze) zu dem, worauf du in deiner bisherigen Finance-Arbeit am meisten stolz bist.

Du hast die ersten Jahre in Finance hinter dir und Lust, jetzt richtig was zu reißen? Dann bewirb dich.

title: Broker Development Manager
description:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

THE ROLE 

Our brokers play a crucial role in making this a reality. We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger. You’ll use AI day to day, from researching brokers to preparing for meetings, so more of your time goes on the conversations that win business. We’re looking for an ambitious and passionate Broker Development Manager to accelerate our distribution through brokers. In this role, you’ll maximise existing broker relationships and build strong, strategic, growth partnerships as part of our fast-paced distribution team right at the heart of Flock’s mission.

WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE:

Be a part of building something truly game changing in the fleet market. You’ll manage a panel of key strategic brokers with significant growth opportunities. You’ll engage them on the market-leading benefits of Flock’s connected fleet proposition, and how together, we can reduce risk, improve costs and save lives. You’ll also have real freedom in how you use AI to work, whether that’s getting under the skin of a broker’s book before a meeting or spotting growth opportunities across your panel.

A LITTLE MORE ON WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

  • Act as a primary face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners, driving mutual growth and long-term success.

  • Deliver high volumes of broker submissions, directly supporting Flock’s ambitious growth targets.

  • Build, grow and develop our broker panel, onboarding new partners at pace and maximising their commercial potential.

  • Proactively engage brokers, finding new and creative ways to promote Flock’s appetite and proposition as we expand into new sectors.

  • Develop and execute clear, data-driven account growth strategies to drive sustained performance.

  • Achieve strong conversion and retention by supporting day-to-day trading activity and helping brokers (and Flock) win and retain business.

  • Work closely with internal teams, collaborating with brilliant Flockers across the business to deliver shared growth objectives.

  • Maintain strong broker advocacy by being visible, responsive and passionate about Flock’s product, proposition and mission.

  • Use AI in your day-to-day work, from broker research and meeting prep to analysing your pipeline, so your time goes on relationships rather than admin.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO FLOCK:

ESSENTIAL

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in managing broker relationships within the insurance sector, possessing a reputable standing in the industry.

  • Energy and innovation in abundance - the ability to work fast, spot opportunity and solve problems. 

  • A proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, driving business growth, and closely collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve collective objectives.

  • An existing network of broker contacts that will enable a rapid integration and immediate impact within Flock’s business development realm.

  • Exceptional understanding of the commercial broker marketplace, competitor carriers, broker business models, and processes.

  • Ability to deliver a consultative sales process, aligning Flock’s value proposition with brokers’ current and future business needs.

  • Comfortable using AI in your daily work, from research and meeting prep to account analysis, and curious about where else it could help you win business.

PREFERABLE

  • Experience building networks of brokers in a Commercial Motor Fleet setting. 

  • Have a broker distribution background with an active panel of brokers in the commercial insurance market. 

  • Can embrace new technologies and products, with experience of successfully distributing these to brokers.

WHAT WE OFFER (in addition to a competitive salary)

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖 

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

ONE LAST THING..

Authenticity is important to us. We value the unique qualities and experiences you bring. So if you apply, just be your genuine self. It’s who we want!

title: Brand Marketing Lead
description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Brand Marketing Lead to join our Brand & Marketing team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help own our brand marketing strategy and campaign execution across six European markets and be part of our marketing team as we scale our spend management platform. If you're excited about building category-defining campaigns that move Pleo from a good solution to the undisputed choice for mid-market finance leaders and are passionate about brand strategy and creative execution, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to the Director of Integrated Marketing, and work in close collaboration with the Director of Brand Experience and Strategy, as well as the Brand Intelligence Manager, our brand foundations team, PR, content marketing and digital channels team. You’ll partner cross-functionally with PMM, MOPS, CX and sales. This is a hands-on, IC role, where you'll do both the thinking and the work—strategy and execution both sit with you.

What you’ll be doing

As a Brand Marketing Lead, you will:

  • Own the brand marketing strategy that moves Pleo from ‘one of many’ to the undisputed choice for mid-market European finance leaders.

  • Build and execute integrated brand campaigns from concept through to reporting — learning from what we’ve just launched, and pushing further.

  • Create branded content that shows how financial services should be done. Content that recognizes the precision, rigor, and craft that finance leaders bring to their work.

  • Manage the funnel strategically — balancing awareness, consideration, and conversion. Not just fishing in the pond of people who already know us, but earning the right to speak to people we don’t know yet.

  • Own your budget and agency relationships — you’re the strategic partner they answer to.

  • Measure what matters — working with Brand Intelligence, Integrated Marketing, Data, and MOps to track brand lift, earned media, consideration, and how brand work flows into pipeline and revenue.

  • Set the benchmark for brand work in fintech — prove that category-defining campaigns come from strategic rigor and creative excellence working together. You’ll establish Pleo as the model for how brands should think about their audience, and show that understanding someone better than anyone else is a more powerful differentiator than any feature.

What you bring


You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 10+ years in brand marketing (B2B or fintech might be helpful, but we care more about the thinking than the category)

  • A portfolio of work that shows you’ve led campaigns from strategy through to execution — ideally integrated campaigns that work across multiple channels

  • Strong stakeholder management skills — you can influence a room, sell an idea, and push back when something isn’t working

  • Strategic thinking + execution mindset — you’re equally comfortable building a 6-month brand strategy and getting your hands dirty on day-to-day campaign work

  • Comfort with ambiguity and pace — this is a growing company, and things move fast. You thrive in that

  • Understanding of how brand and pipeline connect — you know that brand campaigns need to serve business growth, not just awareness

  • A point of view on category dynamics — you can look at a market and spot where everyone’s getting it wrong

  • A strong understanding for when/how to localise concepts, messaging & GTM campaigns across different markets.

  • Fluency in one or more of our European markets is a bonus (not required, but helpful)

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You want to reframe an entire category's conversation by competing on human insight rather than just feature parity.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, autonomous environment where you can build campaigns that serve as a 5-year foundation.

  • You believe brand strategy must be grounded in audience understanding and directly drive business outcomes.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer purely high-level strategy without getting hands-on with day-to-day campaign execution.

  • You operate best in rigid, highly structured environments with slow moving pace and minimal ambiguity.

  • You view brand marketing in isolation from performance data, pipeline metrics, and commercial growth.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Map customer journeys across SMB, mid-market, and enterprise segments to identify brand opportunities.

  • Develop a comprehensive European brand roadmap that builds on recent launch momentum.

  • Develop a comprehensive European brand roadmap that builds on recent launch momentum.

The location


Please note: We can hire on a hybrid set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience

  3. Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role

  4. Final Interview: A final interview with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for this role, we received a total vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: VP of Data
description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

Why this role, why now

12,000+ companies trust Perk with their travel and spend, and we've brought both together in one intelligent platform. Every booking, expense and invoice adds to a wealth of data at your fingertips, and now is the moment to enable teams to use this data intelligently to power better decisions, precise reporting, and to create cost and time savings for our customers. Come lead the team that makes all of this possible.

The Role

Data is at the core of Perk's innovation and the backbone of how we will evolve our products using new technology. As our VP of Data, you'll step into one of the most influential leadership roles in Builders (Data, Product, Design, Engineering) with a direct hand in shaping Perk's strategy and success, and we scale our multi product platform.

Reporting to our President of Product and Technology, you'll lead a 40+ person organisation, with a remit that spans our Travel, Spend, and Events products. This role also spans our core functions and drives the business, including Customer Care, Marketing, Finance, Revenue and People. You'll join a strong, talented team with a clear mandate to shape how we create exceptional products at Perk, using our proprietary data.

Across travel, spend, and events, Perk holds a wealth of data that touches every booking, expense, invoice and payment. Your opportunity is to reshape it so it powers smarter, more intelligent products that keep us on the cutting edge of what is possible.

This is a role for a data leader who thrives in fast-paced environments, scales high-performing organisations through senior leaders, and has the technical credibility to go deep when it matters. You'll join a top-notch leadership team where we elevate each other, build shared strategies and win together. You'll help define how we grow and make decisions, with accountability for data across the whole company.

Your team

You’ll lead a talented, collaborative and innovative team who are excellent at what they do. They span seven crafts: Data Product Partners, Reporting Analytics, Data Analytics, Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science and Data Governance. Together they power the work the business relies on every day, and they’re ready to take data to its next stage of scale with you.

Your missions

  1. Strategy and Roadmap. More than ever data informs everything we do and is core to the AI native products that we build. You’ll own the long term vision and strategy for data architecture, analytics, predictive modeling, and AI product integration. Work hand in hand with Product, Engineering and Platform teams across Perk to turn machine learning and advanced analytics into products customers love.

  2. Set the standard for trust. Own data governance, privacy and compliance, so security and regulatory requirements are built in from the start. Partner with our AI leadership to make sure the data behind every AI product is trusted, so everything we build earns customer confidence.

  3. Build a data platform we rely on. Run data infrastructure like a flagship product: governed, reliable, built for scale from day one. You own the budget and the build, buy and prioritisation calls.

  4. Lead with conviction. Unify the craft, standards and roadmap across teams so data speaks with one voice, and anticipates questions before they're asked. Be the data voice alongside Product, Engineering, Finance, Customer Care, Marketing, Revenue and People.

  5. Grow leaders who grow the business. Coach your senior leaders, shape the operating model and org design, attract top talent, and build a culture of ownership, autonomy and measurable results.

What success looks like

  • Data is the foundation of products that know our customers and anticipate what they need: personalised experiences, smarter recommendations and proactive insights, so they get answers before they have to ask.

  • You've built a high-performing, trusted data organisation that delivers measurable value across the business so all functions use and trust the data to shape decisions, inform strategy and change how we work, well beyond reporting.

  • Your teams operate with clear priorities, solid infrastructure and real ownership, and what they ship is core to our business and our success.

description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world, processing 25+ trillion data points annually across thousands of connected devices. The Samsara Application Security team protects this vast footprint end-to-end, spanning cloud services, internal systems, and firmware running on IoT hardware in the field.

As a Staff Application Security Engineer, you'll drive the overarching technical direction for our application security and vulnerability management programs. This is a high-visibility role where you'll influence a broad surface area while retaining the flexibility to dive deep into critical domain focus areas as security priorities evolve.

This is a remote position, open to candidates residing in the UK. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, and countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team - from Finance to HR - to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

With a team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

Reporting to the CISO, you'll own the security roadmap for Pigment's product, infrastructure, and CI/CD environment, and you'll build much of it yourself.

This is a hands-on role: expect to read code, threat model new services, reproduce and triage vulnerabilities, dig through infrastructure configuration and build the automation that closes gaps.

You'll also set direction and bring product and engineering with you, but that influence comes from technical credibility and not process: the engineers you work with will take you seriously because you've been in the same code they have.

The scope is broad: application security, infrastructure security, detection and response, and the assurance work that keeps our certifications standing. You won't be covering it alone. The security team is seven people and growing, with colleagues already owning compliance, governance and security operations, so this role can go deep on product and infrastructure and not be spread too thin across everything. Nobody arrives fluent in all of it: we're looking for real depth in several of these areas and the judgement to grow into the rest.


Key responsibilities include:

  • Product & Infrastructure Security Design - Design security features into the product itself and strengthen defence-in-depth across the platform. Threat model new services before they ship, and make the architectural calls that are expensive to reverse later.

  • Security Review & Risk Assessment - Review code, architecture and configuration yourself, and be the person developers and PMs bring problems to early rather than late. Deliver solutions that balance risk against business benefit, and escalate the calls that genuinely need senior arbitration.

  • Assurance & Testing - Run our assurance programme: internal code, architecture and configuration reviews, red team exercises, and the bug bounty. Own the relationship with third-party auditors, and measure the control KPIs that keep our certifications defensible.

  • Vulnerability Management - Own vulnerabilities from detection through to verified fix: reproduce them, score and triage them, design or validate the mitigation, and confirm it actually worked. Improve the KPIs that tell you whether the process is holding.

  • Detection Engineering - Build and improve our detection capability alongside the infrastructure and engineering teams: identify the signals worth collecting, write rules that catch real attacks without drowning us in noise, and build the response playbooks behind them.

  • Incident Response - Lead security investigations into the production environment end to end, from first signal to root cause, across incidents and fraud. Flag the repetitive work worth automating and the detections worth building, and hand those to the security operations team.

  • SDLC - Set the technical direction for how engineers at Pigment build securely: guidance, paved paths, and reviews that teach and not just gate. Contribute to company-wide awareness where it counts, but your primary audience is product, engineering and SRE.

 

Example projects that would fall under your responsibilities (actual examples of recently completed or currently on the roadmap):

  • Secure the design and development of our AI features, including the MCP Server and Modeler Agent: threat modelling, design reviews, working alongside the engineers building them, and security assessments. 

  • Work out where AI-assisted analysis actually belongs in our pipeline. AI-powered security reviews reason about a diff semantically rather than pattern-matching it, which is genuinely different from classic SAST - but it's not a drop-in replacement, and figuring out the split between AI review, traditional SAST and SCA is an open question we'd like you to answer with evidence rather than vendor claims.

  • Migrate GitHub to managed identities: provisioning through Okta, retiring personal accounts and long-lived PATs, and moving CI to short-lived OIDC credentials instead of stored keys.

  • Design agent identity for the MCP Server - delegated access tokens, token exchange, and making sure an agent acting for a user can never exceed what that user could do themselves.

  • Push least privilege further across production and CI/CD. Better than it was, not where we want it.

For a concrete example: here's how we built a sandboxed execution environment for LLM-generated code.

Technical Environment

Mostly production, with the occasional internal IT-adjacent project: 

  • Main sites in Paris, London, Toronto and NYC 

  • MacOS, Windows, Linux workstations

  • GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, Postgres, SingleStore, Vault

  • Okta, OAuth, JWT, C#, .NET Core, TypeScript, React, Python, Go

  • Datadog (SIEM), CloudFlare ZTNA, Falco, Wiz, Riot, HackerOne, TruffleHog

  • Google Workspace, Jumpcloud, Vanta, Hibob, Slack

  • GitHub, CircleCI, ArgoCD

  • SOC 1, SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, ISO 42001

Who you are

You have at least 8 years of experience in security as a Security Engineer, Pentester or Security consultant, with real depth in product and/or infrastructure security. We care more about the scope of what you've owned than the exact number of years.

What you've done

  • Owned a security roadmap for a product or platform end to end, rather than delivering items on someone else's

  • Driven security work through engineering teams you had no authority over

  • Been the person your organisation escalated to on hard architectural calls

  • Worked hands-on across a broad technical surface - development, databases, networking, web

How you work

  • You're hands-on and intend to stay that way (this position does not include people management)

  • You look for the workable answer, not the blocking one

  • You have a good dose of humility, and you help the people around you get better

  • You speak English fluently, French is a strong plus


How we hire

After a first call with our recruiter, five conversations, around four hours in total, usually over two to three weeks:

  1. Ways of working (45 min) — how you operate with people, and what draws you to this role specifically.

  2. Technical deep dive (1h30) with a security engineer — including a practical. We'll give you a real problem we've already solved and talk through how you'd approach it.

  3. Cross-functional (45 min) with an engineer from product or platform — someone who'd be on the receiving end of your work.

  4. Ownership and career (1h) with the CISO and a member of the security team.

  5. Final (45 min) with our co-founder and CTO.

title: UX/UI Designer (H/F)
description:
A PROPOS DU POSTE

Chez Winamax, nos parcours utilisateurs ne se limitent pas à des formulaires d'inscription ou des tunnels d'achat classiques. Qu'il s'agisse de nos fonctionnalités de Paris Sportifs, de nos tables de Poker, de nos opérations promotionnelles ou de nos mécaniques gamifiées, nous créons des interfaces transactionnelles à fort impact visuel et émotionnel.

Pour soutenir la croissance de nos produits, nous renforçons nos équipes de design produit et recherchons des UI/UX Designers

Ton pari au quotidien ? Rendre l'UX tellement évidente qu'elle s'oublie, et l'UI tellement bluffante qu'elle se remarque.

DESCRIPTIF DU POSTE

Nous recherchons un Profil UI/UX Crafter, focalisé sur la fluidité d’intéractions complexes, l'impact visuel, la typographie, la scénarisation des promotions événementielles et la finition graphique haute fidélité. 
 

 sous la responsabilité du manager UX/UI, tu seras un des garants du niveau d'exigence visuel et ergonomique de nos applications :

  • UI Craft & Direction Artistique applicative : Concevoir des interfaces mobile first à forte valeur créative pour nos produits et nos opérations promotionnelles gamifiées.
  • Optimisation des parcours transactionnels : Fluidifier les étapes clés (recherche, prise de pari, inscription, jeu et interactions, mécaniques de récompense) sans sacrifier le plaisir visuel ni l'immersion.
  • Micro-interactions & Polish : Imaginer les micro-animations et retours visuels qui apportent du dynamisme aux actions des utilisateurs (feedbacks de validation, victoires, animations d’interactions).
  • Design System & Scalabilité : Enrichir, structurer et maintenir nos composants et tokens (Figma, variables, auto-layout) pour garantir une parfaite cohérence entre produits.
  • Prototypage Haute Fidélité : Créer des maquettes interactives pour tester l'ergonomie, la hiérarchie visuelle et le comportement des fonctionnalités avant intégration.
  • Collaboration & Recette "Pixel Perfect" : Travailler au quotidien en squad avec les PM, Graphistes, Animateurs et Développeurs pour garantir une intégration rigoureuse et fidèle aux maquettes.
 

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

Nous cherchons des designers capables d'allier rigueur UX applicative et excellence visuelle. Le portfolio est le cœur de ta candidature.

Ce qui fera la différence :

  • Sensibilité visuelle et UI affirmée : Maîtrise avancée de la hiérarchie visuelle, des grilles, de la typographie, de la couleur et de la mise en valeur de contenus événementiels (tu ne crées pas la DA mais l’écrin des diverses opérations).
  • Culture Web & Mobile Product : Une solide connaissance des standards ergonomiques sur iOS, Android et Web Responsive, nourrie par une veille constante (Mobbin, Awwwards, Dribbble).
  • Culture B2C et entertainment : Passionné de sport, de poker, des paris sportifs ou du jeu au sens large, tu dois respirer le gameplay.
  • Sens du détail et du Craft : Obsession du pixel perfect, des micro-feedbacks visuels et de l'exécution soignée.

    • Compétences requises :

  • Maîtrise experte de Figma (variables, tokens, auto-layout, composants complexes).
  • Gestion handsoff (specs de composants, détails de feature, déclinaisons d’états…)
  • Esprit mobile-first et compréhension des contraintes d'intégration (Full React).
  • Capacité à équilibrer créativité visuelle et contraintes de conversion / UX transactionnelle.
  • Appétence pour les nouveaux outils d'assistance au design (Agent figma, Claude Design, Cursor, Paper...).
  • Savoir travailler en mode squad comme en mode commando au sein d'un univers vivant et passionné.

    • CE QUE TON PORTFOLIO DOIT MONTRER

    Pour retenir notre attention, ton portfolio est obligatoire et doit comporter :

  • Des maquettes UI d'applications web/mobiles montrant une grande maturité visuelle et une DA soignée.
  • Des exemples de parcours complexes ou d'interfaces événementielles/gamifiées.
  • Des prototypes ou vidéos montrant le travail sur les micro-interactions et les animations d'interface.

    • MODALITÉS ASSOCIÉES AU POSTE
  • Poste à pourvoir en CDI temps plein (35h/semaine) exclusivement
  • Semaine en 4 jours
  • Lieu de travail : Paris intra-muros
  • Date de démarrage : ASAP
  • Rémunération selon le profil
  • Modalités de travail exclues : mi-temps, freelance, job étudiant, contrat en alternance

    • PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT
    Nous vous prions de bien vouloir joindre un portfolio à votre candidature ; cette étape est obligatoire.
  • Visio RH
  • Test technique
  • Entretien en présentiel avec 2 membres de l'équipe 
  • Entretien en présentiel avec Franck ( Responsable UX/UI) et Mathieu (Directeur Création & Marque)

title: STAGE - UX/UI Designer (H/F)
description:
Basés en plein cœur de Paris, nous faisons bouger l’industrie des jeux en ligne. Leader du poker et des paris sportifs en France avec 350 000 joueurs et 600 000 parieurs mensuels, nous sommes présents en Espagne, en Allemagne et bientôt en Italie et au Portugal. Nous offrons à nos joueurs une expérience exceptionnelle, à la fois technique, créative et qualitative. Innovation, unité et appartenance : nos valeurs façonnent une culture d’entreprise multiculturelle et unique.
 
Et si tu avais un futur dans le jeu ?
 
Techniquement, Winamax c’est :
  • Un moteur de jeu puissant et innovant : adaptation dynamique de l'offre de jeu, parties de poker hautement configurables, détection de fraude
  • Une architecture distribuée et scalable conçue pour traiter en temps réel les flux de la plateforme
  • Une plateforme modulaire soumise à des contraintes de haute disponibilité et de sécurisation des données, capable de gérer de fortes audience

À PROPOS DU POSTE

Chez Winamax, nos parcours utilisateurs ne se limitent pas à des formulaires d'inscription ou des tunnels d'achat classiques. Qu'il s'agisse de nos fonctionnalités de Paris Sportifs, de nos tables de Poker, de nos opérations promotionnelles ou de nos mécaniques gamifiées, nous créons des interfaces transactionnelles à fort impact visuel et émotionnel.

 

DESCRIPTIF DU STAGE

 
Accompagné par nos designers produits, tu seras pleinement intégré aux réflexions produit et au design des fonctionnalités Poker : 
  • UI Craft : concevoir et sublimer les interfaces de l'écosystème Poker sur desktop et mobile (Lobby de tournois, tables de jeu, mini-jeux promotionnels et challenges Poker). 
  • Ergonomie & Parcours Joueur : fluidifier les parcours transactionnels et d'engagement (inscription aux événements, gestion de types de jeu, filtres de recherche de tables, suivi de progression…).
  • Design System & Scalabilité : contribuer à la structuration et à l'enrichissement du Design System Poker (tokens, variables, auto-layout) pour garantir une parfaite cohérence Mobile et Desktop.
  • Intégration & Recette : préparer des livrables "Ready to dev" clairs et participer à la recette graphique en squad avec les développeurs front et PM. 

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ
Tu prépares un Master 2 / Diplôme de Designer (Bac+5) au sein d'une Grande École de Design, et tu cherches ton stage de fin d'études pour exprimer ton talent de concepteur sur un produit à fort trafic et iconique.
 
 
Ce qui fera la différence sur ta candidature :
  •  Un niveau de Craft UI exceptionnel : maîtrise pointue de la hiérarchie visuelle, de la typographie, des grilles, de la couleur et du traitement du détail (iconographie, effets de texture/profondeur applicatifs).
  • Connaissance ou passion pour le Poker : tu comprends le vocabulaire, les règles, la dynamique d'une table et le comportement des joueurs? Ou tu as une immense curiosité pour l'univers du jeu et de la compétition (ça s’apprend vite).
  • Maîtrise des outils modernes : figma sur le bout des doigts (variables, composants complexes, auto-layout). 
  • Culture Mobile & Product : une veille quotidienne et exigeante sur les meilleures pratiques UX/UI (Mobbin, Awwwards, Dribbble). 
    •  
    CE QUE TON PORTFOLIO DOIT MONTRER
     
    Pour ce poste, ton portfolio est l'élément n°1 d'évaluation. Il doit comporter à minima un projet UX/UI mobile first montrant une grande maturité graphique et un réel souci du détail, des exemples de parcours interactifs, d'interfaces événementielles ou de mécaniques gamifiées.
    Des prototypes animés ou extraits vidéo illustrant ton travail sur les micro-interactions sont un plus. 

    MODALITÉS ASSOCIÉES AU STAGE
  • Stage de fin d'étude (Bac +5), basé à Paris intra-muros
  • Durée : 6 mois
  • Démarrage : Janvier/février 2027

  • Entretien final avec le futur maître de stage, Valérian et Franck, le Manager de l’équipe Product Design

    • Chez Winamax, nos processus de recrutement durent en moyenne 2 à 4 semaines.

    En plus de notre univers poker et paris sportifs, nous avons d’autres avantages !

Sales at Ashby is a unique opportunity to sell a product customers genuinely love during an AI-fueled market expansion. Over 5,000 companies rely on Ashby, including OpenAI, Doctolib, Alan, Mistral and Monday.com, and our business is durably growing faster than 100% year-over-year. We’re well funded, and on a path to profitability. That's exceptionally rare for a company at our scale, and puts us in the top 10% of benchmarks.

Nearly 1 in 3 of Ashby’s globally distributed team call Europe home! We’ve landed over 1000 customers in EMEA representing ~23% of our global revenue base,with well over 100 in France, clear evidence of strong product-market fit. We’re doubling down our investment in the region with in-market GTM, CS and Support resources. EU Data Residency and product localisation are committed and coming soon. We believe there is a meaningful opportunity to help modern teams move beyond legacy recruiting software.

Ashby replaces 3-5 tools in a consolidation & efficiency play that’s equally loved by recruiters and CFOs. We’re known as a clear AI-leader in the recruiting space. We are rapidly extending from a best-in-class recruiting product toward a multi-product platform, expanding upmarket, into new industries, and internationally. For sales reps, that means a large market full of legacy tools, and a product portfolio that creates room for both new business and expansion. This is a chance to participate in how a category-defining company wins in its next phase of growth.

We are equally intentional about how we build the business. We have established a remote-first, high-performing sales organization that rewards learning and accountability. We use data to set achievable quotas, and reward sustained impact with competitive compensation and meaningful upside. We prioritize coaching and career development, with AEs advancing to Enterprise & Leadership roles in just a few years — 38% of the team who have been here more than a year have been promoted or taken on a new role!

We are seeking a French-fluent Mid-Market Account Executive to help us win Mid-Market accounts (100-1k employees) by managing the full sales cycle from pipeline generation through to closed-won.

In this role, you'll focus on new logo acquisition. Our emphasis is on your raw ability to excel in the areas listed below and your appetite for continuous growth & improvement.

  • ⏱️ You leverage tools to maximize the impact of your prospecting and selling time. You believe in research and personalization to spark a conversation.

  • ⚙️ You are at home managing a pipeline of a dozen or more active opportunities concurrently. You take pride in internal operations, including real-time CRM updates.

  • ✈️ You are willing to travel at least 25% of the time for customer engagements and events.

  • 🤝 You have 2+ years of full-cycle closing experience and have closed many >$50,000 ACV opportunities

  • 📢 You have experience selling complex platform technologies in a sales-led GTM motion

title: Senior AI Support Engineer (Paris)
description:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

The role

Support at Dust is not a cost center. It is one of the most important product surfaces we own.

As a Senior AI Support Engineer, you will help define what world-class support looks like in an AI-native company. You will not just resolve tickets. You will own the systems, agents, workflows, and feedback loops that make support better, faster, and more scalable over time.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who has already operated close to support strategy, technical escalation, user experience, and automation. You should be excited by the idea of taking recurring customer pain and turning it into durable systems: better agents, better documentation, better internal tooling, sharper product feedback, and fewer repeat issues.

The best person for this role is not a traditional support leader who wants to manage a queue from a distance. It is someone with strong technical instincts, a deep user mindset, and a track record of building support systems that change how a team operates.

You might be a great fit if you have built an AI-powered support function, owned support tooling at scale, worked deeply with LLMs or automation, or carried a support strategy from problem discovery through implementation and measurement.

What you will own

Building the AI systems that make support scale

You will design, build, and continuously improve the AI-powered systems that help Dust support customers with speed and quality. This includes agents for ticket classification, auto-acknowledgement, response drafting, internal routing, proactive incident detection, knowledge retrieval, and escalation support.

You will identify categories of recurring issues and engineer them out of the support queue. Sometimes that means building a better Dust agent. Sometimes it means improving documentation, creating an internal tool, tightening a workflow, writing a script, or escalating product feedback upstream with enough context for engineering to act.

You will be expected to measure whether the systems you build actually improve the user experience. Seniority here means not just shipping tooling, but knowing what good looks like, instrumenting it, and iterating until the impact is visible.

Running complex support when the systems fall short

You will still be close to the work. You will investigate complex customer issues across logs, code, internal tooling, product behavior, and agent outputs. You will provide clear, accurate answers to customers, including when the underlying issue is ambiguous or technically complex.

You will handle escalated cases with precision and judgment, communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical users. You should be comfortable translating between customer language, product behavior, engineering detail, and business impact.

When AI-generated responses are incomplete, inconsistent, or wrong, you will debug the system behind them. You will improve prompts, knowledge sources, workflows, routing, tooling, and escalation paths so that the same failure mode does not repeat.

Shaping the support strategy

You will help define how Dust should run support as we scale. That means thinking beyond the queue and owning the full loop: what customers experience, what support sees, what agents can handle, what engineering needs to fix, and what product should learn.

You will translate repeated customer pain into high-quality product signal. You will build strong working relationships with engineers and product teams so escalations are high-context, actionable, and efficient.

You will also help raise the bar for how the support function operates: what we measure, how we prioritize, how we review quality, how we onboard junior team members, and how we decide what should be automated versus handled by a human.

What we are looking for

Every candidate and employee’s success at Dust is measured against the same three dimensions: Aptitude, Attitude, and Agency.

Aptitude

You have strong technical depth. You are comfortable with APIs, web applications, logs, scripts, and internal tools. You can navigate a codebase, reason through product behavior, and troubleshoot systems without being stopped by a stack trace.

You have genuine AI fluency at builder level. You have built agents, automations, workflows, or internal tools using AI systems such as Dust, Cursor, Claude Code, n8n, GPT-4, Claude, Mistral, Gemini, or similar platforms. You are not just good at prompting. You understand how to turn AI into operational leverage.

You have experience operating at the strategy layer of support, not only at the ticket layer. You have owned or helped shape support systems, support tooling, escalation workflows, deflection strategy, knowledge management, or AI support operations.

You can balance technical accuracy with user experience. You care about whether the customer understood the answer, whether the product pain was addressed, and whether the issue will happen again.

You are able to communicate bidirectionally: clearly enough for customers, technically enough for engineers, and strategically enough for leadership.

Attitude

You combine resilience with empathy. This is a front-line role, and customer frustration is often direct and unfiltered. You do not take it personally, but you do take it seriously.

You are proactive rather than reactive. You do not wait for a perfect problem statement from the customer. You investigate, infer, clarify, and anticipate what they may need next.

You have strong prioritization judgment. You know what needs an immediate human response, what can be automated, what should be escalated, and what should become product feedback.

You are comfortable setting boundaries. You do not say yes to everything, and you can explain tradeoffs clearly in a way that builds trust rather than eroding it.

You care about the craft of support. You see support as a product experience, not a back-office function.

Agency

You turn patterns into systems. When you see the same issue twice, you start asking whether it should exist at all.

You go deep before escalating. You investigate as far as you reasonably can, so that when you involve engineering or product, they receive a clear problem statement, relevant evidence, and a useful recommendation.

You build without waiting for permission. If you see a gap in the support system, you are excited to prototype, test, and ship a better version.

You continuously improve your own workflows. You treat your time, your tools, and your operating system as things worth debugging.

You extract product opportunities from customer interactions. You do not let support signal disappear into a solved ticket. You close the loop.

What strong candidates may have done before

You may have:

  • Built or led an AI-powered support function

  • Designed support agents, internal copilots, escalation workflows, or deflection systems

  • Owned technical support tooling, support operations, or automation at a fast-growing software company

  • Worked as a senior support engineer, technical support engineer, developer support engineer, support ops engineer, solutions engineer, or implementation engineer

  • Built a support product, internal platform, AI startup, or automation-heavy support system

  • Operated in a high-volume environment where quality, speed, and judgment all mattered

We care more about the depth and relevance of your experience than the exact number of years. That said, we expect this role to be a fit for someone who has already spent several years close to technical support, support engineering, AI tooling, or support systems ownership.

What this role is not

This is not a traditional customer support role focused only on ticket resolution.

It is not a people-management role where you are far away from the technical work.

It is not a pure operations role where you optimize process without building.

It is not a role for someone who is curious about AI but has not yet built with it.

The person we are looking for should be excited to own the messy middle between customers, AI agents, internal tooling, engineering, and product.

Compensation and benefits

  • Competitive compensation

  • Significant equity package in a Sequoia-backed startup

  • Substantial relocation support, up to 10k€, including help finding an apartment in Paris and support with the visa process

  • Health insurance for you and your dependents

  • New MacBook Pro or Linux machine, monitor, keyboard, and equipment

  • Beautiful office in the heart of Paris

  • Opportunity to travel to the US multiple times a year

  • Regular team events and offsites

We can go higher for exceptional profiles.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

Compensation: €50K – €100K

  • Depending on experience • €50K – €100K

title: Global Sourcing Manager Electronics
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

Harmattan AI is seeking a Global Sourcing Manager Electronics to serve as a supply chain expert across electronic systems, including printed circuit boards (PCBs/PCBAs) and custom wire harnesses. In this strategic, high impact position, you will drive the procurement of essential parts, raw materials, and manufacturing services required to build our hardware. You will build resilient strategic supplier networks for emerging and legacy product lines, optimizing for technical capability, unit economics, and quality standards. Working closely with engineering, production, and business units, you will vet supplier capabilities, structure robust commercial terms, and proactively derisk a complex, rapidly scaling electronics supply chain.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and execute long term category roadmaps for PCBs, PCBAs, and cable harness assemblies, targeting cost optimization, quality control, supply resiliency, and full product lifecycle alignment.

  • Direct competitive bidding activities (RFIs, RFQs, RFPs) and strategic sourcing campaigns, maintaining ultimate accountability for part quality, timeline adherence, and target cost fulfillment.

  • Act as the primary relationship owner and escalation contact for Contract Manufacturers (CMs) and specialized board and harness fabricators, overseeing supply continuity, risk mitigation, price negotiations, and the transition from New Product Introduction (NPI) to full scale Mass Production (MP).

  • Collaborate with Hardware Engineering and manufacturing partners to refine design specifications, align production processes, and guide strategic CapEx and equipment investments.

  • Evaluate supplier quote structures through granular cost breakdown analysis, leveraging Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) models to guide procurement decisions.

  • Draft and settle commercial agreements, securing competitive unit pricing, favorable payment terms, and delivery schedules.

  • Work across internal functions to fulfill rapid prototyping needs, meet hardware build milestones, resolve technical bottlenecks, and integrate novel vendor technologies.

  • Lead operational initiatives around integrating new and adapted electronics technologies, delivering technical briefings and progress updates to executive leadership.

  • Establish vendor evaluation systems to track key performance metrics across quality, operational execution, cost variance, and continuous innovation.

Candidate Requirements

  • Educational Background: Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Relevant Experience: 6+ years of specialized experience managing electronic commodities (PCB/PCBA, custom cabling, wire harnesses) within a high tech sourcing or supply chain engineering environment.

  • Technical Aptitude: Advanced proficiency in Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) modeling and data driven vendor evaluation within complex hardware architectures.

  • Commodity Strategy: Demonstrated ability to craft clear commodity strategies in direct collaboration with engineering leadership.

  • Proven Leadership: Strong cross functional leadership skills, with a track record of driving alignment across diverse teams.

  • Adaptability & Mobility: Highly adaptable, hands on professional who thrives in a fast paced, dynamic environment, bridges operational gaps, and removes process friction.

  • Communication & Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, capable of engaging a wide range of stakeholders, from junior members to senior executives.

  • Sector Exposure: Prior exposure to defense, aerospace, automotive, or high reliability technology sectors is strongly preferred.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Cdi - Head Of Production Photos E-Commerce (H/F)
description:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS
 
Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).

Il/elle supervise l’ensemble de la chaîne de production, de la planification des shootings à la livraison des images finales, en 
passant par la sélection des équipes créatives et techniques, la gestion des budgets et des plannings, ainsi que le suivi de la post production, de la retouche et du contrôle qualité.

Garant(e) du rendu visuel et de la conformité des images produites, il/elle assure la fluidité des flux d’images, l’optimisation des budgets et la coordination des équipes internes et des prestataires externes.

Le poste combine une forte dimension opérationnelle et managériale, un rôle de pilotage budgétaire et une responsabilité creative dans la réalisation des supports visuels.

Pilotage de la production photographique e-commerce

  • Superviser les étapes de post-production et de retouche, en garantissant le respect des standards de qualité attendus
  • Être garant(e) du rendu visuel, de la cohérence et de la qualité des images diffusées sur le site

 

Direction artistique, sélection et édition des images

  • Assurer une sélection et une édition des images dès la phase de shooting, en fonction de la direction artistique définie, desbesoins de communication et de la mise en valeur des produits
  • Faire preuve d’un œil créatif affirmé afin d’identifier les images les plus pertinentes, tant sur le plan esthétique que dans leur capacité à valoriser le produit, sa coupe, sa matière et ses détails

  • Assurer le lien entre les besoins créatifs, les contraintes de production et les objectifs de livraison

 

Supervision de la post-production, de la retouche et des flux d’images

  • Piloter la retouche réalisée en interne et auprès de prestataires externes

Management et coordination des équipes

VOTRE PROFIL
 
 
Expertise métier
  • Expérience confirmée en production photographique, idéalement dans les secteurs de la mode, du luxe ou du retail
  • Maîtrise de l’organisation et du pilotage de shootings photo à forts volumes
  • Bonne connaissance de l’art buying et des réseaux de prestataires créatifs et techniques

  • Utilisation de l’IA comme levier d’optimisation des processus de production et de post-production
 
Pilotage et management

  • Maîtrise de la gestion budgétaire, de la planification et du suivi des ressources
  • Capacité à prioriser les productions en fonction des calendriers de drops, des urgences de mise en ligne et des contraintes budgétaires
  • Expérience en management d’équipe et en coordination de prestataires
  • Capacité à structurer les flux de travail, à gérer les priorités et à anticiper les risques
  • Aptitude à résoudre les problématiques opérationnelles et à garantir le respect des engagements de livraison
 
 
Qualités personnelles
 
  • Organisation, rigueur et sens de l’anticipation
  • Sensibilité visuelle et exigence en matière de qualité
  • Leadership et capacité à fédérer des équipes
  • Réactivité et aptitude à gérer des environnements de production exigeants
  • Excellent sens de la coordination et de la communication

description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


We want you as a highly talented Valve Test Engineer II, to help us advance our mission by leading cryogenic valve testing for our high-thrust engine. You will be the primary engineer responsible for defining, planning, executing, and closing valve development test campaigns.


Key responsibilities:

In your capacity as a cryogenic Valve Test Engineer II, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include:

  • Own the valve component-level development test execution for Storm

  • Translate engineering questions and requirements into test plans, matrices, procedures, and success criteria

  • Define test sequencing, configurations, instrumentation, data needs, and readiness criteria

  • Coordinate hardware, test bench, facility, calibration, safety, and operational preparation

  • Lead safety analysis and test readiness reviews and drive campaign execution through completion

  • Execute and oversee functional, pressure, flow, transient, environmental, endurance, and other campaign-specific tests

  • Analyse test data, assess anomalies, and distinguish hardware behaviour from test-system effects

  • Produce clear test reports with conclusions, limitations, recommendations, and requirement traceability

  • Drive root-cause investigations and use test evidence to guide design iterations and follow-on testing

  • Act as the valve-test focal point across design, analysis, manufacturing, quality, systems, and integration teams


Qualifications:

  • Degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, propulsion, or a closely related discipline

  • 3-4 years of experience planning and executing hardware development or qualification tests, ideally involving valves, fluid components, propulsion hardware, or other pressure-bearing components


What we would love to see from you:

  • Strong hands-on experience with functional, pressure, flow, transient, leak, environmental, endurance, or burst testing of cryogenic components

  • Practical knowledge of test planning, instrumentation, data acquisition, test execution, and engineering data analysis

  • Ability to turn requirements and engineering questions into measurable test objectives, procedures, and acceptance criteria

  • Able to work hands-on with hardware and test benches, data acquisition systems, investigate anomalies, and make evidence-based decisions

  • Strong technical writing, communication, safety, risk-management, and configuration-control skills

  • Comfortable owning a technical topic independently while coordinating effectively across multidisciplinary engineering teams

  • Experience in space hardware, propulsion, safety-critical, or regulated environments is an advantage

  • Rigor and attention to detail are core values in everything we do: you take the time to understand requirements, follow procedures precisely, check your work, and maintain accurate records.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment, taking ownership of getting the hardware ready

  • Fluency in English, both written and verbal

  • A passion for space exploration and the motivation to see propulsion hardware move from drawings to tested engines.

Why you should join us!

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind

description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Legal Operations Specialist – Data Licensing on the IP & Licensing team, you will own the processes that let Mistral license content and data without slowing down. This role exists because we need someone who can turn legal analysis into repeatable workflows — managing rights, obligations, and restrictions across our growing dataset portfolio. You will work closely with the colleagues who negotiate our commercial and legal agreements, turning their work into clear metadata, tracked obligations, and automated systems.

Your impact will be visible in how smoothly data moves into our AI products: fewer bottlenecks, clearer rights status, and one reliable record for every data agreement we sign. You will sit where copyright, data protection, and AI meet, making sure that as we acquire and use training data, we comply with EU and US law, respect third-party rights, and enforce the restrictions our contracts impose. In scope: clearing permissions for inbound data, reviewing and codifying contracts, maintaining a central rights-and-obligations database, and building AI-powered workflows that make all of this scalable.

What You Will Do

  • Clear inbound data usage requests by researching rights status, scope, obligations, and restrictions — including anonymization and data protection requirements — before data enters our systems.

  • Review data-related agreements and codify their key terms into structured metadata, maintaining our template library and playbook alongside Legal.

  • Assess whether specific AI use cases fall within the scope of third-party agreements, flag gaps, and recommend contract amendments.

  • Build and maintain a central database that serves as the single source of truth for every signed data-related agreement.

  • Track and manage compliance with ongoing obligations — permitted uses, confidentiality, re-use rights — automate our reporting, and administer master licensing partnerships.

  • Verify provenance, ownership, and consent for acquired data, and identify obligations that require active monitoring.

  • Monitor that Mistral clients and partners stay within their granted rights, operating the approval system that enforces legal restrictions.

  • Design and run AI-powered workflows for contract review assistance, obligation extraction, and renewal alerts.

What We're Looking For

  • A bachelor's degree in law, publishing, information science, business, or a related field.

  • 2–5 years of experience in copyright, permissions, licensing, legal operations, or contract administration — ideally in an AI, tech, or data-driven environment.

  • Working knowledge of EU and US copyright law and contract administration, with demonstrated ability to interpret contracts independently.

  • Meticulous attention to detail and discretion with confidential contracts, combined with strong project-management skills.

  • Clear, direct communication and the initiative to anticipate needs through ambiguity.

  • A legal-ops mindset: you want to turn legal analysis into repeatable, scalable processes, not just handle one-off reviews.

  • Comfort building agentic AI workflows in a complex enterprise environment — you are an AI power user, ideally with experience setting up such workflows in a legal team.

  • Additional depth in formal legal training, CLM platforms (e.g., Ironclad), publishing-house contracts, or European languages (French, German, Spanish, etc.) is welcome.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.
