title: Robot Learning Engineer
description:
Why this role is exciting

Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers buy their groceries from us through Rohlik.cz, Knuspr.de, Kifli.hu, Gurkerl.at and Sezamo.ro, choosing from over 17,000 items, delivered within a couple of hours in 15-minute windows.

We are building the autonomous grocer. Maia, our AI assistant, already talks to customers and builds their orders; agents are moving into our buying and logistics; vision models are learning to watch quality. The next frontier is physical: robots taking over more and more of the work in our fulfilment centres, until fresh food moves from producers to households at a cost nobody else can match.

We are setting out to record how our own people handle groceries and to turn those recordings into a training corpus for manipulation policies. Our warehouses already log what happened on every pick and every quality check, so the recordings can carry labels most datasets never get. Making that hold is part of the job.

You decide what makes an hour of footage trainable — before we bank hundreds of them.

What you will own and deliver

  • The capture spec. Cameras, mounts, calibration, and what disqualifies an episode. You write it before we buy the fleet and enforce it after. When the spec and the floor disagree, you go to the floor and find out which one is wrong.

  • Ground truth. Hand pose is the signal that transfers from human video to robot policies, and warehouse reality — work gloves, occlusion, cold halls — is exactly where the published models struggle. You own how we measure that and how we close the gap.

  • The evaluation harness. The corpus only counts if a policy can train on it. You build the harness that decides which hours make the bank, and you hold the trainability bar as the volume grows.

  • The first training runs. Once hours bank, you post-train open robot-learning models on our data and run the first task evaluations.

  • Judgment before spend. The field moves monthly. You read what is published, reproduce the claims we depend on, and steer our capture before the money is spent, not after.

The scope

This is a seat on a small, newly created team: an operations lead who runs capture on the floor, a data engineer who owns the pipeline, and you: the machine-learning voice in the room. This is not a research-scientist role, and no publication record is required. The job is to make a corpus trainable and to train the first policies on it.

What we are looking for

  • PyTorch, and computer vision with real 3D geometry. Camera calibration, pose estimation, SLAM fundamentals. You have debugged an extrinsic calibration at least once in your life and know why it drifted.

  • You can read a paper and reproduce it. Our pipeline is assembled from published work, and your job is knowing which claims survive contact with a chilled warehouse hall.

  • You know what policies train on. Familiar with the current robot-learning stack and policy classes well enough to know what the training side will demand of the data before the data exists.

  • Dataset instincts. You have trained on data you collected yourself, and you know the failure modes that only show up at training tim..

  • Comfortable as the only ML voice. You make the call, write it down, and revisit it when the pilot data says otherwise.

  • AI is how work gets done here. Our engineers use Claude Code and Devin daily, and we expect you to direct agents for the unglamorous parts — harness code, data plumbing, reproduction scripts — while keeping the quality bar exactly where it was.

  • Particularly relevant. Hand-pose estimation or egocentric video in production; multi-camera rigs and time sync; experience post-training robot-learning models; ROS 2.

What success looks like in 90 days

You have written the capture spec and we set up the first rigs against it. Your pilot gates have numbers, the first hours have passed your harness, and you can tell the people who sign the budget, with data, what the next hundred hours should look like.

Are we a good fit?

Take this role if you would rather own the spec that decides whether a dataset becomes an asset or a write-off than tune someone else's model on someone else's data, if a fulfilment centre at 6 a.m. sounds like a lab to you, and if you want the shortest possible line between your technical judgment and a capital decision. Read our culture code and are we a good fit?.

What we offer

  • The physical-AI side of the autonomous grocer, with the capture spec and the first training runs yours from day one

  • A data asset few teams in the world get to build, in fresh groceries, a domain as hard as manipulation gets

  • Off-the-shelf hardware, a managed cloud estate, and a mandate that has already started

  • Benefits — see what we offer

Are you in?

Instead of a cover letter: pick a published human-video-to-robot-policy pipeline you rate, and tell us where it breaks on a warehouse floor where every hand wears a work glove.

title: Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

Purpose of the role

Zego’s Complex Claims team is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a highly skilled Large Loss Claims Handler to join our team. Our large loss specialists handle Zego’s most complex and high value motor claims including those involving brain and spinal trauma, psychiatric injury, complex fractures and pain conditions.

In this pivotal role, reporting to the Motor Major Loss Manager, you’ll manage your own portfolio of motor cases, focusing on injury claims exceeding £500k. This position requires not only excellent communication and negotiation skills but also a deep understanding of liability, indemnity, and quantum issues to effectively drive down claims costs while ensuring fair compensation for injured claimants.

Alongside handling technical claims, this role involves introducing and executing a quality review programme within the complex loss team, as well as providing mentorship, oversight, and professional development through a structured training scheme.

Beyond handling claims, the team works closely with other claims colleagues, reinsurers, panel solicitors, carriers, rehab providers and colleagues across underwriting and pricing to deliver fair, commercially sound outcomes. As a small, highly technical team, we offer broad exposure to grow your career 🚀

What you'll be working on

  • Managing a portfolio of high value motor claims typically valued between £500k through to £5 million, pre and post litigation

  • Communicate effectively with customers, witnesses, insurers, repairers, solicitors, and medical agencies to expedite claim resolutions

  • Serve as a technical expert within the team, offering guidance and support in large loss scenarios

  • Work with the Motor Major Loss Manager and our Head of TP & Complex Claims on Claims strategy and processes

  • Motivate and develop more junior team members by sharing your knowledge and expertise

  • Maintain Reinsurer and carrier relationships through timely and accurate updates

  • Investigate, negotiate and settle claims

  • Calculation of accurate reserves and make decisions on Indemnity and Liability claims

  • Participate in strategic projects to keep the team at the forefront of industry trends and performance

What you will need to be successful

  • Proven experience in managing high value motor bodily injury claims with a current handling authority of at least £250k

  • Deep knowledge of liability, indemnity, causation, reserving, future losses, the Ogden Discount Rate and complex medical issues

  • Experience handling litigated claims and applying relevant procedures and frameworks including CPR and MIB technical disputes

  • A passion for a career in Large Loss and a desire to help shape a growing large loss function

The Zego ways of working 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🩺 Private medical insurance.

title: Operations & Automation Associate
description:
About Nous

Nous is a household AI agent. It takes over the bills and admin people don't have time for and acts for them: switching energy, buying insurance, cancelling forgotten subscriptions, managing the family calendar. Nearly 250,000 UK households have signed up, and another joins every minute.

We think the real value of AI isn't writing amazing cover letters, it's doing useful things in the real world for real people. That's the hard part, and a brilliant product is only half of it. An energy switch takes weeks, so our agents run on long-running workflows, not a single chat turn. Cancelling a subscription means a browser agent handling the code Apple sends to your phone. Buying insurance meant getting our regulatory principal comfortable with an agent doing it end to end (a UK first), which comes down to knowing exactly when the LLM should hand over to rules because a mistake would cost someone real money.

We're about 30 people running one agent across energy, broadband, mobile, insurance, mortgages and subscriptions (with more being added), each with its own suppliers, rules and ways of going wrong. With far more problems than people, a person or small team owns each one end to end, from spotting it in the data or a customer conversation to shipping the fix. And because the agent acts, you find out quickly whether the fix worked.

Everyone builds here: a product engineer launched our subscription cancellation product within a couple of months of joining, and a PM rebuilt our WhatsApp agent.

And it's working. We're growing more than 20x year on year, with a market-leading NPS above +80, and we manage well over half a billion pounds of household spending. We've raised more than $30M from Heartcore, Mosaic and a who's who of entrepreneurs who founded Monzo, GoCardless, lastminute.com and Onfido. But the real draw is the team - ask anyone here why they joined and you'll get some version of "to do great work with really smart people".

The goal is household life that's simpler, cheaper and fairer, and most of that is still to build.

The role

What Nous does for members can feel simple: helping them understand their bills, save money, and avoid admin. Delivering that reliably at scale is much harder.

You’ll join the Operations team at the heart of the business, working on the difficult real-world problems that sit between our members, our product, external suppliers and the systems that make Nous work.

This is not a traditional customer operations role. You’ll spend time close to our members, understanding their questions, investigating things that have gone wrong and learning in detail how our service works. We think that matters: the best systems are usually built by people who have seen the underlying problems first-hand.

But we don’t want you simply to get faster at doing manual work. We want you to spot the pattern, understand why the problem exists, and help build a better way of doing it.

That might mean redesigning a process, building an automation, using AI to remove repetitive work, querying data to understand what is happening, improving an internal tool, or working with Product and Engineering on a more fundamental fix.

You don't need to arrive knowing all of the tools we use. We care much more about how quickly you learn them.

We’re looking for someone early in their career who is unusually curious, quick to learn and good at figuring things out. You might already have built automations or small products yourself. You might instead have worked in operations, consulting, product, analytics or another demanding environment and found yourself constantly looking for better ways to do things.

Either way, we want someone who gets excited by a problem they don't immediately know how to solve.

You’ll have a lot of support from experienced operators, engineers and product people, but also be given a lot of responsibility unusually early in your career. The aim is for you to quickly become someone who can take an undefined operational problem, understand it properly and build a robust solution.

It’s a rare chance to learn how a fast-growing technology company actually works from the inside while building the systems that allow it to scale.

 

About you

You’re smart, curious, ambitious and unusually high-agency.

You don't need a long list of technical tools on your CV. We care much more about how you think, how quickly you learn and what you do when you encounter something you don't understand.

You’ll probably thrive here if you:

  • Have roughly 1–3 years of experience in a demanding environment such as a startup, operations, consulting, product, analytics or similar

  • Learn unusually quickly and enjoy tackling problems you haven't seen before

  • Are technically curious and actively experiment with AI and new tools to make yourself more effective

  • Have evidence that you like building things, whether that's automations, side projects, spreadsheets, scripts, internal tools, processes or something completely different

  • Are comfortable getting into the detail and tracing a problem until you understand what is really happening

  • Can take something messy and ambiguous and impose structure on it

  • Are naturally empathetic and enjoy understanding what a customer actually needs

  • Communicate clearly and directly

  • Are comfortable working directly with customers and frontline problems, and see that as a source of insight

  • Take ownership rather than waiting to be told exactly what to do

This role is ideal for someone early in their career who wants a steep learning curve, real responsibility and the chance to work as part of a team solving difficult problems.

Plenty of good analysts hit the same wall: you query the data but never build the pipelines, you’re boxed into one lane, and more scope means waiting your turn. Here, it’s the opposite.

Taptap Send moves billions of dollars a month across 6 of 7 continents. We’re probably the largest, fastest-growing money movement business you’ve never heard of. Cards, wallets, business-to-business payments, institutional payments, and new markets are all launching now, and each needs its data, reconciliations and reporting built from scratch. That’s your work.

The job

You’ll own the external reports the business can’t operate without, then automate them into reliable, reusable dbt models. From day one you’ll work with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product and Data Engineering to make sure every number is modelled correctly.

  • Own external reporting: deliver the datasets behind month-end close and regulatory reporting, on time, every cycle.

  • Automate: turn multi-day manual work into scheduled pipelines, runbooks and dbt models, so it only gets done once.

  • Get ahead of launches: build reports and reconciliations as each product and market goes live, before anyone asks.

  • Be first line for data requests: build models so people and AI agents can answer repeat questions themselves.

  • Keep data trustworthy: build tests, checks and alerts that catch reconciliation breaks and stale data before they become incidents.

  • Share what you know: peer-review code and join our weekly meetups.

Why you’ll want it

Grow as fast as you’re able. We hire for potential, not years of experience. On a lean, talent-dense team, you’ll own real work early and take on more the moment you’re ready.

Go from querying data to designing systems. Data, product or business analyst? You don’t need to be an analytics engineer yet. Build the pipelines behind the numbers, and learn dbt, testing, automation and AI tooling from senior analytics engineers.

Don't get boxed in. Own the reporting, automate it, then take on our biggest problems wherever they sit. Your hiring manager started in Finance and has since worked across Partner Ops, Fraud, Compliance, Reconciliation and Product.

See the whole business. You’ll follow a transfer from the moment a customer taps send, through partner payout and reconciliation, to the report a regulator reads.

Own numbers that matter. Auditors and Finance rely on what you build. This isn’t a dashboard role.

Put more money in families’ hands. Remittances are a lifeline for millions of families and are worth more than all foreign aid. Every report you automate helps us keep transfers cheap and reliable.

You’ll fit if you have

  • 1-2+ years in a data or analytics role

  • Reliability under deadlines, a “no task too small” attitude, and comfort chasing stakeholders

  • The right to work in the UK

Nice to have: startup or scale-up experience, Python or R, dbt, Looker or Mode, and something you’ve built, at work or on the side, because the manual way annoyed you.

Sound like you? Apply, even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to meet you.

title: Product & Brand Designer
description:
V7

At V7, we’re building AI platforms that help humans do their best work, at incredible scale and speed. Our mission is to turn human knowledge into trustworthy AI, making complex tasks faster, smarter, and more accurate. The team you'll be joining and impact you'll have

  • Our design team is small and sits close to engineering. Designers here work directly with the people building the product, and the loop between a design decision and it appearing in the codebase is short.

  • A lot of this currently sits with contractors or is spread thinly across the team. You'll pull it in-house and become the person who owns the brand and the product's design language.

  • You'll help shape our design system and the front-end refactor that sits underneath it, defining the components and patterns everyone else builds on. Engineering will do the heavy lifting on implementation, but you'll be the one deciding what good looks like.

  • Own the marketing site end to end in Framer, including the parts most people skip: CMS collections, dynamic content, responsive behaviour and interaction states.

  • Design product UI against our design system, from early exploration through to polished, buildable specs, working alongside engineers rather than throwing designs over the wall.

  • Define motion and interaction: animation, empty and loading states, transitions, and the detail that makes a product feel finished. Where it's quicker to tweak it yourself in the codebase, you can.

  • Take on genuinely new surfaces that don't have a pattern yet, like visualising the Context Graph: nodes, edges, and how a knowledge graph should actually read on screen.

  • Run an AI-first workflow: exploring variants in Claude Design, generating specs in Cursor, using whatever tooling gets you from idea to something real fastest. Fast because of the tooling, not despite it.

Who you are

  • You're a product and brand designer with real craft. Your portfolio shows strong visual instincts and thoughtful product thinking, and you can hold a coherent direction across web, marketing and product.

  • You know Framer properly, CMS collections and all, and you can build a page that looks good and reads well without hand-holding, with the kind of animation and polish that lifts a brand.

  • You can work inside a design system: extending components, keeping things consistent, and knowing when something genuinely needs a new pattern versus reusing what's there.

  • You're comfortable enough around code that opening a pull request in Cursor or similar to fix a spacing issue or adjust a component doesn't scare you. That's a bonus, not the job. You're a designer who can get hands-on when it helps, not an engineer who happens to design.

  • You treat AI tooling as core to how you work, using it to amplify your output and move faster rather than keeping it at arm's length.

V7 champions equality and inclusion because diverse teams build better products. Don't check every box? Apply anyway — we value what makes you unique and will support you through the process, just let our Talent team know how they can help.

title: Information Security & Risk Officer
description:
💬 Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book, which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.


The role

It's a hands-on, delivery-focused role, and you'll make an impact from the start in risk management, security advisory, customer and tender responses, audit readiness and our data strategy.

This isn't a security engineering role. You won't configure firewalls or run vulnerability scans. Instead, you'll understand our technical environment well enough to spot risks and gaps, then recommend best practices for Engineering, DevOps and IT to put in place. A background in compliance management alone won't be enough for this role.

You'll report to our Senior Information Security Officer, who owns our GRC framework, ISO 27001 programme, CE/CE+ & DSPT compliance, and the security risk register. You'll help deliver across all of it.

Challenges you’ll solve...

  • Own risk management: run risk sessions across the business, keep the risk register current, write clear risk reports and chase treatment actions to completion

  • Advise the business: be the security voice with Engineering, DevOps, IT and Product, and a first point of contact for security questions from every team

  • Handle customers, tenders and suppliers: answer security questionnaires and tenders accurately, and assess suppliers before we approve them

  • Keep us audit-ready: gather evidence all year round for Cyber Essentials Plus, DSPT and ISO 27001, and flag control gaps with practical fixes

  • Deliver our data strategy: drive the data classification and access control programmes forward with data owners

You should apply if...

  • You have hands-on infosec and risk experience: ideally in health-tech, regulated SaaS or software development. You've run risk sessions, managed a risk register and reported on risk to senior stakeholders.

  • You possess technical depth to hold your own: You understand authentication vs authorisation, least privilege, IAM, network segmentation and firewalls, patch and vulnerability management, endpoint protection and cloud infrastructure.

  • You understand frameworks: ISO 27001, DSPT, NIST and Cyber Essentials Plus, and a sense of what proportionate looks like in a fast-moving product company.

  • You work fast and independently: You manage your own workload, flag blockers early and can move between a tender, a questionnaire and an engineering conversation in the same day.

  • You care about healthcare: and know the data we protect belongs to patients and clinicians.

Nice to have: enterprise risk management experience, and having been through a CE+ audit cycle.

What’s in it for you?

You’ll join a high-performing team on a mission to solve healthcare productivity, building a platform used by around 300k NHS staff every week, supporting the care of over 50 million NHS patients every year. Traditional research is slow, expensive, and superficial. Running it well requires expertise most teams don't have. That gap affects how well companies understand their customers and how well they can serve them. We're closing it.

As our first Head of Legal, you'll build Conveo's legal function from the ground up. title: Senior AI Product Manager
description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

Our AI product area is growing. We already have two Product Managers working across conversational AI, agentic workflows, and domain-specific automation, and we need a third to expand our capacity as the scope of AI at 9fin accelerates.

Backed by over $170M in funding (Series C), we are scaling rapidly across product, engineering, and go-to-market. AI is not a bolt-on feature at 9fin; it is the core differentiator for the next phase of the company.

You will join an established AI PM team and take ownership of a product area within our AI surface. This could span new AI-powered features for credit analysts, workflow automation for legal and financial analysis, or expanding our conversational AI into new domains. The team has already built evaluation infrastructure and quality frameworks; you will use and contribute to these rather than build them from scratch.

You will work within our product organization (eight squads across AI, data, and domain verticals) and partner closely with ML engineers, data scientists, domain experts, and designers. This is a high-autonomy role with real scope to shape what 9fin's AI products can do for our clients.

 

What You'll Do

 

Product Strategy & Execution

  • Collaboratively create and champion a clear product vision and strategy for your area, with a focus on building and evolving our AI products

  • Synthesize qualitative and quantitative insights into problem statements that identify root causes, not just symptoms

  • Shape the next generation of agentic AI products: multi-step reasoning workflows, tool orchestration, and autonomous task completion for financial professionals

  • Demonstrate a working understanding of the challenges specific to building with LLMs, including managing hallucinations, evaluating output quality, and designing for non-deterministic systems

  • Use confidence-building methods (prototypes, user research, data analysis) to understand how users will interact with AI-powered products before committing to full builds

AI Quality & Data

  • Use the team's AI evaluation framework (LLM-as-judge protocols, quality thresholds, SME eval cycles) to validate and improve the products you ship

  • Contribute to the data strategy for your product area: annotation quality, ground truth curation, and feedback loops that improve model performance over time

  • Proactively identify and track metrics that measure client and business benefit, working with the team on continuous model evaluation and improvement

Team Leadership & Communication

  • Create a collaborative environment for your squad, providing wider context and clear goals so everyone can do their best work

  • Work with data scientists and ML engineers to bridge the gap between business needs and the technical capabilities of AI models

  • Communicate strategy, initiatives, and progress transparently across the organisation

  • Translate complex AI concepts, capabilities, and limitations into language that non-technical stakeholders can act on

  • Champion responsible AI practices: transparency in model outputs, bias monitoring, and compliance with client expectations around AI-generated content

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, preferably in FinTech or B2B SaaS, with at least 2 years focused on ML or GenAI products

  • Working knowledge of RAG architectures, embeddings, prompt engineering, and LLM evaluation methods (not just "AI concepts" at a high level)

  • Experience shipping AI products where output quality is probabilistic: you know how to define "good enough" and iterate from there

  • Comfortable reading Python notebooks and SQL to interrogate model outputs and usage data

  • Track record of shipping AI products where you managed the tension between ML research/exploration and production delivery constraints

  • Collaborative leadership style with strong stakeholder management; you build relationships that empower your team to achieve outcomes

  • User-centric communication skills: you can explain AI capabilities and limitations to clients and internal stakeholders without overselling or underselling

  • You thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and are energised by the challenge of building something new

Nice to Have

  • Experience in financial services, legal tech, or data/analytics platforms

  • Familiarity with credit markets, debt instruments, or regulatory/compliance workflows

  • Experience with NLP applied to document analysis (contracts, legal filings, financial reports)

  • Experience with agent orchestration frameworks, tool use patterns, or multi-step AI workflows


The Opportunity

9fin is already the leading platform for legal intelligence in debt capital markets. Our proprietary AI capabilities extract and analyse legal language at scale, and our unique dataset of credit legal documentation delivers intelligence that generic AI tools simply cannot match.

Now we are investing to extend that leadership. You will lead a dedicated engineering team to define the next chapter of 9fin's legal product — going deeper on AI, building richer workflows, and expanding into the law firm segment, where we see a significant TAM opportunity that is ours to capture.

Your users sit at the centre of the debt markets ecosystem: origination teams at top investment banks, lawyers at leading law firms, and credit analysts at hedge funds and credit funds.

This is a great opportunity to shape the future of a product and a company that's using technology to revolutionise the trillion-dollar debt capital market.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Product Strategy & Execution

  • Strategy: Define and champion the product vision and strategy for the Covenants squad from the ground up, working closely with engineering, our legal analysts, and key customers to establish what to build and why.

  • Problem definition & structured thinking: Synthesise insights from in-house legal subject matter experts (SMEs), customer interviews, customer feedback and data signals to craft a clear problem statement, articulating the root cause in a structured way.

  • Discovery: Use a range of techniques to identify and understand what users need and their workflows, across a sophisticated professional audience spanning credit analysts, portfolio managers, restructuring advisors, and law firms.

  • Impact driven: Align the team around a key outcome and effectively prioritise initiatives across multiple dimensions.

  • Measuring success: Proactively identify and track metrics to measure client and business benefit. Work with the team to define and manage a process for continuous model evaluation and improvement, with particular attention to the accuracy and reliability standards required in legal contexts.

Team Leadership & Communication

  • Team success: Create a collaborative environment for your squad, providing wider context and clear goals so everyone can do their best work.

  • Communication: Ensure all people involved are aware of the team's strategy, initiatives, and progress. You must be able to effectively communicate complex legal and financial concepts to technical audiences, and similarly communicate technical capabilities to legal and credit professionals.

  • Influence: Build strong relationships to empower the squad to achieve the desired outcome, often by influencing stakeholders outside of your team.

  • Stakeholder management: Work closely with stakeholders, including 9fin's legal analysts, credit team to gather the right input and insights. You will need to listen carefully and bring people on a journey.

AI Product Development

  • Own the roadmap for AI-powered legal document extraction and covenant analysis, ensuring outputs meet the precision standards required for professional use.

  • Partner with software and AI engineering to define evaluation frameworks for AI outputs in legal contexts, where accuracy, source attribution, and explainability are critical to user trust.

  • Identify opportunities to apply emerging AI capabilities to novel legal workflow problems, from covenant compliance monitoring to cross-document analysis across deal histories.

About You

This role will be a great fit if:

  • You have a legal or financial markets background, or have built products for this audience. You may have started your career as a lawyer, paralegal, or credit analyst, or you may have been a PM at a legal tech company. You are able to hold a substantive conversation about credit agreements, covenant packages, and how legal language governs capital structures. A sharp PM from an adjacent domain who can demonstrate rapid domain immersion will also be considered.

  • You are a strategic thinker who thrives with a blank page. You are comfortable defining strategy from scratch, not just executing an existing roadmap. You can synthesise ambiguous inputs into a clear direction and bring a team with you.

  • You're a collaborative leader. You have an empathetic leadership style and build strong, effective relationships. You love working autonomously but are able to earn the trust of others with a collaborative style. You are great at prioritising, not afraid to say no, and excel at managing stakeholders while also being confident in voicing your own opinions and challenging others.

  • You've got hands-on experience with AI. You have experience with or a working knowledge of AI and LLMs, including how to evaluate model outputs in production environments. You understand what good looks like when AI is applied to high-stakes, precision-dependent workflows, and you can engage meaningfully with engineering teams on evaluation design and quality standards.

  • You work in an AI-native way. You use generative AI tools as a natural part of how you work: prototyping ideas, conducting research, reviewing PRDs, and building agents or automated workflows to extend your own productivity. You are comfortable using coding assistants to get things done faster and are genuinely excited about what this shift means for how product work gets done. This is not a nice-to-have. We expect our PMs to be at the frontier of how AI accelerates product development.

  • You thrive building from zero. You are energised by the opportunity to define something new rather than optimise something established. You move quickly, make decisions with incomplete information, and course-correct based on evidence.

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Training & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

title: Senior Generative AI Engineer
description:
About Motorway

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

About the team

GenAI Engineering sits within Motorway's Data and AI function, alongside Machine Learning and the Machine Learning Data Platform. We own the AI features that shape how buyers and sellers experience the marketplace, from agentic workflows in the customer journey to LLM-powered tooling for our dealer network.

What we build goes into the hands of real sellers and thousands of verified dealers, usually within weeks. When it works, someone sells their car more easily. When it doesn't, we hear about it. That feedback loop is short, and it shapes how we work. We have a track record of successful deployments and a strong reputation as a result.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior GenAI Engineer to build AI applications and agentic workflows for Motorway, taking them from rapid prototype through to production-grade systems that deliver measurable value.

You'll take a problem that isn't fully defined yet and see it through to a reliable system running in production: the prompting, the retrieval, the agent design, the evals, the guardrails, the monitoring. You own that whole stack. There's no separate team who "productionises" your work later.

Most of what makes a GenAI feature good sits around the model rather than in it. The prompting is rarely the hard part. Retrieval quality is, and so is the data feeding it, evaluation you can trust, sensible behaviour when things fail, and getting it live and keeping it there. If that's the work you want to do, we're not precious about the route you took to get here. Some of us came through data science and machine learning and deliberately built up our software engineering; others came the other way.

In this role, you will:

  • Own AI features end to end, from an ambiguous problem through to a reliable, observable system that real customers depend on.

  • Build the retrieval and data foundations these features stand on, and treat retrieval quality as a first-class engineering problem rather than a tuning exercise.

  • Design evaluation and monitoring approaches that make quality, reliability and safety measurable rather than assumed.

  • Build AI applications and agents using LLMs, orchestration, APIs and data systems, applying solid production software practices throughout.

  • Make the calls on models, cost and latency that shape what a feature costs us to run, and document the reasoning so others can follow it.

  • Prototype quickly, work out what is reusable, and harden the patterns that work into components the rest of the team adopts.

  • Raise the quality of the work around you through code review, design feedback and the standards you set by example.

  • Represent your technical decisions directly to product managers and stakeholders, translating model behaviour into business consequence.

About you

  • You've shipped AI or ML systems that real users depend on, and you've stayed close enough to production to know how they behave when they break.

  • Strong Python, and SQL you genuinely use. A lot of this work is data work: assembling grounding data, building golden datasets, and digging into why something failed.

  • You've invested deliberately in your software engineering craft: testing, error handling, CI/CD, observability, and the MLOps practices that keep things healthy once they're live.

  • You're hands-on across the GenAI stack: LLM APIs, retrieval and vector stores, agents with tool use, and structured outputs, running on cloud infrastructure (we use AWS and GCP).

  • You have a real point of view on evaluation, most likely because you've been caught out by a system that looked fine and wasn't.

  • You can reason about how models fail, including hallucination and prompt injection, and what that means for someone who trusts the output.

  • You know when to reach for a model, when something simpler will do, and when to stop.

  • You're a constructive reviewer, and colleagues are better off for having worked alongside you.

You could be a great fit if

  • You're curious about how things actually work, and you follow that curiosity past the first plausible answer.

  • You're drawn to problems where the right approach isn't obvious yet.

  • You're honest about the limits of what you know and pull people in early rather than late.

  • You take responsibility for what you ship, watch how it behaves, and fix it when it breaks.

  • You get satisfaction from the unglamorous work that makes an AI feature actually good, not just the part that demos well.

  • You can disagree well, and commit once a decision is made.

Benefits

We've got your back, in life's biggest moments and the everyday ones too.

title: Communications, Brand & Events Lead
description:
About Orakl Oncology

Every cancer patient deserves a treatment that works for them. Today, too many never get one in time: fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs make it through clinical trials, and every failure costs patients precious time.

Orakl exists to change those odds.

We bridge biological and artificial intelligence by building large cohorts of virtual cancer patients, combining real patients' tumors with their medical histories and deep biological data. By integrating patient-derived tumor models, experimental biology and AI, we help pharmaceutical companies predict how cancer drugs will perform in patients, identify promising treatments and make better decisions earlier in drug development.

Founded in 2023 by Fanny Jaulin, PhD, Diane-Laure Pagès, PhD, and Gustave Ronteix, PhD, Orakl is a spin-out of Gustave Roussy, one of Europe's leading cancer centres, building on a decade of research. It’s a discussion with your future manager. We’ll get deeper into your expertise and know-how. We’ll also give you a clearer view of what your day-to-day in that role is like. It’s a good opportunity to see if you foresee yourself working at Upflow.

It’s a coding exercise that can only be completed successfully with the help of AI. In addition to delivering working software that meets the requirements, you’ll be evaluated on your product and architectural decisions.

In this interview, we’ll review your take-home assignment and discuss how you approach designing scalable systems and making architectural decisions.

You’ll also meet up with at least two other peers so you can foresee yourself as part of this team.

If the team meetings go well on both sides, we’ll invite you to this final step. description:
About Voodoo

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

This position is Paris-based, with relocation support available.

Team

For this position, you will be an integral part of a newly established internal studio, a dynamic and focused team dedicated to one of our most promising prototype in scale. This studio is specifically chartered to improve this high-potential game up to the successful and market-ready title it is meant to become.

You will be part of the team building Draft Showdown, a turn-based multiplayer game, working alongside its client engineers and game designers as a full member of the game team. You will be part of a small group owning the backend that this game needs as its requirements become more specific and demanding.

You’ll also be plugged into Voodoo's shared gaming backend platform - the same architecture and patterns that power titles like Mob Control and Block Jam 3D - building on it and contributing back, in close collaboration with the wider backend team. You get the focus and ownership of a dedicated game engineer with the leverage and support of a battle-tested platform behind you.

This is a pivotal hire: Draft Showdown is moving towards competitive multiplayer, which means moving game logic from the client to the server. They are also implementing cheat detection safeguards to the game.
You will be central to that transition.

Role

You will design and build the server-side foundation that takes Draft Showdown from a client-authoritative game to a competitive, server-validated one. The current game computes everything on the device - progression, economy, and match outcomes alike, which won't hold up for competitive PvP. Your job is to change that.

Working closely with client developers and game designers from feature design through delivery, validation and iteration, you will:

  • Build server-side validation for the metagame - currency, card upgrades, chest opens, and progression - staged by risk, replicating economy and reward logic on the server.

  • Move toward server authority for competitive features, where game state lives in one place and can be trusted.

  • Implement and improve matchmaking and cheat detection safeguards for a Deterministic lockstep PvP architecture

  • Design APIs and player-state management that the Unity client integrates against, and help shape how client and server split responsibilities.

The responsibilities are cross-functional, ranging from infrastructure, API design & coding all the way to client-side integration (we are using Golang).

To succeed in this role, you will need to have passion for everything you do. You love to write code that scales to millions of users, are skilled at requirements gathering, champion new tech initiatives & leverage existing solutions.

Profile

  • 5+ years of backend development experience

  • Strong knowledge of computer science fundamentals

  • Extreme fluency in Golang (at least 1 year in a professional environment)

  • Mastery of SQL and NoSQL

  • Background in high-scale systems

  • Understanding of Unix-like environments

  • AI-first mindset: Comfortable using AI daily and building custom agents or reusable automations to speed up your work

  • Experience working in cross-functional agile teams

  • Strong analytical skills with a track record of solving complex problems related to scalability, performance, and integration in high-stakes environments.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, capable of influencing teams and interfacing effectively with various stakeholders.

  • Ability to be self sufficient and work autonomously.

  • A deep interest in game development is a plus.

  • Based or willing to relocate in Paris

Benefits

  • Best-in-class compensation

  • Other benefits according to the country you reside

-          Lancer leurs chaussures pour témoigner de leur soutien aux causes portées par Handicap International, la chaussure symbole du poids
de l’engagement citoyen pour protéger les civils ;

-          S’informer à travers une exposition interactive, ludique et pédagogique sur Handicap International, ses champs d’intervention et ses combats ;

-          Rencontrer et échanger avec nos experts terrain.

 

Pour en savoir plus sur les Pyramides : https://www.handicap-international.fr/fr/pyramides-de-chaussures

En complément, nous vous invitons à prendre connaissance des actions de sensibilisation et mobilisation en consultant : l’Espace du bénévolat et de la sensibilisation pour Handicap International.

La mission se déroulera du 1e avril au 30 septembre 2027 (6 mois).

Vos missions sont les suivantes

Activité 1 : Vous appuyez l’organisation et la coordination des Pyramides de chaussures de Villeurbanne et Paris avec

Le poste est facilement accessible en transports en commun (bus, métro). Un parking est également à disposition.   Concernant le bâtiment, des ascenseurs et des rampes d'accès sont mis en place.

title: Ingénieur Conception & Instrumentation - Équipements et bancs d’essais (H/F)
description:
Ingénieur Conception & Instrumentation – Équipements et bancs d’essais (H/F)

À propos de notre client

Notre client est une TPE basée au nord de Lyon, spécialisée dans les énergies du sous-sol : pétrole, gaz, géothermie et stockage de CO2. Son activité repose entièrement sur la R&D : essais sur géomatériaux, géomécanique et développement d'équipements d'essais pour des clients internationaux.

Son équipe pluridisciplinaire et multiculturelle développe des solutions technologiques innovantes au service de l'efficacité, de la protection de l'environnement et de la maîtrise des coûts. L'entreprise est certifiée ISO 9001 et toutes ses activités respectent sa démarche QHSE.

Le poste

Votre rôle : mettre au point de véritables méthodes d’essai. À partir d’un besoin de mesure (température, pression, déplacement, déformation, ultrasons…), vous concevez, instrumentez et validez des cellules d’essais haute température et haute pression. Vous commencez par fiabiliser une cellule existante : simplifier son montage et son démontage, puis la valider à plus haute température. Vous lancez ensuite les cellules suivantes.

Vous travaillez avec l’équipe qui conçoit aujourd’hui les équipements, et avec le bureau d’études d’un fabricant partenaire qui réalise la conception détaillée et les plans de fabrication. Environ 70-80 % conception et développement, 20-30 % laboratoire. Rattachement à la direction des opérations.

Ce que le poste n’est pas : ni dessinateur ou calculateur (le détail et les plans sont externalisés), ni management d’équipe. 

Vos missions

  • Définir le besoin, le cahier des charges et le pré-dimensionnement fonctionnel de nouvelles cellules.
  • Choisir les capteurs adaptés et les intégrer ; résoudre les enjeux d’étanchéité, de tenue en température et en pression.
  • Consulter fournisseurs et sous-traitants, suivre la fabrication des pièces.
  • Monter, instrumenter et tester vous-même vos équipements au laboratoire ; interpréter les mesures et améliorer.
  • Améliorer l’ergonomie des équipements existants et transférer les équipements validés à l’équipe d’essais.
  • Rédiger la documentation technique et contribuer à la protection de la propriété intellectuelle.

Requirements

Indispensable

  • Conception mécanique d’équipements, avec une CAO 3D (aucun logiciel imposé).
  • Instrumentation, capteurs et techniques de mesure physique et physico-chimique : choisir et intégrer, pas fabriquer.
  • Goût du terrain : vous aimez monter, démonter et intervenir vous-même sur les équipements.

Important

  • Gestion de projet : planning, budget, fournisseurs.
  • Rigueur, autonomie, communication proactive des difficultés.

Un plus

  • Anglais technique (échanges écrits avec des fournisseurs étrangers).
  • Mise en plan, notions de matériaux et d’isolation thermique.
  • Expérience en pression ou température.

Formation et expérience

  • Diplôme d’ingénieur (bac +5) en mécanique, génie physique, instrumentation ou mesures physiques. Un parcours associant mécanique et mesures physiques (BUT Mesures physiques puis école d’ingénieurs en mécanique) est particulièrement apprécié.
  • Environ 5 ans d’expérience en conception d’équipements, bureau d’études ou R&D ; profils plus juniors étudiés.
  • Poste orienté conception et terrain : une thèse n’est pas requise.

Conditions

Sur site. Manutention occasionnelle de pièces métalliques lourdes avec moyens de levage. Intéressement
Rémunération : 36 – 48 k€ brut annuel selon expérience

Benefits

Vous rejoindrez une entreprise à taille humaine où chaque développement compte : vos équipements seront directement utilisés pour des projets de R&D menés pour des clients internationaux. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe dynamique et multiculturelle, sur des sujets techniques exigeants au service des énergies du sous-sol et de la transition énergétique.

Account Executive (German Speaking), Mirakl Connect
Conversion Rate Optimisation Manager
description:
At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description

Reporting to the Experience Optimisation Director, you will play a key role in developing and implementing experience optimisation and conversion rate optimisation (CRO) strategies for a French multinational holding company specialising in luxury goods.

We take pride in delivering data-led experimentation, personalisation, and deep analytical insights for premier global brands, setting us apart in the industry. At Jellyfish, we are committed to fostering professional growth. Your career path could lead to progression into a CRO Senior Manager position with future potential to lead the practice.

This is a hybrid position, based out of our Paris office. The gross annual salary range for this position is between EUR 38,000-42,000, and the final offer is dependent on experience.

Responsibilities

  • Lead client meetings with a key luxury account to translate their business needs into strategic optimisation roadmaps aligned with their goals, driving measurable value and high client satisfaction.

  • Be the subject matter expert in conversion rate optimisation (CRO), experience optimisation, measurement, and marketing analytics across the client's brands.

  • Execute full-lifecycle user journey audits, research, continuous experimentation, and cross-channel activation campaigns to deliver actionable insights.

  • Define custom reporting and data-mapping requirements, collaborating cross-functionally to align technical solutions and timelines with strategic rationale.

  • Provide mentorship and escalation support for junior team members to foster professional growth and resolve operational challenges.

Qualifications

  • Fluency in French and professional-level English is required given the scope of work and the client teams.

  • Over 2 years of experience in end-to-end experience optimisation or CRO, including defining, launching, and evaluating A/B and Multivariate Testing (MVT) Campaigns using A/B testing platforms or website optimisation tools.

  • The ability to analyse user behaviour and map customer journeys from initial discovery to final measurement, ideally within the luxury, beauty or fashion industries.

  • Proficiency in web, app and product analytics combined with qualitative research tools (heatmapping, form analytics, live user testing) to uncover user behaviour insights.

  • Analytical and strategic mindset, with the ability to translate complex quantitative and qualitative data into actionable findings, recommendations, and optimisation roadmaps.

  • You love getting to know your clients, developing long-lasting relationships and adding value to their business.

  • When faced with a problem, you collaborate with the appropriate people to evaluate different options find practical solutions.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💰 Reward: You'll be eligible to join our discretionary annual bonus scheme.

💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.

👪 Family Support: Enjoy 14 weeks of paid leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks of paid leave for secondary caregivers. We also provide £1000 (or equivalent) towards courses for returning primary caregivers to support your transition back into work.

Unfortunately, there has been an increase in fake recruiters impersonating Jellyfish and unlawfully using our brand name. If you are unsure if an email with a job offer you have received is genuinely from Jellyfish, or if you suspect any fraudulent activity, please report it to

description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of the Connect Sales team led by Louise, Director of Sales Connect. The team consists of 8 Account Executive covering EMEA Scope. As the SMB Account Executive for the DACH region, you'll be driving new business growth by expanding Mirakl Connect's reach across the SMB segment and bringing more sellers and brands onto the platform in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

Your Impact

  • Proactively identify, prospect, and engage new SMB sellers and brands — owning the full sales cycle from discovery and solution presentation through to negotiation and close.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on Mirakl Connect's Channel Management solution, consulting with SMB clients to understand their needs and clearly articulate platform value.
  • Collaborate with onboarding, customer success, and product teams to ensure smooth integrations and accelerated time-to-value for new customers.
  • Consistently meet or exceed individual sales targets, track pipeline metrics, and surface market feedback to sharpen go-to-market strategy.
  • Stay ahead of SMB landscape trends, competitive dynamics, and evolving customer challenges to continuously refine your sales approach and inform internal stakeholders.

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:
  • 3+ years of experience in a closing sales role with a proven track record in the SMB segment
  • Demonstrated success in building and managing a sales pipeline, negotiating deals, and achieving or surpassing revenue targets
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Finance or a related field; advanced degree is a plus
Skills:
  • Full-cycle sales execution: pipeline management, negotiation, and closing
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels
  • Analytical thinking: turning data and market signals into actionable insights
  • Deep understanding of SMB dynamics and customer needs
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong drive to perform in a high-growth environment

Languages

  • English: Full professional proficiency (required)
  • German: Full professional proficiency (required)
  • French (a plus)

Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.
Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.
  1. Screening call with Talent Acquisition
  2. Interview with Louise, Director of Sales Connect
  3. Values interviews with team members
  4. Case study

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. description:
Qui sommes-nous ? 

Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Autrefois affilié au groupe RES, l’entreprise œuvre depuis 27 ans dans le développement, la construction et l’exploitation de projets éoliens et photovoltaïques.  

 

Aujourd'hui également positionnée sur le marché du stockage d'énergie, Q ENERGY poursuit son expansion vers de nouveaux domaines afin de proposer des solutions intelligentes et complètes pour la production et la fourniture d’énergie durable en France. 

 

L'entreprise compte près de 300 collaborateur.rice.s et 6 agences sur le territoire ainsi qu'un siège social basé à Avignon. Q ENERGY France est une entreprise de la holding européenne Q ENERGY Solutions, créée en 2021 par Hanwha Solutions dans l'objectif de conduire à la prochaine génération de production d'énergie verte et flexible en Europe. Basée à Berlin, Q ENERGY Solutions est une société sœur de Q CELLS, fabricant de modules photovoltaïques reconnu à travers le monde. Les deux sociétés constituent la division Energie du groupe Hanwha Solutions, basé à Séoul. 

 

Vos missions : 

Sous la supervision de la Responsable Qualité et intégré(e) à l'équipe HSQE, vous contribuez activement à l'amélioration continue du Système de Management Intégré de l'entreprise. À ce titre, vous serez amené.e à intervenir sur des projets structurants autour de la qualité, de la performance et de la digitalisation des processus. 

Vos principales missions seront les suivantes : 

  • Concevoir et développer un tableau de bord HSQE sous Power BI, en exploitant différentes sources de données internes afin de faciliter le pilotage de la performance. 
  • Participer à la définition, à la construction et au suivi des indicateurs de performance HSQE. 
  • Contribuer à l'amélioration et à la maintenance du Système de Management de la Qualité. 
  • Participer à la rédaction et à l'optimisation des documents de référence : procédures, modes opératoires, trames, fiches de contrôle et processus. 
  • Accompagner les équipes opérationnelles dans la formalisation et la standardisation de leurs pratiques. 
  • Contribuer à la surveillance des processus et à la mise en œuvre d'actions d'amélioration continue. 
  • Assurer un support aux utilisateurs et participer au traitement des demandes liées à l'outil de management de la performance QHSE Excellence Monitor. 
  • Participer à la préparation, à l'organisation et au suivi des audits internes et externes. 
  • Collaborer à différents projets d'amélioration des outils, méthodes et pratiques qualité au sein de l'entreprise. 

Ce stage vous permettra de développer une vision concrète des systèmes de management, de la performance des processus et des outils qualité, tout en contribuant à des projets à forte valeur ajoutée pour l'organisation. 

HSE : 

Contribution à la culture Santé, Sécurité et Environnement de l’entreprise via :  

  • Réalisation du travail dans le respect des mesures de prévention mises en place au sein de l’entreprise et reprises notamment dans le Document Unique, les Politiques Santé, Sécurité et Environnement, procédures, modes opératoires et guides 
  • Déclaration de tout événement ou situation pouvant représenter un danger pour les personnes y compris collègues et prestataires et/ou l’environnement  
  • Participation aux événements de formations et de sensibilisations traitant de ces thématiques 

  

Qualité : 

  • Respect et mise en œuvre de la politique d’entreprise et des procédures qualité  
  • Participation à la mise à jour des documents du système de management de la qualité  
  • Déclaration des non-conformités et participation à la mise en place d’actions correctives 
  • Participation aux actions et projets d’amélioration continue et de partage des savoirs

Requirements

Votre profil : 

  • Étudiant.e en dernière année d'école d'ingénieur ou en Master spécialisé en Qualité, Management des Organisations, Amélioration Continue ou équivalent.  
  • Connaissances des référentiels de management (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) 
  • La maîtrise des outils bureautiques dont Power BI est indispensable 
  • Intérêt marqué pour l'analyse de données 
  • Capacité d'analyse, esprit de synthèse et rigueur méthodologique.  
  • Aisance rédactionnelle et aptitude à formaliser des processus et des standards.  
  • Vous avez un grand sens de l’organisation et êtes à l’aise avec le travail d’équipe  
  • Autonomie, curiosité et force de proposition. 
  • La maîtrise de l’anglais est un plus 

 

Localisation et déplacements 

Basé à Avignon 

Benefits

Comment faisons-nous la différence ? 

  • Des valeurs fortes et incarnées   
  • Un management de proximité   
  • Une dynamique d’organisation apprenante   
  • Une entreprise en constant développement  
  • Valorisation et développement des compétences   

 

Nos avantages sociaux 

  • Flexibilité et bien-être : jusqu'à 1 jour de télétravail et flexibilité des horaires 
  • Prise en charge à 100% des frais de transports collectifs  
  • Forfait mobilité durable pour les déplacements en mobilité douce (vélo...) ou en covoiturage et aides à l’écomobilité   
  • Titres restaurants (10€ pris en charge à hauteur de 5,5€ par la société)
