Jij bent de schakel tussen strategie en uitvoering, en vertaalt onze organisatiedoelen naar een duidelijke technologische koers.


Wat ga je doen?

Als Solution Architect ontwerp en bewaak je de ICT-architectuur van GGZ inGeest. Je zorgt dat onze informatievoorziening aansluit bij de strategische ambities van de organisatie én bij de behoeften van zorg en bedrijfsvoering.

  • Je bent vanaf de start betrokken bij initiatieven, analyseert de informatiebehoefte en bepaalt de kaders waarbinnen ontwikkelaars en leveranciers de oplossing moeten bouwen.

  • Je adviseert management en projectleiders gevraagd en ongevraagd over technologische keuzes, de impact van nieuwe software en de haalbaarheid van innovaties.

  • Inzicht in bedrijfsprocessen en de vertaling daarvan naar informatie- en ICT-architecturen.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om draagvlak te creëren binnen verschillende lagen van de organisatie.

  • Een proactieve houding: jij signaleert kansen, adviseert en neemt initiatief.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een afwisselende strategische rol in een maatschappelijk relevante organisatie.

  • Ruimte voor eigen initiatief, visie en innovatie.

  • Een salaris conform cao GGZ, ingeschaald in FWG 65.

As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you start by understanding the customer’s business: how people work, what they’re trying to achieve, and where they get stuck. You work alongside them to turn that understanding into AI workflows and agents that make a meaningful difference.

You stay involved from technical presales through implementation and daily use. Customer environments can be complex, from on-premise ERPs to undocumented processes. You enjoy thinking on your feet, testing ideas, and working through business and technical challenges together.

You’ll join our FDE team, working closely with sales, project managers, and product engineering. Success means building something people trust, use, and benefit from.

What you will do

  • Understand the customer: Work with end users and decision-makers to understand their processes, exceptions, and priorities. Help identify what’s worth solving and what a useful outcome looks like.

Find practical alternatives when the first approach doesn’t work, and support fellow FDEs with integration challenges.

  • Applied AI experience: You’ve built LLM-powered workflows, agents, or applications and understand prompts, context, tool use, and evaluation. You can judge where AI adds value and where straightforward logic works better.

  • Practical engineering skills: You’re comfortable with APIs, authentication, data transformations, and coding in a language such as TypeScript or Python. You can investigate unfamiliar systems and troubleshoot complex integrations.

  • Resourcefulness and ownership: You break down unclear problems, test ideas, and adapt as you learn. You take responsibility for delivery, balancing creative solutions with reliability and knowing when to bring in help.

  • Experience in technical presales or a customer-facing engineering role.

  • Familiarity with low-code/no-code platforms.

  • A carry-on ice cream bar. It’s becoming our thing.

We offer

  • A salary of €65,000–€85,000 and a share package.

  • Hands-on work solving real business problems with AI.

  • An experienced, collaborative team working together in Amsterdam.

  • The opportunity to shape our platform and how our FDE team works.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Do you want to work out how you actually measure whether an AI system is doing a good job, and then make it better? We're looking for a sharp, analytical data scientist to own the evaluation and quality loop of our AutoQA product. You can be early in your career (recent graduates with strong LLM fundamentals are welcome), we have room and a clear path for you to grow.

In a nutshell

  • Join a fast-growing SaaS company in an international environment (steep learning curve guaranteed).

  • Own a high-impact problem: making LLM-powered quality assurance measurably accurate at scale.

  • Sit at the intersection of AI and CX, working directly with enterprise customers and their real-world QA rubrics.

  • Grow into a Senior Data Scientist, AI Engineer, or ML Engineer role. We invest in progression.

  • Enjoy the perks: flexible hours, open holiday policy, an office in the heart of Amsterdam with hybrid flexibility, visa sponsorship, great gear, workations, and team events.

About Kaizo

At Kaizo, we build a performance development and quality platform for customer support teams. Our AutoQA product uses LLMs to review support conversations against each customer's own quality rubric, automatically and at scale. Behind it sits a microservices-based stream processing platform handling over 200 million events per day (Kafka, Kubernetes on Google Cloud, ElasticSearch, MongoDB, BigQuery), and an LLMOps stack built around LangSmith for experimentation, prompt management, and tracing.

The hard part isn't calling an LLM. It's knowing, with evidence, how well the system performs on every customer's unique rubric, and having a reliable, repeatable way to improve it. That's where you come in.

What you'll focus on

  • Translate customer rubrics into AutoQA instructions. Work with real customer quality criteria and turn them into precise, testable instructions that LLMs can score reliably.

  • Run experiments that move accuracy. Design and execute evaluation experiments on large, representative datasets using LangSmith and BigQuery, and track quality with our performance metrics.

  • Build the datasets that make evaluation possible. Curate raw production data into golden datasets with balanced coverage, and generate synthetic data to cover the rare cases that matter most. QA is a discipline of rare occurrences: distributions are skewed, positives are scarce, and resourcefulness beats volume.

  • Build LLM-as-a-judge pipelines to assess system quality internally and make evaluation repeatable.

  • Make results actionable. Your experiments should end in a decision: change a prompt, adjust which tools the system uses, surface context the AI is missing, or flag where new capabilities are needed. You'll work with the AI team to ship those decisions.

  • Evaluate across the full stack. Beyond scoring quality, you'll help validate retrieval (RAG/IR), tool calling, and speech pipelines (transcription and diarization quality).

  • Join customer calls with the team to understand how QA leaders define quality, and feed what you learn back into the product.

What you'll grow into

  • Shaping how customers monitor quality themselves, catch drift, and keep their AutoQA setup improving over time.

  • Smarter categorization and routing of conversations to power analytics and get the right tickets to the right evaluation.


  • A solid understanding of how LLMs work and hands-on experience prompting them for accuracy (coursework, thesis, internships, or side projects all count; production experience is a bonus).

  • Good applied statistics: experiment design, classifier evaluation, precision/recall trade-offs, and working with heavily imbalanced data.

  • Strong Python skills and fluency with the standard data toolkit (Pandas, NumPy, Jupyter). SQL is a plus.

  • An analytical, evidence-first mindset: you'd rather measure than assume.

  • Product sense and empathy for end users. You'll be building for QA managers and support agents, not just for benchmarks.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication. You'll present findings to the team and join customer conversations.

  • 0 to 2 years of industry experience. Recent graduates with strong relevant work are encouraged to apply.

  • A team player who's comfortable wearing multiple hats. We're an early-stage company and things move fast.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with LangSmith or similar LLMOps/evaluation tooling

  • Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Docker, or Kubernetes

  • Speech/audio processing or ASR evaluation

  • Fine-tuning or building synthetic datasets for LLMs

Who you'll work with

You'll join our AI team (two data scientists, an AI engineer, and an ML engineer) and collaborate closely with our data engineers, frontend engineers, designer, product manager, and CX teams. You'll have mentorship from day one and real ownership fast.

What's in it for you?

  • An office in the heart of Amsterdam, with the flexibility of hybrid working

  • Visa sponsorship available for eligible candidates

  • Great office gear: MacBook, tools, desk, chair, whatever you need

  • Flexible working schedule and an open holiday policy

  • Fun workations and team events

  • A clear growth path into Senior Data Scientist, AI Engineer, or ML Engineer roles

title: Senior Marketing Specialist
description:
Senior Marketing Manager

Location: Europe, Amsterdam preferred (hybrid or remote possible)
Competitive salary
Start date: as soon as possible

Let’s be blunt: Kaizo doesn’t have a real marketing engine yet.

We’ve had marketers before, but the company we are today is a different company. Over the past 18 months we’ve signed enterprise customers like Canva, Instacart, UiPath and Indeed. We’ve also rebuilt our product around a new reality: support teams now run on a mix of human agents and AI agents, and someone has to check the quality of both. Kaizo is the independent Agentic QA layer for that hybrid workforce. We work across helpdesks and Customer Service platforms, and we don’t build AI agents of our own, so we have no reason to mark our own homework.

The problem is that the market doesn’t know this yet. We’re the customer service industry’s best-kept secret.

  • The website architecture has just been rebuilt, but the content is outdated and doesn’t tell today’s story.

  • We have strong enterprise customer stories that nobody has written up.

  • Inbound is no longer enough. AI search has changed how buyers find vendors, so pipeline now has to come from outbound, partners, events and reputation.

  • We’re going to the field and starting to attend international events.

  • Sales doesn’t have all the decks, battlecards and collateral it needs.

  • Outbound has started, and it needs content behind it.


That’s where you come in.

What this role really is

We need a senior marketer who wants to build from scratch, and who sees a blank page as an opportunity, not a threat. You’ll be the one who:

  • Brings the website to life so it reflects who we are today and gets found, by people and by AI search.

  • Turns our enterprise wins into case studies and references that open new doors.

  • Owns our review and analyst presence: a proper G2 strategy, competitor and comparison pages that convert, and support for analyst relations.

  • Gives Sales and CS the content, one-pagers, battlecards and decks that win deals and renewals.

  • Starts product marketing: positioning, launches, and clear messaging on AutoQA, Agentic QA, Insights and AI Coaching for customers and prospects.

  • Builds our brand through thought leadership, PR and executive content on the future of CX quality in an AI-agent world.

  • Owns our social channels and online reputation.

  • Defines and runs a field marketing plan, so Kaizo shows up at the international events that matter to our enterprise ICP.

  • Works with Sales on outbound and partner campaigns, including our helpdesk and Customer Service ecosystem partners.

You won’t inherit a polished machine. You’ll be the architect, the builder and the driver of Kaizo’s marketing.

The deal

  • Location: Amsterdam preferred, flexible across Europe, hybrid or remote possible.

  • Reporting: directly to Thibaud, Co-CEO, as part of the commercial leadership team.

  • Real ownership, a fast feedback loop with Sales and Product, and a seat at the table where positioning gets decided.

Why this matters

Marketing is the missing piece in Kaizo’s growth engine. The product is there, the enterprise customers are there and the deals are there. Now the market needs to know it, and we need demand that scales.

If you succeed, your fingerprints will be all over Kaizo’s next growth chapter:

  • From a handful of enterprise logos → recognised category voice

  • From inbound dependency → repeatable, multi-channel pipeline

  • From scrappy content → thought leadership

→ If you’re looking for a comfortable role with a big team, a big budget and playbooks already written, this isn’t it.
→ If you want to build the marketing engine that takes Kaizo from great product to visible market leader, let’s talk.


Who you are

  • A content-first marketer. Storytelling is your edge, not growth hacks.

  • You’ve marketed complex B2B SaaS, ideally to enterprise buyers with long sales cycles and buying committees.

  • You’re hands-on: you write, edit, brief designers, manage freelancers and run campaigns yourself.

  • You know what good marketing ops looks like, and you can get by with lean tools (we run on HubSpot).

  • You understand how AI search is changing B2B discovery, and you know how to adapt SEO and content to it.

  • Your English is native or near-native. Everything we publish has to read sharp and professional.

  • Bonus: AI, QA and CX excite you, and acronyms don’t scare you. You’re keen to learn our product, our customers’ pain points and the trends on both the CX and QA sides.

  • Bonus: experience with field events, G2 or analyst relations, or partner and ecosystem marketing.

Equal opportunities

At Kaizo, we believe diversity drives innovation. We’re committed to an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected, supported and able to do their best work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, disability, religion or beliefs. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you.

title: Senior Product Owner - Social Connection & Loyalty
description:
Our Team

We believe travel can create citizens of the world. We spark moments of connection and transformation, giving people the freedom to explore openly and shape their own story.

 

With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight, and a culture of openness, essential to understanding our travellers and one another.

 

We work in a flexible hybrid model from our Utrecht HQ and our homes across the Netherlands.

 

Just as travel is about discovery, we’re looking for people who want to go one stop further, joining a journey that inspires personal transformation through train travel.

                                                                                                

We’re on the search for…

At Interrail, we help people experience Europe by train. We are looking for a PO to make that experience more connected, rewarding, and transformative. You will lead the strategy and roadmap for products that bring travellers together, recognise their journeys, and give them more reasons to return to Interrail and make them feel a sense of belonging. 

 

From social connection, community, to loyalty, referrals, and gamification, you will create experiences that turn a great trip into a lasting relationship with our brand. Some of these experiences will also support informal learning, intercultural exchange and personal development through travel.

 

You will work closely with Design, Engineering, Data, Lifecycle Marketing, Customer Experience, and Commercial teams to build products that customers genuinely value and that strengthen engagement, retention, advocacy, and lifetime value.  

The role exists to solve one fundamental challenge: how do we create meaningful reasons for travellers to remain engaged with Interrail between journeys, and return not only to travel again, but to participate, contribute and advocate for the brand?

 

What you’ll be doing

  •  Define and deliver the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for community, loyalty, referrals, and gamification. 

  • Own the digital loyalty experience and economics. 

  • Design products that enable meaningful interactions and real-world connections between travellers, while maintaining a safe, respectful and inclusive environment.  

  • Develop product experiences that encourage cultural exchange, curiosity and informal learning through social interaction.  

  • Work with Institutional Initiatives to translate relevant programme objectives into engaging traveller experiences, where these align with the broader Social Connection & Loyalty product strategy. 

  • Build experiences that help travellers connect, share, contribute, and discover useful travel content. 

  • Create loyalty, recognition, and referral journeys that encourage advocacy and repeat travel. 

  • Work with Design, CX, and Engineering to deliver simple, scalable web and mobile experiences. 

  • Partner with Lifecycle Marketing to connect campaigns with relevant in-product journeys. 

  • Use customer insight, behavioural data, AI, and experimentation (A/B testing) to identify opportunities and personalise experiences. 

  • Work with Customer Support and relevant partners to ensure community experiences are safe, trustworthy, and useful. 

  • Define and track success metrics across Traveller Participation Rate, engagement, retention, repeat purchase, referrals, loyalty participation, and customer lifetime value. 

 

What we’re looking for

It's already a possible match when you share the same mindset as us, being forward-thinking, results-driven, caring and embracing diversity.

 

In terms of your experience and skills:

  • 8+ years of product management experience, with experience building and scaling B2C digital products across web and mobile.

  • A track record of building products that improve engagement, retention, loyalty, community participation, or growth. 

  • Demonstrated experience building social, community-driven or interaction-led digital products, with a strong understanding of how to create meaningful interactions between users. 

  • Experience owning a product area from strategy and discovery through delivery, scaling, and optimization. 

  • Experience designing for trust, safety, inclusion and healthy community participation, particularly where digital experiences facilitate interaction between people who do not already know one another. 

  • Strong qualitative user research and behavioral insight skills, with the ability to understand why people connect, participate and contribute, not only what they click or use. 

  • Strong product judgment and the ability to turn customer insight into simple, valuable experiences. 

  • Confidence using data, experimentation, and product metrics to make decisions and measure incremental impact. 

  • Experience working closely with Design, Engineering, Data, Marketing, and other business stakeholders. 

  • A thoughtful approach to customer trust, privacy, safety, and responsible engagement design. 

  • Comfort working in a fast-moving, international environment. 

 

Nice to have:

  • Experience translating institutional, educational or social-impact objectives into compelling consumer-facing digital experiences.

  • An interest in travel, rail, and the ways people discover and share experiences.

  • Experience with user-generated content, personalisation, CRM platforms, or notification systems.

 

Our offer

  • We offer a flexible hybrid model that combines remote work with in-office days each week, enhancing teamwork and connection.

  • A complimentary NS train card to travel across the Netherlands for work and leisure.

  • An annual free Interrail/Eurail travel pass for you and a companion, so you can explore Europe and share the same experiences as our customers.

  • Unlimited access to OpenUp for lifestyle & well-being recommendations.

  • Support for your well-being through a personal allowance of €1500.

  • We provide a training allowance of €4000 to support learning opportunities relevant to your role.

  • Variable annual bonus (target 4%), based on company and individual performance.

  • An annual team trip across Europe to experience our product first-hand.

  • 20 working days per year from abroad.

  • An annual leave package of 28 days, plus study days, volunteer days, and a culture day.

  • Salary Scale: 61, Monthly gross salary (excluding 8% allowance): €7000 - 8000 (full-time) based on experience.

 

Curious to apply?

Apply directly via our website (https://www.interrail.com/en/careers).

 

  • We'll ask you to share your resume in English (our business language) and tell us why you're interested in Eurail and this particular role. It doesn't hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through.

  • As part of the process, we may also ask you to complete a short assessment to showcase your skills.

 

If we think you might be a good candidate, the next step is a relatively informal interview. For you, this is a chance to understand if Eurail is your ideal workplace, and for us, it tells us more about the value you would bring.

 

To support fair and unbiased hiring, we use a blind recruitment process in the early stages. Personal details such as your name, date of birth, photo, contact information, social media links, gender, and nationality are hidden, allowing us to focus on your skills, experience, and potential.

In the meantime…

If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values?

 

Got questions? Our People & Culture team would be happy to help — just drop us a note at

 

While you're here, explore our travel passes and get inspired for your next journey at  https://www.interrail.com/en.

title: Medior/Senior Softwareontwikkelaar C#/.NET
description:
Wil jij meebouwen aan een SaaS-oplossing die de zorg slimmer, eenvoudiger en betaalbaarder maakt? Ter uitbreiding van ons team zoeken wij een softwareontwikkelaar die graag werkt aan bedrijfskritische software met maatschappelijke impact.

Over ons

Bij Care Expert werken we elke dag aan één praktisch doel: zorgen dat zorgorganisaties krijgen waar ze recht op hebben, zonder onnodig gedoe. Declareren in de zorg is ingewikkeld, foutgevoelig en tijdrovend – en dat zou eigenlijk niet zo moeten zijn.

Met ons platform helpen we zorgorganisaties om hun declaraties automatisch te laten kloppen. We vertalen complexe wet- en regelgeving naar software die controleert, voorkomt en verwerkt, zodat handmatig correctiewerk steeds minder nodig is.

Care Expert komt oorspronkelijk uit de praktijk. We leveren al jaren software én ondersteuning rondom zorgdeclaraties en weten daardoor precies waar het spaak loopt. Die kennis gebruiken we nu om verder te bouwen aan Care2Declare als volwaardig SaaS‑platform: schaalbaar, betrouwbaar en geïntegreerd met andere zorgsystemen zoals ECD’s en financiële software.

Bij Care Expert werk je aan een systeem dat een essentieel onderdeel vormt van hoe zorgorganisaties functioneren.

Over de functie

Binnen het team werk je aan software die zich richt op het facturatieproces van laboratoria. Via dit platform worden jaarlijks miljoenen declaraties verwerkt, een bedrijfskritische applicatie dus. Performance, stabiliteit en nauwkeurigheid zijn daarom belangrijk in alles wat we bouwen.

Als softwareontwikkelaar werk je aan nieuwe functionaliteiten, verbeter je bestaande onderdelen en los je bugs op die in de praktijk naar boven komen. Je werkt ook mee aan de ontwikkeling van een nieuw systeem voor gegevensuitwisseling tussen verschillende organisaties in de zorg. Care Expert is de eerste marktpartij die deze technische afspraken vertaalt naar werkende software. Dat betekent dat je meebouwt aan nieuwe koppelingen en technische standaarden die nog niet zijn uitgekristalliseerd.

Je werkt in een compact team dat bestaat uit ontwikkelaars, een product owner en een QA. Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat het product goed aansluit op de praktijk en betrouwbaar blijft functioneren in een omgeving waar fouten geen optie zijn.


Wat je gaat doen

  • Nieuwe functionaliteiten ontwerpen en ontwikkelen in C# en de laatste versie van .NET

  • Voornamelijk werken aan backendontwikkeling, met waar nodig frontendwerk in React

  • Schone, onderhoudbare en testbare code schrijven

  • Je voelt je thuis in backendontwikkeling en applicaties met complexe businesslogica

title: Stagiair Finance
description:
Finance leer je pas echt als je ziet wat er achter de cijfers gebeurt.

Ben jij bezig met een opleiding richting Finance, Bedrijfsadministratie, Accountancy of Finance & Control en wil je tijdens je stage ervaren hoe een financiële administratie er in de praktijk uitziet? Dan hebben we binnen het Finance-team van Claus Group een mooie stageplek voor je.

Bij ons kijk je niet alleen mee. Je gaat vooral zelf aan de slag.

Je leert hoe facturen worden verwerkt, hoe betalingen en bankmutaties worden gecontroleerd, hoe we omgaan met debiteuren en crediteuren en hoe financiële gegevens uiteindelijk samenkomen in een betrouwbare administratie.

En die administratie is bij Claus behoorlijk veelzijdig. Binnen onze organisatie komen horeca, events en leisure samen. Een groot bedrijfsevent heeft financieel een heel andere dynamiek dan een avond BARRACA of een druk weekend bij Claus Bowling. Juist daardoor krijg je tijdens je stage te maken met verschillende soorten omzet, kosten, leveranciers en administratieve processen.

Je wordt begeleid door onze Finance-collega's en krijgt gedurende je stage steeds meer ruimte om werkzaamheden zelfstandig op te pakken. Natuurlijk houden we daarbij rekening met jouw opleiding, leerdoelen en wat je vanuit school moet aantonen.

Dit is Claus Group

Claus Group is een veelzijdige horecagroep waar gastvrijheid, kwaliteit en beleving centraal staan. Vanuit onze locaties in Hoofddorp en Amsterdam creëren wij elke dag opnieuw bijzondere ervaringen voor onze gasten.

Claus Group bestaat uit verschillende unieke hospitalitymerken. Bij Claus Events organiseren wij jaarlijks honderden congressen, vergaderingen, bedrijfsfeesten en andere zakelijke evenementen. Met 20 moderne bowlingbanen en het sfeervolle American 50’s Diner restaurant biedt Claus Bowling gasten een gezellige middag of avond uit. Bij Braziliaans restaurant BARRACA Rodizio Grill & Bar brengen we de warme Zuid-Amerikaanse gastvrijheid naar onze gasten met het unieke rodizio-concept.

Elk merk heeft zijn eigen karakter, maar samen vormen we met ruim 150 collega’s één familie. We staan voor elkaar klaar en doen er alles aan om de verwachtingen van onze gasten te overtreffen. Dat doen we met passie, vakmanschap en plezier. We geloven in korte lijnen, samenwerken, ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke aandacht. Of je nu werkt in de bediening, keuken, techniek, evenementen of op kantoor: iedere collega draagt bij aan de beleving van onze gasten. Jouw bijdrage maakt het verschil!

Bij Claus Group werk je niet zomaar in de horeca. Je werkt in een organisatie waar iedere dag iets anders gebeurt, waar collega's voor elkaar klaarstaan en waar je de ruimte krijgt om jezelf te ontwikkelen.

Wat ga je doen?

Tijdens je stage draai je mee met de dagelijkse werkzaamheden van onze Finance-afdeling. We beginnen natuurlijk met een goede uitleg en begeleiding. Naarmate je meer leert, kun je steeds meer werkzaamheden zelfstandig uitvoeren.

Je gaat onder andere:

· Inkoopfacturen verwerken en controleren;

· Meewerken aan de crediteurenadministratie;

· Bankmutaties verwerken en controleren;

· Ondersteunen bij de debiteurenadministratie;

· Openstaande posten controleren en opvolgen;

· Betalingen en financiële gegevens controleren;

· Verschillen en afwijkingen helpen uitzoeken;

· Financiële documenten verwerken en archiveren;

· Contact hebben met collega's over ontbrekende of onduidelijke informatie;

· Ondersteunen bij periodieke controles en afsluitingen;

· Werken met Excel en onze financiële systemen;

· Gegevens verzamelen en controleren voor financiële overzichten;

· Meedenken over hoe administratieve processen slimmer of efficiënter kunnen;

· Ondersteunen bij andere financiële werkzaamheden die binnen het team voorbij komen.

Welke werkzaamheden je precies oppakt, hangt ook af van jouw opleiding, ervaring en ontwikkeling tijdens de stage.

Wat ga je bij ons leren?

Een stage is er om te leren. We vinden het daarom belangrijk dat je niet alleen taken uitvoert, maar ook begrijpt waarom je iets doet.

Tijdens je stage leer je bijvoorbeeld hoe een financiële administratie binnen een organisatie wordt opgebouwd en bijgehouden, hoe verschillende geldstromen worden verwerkt en waarom een correcte administratie zo belangrijk is voor de rest van de organisatie.

Je leert afwijkingen herkennen, verbanden leggen en steeds kritischer naar cijfers kijken. Want als een bedrag niet klopt, is het uiteindelijk veel interessanter om te ontdekken waarom het niet klopt dan het alleen te corrigeren.

Daarnaast krijg je een goed beeld van de samenwerking tussen Finance en andere afdelingen binnen een organisatie.


Dit breng je mee

Je hoeft natuurlijk nog geen ervaren financieel medewerker te zijn – daarvoor loop je juist stage. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je nieuwsgierig bent en graag wilt leren.

Je:

  • volgt een relevante mbo- of hbo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Finance & Control, Bedrijfsadministratie, Accountancy, Business Administration of een vergelijkbare opleiding;

  • vindt het leuk om met cijfers te werken;

  • werkt nauwkeurig en gestructureerd;

  • bent nieuwsgierig en wilt begrijpen waarom iets wel of niet klopt;

  • durft vragen te stellen als je iets niet begrijpt;

  • neemt initiatief en wacht niet altijd af tot iemand je een opdracht geeft;

  • kunt zelfstandig werken, maar vindt samenwerken net zo belangrijk;

  • gaat zorgvuldig om met vertrouwelijke informatie;

  • hebt enige kennis van Excel of wilt hier graag beter in worden;

  • communiceert prettig met collega's;

  • beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed en kunt je ook in het Engels redden.

Ervaring met financiële software of Exact is mooi meegenomen, maar zeker geen vereiste.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Een stage waarin je echt onderdeel bent van het Marketingteam en verschillende kanten van het vak kunt ontdekken.

Je krijgt onder andere:

  • Een veelzijdige marketingstage binnen hospitality, leisure en events;

  • Een stagevergoeding van €500 op basis van 40 uur per week;

  • Veel ruimte voor eigen ideeën en initiatief;

  • De mogelijkheid om mee te werken aan echte campagnes en projecten;

  • Ervaring met verschillende merken, doelgroepen en marketingkanalen;

  • Ruimte om aan jouw schoolopdrachten en persoonlijke leerdoelen te werken;

  • 20% personeelskorting binnen alle merken van Claus Group

  • Een gratis personeelsmaaltijd tijdens je werkdag;

  • Een gezellige en informele werkomgeving waar hard werken en plezier hand in hand gaan.

En misschien wel het belangrijkste: je komt terecht in een organisatie waar collega's elkaar kennen, helpen en samen successen vieren.

title: Senior .NET Developer
description:
Bouw mee aan de toekomst van kassasoftware

Retail staat nooit stil. Ook onze kassasoftware moet betrouwbaar, gebruiksvriendelijk en toekomstbestendig blijven — op de winkelvloer, op drukke momenten en voor de retailers die erop vertrouwen.

 

Voor ons Customer Experience team zoeken we een senior .NET developer die niet alleen sterke software bouwt, maar ook helpt onze bestaande codebase fundamenteel verder te brengen. Een belangrijk deel van je werk is een gerichte refactoring: naar een architectuur die beter onderhoudbaar en testbaar is, waarin testautomatisering vanzelfsprekender wordt en waarin teams effectief en verantwoord met AI kunnen ontwikkelen.

 

Je komt terecht in een rol met inhoudelijke diepgang én zichtbare impact op een product dat dagelijks door retailers wordt gebruikt.

Hoe ziet jouw dag er precies uit?

Je werkt in het Customer Experience team aan onze Windows-kassaclient en aan de technische basis daaromheen. Samen met collega’s uit development en product vertaal je klant- en gebruikersbehoeften naar robuuste software.

 

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het ontwerpen en realiseren van nieuwe functionaliteit voor onze kassasoftware.

  • Het stapsgewijs refactoren en moderniseren van bestaande .NET-code, zonder de continuïteit voor onze klanten uit het oog te verliezen.

  • Het verbeteren van architectuur, modulariteit, afhankelijkheden en codekwaliteit.

  • Het creëren van een codebase die beter testbaar is en waarin geautomatiseerde tests eenvoudiger en betrouwbaarder kunnen worden toegevoegd en onderhouden.

  • Het opzetten en verbeteren van unit-, integratie- en waar relevant end-to-end testautomatisering.

  • Het toepassen en verder ontwikkelen van een AI-native SDLC: van analyse en ontwerp tot implementatie, testen, code review en documentatie.

  • Het kritisch beoordelen, testen en verbeteren van door AI gegenereerde voorstellen en code.

  • Het delen van kennis en het helpen van collega’s om AI-first development effectief, veilig en met behoud van vakmanschap toe te passen.

  • Het samenwerken met product, UX en andere developmentteams om technische keuzes te verbinden met klantwaarde.

Wat bieden we jou?

  • Een inhoudelijk uitdagende seniorrol met directe invloed op de toekomst van onze kassasoftware.

  • De ruimte om een belangrijke refactoring en moderniseringsslag daadwerkelijk vorm te geven

  • Een omgeving waarin AI-first development serieus wordt genomen en waarin je actief kunt bijdragen aan de verdere professionalisering daarvan.

  • Samenwerking met betrokken collega’s in een informele organisatie met korte lijnen.

  • Veel vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

  • Hybride werken, met Breda als kantoorlocatie.

  • Marktconform salaris en aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden.

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke en technische ontwikkeling.


Wat zoeken wij?

Je technische skills

  • Je bent een ervaren software engineer die eigenaarschap neemt en technische vraagstukken graag tot de kern doorgrondt. Je combineert pragmatisme met hoge kwaliteitsstandaarden: je weet wanneer een snelle verbetering passend is, maar ook wanneer een structurele oplossing nodig is.

  • Zeer ruime, aantoonbare ervaring met C# en het .NET-ecosysteem.

  • Ervaring met het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van bedrijfskritische applicaties met een langere technische historie.

  • Goede kennis van objectgericht ontwerp, SOLID-principes, dependency injection, async/await en gangbare design patterns

  • Ervaring met refactoring van complexe codebases en het stapsgewijs verbeteren van architectuur en maintainability.

  • Sterke ervaring met geautomatiseerd testen, bijvoorbeeld met unit tests, integratietests, mocking en testbare architectuur.

  • Ervaring met WPF en .NET Framework; ervaring met .NET MAUI is een plus.

  • Ervaring met bijvoorbeeld Entity Framework, NuGet, CI/CD en Git-gebaseerde ontwikkelprocessen.

  • Een kritische blik op requirements, technische keuzes en kwaliteit.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels.

     

    AI-first development is voor jou de standaard

    Voor deze rol zoeken we nadrukkelijk geen kandidaat die AI slechts af en toe als hulpmiddel inzet. Jij hebt AI-first development volledig omarmd en weet hoe je dit vertaalt naar een professionele softwareontwikkelpraktijk.

     

    Dat betekent dat je ervaring hebt met het inzetten van AI in meerdere fasen van de SDLC, bijvoorbeeld voor analyse, ontwerp, implementatie, testautomatisering, refactoring, documentatie en code review. Je begrijpt tegelijk dat AI geen vervanging is voor engineering judgement: je kunt output valideren, risico’s herkennen, kwaliteit bewaken en de juiste technische beslissingen blijven nemen.

     

    Je hebt een duidelijke visie op hoe AI helpt om sneller en beter te leveren, zonder concessies te doen aan betrouwbaarheid, security, testbaarheid en onderhoudbaarheid.

Je soft skills

  • Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor wat je bouwt én voor de kwaliteit van de technische omgeving waarin je werkt.

  • Je bent analytisch sterk en kunt complexe legacy- of architectuurvraagstukken overzichtelijk maken

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig, blijft jezelf ontwikkelen en deelt graag kennis met anderen

  • Je werkt graag samen, maar kunt ook zelfstandig richting geven aan technische verbeteringen.

  • Je durft bestaande aannames en oplossingen ter discussie te stellen als dat leidt tot een beter resultaat.

  • Je hebt oog voor de gebruiker én voor de lange termijn van het product.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager (all genders)
description:
Als VC-backed Foodtech-Startup schaffen wir den Spagat zwischen gesunder Ernährung, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit. Mit unseren Foodjis bringen wir ultrafrische, leckere Gerichte genau dorthin, wo du die meiste Zeit verbringst – denn wir haben uns zum Ziel gesetzt, über 10 Millionen Arbeitnehmern endlich Zugang zu gesunder Ernährung zu ermöglichen und gleichzeitig Foodwaste zu reduzieren.

Gestalte das perfekte Foodji-Erlebnis

Ein großartiges Produkt allein reicht nicht – echte Kundenzufriedenheit entsteht durch starke Beziehungen und einen klaren Blick auf die Entwicklung des Kundenportfolios. Du machst den konkreten Nutzen und Mehrwert von Foodji sichtbar und schaffst damit die Grundlage für langfristige Partnerschaften.

Deine Mission bei Foodji:

  • (Enterprise-) Kund:innen begleitest du von der Testphase über den Vertragsabschluss durch die gesamte Customer Lifetime.

  • Für dein Kundenportfolio übernimmst du Verantwortung und sorgst dafür, dass Kund:innen Foodji erfolgreich nutzen, langfristig bleiben, wachsen und uns weiterempfehlen.

  • Stabile und vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu zentralen Entscheider:innen und dezentralen Stakeholdern baust du gezielt auf und entwickelst sie weiter.

  • Verantwortung für die Gesundheit und Weiterentwicklung deines Enterprise-Kundenportfolios – von der KPI-basierten Analyse der Account Health bis zur Ableitung gezielter Maßnahmen.

  • Vertragsverlängerungen bereitest du aktiv vor und erkennst Kündigungsrisiken frühzeitig – auch wenn sie zunächst nur an einem einzelnen Standort auftreten.

  • Steuerung von internen und crossfunktionalen Projekten zur Weiterentwicklung des Customer Success Bereichs.


DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Success Management sowie nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Retention-, Vertragsverlängerungs- und Churn-Kennzahlen über ein Kundenportfolio hinweg.

  • Strukturierte, datengetriebene und eigenständige Arbeitsweise mit einem guten Gespür für Kundenbeziehungen sowie der Fähigkeit, Risiken, Kundenpotenziale und nächste Schritte selbstständig zu priorisieren.

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, insbesondere Salesforce, sowie sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse.

  • Kommunikationsstärke auf Entscheider:innenebene – auch in anspruchsvollen Gesprächen – sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Multi-Standort-Accounts mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern strategisch zu betreuen.

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse.

  • Präsentations- und Argumentationsfähigkeit sowie ausgeprägte Networking-Kompetenzen.

  • Ein „Do-it“-Mindset, Teamfähigkeit, Selbstbewusstsein sowie eine lösungs- und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise.

NOCH FRAGEN?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter!

DAS BIETEN WIR

  • Office Foodji & Lunchit App: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office oder Remote

  • Uncapped Bonus: Deine Leistung bestimmt dein Gehalt – nach oben gibt es keine Grenze

  • bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente

  • Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung

  • EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios

  • JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec

  • KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands

  • Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen

  • Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Entwicklungspfade – z. B. vom SDR zum Account Executive

  • Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland

  • Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür

  • Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam!

ÜBER UNS

Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds.

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst.

Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür.

title: Marketing & Communications Lead (f/d/m)
description:
A definitive shift is currently happening. Corporates across the globe are no longer just reporting on sustainability; they are actively investing in it as a core financial and strategic asset.

At CEEZER, we are architecting the infrastructure for enterprise-grade Climate Performance Asset management, transforming how the world's largest companies source and manage carbon credits, Energy Attribution Certificates (EAC), and Sustainable Aviation Fuel certificates (SAFc).

Our platform gives the world’s most ambitious enterprises the data-driven precision, real-time monitoring, and framework-compliant reporting required to confidently deploy capital toward high-impact Climate Performance Asset portfolios and true, measurable climate action.

We are looking for a Marketing & Communications Lead (f/d/m). You will lead CEEZER’s marketing and communications end to end, defining our narrative and building an unmistakably enterprise-grade brand. Partnering with leadership, Sales, Business Development, and Product, you’ll amplify our voice among senior decision-makers at multinational enterprises and make CEEZER their definitive choice.

Your mission

  • Set the vision and strategy. Architect CEEZER's global marketing strategy end to end, owning the roadmap that turns our market position into measurable commercial growth. In close partnership with Sales and Business Development, you'll build demand among decision-makers at leading multinationals and directly shape topline results.

  • Define the category conversation. Lead high-impact PR and thought leadership that brings clarity to complex, fast-moving markets. You'll establish CEEZER and its leaders as the authoritative voice at the center of global climate action.

  • Own the stage. Build a flagship event strategy that puts CEEZER in the rooms, and on the stages, that matter most, with compelling content that inspires and wins over procurement and sustainability leaders.

  • Turn sophistication into advantage. Partner with Product and Commercial teams to translate our technology and data capabilities into clear, value-driven narratives that resonate at board level.

  • Build a marketing function for the AI era. Design, hire, and lead a lean, high-performing team that uses AI and modern tooling to deliver outsized output and measurable business impact. This is your chance to build a model for what modern enterprise marketing looks like.

  • Raise the bar on every touchpoint. Ensure every sales deck, digital channel, and message reflects the polish, precision, and credibility expected by €1B+ revenue organizations.

What you need to succeed

  • 6–7 years of enterprise marketing or brand strategy experience, with a proven track record of translating complexity into clarity for enterprise buyers.

  • Deep experience across Content, PR, Events, and Product Marketing, with a direct focus on generating pipeline, sourcing MQLs, and improving enterprise conversion rates.

  • Demonstrated success driving top-of-funnel lead generation and boosting conversion rates by creating targeted content that resonates with ESG, procurement, and executive stakeholders at multinational companies.

  • Experience managing and empowering marketing talent to produce high-quality, high-impact work with a small, efficient headcount.

  • German fluency (spoken and written) is a strong plus.

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce and Pardot to build, execute, and measure marketing campaigns is also a bonus.

The hiring process

  • An intro call with the People Team

  • A call with our CEO, Magnus

  • A call with our CRO, Juliane Sterzl

  • A panel interview with senior stakeholders

What's in it for you at CEEZER?

  • A mission that matters: Work alongside international teams combining finance, tech, and climate science professionals to direct capital toward the world's most critical climate assets.

  • Accelerated growth: We are scaling fast, and your career will too. Take opportunities to lead cross-functional initiatives and expand your strategic influence.

  • True ownership: We are building in a brand-new market, meaning many of our best practices don’t exist yet. If you see a better workflow, tool, or strategy, you have the autonomy and backing to build it.

  • An empowering environment: We bring together diverse global perspectives, knowing that solving complex climate challenges requires a wide mix of backgrounds and expertise.

  • Real enterprise impact: Transform how global corporates approach sustainability. CEEZER hosts 50Mt+ of vetted carbon credits across all pathways, all backed by sophisticated data and institutional-grade risk management.

  • A net-zero career: We practice what we preach. From your first day, we fully offset your personal and professional carbon footprint because sustainability is how we operate.

 

Excited to create impact with us?

If you don't meet every requirement but have exceptional strengths that could make you excel in this role, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now and let's discuss your potential.

CEEZER is the leading partner for Climate Performance Asset procurement and management, empowering businesses to transform climate ambition into a clear path to net-zero. title: Website Growth & CRO Manager
description:
Berlin, Germany · Full-time

Important: Business-fluent German (C1 or C2) is a must for this role, as optimizing website texts is a key part of the work. Applications with a lower level of German will not be considered.


The Role

We are looking for a highly analytical, action-oriented, and entrepreneurial Website Growth & CRO Manager to take ownership of our websites and help turn them into high-performing digital sales channels.

In this role, you will drive improvements across our websites, landing pages, and conversion funnels, combining data-driven experimentation with strong UX/UI intuition, compelling copy, and a deep understanding of customer behavior.

You will take ownership of conversion rates, identify opportunities for growth, and turn insights into tangible improvements. You will also contribute to the development of a new product configurator, helping shape intuitive digital experiences that make it easier for customers to discover, customize, and purchase our products.

We’re looking for someone who thinks analytically, moves quickly, and enjoys taking ideas from insight to execution. Early-career candidates with exceptional analytical ability, initiative, and potential are also encouraged to apply.


Key Responsibilities

  • Website Product Ownership: Take ownership of existing websites, landing pages, and conversion funnels, continuously identifying opportunities to improve performance and the customer journey.

  • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Design and implement A/B tests across entire pages and individual sections to improve conversion rates and generate measurable results.

  • UX/UI & Web Experience: Create intuitive, visually compelling, and high-converting web experiences in collaboration with designers and AI tools.

  • Copywriting & Messaging: Develop persuasive headlines, unique selling propositions (USPs), calls to action (CTAs), and website copy in German that clearly communicate the value proposition and encourage users to take action.

  • Growth Experiments & User Research: Translate data and customer insights into actionable improvements. Independently conduct customer surveys and user research to identify friction points and growth opportunities.

  • Product Development: Contribute to building a new product configurator and help shape the digital experience around the products.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Drive implementation and improvements in close collaboration with Performance Marketing, Content, Design, and Tech teams.

  • AI-powered Execution: Use AI tools proactively to accelerate workflows, explore solutions, and improve the quality and speed of execution.


Requirements

  • MUST: German at C1 or C2 level. You will write and optimize website texts in German as a key part of your work. Profiles with a lower level of German will not be considered.

  • Strong analytical thinking and commercial understanding, with the ability to turn data into clear priorities and measurable improvements.

  • Experience or demonstrated potential in Digital Product Management, Growth, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), Growth Design, or E-commerce.

  • Excellent understanding of UX/UI principles and a strong aesthetic sense for creating intuitive, engaging digital experiences.

  • A talent for clear, persuasive website copy and commercial messaging, including headlines, USPs, and CTAs.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to prioritize, take initiative, and drive ideas through to execution.

  • Comfortable using AI tools as part of your everyday workflow to improve productivity and problem-solving.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity, and a willingness to experiment, learn, and continuously improve.

Experience level: We welcome candidates with approximately 3–5 years of relevant experience, but exceptional early-career candidates with 1–2 years of experience and a strong analytical mindset, high initiative, and outstanding potential are also encouraged to apply.


Why Join Us?

  • An international and entrepreneurial environment: Work with colleagues across Berlin, Wrocław, and Helsingborg.

  • Real ownership and responsibility: Have a direct impact on the digital customer experience, conversion rates, and business growth.

  • A culture of trust and development: Take initiative, shape ideas, and grow alongside a collaborative, ambitious team.

  • Ambitious growth with strong foundations: Join an established, founder-led business focused on long-term growth, quality, and building a scalable operation.

  • A distinctive product and industry: Help shape the future of signage by combining physical products, technology, and digital customer experiences.


Location & Work Setup

  • Location: Berlin, Germany

  • Employment type: Full-time

  • Contract type: Permanent employment

Your Role

We’re looking a Solutions Manager with Finance / Procurement System experience (SAP) to lead onboarding for new customers and drive their implementation of our product. We’re also looking for someone who is excited to be hands on and influence our product roadmap.

As every business needs our type of product, you’ll work with a variety of new clients and industries as Zip scales. Current clients include Coinbase, Snowflake, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Databricks.

 

You Will

  • Lead project teams onboarding new customers, with a heavy emphasis on project / stakeholder management and understanding client requirements

  • Responsible for leading the end-to-end implementation for new customers -- roll up your sleeves and build out the customer’s processes from scratch

  • Proactive project management across many customers, to manage requirements and tasks across onboardings

  • Lead, mentor and train training and Q&A sessions with customers and key stakeholders to empower them to utilize the product without additional ongoing help from Zip

  • Collaborate closely with the product and engineering teams to determine which customer requests we should and shouldn’t support, and set expectations with customers

  • Do whatever it takes to make customers happy + successfully onboard them as quickly as possible

  • Continuously improve the post-sales processes to help our customers accelerate the time to value

 

Qualifications

  • 8-10 years of experience implementing or administering a finance / procurement tool

  • Prior experience with the implementation or administration of a procurement tool / ERP (SAP S/4HANA: procurement and AP, SAP Ariba Buying / Invoicing)

  • Germany fluency required

  • Fantastic communication and documentation skills

  • Extreme attention to detail and pride yourself in being incredibly proactive

  • Very strong data management skills, specifically with handling large sets of sensitive customer data in MS Excel

  • You’re able to push back and still make people happy

  • Very comfortable with software configuration (not necessarily technical skills, which would be a plus)

 

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

description:
Job Title: Project Manager - Software Implementation (m/f/x) 

Location: EU

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Project Managers who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:

  

  • Lead the planning and implementation of software projects related to system connections with our customers, ensuring they are delivered on time and within scope. 

  • Maintain and update project plans, proactively identifying and managing any project risks. 

  • Ensure the availability of the right expertise for each project phase, coordinating with internal and external resources as necessary. 

  • Manage stakeholder expectations, delivering regular and comprehensive project updates and effectively resolving any arising issues. 

  • Contribute to the standardization of project implementation methodology and project templates to improve project standardization and efficiency. 

  • Generate thorough Project/Solution Documentation, outlining project goals, deliverables, and timelines. 

  • Handle all customer communication across various projects, ensuring clear, consistent, and timely communication with all stakeholders. 


  • Master's degree in project management or related technical field required. 

  • Background in Electronics/Electricals

  • Professional Project Management Certification from an accredited institution preferred. 

  • Demonstrated understanding of Project Management processes, strategies, and methods 

  • Excellent time management and organizational skills and experience establishing guidelines in these areas for others. 

  • 3+ years of Project management experience in the field of software implementations 

  • Experience with complex data projects where a systematic approach is crucial to success. 

  • Dexterity with software tools and data manipulation & analysis 

  • A creative mind that can think outside the box. 

  • Curiosity to find disruptive as opposed to incremental solutions to challenging data problems. 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. 

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here 

  

Diversity and Inclusion 

If you have a medical condition or an individual need for an adjustment to our process, and you believe this may affect your ability to be at your best – please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support you and make any adjustments that may be needed.  

 

At Makersite, we are dedicated to fostering an environment that champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will consider all applications regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, nationality, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rest assured, all applications will be handled with the utmost confidentiality.

Für den Maschinenraum suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen

Über den Maschinenraum

Der Maschinenraum ist das geteilte Innovationsökosystem deutscher Mittelstands- und Familienunternehmen, um gemeinsam Zukunftsthemen besser zu verstehen und mutiger zu gestalten. Gemeinsam mit rund 80 Mitgliedsunternehmen – darunter Fiege, Sennheiser, Vorwerk und Viessmann – bietet der Maschinenraum Formate und Strukturen, um Transformation systematisch anzugehen: durch den Austausch von Erfahrungen, den Aufbau von Kompetenzen und die Entwicklung konkreter Lösungen. Das Team aus rund 40 Mitarbeitenden betreut die Mitgliedsunternehmen, entwickelt Trainings- und Beratungsformate und betreibt einen Co-Innovation-Space im Herzen Berlins.

Als CRM & Marketing Intelligence Manager (m/w/d) bist du die datengetriebene Kraft hinter unserer Mitgliederkommunikation. Du analysierst, wie sich unsere Mitglieder verhalten – welche Formate sie nutzen, wo sie aktiv sind und wo sie abspringen – und übersetzt diese Erkenntnisse in gezielte Maßnahmen, die Engagement und Bindung stärken. Du konzipierst zusätzlich Strategien zur Identifizierung und Ansprache von neuen Zielgruppen und Kontaktpersonen im Netzwerk.

Was du bewirkst

  • CRM-Management & Datenstruktur
    Du verantwortest die Pflege und Weiterentwicklung unserer CRM-Struktur in Salesforce und stellst sicher, dass Daten vollständig, aktuell und auswertbar sind. Du baust ein KPI-Framework auf, das dem Team eine datenbasierte Steuerung ermöglicht und erstellst regelmäßige Reportings, aus denen du Optimierungsmaßnahmen ableitest.
  • Zielgruppen- & Verhaltensanalyse
    Du analysierst das Verhalten unserer Mitglieder systematisch – auf Basis von CRM- und Analytics-Daten – und entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis dafür, was verschiedene Zielgruppen antreibt und was sie zurückhält. Du bist verantwortlich für die Segmentierung unserer bestehenden Mitgliederbasis und erstellst Strategien für und mit unseren Teams, wie sie diese zielführend identifizieren und ansprechen.
  • Growth & Retention Maßnahmen
    Auf Basis deiner Analysen entwickelst und steuerst du gezielte Handlungen sowie automatisierte Marketingmaßnahmen zur Steigerung von Awareness, Engagement und Loyalität. Du arbeitest dabei eng mit den anderen Teams des Maschinenraum zusammen und unterstützt sie mit Handlungsempfehlungen für die Weiterentwicklung sowie Vermarktung von Angeboten.

Stellenanforderungen

Das bist du

  • Du denkst in Daten, aber handelst in Maßnahmen. Du weißt, dass Zahlen allein nichts verändern – und verstehst es, Insights in überzeugende Empfehlungen und konkrete Umsetzung zu übersetzen.
  • Du bringst 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im CRM, Growth Marketing oder einer vergleichbaren datengetriebenen Rolle mit – idealerweise in einem B2B-Umfeld, einem E-Commerce oder einer mitgliederbasierten Organisation.
  • Du hast nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Zielgruppensegmentierung und Verhaltensanalyse sowie in der Ableitung konkreter Kommunikations- und Marketingmaßnahmen.
  • Du arbeitest sicher mit Salesforce (Sales/Marketing Cloud) – alternativ bringst du tiefes Know-how in vergleichbaren B2B-CRMs (z. B. HubSpot) mit und hast keine Scheu vor Salesforce
  • Du bringst Erfahrung mit relevanten KI-Tools in den Bereichen Analyse und Marketing Automation mit.
  • Du denkst strukturiert, arbeitest präzise und kannst komplexe Datenzusammenhänge klar und verständlich kommunizieren.
  • Du bist eigeninitiativ und verlierst dich nicht in der Analyse – du willst Dinge bewegen.
  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau ist Voraussetzung; gute Englischkenntnisse sind ein Plus.

Was dich erwartet

  • Verantwortung & Freiraum: Die Möglichkeit, datenbasiertes Marketing in einer der spannendsten Netzwerkorganisationen im deutschsprachigen Mittelstand von Grund auf aufzubauen.
  • Teamwork: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung, Member Success und Kommunikationsteam.
  • Hybrid Work: Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit einer ausgewogenen Mischung aus Präsenz in unserem Büro und der Möglichkeit, nach Bedarf mobil zu arbeiten
  • Arbeitsplatz & Lage: Ein moderner Space im Herzen Berlins mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung
  • Impact & Ökosystem: Ein purpose-getriebenes Unternehmen mit einer klaren Vision und einer inspirierenden Community aus Mittelstand, Start-ups und VCs
  • Teamkultur: Eine wertschätzende Feedback-Kultur mit Mut zu neuen Ideen, regelmäßigen Teamevents (z.B. Sommerfest & Offsite), Teamtrainings und echtem Raum für persönliches Wachstum
  • Benefits & Auszeit: 30 Urlaubstage, freie Brückentage sowie attraktive Corporate Benefits (z. B. Urban Sports Club, BVG, Aware by Aeon)

Bei FlixTrain gestaltest du die Zukunft der Mobilität aktiv mit. Wir bieten dir nicht nur sichere Arbeitsplätze sowie attraktive Zusatzleistungen, sondern auch ein dynamisches, internationales Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen echten Einfluss haben. 

Als Netzwerkingenieur (m/w/d) bei FlixTrain verantwortest du die Technologie, die bestimmt, wie unsere Fahrgäste an Bord verbunden sind, navigieren und jede Reise erleben - von WLAN und Netzwerk-Infrastruktur über On-Board-Units bis hin zu mobilen Endgeräten für unser Zugpersonal. In einer Bahnwelt, in der Konnektivität zum entscheidenden Differenzierungsmerkmal wird und Technologien wie Starlink neu definieren, was möglich ist, prägst du unmittelbar, wie FlixTrain vorne bleibt und weiterhin hochwertige, unvergessliche Reisen bietet. 

Als Teil des Product-Development-Teams im Bereich Rolling-Stock & Maintenance sorgst du dafür, dass unsere On-Board-Hardware ein herausragendes Reiseerlebnis für unsere Fahrgäste, einen reibungslosen Betrieb und eine gute Arbeitsumgebung für unser Zugpersonal ermöglicht. Deine Arbeit beeinflusst direkt, wie FlixTrain im Wettbewerb um Konnektivität an Bord die Nase vorn behält und verlässliche, hochwertige Reiseerlebnisse liefert. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Operations, Customer Product und FlixTech sowie mit externen Partnern wie Talgo, ECMs und Lieferanten (z. B. Icomera, Advantech) zusammen.

Über die Rolle

  • Du verantwortest das gesamte On-Board-Technologie-Ökosystem von FlixTrain - WLAN, Netzwerke, On-Board-Units und mobile Endgeräte - und gibst dich nie mit dem Status quo zufrieden 
  • Als zentrale technische Ansprechperson für alle On-Board-Systeme bewertest du Spezifikationen, wägst Trade-offs ab und triffst fundierte, gut begründete Entscheidungen 
  • Kontinuierlich überwachst du die Performance unserer On-Board-Technologie, erkennst Probleme frühzeitig und treibst Verbesserungen voran, die jede Reise reibungsloser machen 
  • Cross-funktionale Projekte rund um Konnektivität, Netzwerk-Performance und die Integration mobiler Endgeräte in die Fahrzeugflotte leitest du eigenverantwortlich und mit klarem Fokus auf Wirkung 
  • Technische Spezifikationen und Netzwerkarchitekturen definierst du so, dass sie ambitioniert und zugleich umsetzbar sind und nahtlose Schnittstellen zu unserer Fahrzeugflotte gewährleisten 
  • Testszenarien und funktionale Validierungen entwickelst du - besonders an der kritischen Schnittstelle zu Kund*innen und Zertifizierungsstellen – und stellst so sicher, dass unsere Lösungen im echten Betrieb funktionieren 
  • Neue Technologien wie 5G, IoT und Starlink behältst du im Blick und übersetzt deine Erkenntnisse in konkrete Empfehlungen für die Technologie-Roadmap von FlixTrain 

Über Dich

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Telekommunikation, Informatik, Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten Bereich 
  • Mit mehr als zwei Jahren praktischer Erfahrung in Netzwerkarchitektur, WLAN-Systemen oder Mobile Device Management überzeugst du - idealerweise im Umfeld von Schienenfahrzeugen oder einer vergleichbar komplexen technischen Umgebung 
  • Ausgeprägte Problemlösungskompetenz zeichnet dich aus, ebenso wie nachweisliche Erfahrung im Troubleshooting komplexer Netzwerksysteme unter Zeitdruck 
  • Verantwortung übernimmst du gern: Du bringst Themen eigenständig zum Abschluss und leitest cross-funktionale Initiativen mit Menschen aus unterschiedlichen Teams und Disziplinen souverän 
  • Klar und überzeugend kommunizierst du mit technischen Expert*innen wie auch mit nicht-technischen Stakeholdern, ohne dabei an Präzision zu verlieren 
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse bringst du mit, da du in einem internationalen Team arbeitest und mit deutschsprachigen Lieferanten und Behörden zusammenarbeitest 
  • Von Vorteil ist Erfahrung mit Lieferanten von Schienenfahrzeugsystemen sowie Vertrautheit mit dem vertraglichen, technischen und regulatorischen Umfeld der Bahnbranche 

Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze – auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! 

Was Wir Bieten

  • Reisevorteile: 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie.
  • Arbeiten von Überall: Je nach Rolle kannst du bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus arbeiten.
  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit Bürokultur, bieten jedoch Flexibilität, um Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen.
  • Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote: Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Stressbewältigungsmaßnahmen – für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige.
  • Lernen & Entwicklung: Nutze Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen.
  • Mentoring-Programm: Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen.

Warum Teil von Flix werden? 

Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und erschwinglich zu gestalten – sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns täglich weiter und suchen Menschen, die bereit sind, sich einzubringen und die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, mitzugestalten. 

Wenn du einen Job suchst, in dem du wachsen und etwas bewirken kannst, dann bist du bei FlixTrain genau richtig. Hier kannst du Teil eines Teams werden, in dem dein Beitrag zählt und du deine Reise selbst gestalten kannst!

title: Senior Manager Tax Planning & Strategy
description:
SumUp's tax function is scaling to match a business that now spans more than 40 entities. This role is a senior partner to the Head of Tax across the Group's tax agenda. You'll lead the implementation and operationalisation of corporate income tax, transfer pricing, and indirect tax strategy, and you'll help shape the positions and policies behind it. You'll bring your own judgement to the most important topics, from how Pillar Two, CbCR, and ATAD III affect our structure to how we manage tax risk in audits, and you'll help the Head of Tax turn those views into a clear Group direction. This role reports to the Global Head of Tax and will have an impact on SumUp's IPO readiness.

What you'll do

  • Lead delivery of SumUp's tax agenda across corporate income tax, transfer pricing, and indirect tax, within the Group tax strategy set by the Head of Tax
  • Oversee the transfer pricing framework and its implementation, and propose improvements to both substance and automation
  • Draft and maintain tax policies, controls, and governance documentation for Group entities, for sign-off by the Head of Tax
  • Act as the first point of contact for tax authority audits and controversies, keeping the Head of Tax aligned on positions and exposure
  • Provide independent technical judgement on high-stakes tax positions, challenging assumptions and bringing options and recommendations to the Head of Tax
  • Partner with Tax Compliance and Tax Operations to keep strategic positions compliant and operationally workable
  • Lead the Pillar Two and CbCR implementation, turning requirements into practical plans for affected markets
  • Lead, develop, and prioritise the tax team, and deputise for the Head of Tax when required

You'll be great for this role if…

  • Senior tax experience across corporate income tax, transfer pricing, and indirect tax in a multinational, combining strategic leadership with hands-on technical delivery. You're comfortable working through the detail yourself, from modelling and documentation to reviewing returns, and you don't need to hand every technical question to an adviser.
  • A track record of building in-house tax expertise, with a preference for developing capability internally and using external advisers selectively, for specialist opinions and peer review rather than day-to-day analysis.
  • Proven track record developing senior tax team members, including people leadership, prioritisation, and performance development.
  • Strong knowledge of European corporate income tax, transfer pricing, and cross-border structuring, along with Pillar Two, CbCR, and EU Directives.
  • Experience leading tax audits and controversies, including extensive direct engagement with tax authorities.
  • Ability to translate complex regulatory and commercial issues into clear tax positions, communicated confidently to non-tax stakeholders such as finance leadership and auditors.

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Join a global fintech with meaningful complexity, scale, and ambition, and play a visible role in shaping the future of tax at SumUp

🚀 Work on high-impact topics including corporate tax, transfer pricing, structuring, controversy, governance, and international expansion

🤝 Act as a true business partner, helping shape how tax supports product, commercial, and strategic decisions across the company

🌈 Be part of a collaborative and inclusive environment where different perspectives are welcomed and valued

📚 Access opportunities for continuous learning and professional development

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 39 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 4,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. description:

You've probably paid for a coffee or tapped your card at a hairdresser using one of our card readers already. Our Hardware team designs and builds the beautifully engineered payment devices and accessories that let millions of small merchants start, run and grow their businesses, spanning industrial design, electronics, embedded systems, mobile apps and backend services.   • Partner with Mechanical Engineering, Android and embedded software, Product and Supply Chain teams to align platform choices, interfaces and product integration

  • Own hardware delivery from prototyping and bring up through validation and mass production readiness, debugging designs and reducing technical risk along the way

  • Significant experience in electrical engineering, gained in consumer electronics or hardware product development.

  • Track record of bringing multiple hardware products through to mass production.

  • Proficiency in a mainstream CAD system such as Altium or Cadence/Allegro.
