title: Customer Success Manager - Enterprise
description:
About Hiya

At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.

Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.

About the Role

You’ll own a portfolio of Hiya’s largest enterprise customers across the UK and Europe, with full accountability for retention, renewals and expansion. As a trusted adviser to their senior leaders, you’ll prove the measurable value of Hiya Connect and grow each account over time. You’ll work closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product and Hiya’s leadership team.

You’ll need fluent English and business-level proficiency in at least one of French, Spanish or German, as you’ll manage many of your European accounts in those languages.

What You'll Do

  • Own 20–25 strategic enterprise accounts across the UK and Europe. You’ll be accountable for gross and net revenue retention, renewals and expansion.

  • Build executive relationships from Director to C-level, working across customer experience, contact centre, marketing, fraud, security and procurement.

  • Develop strategic account plans that map each customer’s objectives, success metrics, buying centres and whitespace into a clear growth roadmap.

  • Lead executive and quarterly business reviews that quantify return on investment (ROI), such as answer-rate uplift, contact-centre efficiency and fraud reduction, and agree next priorities.

  • Run complex renewals and multi-year negotiations covering pricing, contract structure, procurement, legal and security, and forecast them accurately in the CRM.

  • Partner with Sales and Solutions Engineering to find and close expansion across new business units, geographies, use cases and Hiya products.

  • Spot risk early through usage, health and relationship signals. Turn customer insight into clear input for Product, Engineering and Marketing.

What We Are Looking For

  • Typically 5+ years in customer success, strategic account management or enterprise account management at a B2B SaaS or technology company

  • Fluent English plus business-level proficiency in at least one of French, Spanish or German, with the confidence to lead executive conversations, renewals and commercial negotiations in that language

  • A track record of owning and growing large, complex enterprise accounts, including six- or seven-figure renewals and expansions against a net revenue retention (NRR) or quota target

  • Experience influencing senior executives and working through large organisations with many stakeholders

  • Strong commercial sense: you can build a value case, lead a negotiation and link product capabilities to a customer’s financial and operational outcomes

  • Experience creating and running strategic account plans and executive business reviews

You’ll Likely Stand Out If You Have

  • Experience managing enterprise customers in regulated industries such as financial services, insurance, telecoms, utilities or healthcare, ideally across several European countries

  • A background in communications technology, CPaaS, contact-centre solutions, caller ID, fraud prevention or conversation intelligence

  • Working knowledge of UK and EU regulation on caller ID, spam and fraud

  • A record of turning customer feedback into product or go-to-market improvements

How We Work

Hiya is not a passive environment. We expect people to take ownership, form opinions, and engage directly with hard problems.

We work with a high degree of transparency and autonomy. Context is shared openly, and decisions are discussed, challenged, and then made. Once a call is made, we commit and move forward.

You'll be expected to work through ambiguity, weigh tradeoffs, and take responsibility for results, while keeping a high bar for quality and customer trust.

Every team member at Hiya is expected to live our core values:

  • Serve, our customers and partners by holding a high bar for trust and quality

  • Own, share in success and open up to failures

  • Lead, listen, show up with a point of view but commit entirely once a decision has been made

  • Improve, even if it means changing course or contradicting ourselves

  • Do, rather than observe

How We Invest in You

Compensation & Ownership
Equity Compensation: ownership aligned with your impact and the company's growth

We offer an L&D budget to support your growth and real internal mobility so career pathing isn't just a talking point — because we're building this with people who own the outcome.

 

Come Work With Us!

We're building a team with diverse perspectives, identities, and professional experiences. We evaluate candidates through a business lens and believe that diversity and unique viewpoints make our company stronger, more dynamic, and a great place to build a career.

We've been recognized by Built In, GeekWire, Comparably, G2, Forbes, and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 for our culture, innovation, leadership, compensation, and more. At Hiya, we're a people-centric company focused on helping each employee grow both personally and professionally. We create a culture of support and empowerment that challenges the status quo, resulting in an energized team that's passionate about their work. You'll love working here if you're looking for an innovative challenge that's disrupting an industry. Come join us!

Hiya is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

Our mission is to enable businesses and their communities to thrive in the digital economy. Checkout.com builds payment technology that helps ambitious businesses accept payments, get paid out, and grow into new markets. We work as one team, move with ownership, and look for better ways to help our merchants succeed.

As the BDR Academy Lead, you will own the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of Checkout.com’s global Revenue Academy. You will turn commercial priorities into a structured, measurable development journey that helps Business Development Representatives (BDRs) build deep product knowledge, master prospecting skills, and apply our proprietary Sales Methodology. The Academy provides a consistent global foundation, tailored to two distinct sales motions: Mid-Tier and Enterprise.

  • Measurable Value: Executive leadership receives clear, data-backed insights on cohort health, capability growth, and revenue contribution.

What You Bring

Preferred (Nice-to-Have)

title: Application Scientist
description:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

We hire across a spectrum of backgrounds. Some Application Scientists are computational (atomistic and molecular simulation, machine-learned force fields), some are experimental (synthesis, processing, characterisation, lab automation), and some are data-driven (materials and cheminformatics, optimisation). What they share is the ability to turn a partner’s problem into a plan, deliver it, and translate fluently between experimental, computational, and machine learning teams.

We operate a matrix structure. You will have a home team, but may contribute to projects in another pillar as demand and your expertise evolve.

Your Impact

You will own the scientific delivery of partner projects, from scoping to results. Working with our technical programme managers, ML researchers, platform engineers, and lab integration team, you will make sure our platform answers the questions that matter to partners, and that what is learned on each project feeds back into tools and workflows used across the company.

Alongside delivery, you will help build the cross-cutting capabilities that future projects depend on, such as validated workflows, harmonised data pipelines and agentic design campaigns.

Application Areas

We are particularly interested in candidates with expertise in one or more of the areas below. You do not need to cover a whole pillar.

  • Electronics: Semiconductor processing, device-level modelling and electronics, photonic and thermal materials

  • Energy: Catalysis, batteries, photovoltaics and multiscale kinetics.

  • Environment: Porous and soft materials, interfaces, and separations

  • Cross-cutting: Materials informatics, automated experimentation and optimisation.

What You Will Do

Project leadership and delivery

  • Lead partner projects from scoping to delivery, as a key point of contact alongside the technical program managers.

  • Write technical scopes that define objectives, deliverables, success criteria, and timelines.

  • Prepare regular technical reports and presentations for partners and internal teams.

Science and campaigns

  • Apply and extend our platform to partner problems, using simulation, machine learning, data-driven optimisation, or experiments as the project requires.

  • Design and steer discovery campaigns, including agentic and closed-loop campaigns with partner labs.

  • Assess when models, simulations, and data can be trusted, and contribute to validating them against experiments.

Bridging experimental and computational teams

  • Translate platform recommendations into clear, executable experimental plans, and translate lab realities back into requirements for internal teams.

  • Make sure data from partners and our own workflows are clean, structured, and consistent.

  • Work closely with partner labs, including on-site visits at key stages of a project.

Capability and product development

  • Build and automate workflows that run reliably at scale within our platform.

  • Relay partner feedback to TPMs, ML researchers, and platform engineers to improve tools and workflows.

  • Stay informed about advances in your field and contribute to the scientific direction of your team.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications

  • A PhD in chemistry, materials science, physics, chemical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise in at least one of: atomistic simulation (including machine-learned force fields); experimental materials or chemistry, ideally with automation or high-throughput methods; materials or cheminformatics with machine learning and optimisation.

  • A track record in one or more of the application areas above.

  • Python skills for data handling, analysis, automation or modelling, and familiarity with version control (Git).

  • Exceptional ability to communicate with both experimental and computational scientists, and to translate between them.

  • A personal passion for CuspAI's mission and the potential of AI to unlock breakthroughs in materials science.

Bonus Points (But Not Critical)

  • Industry experience, particularly in the semiconductor, electronics, energy, or chemical sectors.

  • Experience leading projects or collaborations with external partners, including writing technical scopes or proposals.

  • Experience with multiscale modelling, from atomistic to mesoscale, continuum or device level.

  • Practical synthesis or processing experience, with an understanding of what makes a route feasible and reproducible.

  • Professional software engineering practice, such as code review, testing and deployment.

  • Prior experience in a start-up or fast-growth technology company.

Additional Considerations

These roles can be based in our London, Cambridge, Amsterdam, or Berlin offices, with the expectation of being in the office at least three days per week. There may be regular travel to partner sites and other CuspAI offices for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.

Screening Requirements

This role requires successful completion of the Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) screening prior to commencement. BPSS is a government-mandated pre-employment check that includes identity verification, right to work, employment history, and criminal record screening.

Depending on the nature of the work undertaken, additional security clearance at Security Check (SC) level or above may also be required. Candidates must be eligible to work in the UK and willing to undergo the necessary vetting processes.

  • Certifications: Relevant certifications such as CREST CRT, CREST CCT, OSCP, OSWE, OSCE, or equivalent level.

  • Communication: Strong verbal and written skills for stakeholder management, collaboration and report writing.

  • Independence: Ability to work solo or as part of a team on penetration tests.

Key Attributes

  • Analytical thinker with a proactive, detail-oriented approach.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of engaging with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Ability to work effectively under pressure and adapt to rapidly changing threat landscapes.

  • Commitment to maintaining the highest ethical and professional standards.

La version actuelle repose sur un classeur Excel/VBA développé en interne, aujourd'hui fonctionnel mais limité en termes d'évolutivité, de travail collaboratif et de gestion des accès.

Une refonte web de l'outil a été initiée : architecture posée, environnement de développement en place, spécification fonctionnelle rédigée (CDC v1.0) et modèle de gestion des droits par rôle (RBAC) conçu. L'objectif du stage est de reprendre ce socle, poursuivre le développement et amener l'outil à un niveau de finalisation permettant sa mise en production, en remplacement progressif de l'outil VBA/Excel existant.

Missions:

Rattaché(e) à l'ingénieur ayant initié le projet, vous serez responsable du développement de bout en bout de la nouvelle plateforme :

  • Prendre en main l'existant : architecture, spécification fonctionnelle, modèle de données et base de code déjà initiée

  • Développer le back-end (API, logique métier, persistance des données)

  • Développer le front-end (interface utilisateur, ergonomie, navigation dans la structure produit)

  • Implémenter la gestion des droits par rôle (RBAC)

  • Reprendre les fonctionnalités clés de l'outil VBA existant (import de structure produit, génération de listes documentaires, gestion des statuts et indices de documents, historique/traçabilité) et les adapter à l'architecture web

  • Mettre en place les tests (unitaires / fonctionnels) et documenter le code et les choix techniques

  • Participer aux phases de validation avec les utilisateurs métier et itérer sur les retours

  • Contribuer à la finalisation du déploiement de l'outil

Profil recherché:

  • Étudiant(e) en école d'ingénieur ou master, spécialisation informatique / développement logiciel, à la recherche d'un stage de fin d'études (6 mois)

  • Bonne maîtrise de Python et d'un framework web back-end (FastAPI, Django ou équivalent)

  • Bonne maîtrise de React (ou forte motivation à monter en compétence rapidement)

  • Connaissances en modélisation de données et bases relationnelles

  • À l'aise pour travailler en autonomie sur un projet existant, en comprendre la logique métier et en assurer la continuité

  • Rigueur, sens de la documentation, capacité à dialoguer avec des utilisateurs non-développeurs

  • Une sensibilité pour les problématiques industrielles / gestion documentaire est un plus

title: ML Platform Engineer
description:
About us

Bleu Robotics is an AI company developing universal AI software for the deployment of advanced robots , humanoids, mobile manipulators, and industrial arms, in real factories. The convergence of humanoid robotics and modern AI is one of the most significant technical opportunities of the decade, and most of the work today still happens in research settings. We are building the software layer required to bring it into operational use.

We have a strong ambition to become the next Microsoft to run on every industrial humanoid. We have closed our pre-seed round with Top-tier fund to deploy our robot in Tier 1 manufacturing facilities.

We are looking for deeply passionate scientists who can help us push the frontier and build a major lab in physical AI.

Our vision

To enable a robot to learn a new industrial task from a few demonstrations and operate autonomously, with under one hour between the start of the demonstration and the start of deployment.

This objective shapes our roadmap and every technical decision we make.

THE ROLE

We are hiring an ML Platform Engineer to put our robot learning stack in the cloud and own the full stack. The platform will let customers run our learning pipelines on their own data as a hosted service; its exact scope will evolve with the product.

You will be the first engineer at Bleu Robotics with cloud expertise. The scope covers infrastructure, training and inference services, the web front end, security, and cost. The choice of cloud provider and web framework is open; you will make it with the team.

The role is based in Paris and is on-site.

BACKGROUND

We are equally interested in two kinds of background:

  1. software or ML platform engineer who has built and operated a cloud service that runs training or inference jobs on data uploaded by users (e.g., an ML platform team, an MLOps product, a SaaS that runs compute on customer data).

  2. backend or full-stack engineer with solid DevOps experience who has shipped a web product on a major cloud provider and wants to work on robot learning.

Experience with robotics or robot learning is appreciated but not required. You will learn the learning stack from the team; the team will learn cloud practices from you.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design the architecture of the platform and select the cloud provider, orchestration layer, and web stack, in agreement with the team

  • Package our training and inference pipelines (Python, PyTorch) as cloud services: job scheduling, GPU provisioning, artifact storage, versioning of datasets and policies

  • Build the web application through which users upload data, follow training runs, and download policies, including its front end and API

  • Add interactive, browser-based components to the platform, including simulation, as the product evolves

  • Set up infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring, logging, and alerting for the platform

  • Implement authentication, per-customer isolation, and data protection for confidential industrial data

  • Control cloud costs: GPU usage, storage, and idle resources

  • Bring cloud and DevOps practices to the rest of the engineering team through documentation, reviews, and training

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s degree or PhD in computer science or a related field, followed by 2 to 3 years of professional experience building and operating a comparable cloud service

  • Hands-on experience running production workloads on at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure, or a European provider such as Scaleway or OVHcloud)

  • Proficiency with containers and orchestration (Docker and Kubernetes or a managed equivalent) and with infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar)

  • Strong Python development skills for backend services, including asynchronous job execution

  • Front-end development experience with a modern web framework (React, Vue, Svelte, or similar), sufficient to ship the user-facing application yourself

  • Experience with CI/CD, monitoring, and security practices for a multi-tenant service

  • Comfortable working in Linux environments with Git

  • Professional proficiency in English, the official language of the team. Proficiency in French is not required; many of our employees do not speak French.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

The strongest candidates will combine cloud fluency with experience across several of the following:

  • ML infrastructure: training job orchestration, GPU scheduling, experiment tracking, model registries

  • PyTorch and the Python machine learning ecosystem

  • Physics simulation (MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, or similar) and 3D rendering in the browser (WebGL, three.js)

  • Streaming interactive content to the browser (WebRTC or similar)

  • Data engineering for large volumes of video and time-series data

  • Security and compliance requirements of industrial customers: data residency, access control, audit logs

  • Cost optimization of GPU workloads

  • An early-stage startup, or a leading research lab (academic or industrial)

THE TEAM

The engineering team is a dozen top engineers and researchers in robotics and machine learning, organized around three focus areas: Integration, Vision & Perception, and Robot Learning. This position is the first cloud and platform role at Bleu Robotics. You will work with the whole team and with the founders on product decisions. Early hires help shape engineering practices, hiring, and culture.

What we offer

  • A clear, ambitious research mission with measurable real-world impact

  • A diverse fleet of advanced robots, including humanoids, on which to run your research

  • Research that ships: your algorithms run on real machines in real factories

  • Tight collaboration with engineering teams that take your work to production

  • Significant ownership of the research agenda as an early member of the team

  • A focused, technically strong team and a serious engineering culture

  • English-speaking working environment, no French required

  • Fair compensation + equity

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
About the Role

We’re looking for a top-tier Forward Deployed Engineer to join Linkup and work hand-in-hand with our founders, customers, and partners. You'll be part of the founding FDE team at Linkup

Your mission: help leading AI companies, developers, and enterprises integrate Linkup’s AI-ready search APIs into their products - and shape how the next generation of AI agents connects to the web.

This is a highly cross-functional role. You’ll operate at the intersection of engineering, GTM, and customer success, turning technical integrations into insights that drive our product roadmap, marketing narratives, and outbound strategy.

You’ll be the connective bridge between what customers build with Linkup and how we tell that story to the world.

What You’ll Do

  • Work directly with customers and partners to design, prototype, and deploy integrations of Linkup’s APIs into real-world agentic systems.

  • Participate in pre-sales efforts - technical discovery, proof-of-concept design, demo environments.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with backend, ML, and product teams to ensure performance and reliability at scale.

  • Partner with the GTM Engineer and DevRel team to turn customer learnings into automation, tutorials, and playbooks.

  • Identify and implement technical integrations with our other partners in the value chain (workflow orchestration, AI frameworks, etc.)

  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear explanations for both developers and business audiences.

Why This Role Matters

Every integration you build helps define how AI systems connect to live, trusted information.

You’ll operate on the frontier between customers and product - bringing the voice of the field into everything we build and say.

Your work will inform:

  • The stories we tell in marketing.

  • The use cases we automate in our GTM systems.

  • The features we prioritize in our roadmap.

If you love blending engineering with impact - building things users actually depend on: this role is for you.

You’re a Great Fit If You

  • 2+ years in technical support engineering, software engineering, or solutions engineering, with direct application development experience.

  • Strong API integration skills - able to design and debug REST/JSON payloads, manage auth flows, and optimize latency.

  • Understand web infrastructure, distributed systems, or retrieval pipelines.

  • Are comfortable debugging integrations and solving ambiguous technical challenges in customer environments.

  • Communicate clearly and empathetically with both technical and business audiences.

  • Are curious about AI infrastructure, retrieval, and the emerging agentic ecosystem.

  • Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment.

Example Projects

  • Help a partner integrate Linkup’s /search endpoint into their multi-agent workflow.

  • Build a proof-of-concept combining a customer’s private data with Linkup’s real-time web results.

  • Collaborate with the backend team to improve SDK telemetry and enterprise deployment reliability.

  • Work with the GTM team to turn successful integrations into published use cases and reference architectures.

  • Identify recurring customer needs that can become productized templates or automation.

About Linkup

Our Vision

We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web. These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information.

AI agents need web search. To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off.

Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs. Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space.

Web 2.0 is sunsetting. The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home.

Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up. We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone.

Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup.

Our Mission

Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve.

Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs.

Our Culture

Our culture is built on the following values:

  • Mission. We believe we play a critical role in building the agentic web. We are 100% committed to our mission of bringing the reality of the world to AI agents.

  • Speed. We build fast, we build to last. We get things done, well.

  • Ownership. We empower every team member to take ownership of their projects, ensuring they see them through to successful completion.

  • Teamwork. Our strength lies in our unity. We rely on one another and embrace our diversity as a core asset.

  • Humility. We maintain low egos, showing respect for others and continuously learning from their insights and experiences.

We expect all team member to take an active role in shaping our company culture.

Our Team

We are small technical team, working shoulder to shoulder to build the web of agents.

A bit more about our 3 co-founders:

  • Philippe Mizrahi- Led the development of Lyft’s Autonomous Vehicles marketplace. Previously launched Amundsen, an open source search engine.

  • Denis Charrier- Founding Engineer at Niland, an audio search company (acquired by Spotify), then Staff Engineer at Spotify. 15y of software development experience.

  • Boris Toledano- Led robotics at Carrefour, after 3y at McKinsey & Co working on public affairs and digital transformation.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Web + Infrastructure)
description:
Searoutes makes the emissions data that shippers use to run and reduce their
logistics. It is an operational problem before it is an environmental one, and
in our hands it is mostly an engineering one.

We are hiring a senior engineer who works across our web frontend and our
infrastructure — the same two codebases, in the same week. Someone who ships a
product screen on Monday, changes an identity-provider flow on Wednesday, and
considers those the same job.

We are looking for a broad profile rather than a specialist. The next year is
mostly platform work with a user-facing edge — user management, API gateway
management, payments, SEO, and a great deal of compliance, GDPR and ISO 27001.

If you are passionate about the environment, proactive and pragmatic in getting
things done, and love to work in a complex but fascinating industry where you
learn every day — then this is the place for you.

The work in front of us

Some of the items on our tech roadmap for the coming year. Bets are picked a
cycle at a time and shared out, so you would take the ones that suit you and
grow into the rest.

  • Product and marketing UI in React — multi-brand, WCAG AA, strong on
    technical SEO, fast enough to hold a performance budget.
  • User management and identity — Keycloak realms, organisation hierarchies,
    partner brokering, and the entitlement model in the app.
  • API gateway work in APISIX — routes, plugins and auth policy as code.
  • Payments and billing.
  • ISO 27001 and GDPR — access control, change management, audit logging,
    observability and alerting, consent and retention.
  • The infrastructure underneath — Pulumi in TypeScript, Docker Swarm on
    Hetzner, Cloudflare at the edge, Tailscale for all engineer and CI access.
  • Third-party integrations — usually the seam between two systems that were
    never designed to meet.

Nobody arrives fluent in all of that, and we are not expecting it. We want
someone strong across a good part of it, comfortable being new to the rest, and
used to working things out — with a team and with agents, rather than alone.

Also in daily use: Postgres and PostGIS, Valkey, ClickHouse; Vite, Tailwind and
Radix; Jest and Playwright; GitHub Actions; HAProxy. Most of what we write is
TypeScript, strict — though our core API is Java and Spring, and the identity
layer has Java in it too, so how far you go into that side is up to you.

How we work

LLM-native, in the codebases you would work in. They are built around
agent-assisted development rather than merely tolerant of it — the conventions,
the tooling and the review gates all assume it. Agents do most of the
implementation and much of the review; humans design, verify and approve. What
we are really hiring for is judgement over output you did not write by hand:
knowing what to specify, what to check, and what to throw away. The bar did not
move when the tooling did.

Shape Up, and you own what you take. Roughly three weeks of building, then a
week of cooldown, with bets chosen at a betting table. We are small enough that
an area becomes yours quickly — you make the calls inside it and you answer for
how it turns out. We hand out problems, not the steps that solve them.

Remote first, with most of the team in Europe and everyone together in person at
least twice a year. Significant technical decisions get written down, and a
green build is never on its own enough to merge.

Requirements

You'll thrive here if you have…

  • Senior full-stack experience — you have owned features from the browser to
    the machine they run on.
  • A track record of taking something and running with it — a domain, a
    migration, a subsystem you took on, decided and stayed accountable for.
  • Taste. You can tell a good design from a merely plausible one, and you
    will reject work that functions but is not right — your own, and an agent's.
  • React beyond the client — server rendering, static generation, data
    loading and hydration; you know what runs where and why it matters.
  • TypeScript at strict — typed boundaries, and an instinct for when types
    are carrying real weight.
  • Infrastructure as code — Pulumi ideally; Terraform if you are ready to
    pick up Pulumi.
  • Containers and Linux in production — not writing a Dockerfile, but
    debugging a service on a machine you have to SSH into.
  • Postgres beyond queries — backup and restore, migrations, what a schema
    change does under load.
  • Wholehearted LLM-assisted development — you use coding agents daily, have
    opinions about steering them, and review their output as critically as a
    colleague's.
  • Integration instincts — third-party APIs, webhooks, OAuth/OIDC, and
    patience for other people's undocumented edge cases.
  • A working day that overlaps ours: based within CET ±3.
  • Fluent in English, our working language.

Nice to have

  • Identity and API gateways in depth — Keycloak, OIDC, SAML brokering, APISIX.
  • Compliance from the inside — an ISO 27001 certification lived through, or GDPR
    beyond a cookie banner.
  • Payment systems, billing models, or PSP integrations.
  • Observability and alerting — Prometheus, Grafana or equivalent.
  • Experience in the maritime, logistics or freight industry.
  • Familiarity with emissions accounting frameworks (GHG Protocol, GLEC, EU
    ETS..).

Benefits

As part of our team, you will:

  • 🌱 Have a chance to re-shape the future of climate in the logistics.
  • 👩‍💻 Be empowered to deliver your best work remotely, and get a stipend to set
    you up.
  • 🏄‍♂️ Have a flat hierarchy, where you will have direct access to the founders
    and won't be tied up in politics.
  • 🎓 Have a high degree of learning and ownership in a dynamic environment.
  • 🏝 Take part in our team-building events.

description:

Je helpt mee om data betrouwbaar, vindbaar en bruikbaar te maken en ondersteunt daarmee de ontwikkeling van de AFM als Smart Supervisor.

Een greep uit je werkzaamheden:

  • Structureel verbeteren van masterdata, zoals vergunningen en ondernemingen.

  • Initiëren en doorontwikkelen van datamanagementkaders: beleid, processen en standaarden die bijdragen aan datagedreven werken. Ontwikkelen en implementeren van Data Governance-structuur, inclusief rollen, verantwoordelijkheden, eigenaarschap en besluitvormingsprocessen rondom data.

  • Adviseren vanuit expertise aan ontwikkelteams bij complexe vraagstukken rondom bijvoorbeeld datamodellering, data-architectuur en autorisatiebeheer.

  • Leiden van organisatiebrede verbeterinitiatieven en creëren van draagvlak voor datagedreven werken binnen de AFM.

  • Coachen en begeleiden van (junior en medior) datamanagementspecialisten en fungeren als inhoudelijk expert binnen de organisatie.

Afdeling

Je werkt binnen de afdeling Data, Technologie en Innovatie in het team Datamanagement. Dit team ondersteunt toezichtsafdelingen en ondersteunende afdelingen met specialistische kennis op het gebied van onder andere data governance, datamodellering, masterdatamanagement, datakwaliteit en metadatamanagement.

Let op: Deze functie is aangemerkt als een kwetsbare functie. Voor interne medewerkers geldt dat bij een overstap naar deze functie een herscreening kan plaatsvinden.

Voorbeeld uit de praktijk

"Je werkt vanuit datamanagement aan de ontwikkeling van een nieuwe centrale capability: de Self Service Analyse Omgeving (SSA). Deze omgeving moet toezichthouders in staat stellen om zelfstandig analyses uit te voeren op beschikbare data. Hoe pak je dit aan?"

 

Je werkt samen met Data Analisten aan het opzetten van deze capability. Vanuit datamanagement ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het definiëren van de randvoorwaarden waarbinnen data veilig, verantwoord en effectief gebruikt kan worden. Daarbij richten jullie je op drie belangrijke onderdelen: Datatoegang: samen bepalen jullie welke datasets beschikbaar worden gesteld aan toezichtteams en hoe deze toegankelijk worden gemaakt. Governance en compliance: jij zorgt ervoor dat datagebruik voldoet aan wet- en regelgeving, waarbij herkomst, eigenaarschap, toegangsrechten en doelbinding van data duidelijk zijn vastgelegd. Standaardisatie: samen ontwikkelen jullie een centrale en uniforme werkwijze, zodat gebruikers data op een consistente manier kunnen raadplegen en analyseren. Uiteindelijk leveren jullie een veilige en gestandaardiseerde Self Service Analyse Omgeving op. Hierdoor kunnen toezichthouders zelfstandig inzichten verkrijgen uit data, terwijl de kwaliteit, veiligheid en governance van de data gewaarborgd blijven. Zo draagt de capability bij aan een meer datavaardige organisatie.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Help Build the Future of Secure Personal Data Sharing

At Ockto, our mission is to set the benchmark for simple, secure, and ethical personal data sharing. Already a vital part of digital journeys like mortgage applications, rental agreements, and private lease processes, we enable people to control and share their sensitive data with confidence.

As our platform grows, reliability, scalability and security become increasingly important. As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you help build and operate the platform that keeps Ockto available, secure and performant across millions of transactions — and you keep it that way as we scale into new markets.

We are a team of curious, highly skilled engineers who value ownership, trust and continuous improvement. You’ll have the freedom to make a real impact while working in a collaborative environment with short decision-making lines.

The Opportunity: Senior Site Reliability Engineer

We are growing rapidly and pushing boundaries in secure, cloud-native digital services. We’re seeking a Senior Site Reliability Engineer who thrives on impact and innovation. You’ll be part of a collaborative and diverse team, contributing directly to our SaaS platform built with TypeScript and .NET technologies in a public cloud environment.

At Ockto, you’ll find:

  • A dynamic, ambitious engineering culture that values trust, autonomy, and ownership.

  • A team of smart, friendly colleagues who share knowledge and challenge each other to grow.

  • A product with real societal value-empowering users to take control of their personal data securely and effortlessly.

What You’ll Do

You’ll work across engineering to continuously improve the reliability, resilience and security of the Ockto platform.

  • Design, build and automate secure, scalable AWS infrastructure and deployment pipelines using Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD.

  • Drive reliability and resilience through observability (monitoring, logging, alerting), incident response, root cause analysis, and disaster recovery / business continuity.

  • Strengthen our cloud security posture and operate the controls behind our SOC 2 and ISO 27001 commitments — IAM, secrets management, hardening, and native tooling such as GuardDuty, Security Hub and CloudTrail.

  • Keep cloud cost efficient, balancing performance and resilience against spend.

  • Drive structured adoption of AI-assisted development workflows (code assistants, automated testing, spec-to-code pipelines).

  • Uphold privacy and ethical standards, recognising the responsibility that comes with managing people’s most personal data.

About the Ockto Platform

The Ockto platform enables consumers to securely collect and share personal data: such as identity, income, assets, and spending from trusted sources like government agencies and financial institutions.

Trusted by many organisations and financial service providers, Ockto replaces outdated manual data sharing with a streamlined, digital-first experience that benefits both consumers and businesses.

With Ockto, users are in control. No paperwork, no emails, just secure, verified data sharing at the click of a button.


About yourself

What we are looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering or DevOps.

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS.

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK or CloudFormation).

  • Experience with Linux, networking and cloud-native architectures.

  • Experience with CI/CD, monitoring and observability.

  • Experience securing cloud platforms using IAM, secrets management and infrastructure hardening.

  • Experience with scripting or programming (Python, Go, Bash or PowerShell).

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

  • A passion for automation, reliability and continuous improvement.

Will be a plus:

  • Experience with AWS security tooling (Security Hub, GuardDuty, Inspector or CloudTrail).

  • Experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001 or other security frameworks.

  • Experience in fintech or another regulated environment.

  • Experience introducing AI-assisted tooling responsibly in a regulated or data-sensitive environment (data-leakage awareness, prompt and secrets hygiene).

  • Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.

  • Serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, API Gateway, EventBridge).

  • Experience with Docker.

  • Familiarity with operational-resilience requirements such as DORA.

What you get

We offer an inspirational international working environment where:

  • You’ll be working on in-depth engineering challenges with high-tech solutions.

  • You can grow and broaden your professional skills.

  • We respect a good work/life balance.

  • We have an eye for your unique person & talents and allow you to apply them.

Also, Ockto will provide:

  • A good salary;

  • Room and budget for investing in your personal and professional development;

  • A MacBook Pro and smartphone of choice;

  • Phone- and travel-allowance;

  • Great home/remote working facilities;

About Terminal.exe

Terminal.exe is All Your BI's SaaS platform for container terminals. It unifies fragmented data, TOS, maintenance, gate, sensors, into one governed model, so every site works from the same numbers instead of rebuilding its own reporting from scratch. The platform is growing fast. You'll help shape the engineering foundations that need to scale next: multi-tenant data architecture, near-real-time pipelines from 24/7 operations, and a standardized data model that works across terminals worldwide.

What the job looks like

You will design and build the pipelines that move data from terminal operating systems (such as Navis N4) into our platform, and the transformation layer that turns raw operational data into curated, documented datasets.

Concretely, you will work on:

  • ELT pipelines from on-premises terminal databases into our Azure-based platform, with near-real-time refresh (3-minute microbatch) for operational reporting and daily batch for analytics. Extraction uses watermark-based incremental queries over Kafka (Azure Event Hubs) to PostgreSQL staging.

  • A multi-tenant data architecture on Azure PostgreSQL with database-per-tenant isolation and a standardized STG → ODS → DataMart layer structure driven by our internal declarative transformation framework (dewi)

  • Our internal connector tooling written in Go, which you will help develop and extend

  • Data quality monitoring: gap detection, freshness alerting, and reconciliation

  • The standardized terminal data model: mapping source data from different TOS versions and configurations onto shared definitions of moves, calls, and equipment events

You will work directly with terminal operations staff, without intermediate layers.

  • Pipelines and streaming: experience building and operating ELT pipelines against operational source systems, including watermark/incremental or CDC/replica-based extraction, and with event-driven or streaming architectures, we use Azure Event Hubs with a Kafka-compatible endpoint.

  • Cloud and observability: cloud data platform experience on Azure, familiarity with AKS, Azure DevOps CI/CD, and GitOps (Argo CD) is a plus, alongside a strong focus on data correctness and instrumentation, we use OpenTelemetry.

title: Robot Transporter (C Driver)
description:
We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from diverse backgrounds, including consumer tech, finance and media, and companies like Dyson, Shopify, Meta and Tesla. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you'll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural, alongside other renowned investors.

Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with a fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house, hardware and software. Our work involves building robots in our workshop and houses on real construction sites, so we're onsite five days a week.

Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision and company. You might enjoy our YouTube Channel, Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage, or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like.

About the role

You’ll transport robots that build houses. You’ll load them at our Amsterdam workshop, get them onto construction sites, and bring them back for repairs before their next job. When a team needs a replacement robot to keep building, you’re the person who gets it there.

We’re hiring our first Robot Transporter. We already have 150+ robots in the field and we’re expanding from the Netherlands into the UK and US. You’ll be the first person dedicated to getting our robots, equipment and materials where they need to be, helping more teams build more homes.

Your day could take you from the workshop to several active construction sites, delivering robots, collecting systems for repair and getting equipment to the next crew. You’ll work out the order of stops, what fits in each vehicle, and how to load and secure it safely. You’ll drive a C-licence box truck or B-licence van, work closely with our deployment team, and get to know the robots and the people building with them.

This is practical, physical work with room to take charge. You’ll start by planning alongside the deployment team, then take ownership of routes and transport requests as you learn the sites and loads. Plans change, sites get muddy, and teams depend on you. You’ll see the houses going up and know you helped get them built.

What you'll do

  • Drive. Operate our leased C-licence box truck and our B-licence van across the Netherlands, usually two or more movements a day. When a move needs a flatbed with forklift loading, you arrange it.

  • Plan the day’s transport. Work with the deployment team on the day’s plan: what goes in which vehicle, and the order of drop-offs and pick-ups across sites, our Groningen hub and our Amsterdam locations. Over time, more of this becomes yours to own.

  • Load and secure. Robots, hoisting cages, scaffolding, inventory kits, equipment. You know weight limits, lashing and what it takes to get a 400+ kg system in and out of a vehicle safely.

  • Run deployment logistics. Systems, kits and operational tools out to a new site before the team arrives, back to the workshop when a build wraps, and everything in between.

  • Keep the fleet where it's useful. Move idle systems from one site to another that needs them, and bring systems back for repair so that a broken robot swapped today is a wall going up tomorrow.

  • Own the vehicles. Servicing, inspections, cleaning, fuel, damage reporting and fines. Vehicles are always road-ready.

  • Log every move. Each transport is recorded in our fleet tooling so deployment managers see when their request is planned and the company always knows where every system and kit is.

  • Improve the process. Feed what you see on the road back to the inventory team (packing standards), deployment team (equipment ratios per site) and the team building our transport tooling.

  • Help with inventory in downtime. When there's nothing to move, you work with the inventory team to prepare kits, organise stock and check returned equipment back in.

What we're looking for

  • A valid C licence with Code 95 and a driver card (bestuurderskaart) (required).

  • Professional driving and load securing experience (required). Trucks, ideally box trucks with tail lift, with real responsibility for what was in the back: lashing, weight distribution, awkward loads. Equipment rental, construction logistics, removals or last-mile delivery are all good backgrounds.

  • Comfortable with physical work. Loading heavy systems with the right equipment, early starts, all weather, construction site conditions. You don’t need a robotics or construction background, but you should want to know how the systems you’re moving work.

  • Organised in chaos. You can hold a day with five drop-offs in your head, re-sequence it when a site calls, and still log everything at the end.

  • Reliable and careful. A damaged robot costs a build day. You check straps twice and say no to an overloaded vehicle.

  • Clear communication. You deal with deployment managers, site crews and the workshop every day, in person and on Slack. You raise problems early.

  • Based in the Netherlands. Able to work from Amsterdam and drive to sites nationwide. We can't support relocation or visa sponsorship for this role.

  • English required; Dutch is a plus.

Nice to have

  • Forklift certificate (heftruckcertificaat)

  • VCA safety certificate (we can arrange it)

  • Basic mechanical sense: you notice when something on a vehicle or a system doesn't look right

  • Experience planning for more than one driver or vehicle

  • Comfortable with simple apps and forms for logging work

Why Monumental?

Joining Monumental means being at the forefront of a movement aimed at making significant strides in the construction industry. Here, your work has the potential to impact not just the company but the future of how we build. If you're driven by innovation, eager to tackle complex challenges, and ready to make a tangible difference, we want to hear from you.

Unfortunately we do not currently support internships.

If you don't meet all the qualifications here but are excited about Monumental and feel you'd still be able to help us tackle complex challenges, do get in touch. We welcome generalists who focus on outcomes and are eager to learn on the job.

title: Finance & Growth Projects Specialist
description:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

We are looking for a highly educated, analytically strong professional with a genuine passion for Finance who is energized by variety, problem-solving and getting things done and is ready to jump into anything and everything. This is a broad role within the Finance team, supporting a range of finance improvement, growth, compliance and strategic projects. You will work closely with Finance leadership and collaborate across the organization on topics ranging from process improvement and AI to grants, contracts and international expansion.
The role is ideal for someone who enjoys learning quickly, taking ownership of new topics and moving comfortably between analysis and execution.

What you’ll be doing

  • Finance Projects & Improvement

    • Support a variety of finance improvement projects across processes, controls, reporting and systems.

    • Identify opportunities to simplify, automate and improve the way Finance works and reports, including through AI and new technology.

    • Take ownership of cross-functional projects and turn ideas into practical improvements.

  • Finance Leadership Support

    • Support Finance leadership on strategic, analytical and operational priorities.

    • Prepare analyses, reporting and decision-ready materials.

    • Pick up new projects and business questions as priorities evolve.

  • Grants & Funding

    • Identify relevant grants, subsidies and funding opportunities and support the application process.

    • Coordinate applications, financial models, documentation and input from internal and external stakeholders.

    • Manage grant administration, reporting requirements and supporting documentation.

  • Legal, Compliance & Growth

    • Support Finance and legal counsel on commercial, compliance and regulatory topics.

    • Help streamline contract processes, including workflows, templates, approvals and contract administration.

    • Support new markets, partnerships and initiatives by coordinating relevant finance, tax, legal and compliance requirements.

  • Export & Regulatory Support

    • Support the organization on export controls, sanctions and other requirements related to international activities.

    • Help assess requirements for new customers, markets, products and transactions.

    • Coordinate external specialist support and help translate advice into clear internal actions.

Your Profile

  • Strong academic background and a genuine interest in Finance, business and how companies operate.

  • Analytical, structured and intellectually curious, with the energy to work on many different types of projects.

  • A proactive self-starter who enjoys improving things, learning new topics and taking ownership from analysis through execution.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in a finance role within a high-growth technology company.

  • Experience in a deeptech environment (e.g. semiconductors, photonics, quantum technologies, advanced materials, robotics, AI infrastructure, or other R&D-intensive businesses) is highly desirable.

  • Experience with Capex heavy companies & manufacturing companies (COGS)

  • Experience with ERP systems and leading or participating in ERP implementation and finance transformation projects is a plus.

  • Experience with business intelligence tools is an advantage.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. title: RF Test Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As an RF Test Infrastructure Engineer, you will be the bridge between our R&D innovations and proven, reliable, hyper-scaled hardware. This is a highly autonomous, hands-on lab role. You won’t just be running routine tests, you will be designing, building, and commissioning the room-temperature (RT) and cryogenic measurement infrastructure required to validate high-density QPUs.

By implementing automated switching matrices and optimizing high-throughput signal lines, your work will directly eliminate the characterization bottleneck, allowing us to de-risk new technologies and scale toward increasingly complex quantum systems.

What You’ll Be Doing

Core Responsibilities

  • Test & Validate Devices: Plan and execute RF and DC test campaigns for VIO™ devices and test vehicles, verifying performance against specifications.

  • Build & Scale Measurement Infrastructure: Bring up, install, operate, and maintain room-temperature and cryogenic measurement setups, scaling them as R&D needs grow.

  • Investigate & Resolve Anomalies: Diagnose test failures, trace root causes, and feed findings back into device and process improvements.

  • Document & Track: Document setups and track process parameters across R&D cycles to build a reusable knowledge base.

Collaboration & Ownership

  • Work with a highly interdisciplinary R&D team to align test efforts with development priorities.

  • Own validation end-to-end, from setup and sample integration through execution, analysis, reporting, and recommendations.

  • Lead initiatives to improve test repeatability, measurement standards, and validation scalability.


Your Profile

Must-haves

  • A Master’s degree in electrical engineering, applied physics, or a related field.

  • 3+ years of experience in test, validation, or characterisation of deep-tech or low-volume hardware (industry experience is a plus).

  • Hands-on experience with RF and/or DC measurement and test methods, and instrumentation such as VNAs and SMUs

  • Direct experience working with high-density interconnects, switching matrices, and evaluating RF link budgets (insertion loss, return loss, crosstalk).

  • Proficiency in Python and data analysis and visualisation for experiments, and for control and measurement electronics.

Bonus

  • Experience with cryogenic systems such as dilution refrigerators.

  • Exposure to transport and microwave characterisation of superconducting circuits - such as critical temperature and current (Tc/Ic), residual resistance, and resonator quality factors (Qi/Qc) via VNA S-parameter measurements is a plus.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend
description:
Staff Software Engineer, Backend

 

About Stream

Stream powers real-time Chat, Video, Activity Feeds, and AI Moderation for more than 1 billion end users across 4,000+ apps, from Strava and Bumble to eBay and Patreon. Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low-latency services and a great developer experience.

The role

We’re looking for Staff Software Engineers. You’ll join our Chat or Activity Feeds team and own backend systems that thousands of developers build their products on, from how they’re structured to how they scale.

This is a full-time role based in our Amsterdam (visa & relocation support possible), Toronto, or Skopje office. We are also open to hiring the right person remote from the EU.

About you

You’ve built backend systems at high scale and stayed long enough to live with your own decisions, good and bad. You care about how a system is structured, not only the next feature, and you can explain your trade-offs to the people who’ll live with them. Maybe you led a team for a few years and chose to go back to hands-on work. That’s welcome here: this is an individual contributor role, and you’ll write code and touch databases yourself. Our leads spend about 80% of their time hands-on too. You won’t enjoy it if you want to manage people, or if you’d rather stay away from infrastructure and database work.

We’re also hiring Senior Engineers on these teams. If your experience fits Senior better than Staff, we’ll say so openly and talk it through with you.

You have

  • Extensive backend engineering experience, including technical leadership on systems in production.

  • Proficiency in Go, Python, or in another backend language plus the willingness to switch to Go.

  • Experience building features used by a large number of users, and scaling them as usage grows.

  • Strong experience with a relational database. We use PostgreSQL, but any relational database counts.

  • Hands-on experience with Redis or a similar in-memory data store.

  • Experience building public APIs or SDKs that other developers use.

  • Comfort with infrastructure and database work as part of your normal week, including Kubernetes.

  • Good written and spoken English. It’s our working language.

Bonus points

  • PostgreSQL in production at scale, including sharding, partitioning or large migrations.

  • Experience improving or redesigning legacy parts of a system that’s serving live traffic.

  • Go and gRPC in production at high request rates.

  • Messaging, feeds or other real-time systems, or message queues such as RabbitMQ or Kafka.

  • Distributed storage internals, such as Raft or RocksDB.

  • You’ve cut infrastructure cost at a company where margins mattered.

  • Experience running workloads on GCP or AWS.

Don’t worry if you haven’t used every tool we run. You’ll get exposure to most of them, and you’re welcome to convince us to add your favorites.

What makes this role exciting

  • Scale: more than 1 billion end users and billions of API requests a month go through the systems you’ll own.

  • Impact: cost per message and query latency show up directly in our margins and in the apps of customers like Strava and Patreon.

  • Stack: Go, gRPC, RocksDB and Python; PostgreSQL and RabbitMQ; GCP and Kubernetes; Grafana, Prometheus, ELK (Elasticsearch and Kibana), Jaeger and Tempo for distributed tracing, and Datadog; Redis, Valkey and Memcached.

  • Starting point: you’ll ship to production in your first weeks and own a meaningful area within your first months.

What we offer

  • Generous compensation

  • Stock options

Amsterdam office benefits:

  • 28 days paid time off plus Dutch public holidays.

  • Pension plan with a company contribution.

  • NS Business Card or a company bike, covered by Stream.

  • EUR 500 per year for personal development.

  • Catered lunches in the office.

  • MacBook Pro.

  • Up to EUR 60 a month toward a gym or sports club membership of your choice.

  • Relocation support if you move to Amsterdam, including visa sponsorship as a recognised IND sponsor.

Toronto, Skopje and remote EU: local benefits depending on your country of employment.

Why join Stream?

We’re a Series B company with offices in Boulder, Amsterdam, Skopje and Toronto, and a team of 140+ people from 37 nationalities. We’re backed by Felicis Ventures, GGV Capital, 01 Advisors, Techstars, and Arthur Ventures, with angels including Dick Costolo (ex-CEO of Twitter), Olivier Pomel (CEO of Datadog), Tom Preston-Werner (co-founder of GitHub), and Nicolas Dessaigne (co-founder of Algolia).

We’ll be straight with you: a startup is more demanding than a large company. There’s no fixed playbook, you’ll own things end to end, and you’ll sometimes pick up work outside your title. That’s also what makes it a fast place to grow. If you want real ownership and high scale more than structure and a set career ladder, you’ll feel at home here.

title: Senior Supply Chain Coordinator
description:
At i3D.net, we provide world-class global coverage with one of the most interconnected networks in the world. Our solutions focus on low latency, zero packet loss, and unmatched scalability, enabling seamless experiences for millions of users worldwide. Partnering with major names like Nvidia, DuckDuckGo, and Ubisoft, we are shaping the future of gaming and network technology.

Waarom jouw rol belangrijk is

Als Senior Supply Chain Coordinator bij i3D.net speel je een belangrijke rol in de succesvolle realisatie van onze infrastructuurprojecten in Nederland. Je opereert op het snijvlak van Supply Chain, Data Center Operations, Finance, technische teams en Legal. Daarbij ben je verantwoordelijk voor de commerciële en contractuele aspecten van infrastructuurprojecten. Van het begeleiden van aanbestedingen en onderhandelen over contracten tot het beheren van contractwijzigingen, meer- en minderwerk, claims en kosten tijdens de uitvoering: jij zorgt voor structuur, overzicht en grip op het proces.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Aanbestedingen en inkoop: Je begeleidt het volledige aanbestedings- en inkoopproces voor infrastructuurprojecten, waaronder het opstellen en uitzetten van offerteaanvragen (RFQ's), het vergelijken en beoordelen van aanbiedingen, het selecteren van aannemers en het voeren van commerciële onderhandelingen.

  • Contractmanagement: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van contracten gedurende de volledige projectcyclus. Van de eerste onderhandelingen en contractafspraken tot het afhandelen van contractwijzigingen, meer- en minderwerk en claims tijdens de uitvoering.

  • Leveranciers- en aannemersmanagement: Je bouwt en onderhoudt sterke relaties met aannemers, leveranciers en andere externe partners. Je bewaakt contractuele afspraken, kwaliteitsnormen en oplevertermijnen.

  • Ondersteuning van infrastructuurprojecten: Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt vanuit Supply Chain voor de uitvoering van infrastructuurprojecten in Nederland en werkt nauw samen met datacenter-, technische en projectteams.

  • Kostenbeheersing en rapportages: Je bewaakt financiële verplichtingen, uitgaven en contractwaarden. Met jouw gevorderde Excel-vaardigheden zorg je voor betrouwbare financiële inzichten en signaleer je tijdig mogelijke risico's.

  • Contractmanagementsystemen: Je ondersteunt bij de selectie, implementatie en ingebruikname van een Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM)-systeem binnen de Supply Chain-afdeling.

  • Samenwerking met stakeholders: Je werkt nauw samen met Finance, Legal, technische teams en externe aannemers om projecten soepel te laten verlopen en besluitvorming te ondersteunen.

  • Procesverbetering: Je signaleert kansen om inkoopprocessen, contractbeheer, kosteninzicht en de algehele efficiëntie van projecten verder te verbeteren.

Wat heb je in het eerste jaar bereikt?

  • Je hebt aanbestedingstrajecten en contractonderhandelingen voor belangrijke infrastructuurprojecten succesvol begeleid.

  • Je hebt duidelijk inzicht en overzicht gecreëerd in contractuele verplichtingen, projectkosten, wijzigingen en claims.

  • Je hebt actief bijgedragen aan de succesvolle implementatie en ingebruikname van een contractmanagementsysteem binnen de afdeling.

  • Je hebt relaties met aannemers en leveranciers versterkt en betere commerciële resultaten gerealiseerd.

  • Je hebt meer structuur, transparantie en financiële beheersing aangebracht in de uitvoering van infrastructuurprojecten.

  • Je bent uitgegroeid tot een betrouwbare sparringpartner voor Supply Chain, Data Center Operations, Finance, Legal en technische teams.

Wie ben jij?

  • Proactief en oplossingsgericht: Je signaleert contractuele en commerciële uitdagingen vroegtijdig en onderneemt actie voordat ze de voortgang van projecten beïnvloeden.

  • Sterk in onderhandelen: Je gaat zelfverzekerd het gesprek aan met aannemers en leveranciers en weet commerciële belangen te combineren met duurzame samenwerkingen.

  • Gericht op verbetering: Je krijgt energie van het aanbrengen van structuur, het verbeteren van processen en het efficiënter laten samenwerken van teams.

Wat breng je mee?

  • 5 tot 10 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen inkoop, contractmanagement, projectinkoop of een vergelijkbare commerciële functie binnen infrastructuurprojecten.

  • Aantoonbare expertise in contract- en leveranciersmanagement, waaronder het beheren van contractwijzigingen, meer- en minderwerk en claims tijdens de uitvoering van projecten.

  • Ervaring met het zelfstandig begeleiden van volledige aanbestedingstrajecten, inclusief offerteaanvragen (RFQ's), offertevergelijkingen, aannemersselectie en commerciële onderhandelingen.

  • Een achtergrond binnen infrastructuur, bouw, datacenters, industriële projecten of andere bedrijfskritische omgevingen.

  • Kennis van Nederlandse contractvormen en voorwaarden binnen de bouw en infrastructuur, met name UAV en UAV-GC.

  • Praktische ervaring met het implementeren of gebruiken van een Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM)-systeem.

  • Gevorderde Excel-vaardigheden en ervaring met kostenbeheersing, financiële monitoring en uitgavenrapportages.

  • Sterk commercieel inzicht en het vermogen om contractuele en financiële risico's te herkennen en te beheersen.

  • Uitstekende beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal, mondeling en schriftelijk.

  • Je woont in de regio Rotterdam, zodat je regelmatig aanwezig kunt zijn op kantoor en op projectlocaties.

Mooi meegenomen

  • Een PRINCE2- of PMP-certificering.

  • Ervaring met het ontwikkelen van financiële dashboards, uitgavenanalyses en kostenrapportages.

  • Beheersing van de Franse taal, met het oog op mogelijke internationale infrastructuurprojecten.

Waarom werken bij i3D.net?

  • Je levert een directe bijdrage aan de realisatie en uitbreiding van bedrijfskritische infrastructuurprojecten.

  • Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid voor belangrijke contracten, aannemersrelaties en commerciële onderhandelingen.

  • Je speelt een sleutelrol in het verder professionaliseren van contractmanagement en inkoopprocessen.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met ervaren technische, financiële en juridische professionals in een internationale omgeving.

  • Je komt terecht in een dynamische, snelgroeiende organisatie waar jouw expertise en ideeën daadwerkelijk het verschil maken.

Who We Are

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

The Opportunity

Toqan is Prosus's internal AI platform — the infrastructure and tooling layer that powers agentic AI-driven products across the entire group.We are building secure, configurable agent runtimes that can operate reliably at scale across different products, channels and use cases..  

You’ll work where distributed systems meet applied AI: orchestrating models and tools, enabling agents to perform long-running work, and turning rapidly evolving AI capabilities into dependable platform primitives. The challenges span asynchronous workflows, isolated execution, extensible integrations, reliability, observability and cost control.

The Toqan platform serves the whole Prosus portfolio and other connected businesses, which means the backend systems you build here have reach far beyond a single team. You'll join a 12-person engineering team in Amsterdam and work closely with product, platform and AI colleagues to ship end-to-end — at pace, without compromising quality.

Who You Are

You are a senior backend engineer who has moved well past following patterns and into setting them. You're comfortable owning architectural decisions on novel infrastructure — the kind where the right answer isn't obvious and the stakes are real. You think in systems, spot failure modes early, and hold a high bar for production quality without letting perfect block good. The 80/20 mindset comes naturally: you know when to go deep and when to ship.

You've likely come from a startup or high-velocity environment where shipping fast wasn't a culture slogan — it was survival. You know how to cut scope without cutting corners, move from zero to production without a safety net, and iterate quickly on systems that are still finding their shape.

You're genuinely curious about the AI and LLM space — not as a trend to track, but as a domain where you've already done hands-on integration work and want to go further. AI tools aren't an afterthought in how you work — you use them daily, whether that's Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or OpenAI Codex, and you've developed real judgment about where they accelerate work and where they don't. You operate with low ego, share context freely, and thrive in an environment where autonomy and accountability go hand in hand. Ambiguity doesn't slow you down — it's where you do your best work.

What You Bring

  • Strong Go programming skills with a track record of building and operating production backend services

  • Hands-on AWS experience — designing, deploying, and operating cloud-native services at scale

  • Experience integrating LLMs, AI models or tool-calling systems into production applications

  • Familiarity with agentic architectures and protocols such as MCP, A2A

  • A systems mindset, with attention to reliability, scalability, performance and security

  • Experience with CI/CD, automated testing and production observability

  • A record of working across product and platform teams to deliver outcomes end-to-end

  • Regular, thoughtful use of AI coding tools as part of your development workflow

Nice to haves

  • Hands-on experience building agentic AI systems that use tools and execute multi-step workflows

  • Experience building or maintaining event-sourced systems

  • Python programming skills

  • Experience with AI or ML infrastructure and developer productivity tooling

Your Typical Day

No two days look exactly the same. You might design a new capability for the agent runtime, improve how models and tools are orchestrated, investigate a production reliability issue, or take an integration from an early prototype to a secure, observable service.

You’ll spend much of your time building in Go, reviewing code and making architectural decisions with the team. You’ll also work closely with product, platform and AI colleagues to shape requirements, test ideas and ship them safely. Along the way, you’ll improve the testing, deployment and observability foundations that let the team move quickly with confidence.

What We Offer

  • Global Impact: Play a crucial role in shaping the future of global commerce.

  • Growth Opportunities: Expand your expertise through diverse global challenges and unique opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Join a forward-thinking team that values strategic insights and fosters continuous innovation.

  • Creative Environment: Engage in work that encourages creativity and constant improvement.

  • Collaborative Atmosphere: Benefit from autonomy and self-management in a supportive and positive workspace.

  • Hybrid Work: Experience the satisfaction of our flexible model tailored to balance work and life.

  • Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a salary package that reflects your skills and contributions.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: From health and wellness to learning, commuting, and everyday perks, we offer a well-rounded package designed to help you thrive at work and beyond.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people.
