title: Scientific Product Manager
description:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to rapid growth in our partner lab network, we are seeking a Scientific Product Manager to join our Product team and bring partner labs and their experimental workflows onto the CuspAI platform.

Your impact

This is an exciting opportunity to join the product team at CuspAI, working closely with materials scientists, ML researchers and platform engineers to make AI-driven experimentation work in real laboratories. As one of a small team of Scientific Product Managers, you will take ownership of a set of partner labs and the lab integration work around them, translating what each lab actually needs into requirements our engineers and ML researchers can build against. Alongside the product work, you will spend real time with your partners' teams and their experimental data.

What You Will Do

Product Requirements & Roadmap

  • Shape and prioritise the roadmap for how experimental data, protocols and campaigns get into the CuspAI platform, together with your fellow Scientific Product Managers, the engineering lead and the wider product team.

  • Write requirements, specifications and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from, covering experiment types, instrument integrations and LIMS/ELN connections, and work with the data team on the underlying data models and provenance.

  • Contribute to decisions on what we build, what we integrate, and what we leave to partners' existing systems.

Partner Lab Onboarding

  • Lead technical discovery with the partner labs you take on: map their workflows, instruments, sample logic and data systems, and pin down the true experimental unit and the parameters that matter.

  • Own onboarding for your partner labs from scoping to the first closed-loop campaign, and turn each onboarding into reusable patterns and documentation shared across the team so the next one is faster.

  • Act as the main scientific counterpart for the partner labs you look after, and represent the product in partner meetings, workshops and conferences.

Closed-Loop Campaigns

  • Work with ML researchers to design optimisation campaigns (e.g. Bayesian optimisation) that respect real experimental constraints such as throughput, noise and failed samples.

  • Define how platform-driven campaigns are validated, including benchmarks against manual or legacy workflows, success metrics and the evidence we bring to partners.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • PhD in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, Chemical Engineering or a related experimental discipline, or equivalent experience in scientific research.

  • Hands-on experience with high-throughput or automated experimentation (e.g. robotic synthesis, combinatorial libraries, automated characterisation, or self-driving / closed-loop labs) in industry, a national lab or research institute, or academia.

  • Proven track record of translating scientific or process needs into requirements for engineers, software teams or automation vendors, and of validating that what was built works in the lab.

  • Firsthand understanding of how experimental data is produced and where it fails: which metadata and provenance matter, instrument quirks, data quality issues, and what makes a dataset usable for machine learning.

  • Depth in at least one materials domain (e.g. semiconductors and thin films including photovoltaics, catalysis and electrochemistry, energy materials including batteries, polymers and formulations, or separations and surfaces) and the curiosity to work across others.

  • Working knowledge of Python for data handling and analysis; comfortable working with APIs and data schemas.

  • Strong communicator and a proven collaborator, comfortable working directly with external partner labs as well as multidisciplinary science, ML, product and engineering teams.

Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Direct experience with closed-loop optimisation in an automated setting, such as Bayesian optimisation, active learning or design of experiments.

  • Experience with research data management, LIMS/ELN systems, FAIR data or metadata schemas, and familiarity with lab data standards (e.g. SiLA 2, AnIML, Allotrope).

  • Instrument integration experience, including vendor software, data formats, and scheduling or orchestration.

  • Product or project management experience, such as roadmaps, user research, external research collaborations or vendor relationships. We are equally open to strong experimental scientists making their first move into product.

  • Experience working in industry at a materials, chemicals, energy or deep-tech company, or closely with industry at a research institution or national lab.

  • Experience coordinating work across multiple labs, sites or countries.

Additional Considerations

This role could be based in any of our locations with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to partner labs and other locations for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.


CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team.

Please let us know if you require any specific adjustments during or after the interview process. We will do everything we can within reason to accommodate.

title: Data Engineer – Healthcare
description:
About PAICON

PAICON is a Heidelberg-based health data intelligence company building the global health data foundation through its PaiX ecosystem, working to close the representation gap in medical data so personalised medicine works for everyone. We harmonise ethically approved, GDPR compliant real-world health data from providers around the world into a global dataset. The data covers multiple modalities on various disease entities. Our flagship product, PaiX Navigator, generates actionable insights for pharma, biotech and AI companies worldwide.

The role

We are looking for a hands-on data engineer to integrate data from our global partners into our platform. Data integration is the core of the role, and agentic AI tooling is part of how we do it. This is an on-site position in our Heidelberg office.

You will work closely with medical, engineering and commercialization colleagues in a small, pragmatic team with short decision paths and direct access to the founders.

What you'll do

  • Onboard new data partners, from first assessment of their data through to reliable production ingestion

  • Map partner data to our internal data model and work with providers to close gaps

  • Build and maintain robust, well-tested data pipelines

  • Ensure high standards in data quality and help evolve our database and data infrastructure

  • Document data and transformations so that every step is transparent and traceable

  • Ensure data is handled securely, de-identified and in line with healthcare data regulations

  • Help us apply AI-assisted methods to data integration, with appropriate quality checks

What you bring

  • Several years of hands-on data engineering, including building and running production data pipelines

  • Strong SQL and relational database design skills

  • R and Python skills on Linux systems

  • Familiarity with healthcare data standards such as HL7 FHIR and common clinical coding systems

  • Understanding of data privacy and security in a regulated environment, including GDPR

  • Day-to-day use of AI-assisted development tools and curiosity to go further with them

  • A pragmatic mindset: you choose the simplest solution that works

  • Ability to turn messy, real-world data into clear findings and next steps

  • Good communication with technical and non-technical colleagues

  • Independent, hands-on working style with agile mindset

  • Fluent English, our primary working language

Nice-to-have skills

  • Experience with genomics/clinical & pathology data/digital histopathology data

  • Experience with graph databases or ontologies

  • Experience with containers, CI/CD and cloud infrastructure on hyperscalers.

What you get from joining PAICON

  • Hybrid working, with core office days to help organise how you do your best work

  • An inclusive team where different backgrounds and perspectives are part of the point

  • A friendly, motivated and agile environment where things move quickly and you see the impact of your work

  • Flat hierarchies and short decision paths, with direct access to founders and medical, engineering and commercial colleagues

  • Real ownership of your ideas: propose something good and you will be the one building it

You will join a team solving a problem that matters, in a company where your voice carries weight from day one. There are no long approval chains between a good idea and a production system, and no layers between you and the people who depend on the data you integrate. If you want to shape how global health data is built rather than inherit someone else’s architecture, this is the place to do it! Cheers!

description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken Customer

 

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

We have been licensing Kraken for over 4 years now, transforming businesses by not only moving their customer base to our Kraken platform but also changing their operating model & ways of working. Throughout this time our team has been at the forefront of industry leading migrations whilst setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like.

 

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

You will be joining the client delivery team with Kraken working to support European clients through their technology transformation journeys, supporting long term migration projects.

The Client Delivery Lead has direct responsibility managing a tech domain (billing, finance, comms..) for our client projects. This is either migrating onto our Kraken platform or managing long term technology requirements. They need to work in partnership with the technology and operational teams at Kraken as well as the client to deliver results for our client’s project or business needs.

 

The Client Delivery Lead has to really understand how Kraken works, understand problems or requests raised by the client and refine solutions in the best way to leverage existing and new capability. They will bring technology, people and processes together to innovate improvements for our clients. You will also support the client in adapting to ways of working that are aligned to Kraken’s development style. You will work closely with Kraken’s product managers and developers to request development needs and act as a link to the client.

  • Supporting the engineering team to deliver product features

This is a hands-on, individual contributor position. The role is European based and your projects could be run from any country, travel is expected as part of this role.

 

We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for open minded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity and an ever changing environment. To thrive here you must be a self-starter and willing to roll your sleeves up to solve any problem, constantly flexing outside of your typical job role to drive progress for our clients and organisation.

You must be committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing stakeholders through a journey of change.

 

You must be willing to challenge beliefs, have the ability to see through multiple viewpoints and, if needed, reach beyond your remit to support the client.

 

We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. If you believe this too then Kraken Tech is the right place for you.

(“Every problem has a solution, facing new challenges is exciting because that’s what makes us better every day and the bigger the challenge, the bigger the feeling of success”)

title: Partner Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Über ALVA Energie

Wir bei ALVA Energie treiben die Energiewende voran! Mit Solarbetreibermodellen auf Mehrfamilienhäusern und Gewerbeimmobilien bieten wir ein Rundum-sorglos-Paket: Von der Installation über die Verwaltung bis hin zum Betrieb der PV-Anlagen als Energielieferant. Unser Ziel ist es, die dezentrale Energiewende einfach und zugänglich zu machen. 🌞

Als wachsendes Start-up in Berlin setzen wir auf Teamarbeit, Verantwortung und Mitgestaltung. Jede:r hat die Möglichkeit, aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung beizutragen und Ideen einzubringen. Gemeinsam arbeiten wir an einer nachhaltigen Zukunft. 🚀

Über die Rolle

Als Partner Manager*in machst du unser Partnernetzwerk zu einem zentralen Kanal für Leads und Umsatz. Du findest die richtigen Partner, verhandelst die Zusammenarbeit und sorgst dafür, dass Partnerschaften nicht auf dem Papier bleiben, sondern messbar Ergebnisse liefern. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem Sales-Team zusammen.

Deine Aufgaben

Partner gewinnen & entwickeln

  • Du identifizierst und priorisierst strategische Partner, die zu unserem Angebot und unserer Vision passen

  • Du baust neue Partnerschaften auf und entwickelst bestehende Beziehungen kontinuierlich weiter

  • Du verhandelst Kooperationsvereinbarungen und Rahmenverträge, die für beide Seiten echten Mehrwert schaffen

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern Go-to-Market-Strategien und setzt sie um

Partner befähigen & steuern

  • Du führst neue Partner strukturiert ein und befähigst sie, qualifizierte Leads für uns zu generieren

  • Du konzipierst Partnerkampagnen und Anreizsysteme, die die Bindung stärken und messbare Ergebnisse bringen

  • Du sorgst für eine saubere Deal-Registrierung und erstellst verlässliche Forecasts zu Pipeline, Umsatz und Partnerperformance

  • Du stimmst dich eng mit unserem Sales-Team ab und sorgst dafür, dass Partner-Leads reibungslos übergeben werden

Gewünschte Qualifikationen

Das bringst du mit:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium, z. B. der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Du konntest bereits mehrjährige Erfahrung im Partnermanagement, Channel Sales oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle sammeln, idealerweise im kommerziellen B2B-Umfeld

  • Du verhandelst sicher und hast Erfahrung in der Gestaltung von Kooperations- und Rahmenverträgen

  • Du hast bereits strategische Allianzen aufgebaut und komplexe Beziehungen mit mehreren Stakeholdern gemanagt

  • Du hast nachweislich zu Lead-Generierung und Umsatzwachstum beigetragen und denkst in Pipeline und KPIs

  • Du verfügst über fließende Deutschkenntnisse (mind. Niveau C1) und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

  • Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung aus der Energie-, Immobilien- oder Solarbranche mit

Zusätzlich zählen für uns folgende Kompetenzen:

  • Beziehungsaufbau – Du gewinnst schnell das Vertrauen von Partnern, kommunizierst klar und bleibst auch in schwierigen Phasen der Zusammenarbeit lösungsorientiert

  • Verhandlungsstärke – Du bereitest Verhandlungen strukturiert vor, verstehst die Interessen deines Gegenübers und schließt Vereinbarungen, die langfristig für beide Seiten funktionieren

  • Ergebnisorientierung – Du misst Partnerschaften an Leads, Pipeline und Umsatz und steuerst nach, wenn ein Partner nicht performt

  • Flexibilität & Hands-on-Mentalität – Du passt dich schnell an neue Situationen an und packst selbst mit an, wenn Prozesse im Partnergeschäft erst noch entstehen

Das erwartet dich bei uns

Mit deinen Ideen hast du die Chance, unser dynamisches Team zu bereichern und aktiv die Zukunft der Solarenergie in einem schnell wachsenden Start-up mitzugestalten!

  • Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und direkte Kommunikation in einer lockeren und positiven Arbeitsatmosphäre

  • Gestaltungsspielraum - Bei uns hast du 100% Verantwortung für das, was du tust, und darfst mit Herausforderungen wachsen

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern und dadurch eine steile Lernkurve

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Möglichkeit zum Home Office sorgen für eine gute Work-Life-Balance

  • modernes Office im Zentrum von Berlin und guter BVG-Anbindung (z.B. Nordbahnhof, Rosenthaler Platz)

  • ausgestattete Küche mit Kaffee, Softdrinks und Snacks rund um die Uhr

  • regelmäßiges Team-Lunch und weitere Teamevents

  • Wir bieten attraktive Zuschüsse zu Urban Sports Club, einem DanceBike und für den ÖPNV

title: Controller für Infrastruktur- & Ingenieurprojekte (m/w/d)
description:
Wer wir sind

Wir sind ein wachsendes Infrastruktur- und Ingenieurunternehmen mit Fokus auf zukunftsfähige Projekte in den Bereichen Straßenbau, Brücken, Tunnel, Altlasten sowie Wasser- und Versorgungsinfrastruktur.

Wir verbinden technische Expertise mit unternehmerischem Denken und kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Für unseren weiteren Wachstumskurs suchen wir einen Controller (m/w/d), der unser Controlling aktiv mit aufbaut, unsere Gesellschaften operativ unterstützt und Transparenz für fundierte unternehmerische Entscheidungen schafft.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Projekt- und Unternehmenscontrolling: Du baust unser Controlling auf Gruppen- und Gesellschaftsebene auf und entwickelst es kontinuierlich weiter. Dabei begleitest du unsere einzelnen Gesellschaften aktiv bei der Einführung geeigneter Controllingstrukturen und -prozesse.
  • Hands-on-Unterstützung der Gesellschaften: Du arbeitest eng mit den operativen Teams zusammen, hilfst bei konkreten Fragestellungen und befähigst sie wirtschaftliche Kennzahlen und Zusammenhänge eigenständig zu verstehen und zu steuern.
  • Holding- und Finanzcontrolling: Du etablierst das Controlling auf Holdingebene und unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Bankenreportings, Investoreninformationen und aussagekräftigen Management-Reports.
  • Planung und Steuerung: Du unterstützt bei Budgetplanung, Forecasts, Kostenanalysen und der wirtschaftlichen Steuerung unserer Infrastruktur- und Ingenieurprojekte.
  • Kalkulation und Wirtschaftlichkeit: Du wirkst bei Angebotskalkulationen, Wirtschaftlichkeits- und Investitionsanalysen sowie bei Projektbewertungen und Nachkalkulationen mit.
  • Kennzahlen und Transparenz: Du entwickelst aussagekräftige KPIs zu Projektfortschritt, Kostenentwicklung, Ressourcen und Effizienz und schaffst damit eine fundierte Grundlage für unternehmerische Entscheidungen.
  • Risiken und Potenziale: Du erkennst frühzeitig wirtschaftliche Risiken, identifizierst Optimierungsmöglichkeiten und leitest gemeinsam mit den Verantwortlichen konkrete Maßnahmen ab.
  • Schnittstellenmanagement: Du bist Ansprechpartner für Gründer, Geschäftsführungen, Ingenieure und Projektleiter und verstehst es, unterschiedliche Perspektiven und Interessen zusammenzubringen.
  • Digitalisierung und KI: Du treibst die Weiterentwicklung unserer Reporting- und Controllingprozesse voran und prüfst, wie digitale Lösungen, Automatisierung und künstliche Intelligenz unsere Arbeit effizienter und besser machen können.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL, Finance, Controlling, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Bauingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Erste Erfahrung im Projektcontrolling, Baucontrolling oder technischen Umfeld von Vorteil.
  • Analytisches Denkvermögen, eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und ein gutes Verständnis wirtschaftlicher Zusammenhänge.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Excel sowie idealerweise ERP- oder BI-Systemen.
  • Interesse an Infrastruktur- und Ingenieurprojekten sowie an digitalen Lösungen und KI.
  • Kommunikationsstärke, Empathie und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen.
  • Eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität: Du packst selbst mit an, denkst unternehmerisch und entwickelst pragmatische Lösungen.

Was dich erwartet

  • Gestalten statt nur verwalten: Du baust unser Controlling aktiv mit auf und prägst Strukturen, Prozesse und Standards von Anfang an.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit den Gründern, Geschäftsführungen, Ingenieuren, Projektteams sowie Investoren und Banken zusammen.
  • Abwechslungsreiche Projekte: Du erhältst Einblicke in spannende Infrastruktur- und Ingenieurprojekte mit langfristiger wirtschaftlicher und gesellschaftlicher Bedeutung.
  • Unternehmerische Verantwortung: Deine Analysen und Empfehlungen schaffen Transparenz und fließen direkt in wichtige Entscheidungen ein.
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege: Wir setzen auf pragmatische Lösungen, offene Kommunikation und schnelle Entscheidungen.
  • Wachstum mit Perspektive: Du hast die Möglichkeit, deine Rolle aktiv zu entwickeln und mit dem Unternehmen fachlich wie persönlich zu wachsen.
  • Moderne Arbeitsweise: Flexible Arbeitsmodelle und die Bereitschaft, neue digitale Werkzeuge und KI-Anwendungen einzusetzen, gehören zu unserem Anspruch.
  • Attraktive Vergütung: Dich erwartet ein attraktives Gesamtpaket aus Gehalt und Bonus; ein Dienstwagen kann ebenfalls Bestandteil des Pakets sein.

description:
About Cellsor

Cameras digitized vision. Microphones digitized sound. Smell is the one major sense we still can't capture, measure or transmit reliably. Cellsor is building the sensor that changes that.

We replicate the mammalian olfactory epithelium outside the body – living olfactory tissue on microelectrode arrays – and read it out with machine learning. The result is a sensor that detects chemicals the way a nose does, with the breadth and sensitivity that conventional gas sensors lack. Applications span flavor and fragrance, defense and security, medical diagnostics, food quality and industrial monitoring.

We are a VC-backed Tufts University spin-out with a working proof of principle and paid industry pilots, with teams in Boston (biology) and Munich (engineering).

About the role

As our first engineer in Munich, you develop the instrument that keeps our living sensor tissue alive and samples the air it analyzes. You take it from today's lab setup to a field-ready prototype at a customer site within 18 months.

What you will do:

  • Define the instrument architecture, then build prototypes across mechanics, fluidics and housing

  • Develop automated media exchange that keeps cells viable for weeks to months

  • Build the air path: sampling, filtration and controlled delivery of odorants to the sensor

  • Integrate sensors, pumps and controllers for monitoring and automation

  • Test and iterate with our Boston biology team

  • Contribute to grant applications

What you need to succeed

Must-have:

  • MSc or PhD in mechanical, biomedical or bioengineering, or a related field

  • Built a lab or medical device from concept to working prototype

  • CAD, rapid prototyping, and electronics integration

  • Comfortable with uncertainty: you make progress without a defined path and decide what to build next

  • Hands-on and self-directed – you'd rather test an idea on the bench than discuss it for a week

  • Fluent English; German a plus

Nice-to-have:

  • Cell culture, perfusion or microfluidics

  • Gas handling or air sampling

  • Startup or grant-funded R&D experience

Why join Cellsor now

Cellsor is an early-stage, VC-backed deep-tech startup, funded to focus on building. Most hardware roles mean optimizing one part of an existing product. Here you build the first instrument for a new category of sensor, and your design decisions become the foundation of the platform. The technical risk has moved from "does this work?" to "how do we build it for the field?" – which is exactly where an engineer makes the difference. As the platform grows into electrode integration, machine learning and product design, so does the scope of your role.

What we offer

  • Equity in Cellsor, so you share in the value you help create

  • The opportunity to build and lead the Munich engineering team as we grow

  • Real responsibility from day one, working directly with the founders and technical advisors

  • Lab and workspace at UnternehmerTUM, with regular exchange with our Boston team

title: Agentic Platform Engineer (gn) @ AI Venture, Berlin
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up.

Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around.

We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task.

Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one.

Our founder brings considerable drive, a hands-on approach and a strong sense of urgency to building the company. Backed by Atlantic at pre-seed, we are growing the engineering team to bring the product into production, with people already waiting to use it.

About the Role

As one of our first platform engineers, you will build the foundations that every product feature depends on: the gateway and router, usage and billing systems, customer key management and the European infrastructure underneath.

Much of that platform is still taking shape. Working directly with the founder, CTO and founding AI engineer, you will help turn early architectural decisions into systems that remain reliable as the product grows.

You will take capabilities from design through to production, thinking through their APIs, failure modes, deployment, observability and ongoing operation. In a team this small, building and running the system belong together. You will also work alongside our founding AI engineer on evals, embeddings and open-weight model serving, bringing platform engineering depth to the ML side of the product.

Agentic engineering is central to how we work. You will operate in an agentic way by default, using coding agents as a core part of how you design, build, test and ship software. You'll develop the harnesses and workflows that allow you to delegate and parallelise work effectively, increasing what a small engineering team can deliver. This requires strong coding fundamentals and the judgement to review, challenge and take responsibility for everything that reaches production.

There is a lot to build and an ambitious timeline ahead. We work with intensity, move quickly from decisions to execution and value people who take initiative and see things through.

What You’ll Work On

Your first area of ownership will depend on your strengths and our priorities. From there, you will contribute across the platform as it develops.

  • Gateway and routing: build a consistent API across model providers, with reliable streaming, fallbacks and safe handling of retries and provider errors.

  • Agentic engineering workflows: build and refine the harnesses, tooling and workflows that enable coding agents to work effectively across the development lifecycle, from implementation and testing to debugging and deployment.

  • Cost optimisation: develop caching, history compression and model selection, measuring savings while keeping estimated costs distinct from actual spend.

  • Usage and billing: build accurate accounting for model calls, usage reports, plan entitlements and invoice reconciliation.

  • Agent infrastructure and integrations: support tool calls, cost limits, human approvals and runs that can recover safely from interruptions, alongside connectors for services such as Gmail, Slack and calendars.

  • Tenancy and secrets: maintain workspace isolation, secure authentication and encrypted customer key management.

  • European infrastructure and model serving: build and operate our cloud infrastructure, including the GPU capacity used to serve open-weight models.

  • Production reliability: make systems observable, migrations reversible and releases safe, with tests that protect data integrity and logs that keep customer content and secrets private.

The platform will evolve quickly. You will need to move comfortably between improving what exists and learning enough about a new problem to build the next piece well.

Our Stack

Our backend is built in Python, with a TypeScript frontend in a shared monorepo.

  • Backend: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic and LiteLLM.

  • Data and queues: Postgres with row-level security and pgvector, Redis and arq.

  • Frontend: Next.js, React and TypeScript.

  • Cloud and infrastructure: Scaleway, Terraform and Kubernetes for GPU workloads.

  • Auth and secrets: Zitadel, Secret Manager and KMS.

  • Observability and testing: OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, Sentry, pytest and testcontainers, alongside frontend testing tools.

You should be comfortable with the core backend technologies and ready to learn the rest as the work requires.

About You

You enjoy the craft of engineering and the responsibility of seeing your work used in production. Faced with an unclear problem, you can identify what matters, make sensible trade-offs and carry a solution through to release without someone planning every step. title: Technical Co-Founder (AI Efficiency) @ AI Venture, Berlin
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up.

Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist.

We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the results against agreed quality standards. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the best combination for each task.

Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one.

Our founder was selected for Slush 20 Under 20, awarded by Anthropic, Slush, Index Ventures and Sifted. We closed our pre-seed round in two weeks and already have people waiting to use the product. We're now looking for a technical co-founder to help turn this opportunity into a company.

About the Role

As Technical Co-Founder, you will lead the development of our AI efficiency engine, working alongside the founder to turn a compelling technical opportunity into a product.

At the heart of the role is a deceptively simple question: how can we make AI models deliver the same or better results at a fraction of the cost?

You will explore approaches to model routing, fine-tuning, caching and inference optimisation, combining scientific curiosity with the ability to turn promising ideas into measurable improvements.

This is a role for someone who enjoys difficult technical problems, rigorous experimentation and challenging existing approaches. You won't be expected to build every part of the platform yourself. Working alongside our founding AI engineer and backend platform engineer, you will set the technical direction and focus your expertise where it creates the greatest impact.

Agentic engineering is central to how we work. We're looking for someone who already operates this way, using coding agents and developing the workflows and harnesses that allow a small team to move exceptionally quickly without compromising technical quality.

Above all, this is a co-founder role. We're looking for someone who wants to take genuine ownership, work with relentless intensity and help build a company from its earliest stages.

What You'll Work On

  • Drive AI cost efficiency: develop approaches to reducing inference costs through model selection, routing, caching, fine-tuning, quantization and other optimisation techniques.

  • Experiment and benchmark: design rigorous evaluations to understand the trade-offs between cost, quality and latency, turning technical insights into measurable improvements.

  • Shape the efficiency engine: determine how closed and open-weight models can be combined and optimised to deliver the best outcomes for different tasks.

  • Set technical direction: identify promising opportunities, make key architectural decisions and guide the founding engineers in bringing them to production.

  • Push agentic engineering forward: use coding agents as a core part of your work and develop the harnesses and workflows that allow a small team to operate with exceptional leverage.

  • Build the company: work closely with the founder on technical strategy, attract exceptional talent and help shape the product and business.

About You

You bring deep technical curiosity, scientific rigour and an entrepreneurial mindset. You enjoy getting into the details, testing hypotheses and finding approaches others might overlook.

We're particularly interested in people who bring:

  • Deep expertise in AI efficiency: meaningful experience optimising the cost or performance of LLMs or other AI systems, with concrete results to show for it. Experience in inference optimisation, routing, fine-tuning or related techniques is particularly relevant.

  • Strong technical foundations: a solid understanding of modern AI models, rigorous experimentation and the ability to translate research into practical improvements.

  • An agentic approach to engineering: you actively use coding agents, know how to orchestrate them effectively and are excited by what small, highly leveraged teams can achieve.

  • A co-founder mindset: you're resourceful, ambitious and comfortable with uncertainty. You take initiative, move quickly and want to build something from the ground up.

  • Technical leadership potential: you have the judgement to make difficult technical decisions and guide others. Previous CTO or engineering management experience is not required.

We're more interested in exceptional depth in AI efficiency and the ambition to build a company than a conventional CTO background.

Fluent English is required; German is a plus.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with open-weight models, GPU inference or model serving.

  • A strong research or open-source track record in AI or machine learning.

  • Experience taking AI systems into production or working in an early-stage startup.

Why Join

With the pre-seed round closed and early momentum behind us, you'll join at a point where there is considerable room to shape what comes next. You'll work alongside the founder, set the technical direction and receive meaningful co-founder equity in the company you help create.

We're competing with teams that have more people, more funding and an earlier start. Our conviction is that exceptional technical depth, focused decisions and an agentic approach to engineering can give a small team a meaningful advantage.

For someone who wants to apply their expertise in AI efficiency to an ambitious technical challenge, and take the leap from specialist to co-founder, this is an opportunity to build something of their own.

This is a full-time commitment, based in our Berlin office five days a week, starting as soon as possible.

title: Head / Senior Director of Sales – Central Europe
description:
About Cyclomedia


At Cyclomedia, our mission is to digitise the outside world with precision. Our geospatial technology turns street-level and aerial imagery into data and insights that cities, municipalities, utilities, telecom operators and infrastructure owners use to plan and run their operations more safely, efficiently and sustainably.

Backed by private equity investor Volpi Capital, we operate across the Netherlands, Germany, Belgium, Poland and the United States. Our customers range from Kommunen, Länder and federal authorities to Stadtwerke, utilities and telecom infrastructure companies.

Our culture is driven by curiosity and innovation, guided by impact and purpose, and built on collaboration, trust, transparency and accountability. We believe diverse perspectives drive innovation, and we are committed to building a team that reflects different backgrounds, identities and experiences. We welcome applications from everyone.

Job Summary


Germany is one of Cyclomedia's most important markets and a key pillar of our growth strategy. As Head / Senior Director of Sales, Central Europe, you will lead the next phase of our growth across DACH and Poland as a hands-on sales leader who owns the pipeline, the team and the plan.

You will build on a strong foundation: an established sales team and a base of strong reference customers. Your mandate is to take this to the next level by building a predictable, scalable sales engine with full visibility across pipeline, accounts and forecast.

Around 75% of your time goes into hands-on sales leadership, and around 25% into business development and growth strategy. You will be a member of the commercial leadership team, alongside the regional VPs and the VP Marketing.


Job Duties

Pipeline and forecast

  • Lead the weekly pipeline review across every rep, deal and stage.

  • Drive qualification rigour from first contact to close, ensuring forecasts are built on well-qualified opportunities.

  • Deliver a reliable monthly and quarterly forecast with clear insight into drivers and variance.

  • Be a hands-on CRM user and champion high standards of data quality and accuracy across the team.

  • Identify deals that need momentum early, create urgency and engage personally where it adds the most value.

Team leadership

  • Set clear, measurable expectations for every seller, supported by structured 1:1s, deal reviews and coaching.

  • Develop team performance through coaching, enablement and effective talent management.

  • Lead the team through growth and change with a style that inspires people to follow.

  • Maintain transparent, proactive communication with senior leadership, raising topics early and always with a recommended next step.

Customers and key accounts

  • Personally own key accounts and strategic deals as a player-coach.

  • Build senior relationships across Kommunen, Länder and Bund, Stadtwerke and utilities, and infrastructure and telecom accounts.

  • Lead or steer public tenders (RFQ / RFP, Vergaberecht, framework agreements) together with pre-sales.

Growth strategy and business development

  • Build and own the growth plan for Germany, DACH and Poland: where the next 12–24 months of revenue will come from, by vertical, segment and channel.

  • Translate the plan into quarterly targets, headcount needs and channel priorities, and keep it current as a live commitment.

  • Align public-sector buying cycles with the company's annual planning cadence.

  • Identify white space in the existing customer base and the wider market.

  • Bring structured market intelligence to the commercial leadership team, always with a recommendation.

  • Orchestrate pre-sales, marketing and product through influence and collaboration.


Job Requirements:

  • 10+ years in B2B sales, including 4+ years leading sales teams against revenue targets; around 15 years of overall experience is a useful guide.

  • A hands-on operating style: you personally run the forecast, the weekly cadence, the pipeline and key accounts.

  • Public-sector exposure: familiarity with tender mechanics, procurement rules and public-sector buying timelines.

  • Experience in data or technology solution sales, ideally geospatial or adjacent technology, or data-driven solutions with a long, considered buying cycle.

  • Experience in a larger, structured corporate environment, combined with the motivation to apply that discipline in a company where your impact is direct and visible.

  • Leadership people follow: you set high standards, coach people to meet them and make sound people decisions.

  • Fluent German and fluent English.

Nice to have

  • Experience selling across several verticals such as government, utilities / Stadtwerke, telecom and infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with Vermessung / Kataster and municipal planning buyers.

  • A regional growth plan you built and executed with measurable accountability.

  • Experience running several sales motions at once: direct enterprise, public sector, channel / partner and inbound.

  • Hands-on knowledge of public procurement, including RFPs, tenders and multi-year framework agreements.

  • Experience aligning public-sector sales cycles with the planning cadence of an investor-backed growth business.

  • Polish language skills.

  • Based in the Wetzlar / Frankfurt region

Benefits

  • Real ownership: a clear growth mandate, genuine freedom to shape the plan, and a seat on the commercial leadership team.

  • A strong starting point: an experienced team and solid reference customers.

  • Competitive package: attractive base salary plus performance-related variable pay.

  • Company car.

  • 28 days of annual leave, plus public holidays.

  • Supplementary health insurance: treatment by senior physicians and a private room, fully paid by Cyclomedia.

  • Company pension (Direktversicherung) with an employer contribution.

  • Learning and development: team coaching, online courses and individual training.

  • Team events: hiking, karaoke, treasure hunts and wine tastings are all part of how we get together.

Ready to lead the growth of one of our most important markets? Apply now and help us bring Cyclomedia's geospatial insights to the organisations shaping Central Europe.

title: Senior Product Manager | Reporting (f/m/d)
description:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to join bunch’s Reporting team. You’ll own the products and workflows that turn fund and portfolio data into correct, trusted reporting that’s ready to send to investors.

You’ll work at the heart of how fund managers communicate performance and activity to their investors. That means building intuitive reporting experiences and report-generation capabilities customers can trust.

As Senior Product Manager, Reporting Platform, you will:

  • Own key parts of our reporting product and its workflows end-to-end

  • Make sure the numbers investors see are right, from the data fund managers enter, through the calculations, to the final reports and the LP portal

  • Drive product decisions that balance accuracy, compliance and usability

  • Partner closely with engineering, design and operations to deliver a system customers can rely on

This role focuses on the Reporting side of the platform. Typical areas include:

  • Portfolio data capture: how fund managers record investments, valuations and portfolio events like follow-ons, conversions and exits, with a strong focus on intuitive UI/UX, data quality and completeness

  • The calculation layer between fund accounting and investor reporting: turning the fund’s books and portfolio valuations into correct investor numbers, with checks that tie them together

  • Report generation workflows: quarterly and annual packages, capital account statements and PDFs ready to send to investors

  • Configuration and customisation: templates, branding, disclosures, and language and currency formatting

  • Data readiness and correctness for reports: validation, completeness checks and auditability

  • Distribution and delivery: review and approval flows, delivery to investors, and access controls

  • Observability for reporting runs: errors, retries, performance and transparency for customers

Top Responsibilities

  • Drive roadmap and execution for reporting workflows and the reporting experiences customers see

  • Translate domain requirements into clear product specs (inputs → transformations → outputs) with strong edge-case handling

  • Partner with engineering to define the right building blocks for scalable report generation (templates, data contracts, versioning)

  • Collaborate with design to make complex reporting setup and review flows intuitive and fast

  • Work with fund accounting, operations and customer-facing teams to identify friction, ensure correctness and improve time-to-report

  • Define and track success metrics across adoption, report quality, operational efficiency and reliability

  • Maintain a high bar for data integrity, traceability and customer trust

About You

  • 7+ years of product management experience building B2B fintech products

  • Strong product execution skills: shipping, iteration loops, prioritization and stakeholder alignment

  • A solid grasp of financial reporting basics: how they work and why every number has to trace back to a source. Experience from accounting, banking, payments, treasury or financial data products all counts

  • Ability to turn complex requirements into simple product surfaces and crisp product logic

  • Analytical mindset: you can define metrics, investigate root causes and make data-informed tradeoffs

  • Excellent communication: you write clear specs and collaborate well with technical and non-technical partners

  • Experience working closely with engineering on systems that need reliability, monitoring and rigor on edge cases

  • Nice to have: exposure to fund or investment reporting (NAV, capital accounts, fees, IRR, TVPI, DPI). You don’t need a private markets background. We’ll teach you, and you’ll work every day with our fund accounting experts

Workplace & Benefits

  • Competitive salary plus equity

  • Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food and more)

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Hybrid setup with 2 days a week in the office

  • Up to 4 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 140+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring process

  • First interview with the People team (20 min) to get to know bunch and explore whether what we’re offering matches what you’re looking for

  • Hiring manager interview with our VP of Product (45 min) to discuss your experience, your approach and your fit for the role

  • Product case interview with our Product & Design team (60 min) to show your product thinking, communication and execution style

  • Stakeholder interviews (3 x 30 min) with members of Operations, Engineering and our Founders to align on vision and expectations

Curious to learn more?

Get a feel for who we are, how we work, and what we’re building:

  • About bunch – Our mission, product, and journey so far

  • Case Studies – About those who already build on bunch

  • Gathering insights – Our latest bunch of blog posts

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

Release Manager - AI Models
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.


🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Our engineering teams bring together ML engineering, evaluation and data science, software platform, testing, and product to turn breakthrough autonomous-driving technology into reliable products. Model releases connect these disciplines, taking AI models from early hypotheses through training, evaluation, and on-road testing to deployment across our vehicle fleet.

As our Release Manager — AI Models, you’ll help ensure that a core part of our technology — the AI model — is released reliably, on time, and to the standard required for production. You’ll bring structure and disciplined release practices to the fast-paced, non-deterministic world of ML, building the processes and systems that support clarity, stability, and business goals.

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Own the model release cycle, maintaining a steady and predictable cadence while adapting to changing business priorities.

  • Coordinate across ML engineering, evaluation and data science, software platform, testing, and product to keep releases moving and resolve dependencies.

  • Run the gates that promote models from hypothesis → training → evaluation → validation → deployment, making clear what is ready to ship and what needs more work.

  • Drive investigations into regressions and integration issues, coordinate rollback or roll-forward decisions, and follow through on technical debt and corrective actions.

  • Be the central point of contact for model-release status, risks, and timelines, giving engineers and leadership the right level of detail.

  • Run post-release reviews and turn lessons learned into practical improvements across teams.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

  • Release gates and promotion criteria: Define and justify what it takes for a model to progress, balancing performance gains, reproducibility, product requirements, safety, and compatibility with the onboard software stack and vehicle platform.

  • A release process that works for ML: Build frameworks that connect model development, evaluation, the Wayve onboard stack, and product needs — applying strong release-engineering practices while recognising where hypothesis-driven, non-deterministic systems need a different approach.

  • Bottleneck identification and improvement: Find constraints in the release lifecycle, implement dashboards and KPIs to make them visible, and proactively escalate gaps.

  • Tooling and automation: Partner with ML platform and integration teams to shape end-to-end automated release tooling. Define requirements that improve developer experience, release efficiency, and stakeholder communication.

  • Reliable, stable deployments: Strengthen how teams handle model versions, integration issues, regressions, and recovery so that releases deliver value reliably.

🙌 You should apply if:

  • You have 5+ years of experience in release management, software engineering, or a related field.

  • You understand the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and release management practices, including testing strategy, system integration, branching, and versioning.

  • You have a conceptual understanding of ML fundamentals: what training data is, the difference between training and inference, what a model version or checkpoint represents, and why model validation is probabilistic rather than simply pass/fail.

  • You have experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools such as GitHub, Buildkite, and CLI tools.

  • You’re skilled at managing releases in complex, fast-moving systems and comfortable adapting processes and tooling as requirements, architecture, and timelines change.

  • You bring strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, including when release trade-offs depend on limited or ambiguous data.

  • You communicate clearly with engineers and leadership, helping people understand priorities, risks, and decisions.

  • You’re pragmatic, methodical, and system-minded. You bring strong release-engineering instincts and are keen to develop the judgment to know where ML systems require a different approach.

It’s a bonus if you also bring:

  • Experience in AI/ML, autonomous vehicles, or robotics.

  • Familiarity with MLOps methodologies and tooling.

  • Experience with ML evaluation practices and tooling, especially for physical systems — including simulation, model leaderboards, and statistically powered experiments such as A/B or shadow-mode testing.

  • Awareness of model hardware and software dependencies.

  • A BSc or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end-to-end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real-world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand-coded rules or pre-mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once-in-a-generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human-driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware-agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real-world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻 — Locations & Flexible Working:

This is a full-time role based in our London office.

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency Interviews (Release Management & Cross Functional Collaboration)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Technical Assessment and Case Study)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependent):

  • 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually

  • 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long-term success of Wayve

  • ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable

  • ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands-on in vehicle workshops and labs

  • 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth

  • 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

  • sequencing and gap detection

  • snapshot-to-increment consistency

  • reconnect and replay correctness

  • staleness of live subscriptions

  • agreement between the streamed view and the REST view of the same state

  • Use adaptive detection, not static thresholds. Learn baselines per endpoint and per market, and let them adjust as "normal" changes. Hand-set limits get noisy, go stale, and teach people to ignore alerts.

  • Apply LLM and agentic tooling to generate checks from API specs and schemas, keep them current as the product changes, and triage alerts before a human sees them. Know when a deterministic rule, invariant or cross-source reconciliation is the better tool.

  • Test resilience and load. Design load, performance and failure-mode tests.

  • When you find a fault, raise it with the owning team with enough evidence for them to act. Drive it to resolution, then add a check that would have caught it earlier.

  • Measure and publish endpoint and field coverage, time to detect, detected-before-client rate and false-positive rate.

  • Run data governance

  • Build and maintain a catalog of our data assets and APIs, covering lineage and downstream consumers. Maintain an understanding of assets, how they're used and what breaks when they change.

  • Own data governance tooling such as OpenMetadata.

  • Own reference and security master data

  • Lead the build-out of the next-generation security master platform, then run it day to day: new listings, symbol mapping across venues, and increment and contract specs.

  • Design processes for safe updates to security entries, with validation and rollback.

  • Expand coverage across the firm

  • Over time, extend data quality coverage beyond client APIs to:

  • trade signals

  • pre-trade analytics

  • client post-trade analysis

  • PMS analytics

Qualifications

  • A track record of leading data QA or data quality teams, preferably on market data or other high-throughput, real-time data.

  • A deep understanding of streaming and API behaviour: throughput, WebSocket semantics, ordering, recovery and failure modes.

  • Experience inventorying and testing a large API and data surface end to end.

  • Hands-on experience with data governance: cataloging, lineage, ownership.

  • Experience with performance and load testing of distributed systems.

  • A strong engineering background. You design platforms, not scripts on a cron job, and you build on shared infrastructure rather than creating one-off tooling.

  • Practical experience applying LLM and agentic tooling to engineering problems.

  • Our stack: Flink, Doris, Dagster and Spark, plus OpenMetadata (or an equivalent such as Apache Atlas). Experience with comparable tools is just as relevant.

title: Director, Sanctions
description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. How you'll make impact

Airwallex is scaling a global sanctions programme across multiple jurisdictions, payment rails, and regulatory expectations. You'll provide the second-line leadership, challenge, and transformation needed to keep the programme effective, defensible, and ready for what comes next.

  • Own and continuously elevate Airwallex’s global sanctions strategy, policy framework, and second-line governance across all operating jurisdictions, including OFAC, the EU, UK OFSI, the UN, MAS, HKMA, AUSTRAC, and local regimes.

  • Provide independent second-line oversight and challenge of first-line customer, payment, and counterparty screening operations, setting global standards for investigative quality, threshold tuning, and risk-based decision-making.

  • Act as the global second-line escalation point for complex sanctions nexus determinations, potential hits, voluntary self-disclosures, asset freezing, and high-risk commercial deal approvals.

  • Partner with Data, Product, and Engineering to co-design and validate fuzzy logic, name and transaction screening algorithms, geographic blocking mechanisms, and AI/ML-driven alert reduction systems, ensuring model defensibility and explainability.

  • Lead the roadmap to modernise sanctions screening through AI-assisted workflows, graph analysis, automated detection, and real-time capabilities for cross-border payment rails.

  • Lead regulatory examinations, supervisory inquiries, and complex due diligence reviews from global banking partners, keeping systems and decision trails audit-ready by design.

  • Monitor geopolitical developments, sanctions evasion typologies, trade controls, and enforcement trends, translating changes into platform requirements ahead of regulatory deadlines.

  • Report sanctions programme health, residual risk, key performance indicators, and emerging risk trends to executive leadership, risk committees, and the board.

  • Lead, inspire, and scale a high-performing team of sanctions managers and subject matter experts across multiple regions.

You'll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 12+ years of dedicated experience in sanctions compliance and financial crime risk management.

  • Executive leadership experience managing cross-regional teams in a second-line-of-defence or global policy capacity.

  • Deep expertise in global cross-border payments, multi-currency account structures, foreign exchange, platform or embedded finance, or digital asset ecosystems.

  • Expert knowledge of global sanctions regimes, including OFAC, the EU, UK OFSI, the UN, MAS, HKMA, and AUSTRAC, as well as trade restrictions, export controls, and sanctions evasion techniques.

  • Experience providing independent oversight of customer, payment, and counterparty screening operations.

  • A track record of evaluating, tuning, or deploying modern sanctions technology, including AI/NLP-assisted screening tools, graph databases, and automated alert disposition frameworks.

  • Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to operationalise complex regulatory requirements in automated payment infrastructure.

  • Hands-on experience leading regulatory examinations, managing voluntary disclosures, and presenting screening architectures to regulators and institutional banking partners.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional leaders, defend risk positions to regulators, and present complex sanctions topics clearly to executive leadership.

  • A bachelor’s degree.

Preferred

  • Certified Sanctions Specialist (CGSS), CAMS, or equivalent professional designation.

  • An advanced degree, such as a Juris Doctor, master’s degree, or degree in a technical or quantitative discipline.

You'll thrive here if

  • You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You communicate clearly and directly across cultures, and you're thoughtful about how context shifts meaning across borders.

  • You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.

  • You can advocate hard for a position, then fully support the team's direction once a call is made.

Learn more about your team

Regulatory & Compliance is where we build the trust, discipline, and operational resilience required to scale a generational financial platform.

As Airwallex grows across 30+ markets, this team turns regulatory complexity into strategic control. You'll lead compliance, enterprise risk, and regulatory engagement in a way that protects the business while letting it move with conviction. Our ambition goes beyond meeting expectations: we're building a risk posture that acts as a competitive moat, grounded in ownership, proactive regulatory partnerships, and frameworks that scale globally while respecting local nuance.

It's a team for strategic operators with sharp judgment, high standards, and the confidence to execute at pace in a high-stakes environment. You'll thrive here if you can balance rigor with progress and influence across functions.

description:
About the Team

The Privacy Engineering team builds secure, reliable systems that help OpenAI meet its legal obligations while protecting user data. We partner closely with Legal and Engineering teams across OpenAI to support lawful data access requests and other critical legal workflows. Our work turns complex, high-stakes processes into auditable and dependable technical systems with clear human oversight and strong privacy and security controls.

About the Role

We’re looking for a full-stack Software Engineer to build the internal tools and data pipelines that power lawful data access request workflows and Legal Operations. You will work across product and data systems to make authorized retrieval and case handling accurate, efficient, and auditable. This role is well suited to someone who enjoys translating ambiguous operational requirements into durable systems, cares deeply about sensitive-data handling, and wants to improve both technical reliability and the day-to-day experience of the people operating these workflows.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA, with two additional locations under consideration: London, UK, and Dublin, Ireland. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and operate backend systems and workflow tooling for the full lifecycle of lawful data access requests, from intake and scoping through authorized retrieval, review, preparation, and audit.

  • Build reliable data pipelines and interfaces across products and data stores so authorized teams can locate and handle the right records accurately and reproducibly.

  • Implement least-privilege access, approval gates, provenance, audit trails, data minimization, and safe failure modes for sensitive workflows.

  • Partner with Legal and Legal Operations to translate legal and operational requirements into clear technical designs and intuitive operator experiences.

  • Identify responsible automation opportunities that reduce repetitive work while preserving human review, judgment, and accountability.

  • Own production systems through testing, observability, incident response, documentation, and continuous reliability improvements.

  • Help define the architecture and roadmap for reusable privacy and legal-infrastructure foundations as OpenAI’s products and obligations evolve.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have experience building or operating systems for lawful data access requests and understand the domain’s legal-process lifecycle, privacy and security constraints, auditability requirements, and operational sensitivities.

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals and experience building production services or data-intensive systems.

  • Ability to reason carefully about correctness, authorization, security, and privacy when working with sensitive data.

  • A track record of turning ambiguous requirements into pragmatic plans and communicating technical tradeoffs clearly.

  • End-to-end ownership, including operating what you build, and comfort learning unfamiliar products and domains.

  • Care for operator experience and a drive to make complex workflows safer, clearer, and more efficient.

  • Experience collaborating across Engineering, Legal, operations, Privacy, and Security stakeholders.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
