title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to join our Marketing Operations, RevOps team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help build the operational infrastructure needed to support our upmarket expansion into Mid-Market and Enterprise segments and be part of our Marketing Ops team as we scale our spend management platform across growth companies in Europe. If you're excited about designing account-based go-to-market systems, establishing AI enablement across operational workflows, and solving complex cross-functional challenges, and are passionate about marketing operations, RevOps, and systems architecture, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Associate Director, Marketing Operations and work closely with teams in Marketing Operations, RevOps, and Sales Ops. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to powering how the marketing team runs—from campaign operations and reporting cadence through to AI adoption and process improvement. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across Data, BAT (Business Automation & Tools), CX Ops, and Engineering to ensure success and maintain a single account truth across systems.

What you’ll be doing

As a Marketing Operations Manager, you will:

  • Build and refine marketing operational frameworks – Lead initiatives to continuously improve campaign workflows, request intake, approval processes, team governance, MQL→MQA routing logic, and SDR/BDR handoff processes.

  • Own account intelligence and reporting cadence – Design account scoring models for Mid-Market and Enterprise, maintain executive dashboards, integrate intent/firmographic/behavioral signals into segmentation, and manage account assignment logic.

  • Drive AI adoption across Marketing Ops – Translate AI capabilities into operational reality by building processes, governance, and enablement that accelerate execution and scale output within the team.

  • Ensure tooling health and systems ownership – Manage HubSpot workflows, automations, and integrations while coordinating with BAT and Engineering on tech stack builds, QA standards, and enterprise tooling requirements.

  • Enable team capabilities and documentation habits – Upskill Marketing and Marketing Ops teammates through shared standards, QA checklists, repeatable guides, templates, and onboarding resources to raise the operational floor.

What you bring


You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • HubSpot Fluency – A solid understanding of designing workflows, routing logic, and automation in HubSpot, including its limitations and when to extend outside the platform.

  • Account Operations Mindset – Track record of building ABM operational processes, MQL-to-MQA scoring rules, multi-stakeholder buying committee motions, and AI/automation adoption that sticks.

  • Sales Ops Partnership – Ability to collaborate seamlessly with Sales Ops on account strategy, territory strategy, handoff logic, and rep productivity without jargon.

  • Data & Documentation Habits – Excellent habits in building auditable specs, validating data quality, and diagnosing root causes in data flows alongside Data and BAT teams.

  • Experience with multi-touch attribution modeling, lifecycle marketing operations (nurture flows, recycling, engagement scoring), and ABM platforms / account intelligence tools.

  • A background in seeing a company move upmarket to Mid-Market/Enterprise and building scalable, long-term GTM operations.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You are an operational thinker who naturally designs sustainable systems, governance, and frameworks rather than executing quick-fix tasks.

  • You love working cross-functionally across Marketing, Sales Ops, and Data teams to streamline GTM processes and remove friction.

  • You are energized by driving practical AI adoption and upskilling team members through documentation, templates, and shared standards.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer operating in established, rigid systems rather than designing new account-based infrastructure in ambiguous environments.

  • You look at marketing operations as purely executing inbound lead lists without considering account context or buying committees.

  • You rely on tribal knowledge rather than maintaining clear, auditable documentation and QA standards for your builds.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Lead the launch of our account segmentation model to directly power SDR assignments and Mid-Market/Enterprise routing.

  • Collaborate with Data and Marketing Ops teams to clean up attribution, reporting, and lifecycle data so performance metrics are fully trusted.

  • Grow your skills in AI enablement, enterprise GTM systems, and cross-functional RevOps alignment, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale.

We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills in advanced RevOps and enterprise go-to-market strategies.

The location


Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 mins chat with the hiring manager, to deep dive in your experience and role

  3. Pleo Challenge and Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role

  4. Final Interview: A final interview with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for this role, we received a vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include very energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Description of the Project

As a Quantum Applications Engineer, you will work at the intersection of quantum algorithms, real-world applications and customer projects.

Your mission will be to identify relevant problems that can be addressed using Quandela's quantum computing technology, assess their feasibility and define how meaningful performance should be measured.

Working directly with industrial and academic partners, you will translate real-world challenges into quantum computing problems, evaluate potential approaches and establish the appropriate benchmarks against classical methods.

This is a highly technical role with strong exposure to customers and partners. It is particularly suited to someone with a background in quantum algorithms who wants to apply that expertise to practical use cases rather than focus exclusively on theoretical research.

Your Key Responsibilities

    • Identify and assess quantum use cases by working with customers, industrial partners and internal teams to understand their challenges and translate them into relevant computational problems.
    • Perform feasibility studies to determine whether and how these problems can be addressed using current and near-term quantum computing technologies, with a particular focus on NISQ approaches.
    • Define meaningful benchmarks, including relevant problem instances, expected outputs, accuracy targets and classical baselines to objectively evaluate quantum approaches.
    • Explore promising application domains and contribute to application roadmaps, from near-term demonstrations to longer-term utility-scale applications.
    • Evaluate scientific, industrial and economic value to help prioritize the applications where quantum computing can have the greatest impact.
    • Design and maintain strategic demonstrations and Proofs of Concept, working with internal teams or external software partners depending on the project.
    • Follow customer projects throughout their lifecycle, including projects where algorithm development is performed by external partners.
    • Present technical work to customers and partners, explaining quantum approaches, results, limitations and opportunities to both technical and non-specialist audiences.
    • Collaborate closely with Quandela's algorithm, machine learning, product, project management, sales and engineering teams.

Depending on the strategic interest of a project, you may also contribute directly to the development and implementation of quantum algorithms in Python.

What will make you successful

You do not need to know every possible quantum application from day one.

What matters is your ability to approach an unfamiliar problem, ask the right questions, understand its computational structure and determine whether quantum computing provides an interesting direction to explore.

You are comfortable navigating between research and practical applications: scientifically rigorous enough to challenge an algorithmic approach, pragmatic enough to assess its real-world relevance, and comfortable enough with people to discuss your conclusions directly with customers.

Requirements

You have a strong technical background in quantum computing and quantum algorithms, combined with the curiosity and communication skills required to explore real-world applications.

You ideally bring:

  • A PhD in quantum computing, quantum information, physics, applied mathematics, computer science or a related field, or a Master's degree combined with relevant professional experience.

  • Strong understanding of quantum algorithms, particularly approaches applicable to current or near-term quantum computers.

title: Platform Architect - Banking
description:
About us

EggAI is a fast-growing AI consulting and development startup. We build agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients. We are growing in several European markets.

The role

You will own the design of a shared AI platform for our clients. The platform has two parts. An AI Control Plane governs what agents may do, through identity and delegated permissions, policy enforcement, approvals, budgets and durable audit records. A managed AI Runtime is where the agents run. Both integrate with the client's identity, security, delivery and audit services.

You will set the architecture, define how services and controls fit together, and make sure what the team builds is sound, assured and ready for production. The role reaches across engineering, security, audit, risk and the client's architecture function. You will take designs through their governance, record the decisions, and give the engineers a design they can build and the client a design they can approve.

You will be EggAI's accountable architecture lead on the engagement, leading design for a delivery team of platform engineers. You make the technical decisions within the team's remit, recommend on the rest, and secure the client's approval where their architecture or risk governance requires it. 

What you will do

- Own the architecture of the AI Control Plane and AI Runtime and keep it aligned with the client's architecture standards, cloud substrate, API gateway, identity provider and audit services.
- Define service interfaces and contracts. Decide where each security and policy control is enforced: in the gateway, the control plane, the runtime or the client's own services.
- Keep the design record. Write architecture decision records (ADRs) and record every deviation from the client's standards or our reference designs for a client decision.
- Take designs through the client's architecture and risk forums. Secure approvals in time for dependent work, so that design precedes implementation.
- Lead design and quality review across all platform services. Review engineers' changes, cross-service tests and fault exercises with the CTO.
- Define how the architecture will be proven. Agree acceptance criteria with engineers and client control owners for each interface, control and infrastructure contract, including behaviour when a dependency fails, and review the test evidence showing they are met.
- Hold the build to the design's principles: policy enforced outside the agent, decisions recorded before actions take effect, fail closed with stop always available, and audit evidence that is administered independently of the people who build and run the platform, reconciled against what actually happened, and readable with the client's own tools.
- Maintain the inventory of platform controls. Record for each one whether it is enforced or only monitored, whether it is implemented, tested or still open, and what evidence it produces, so acceptance reviews work from a current record and coverage gaps are visible.
- Assess proposed technology, scope and dependency changes for their effect on the design, controls, effort and running costs, and give the programme lead a clear basis for plan and cost decisions.
- Evaluate new runtimes and managed services against the platform's control requirements. Compare shared controls with provider-native ones on integration effort, operating cost and assurance gaps, separate what is verified from what is assumed, and recommend whether to adopt, change the design or hold scope.
- Lead the technical assessment of production readiness. Review recovery, containment and fault-exercise evidence, and give the programme lead a clear view of what is ready and what is not.
- Stay with the platform through go-live and the support period after it. Resolve the architectural issues that production exposes, and decide when a fix is a design change rather than a defect.
- Prepare the client's receiving engineers to maintain the design. Lead the architecture parts of training and handover, and leave documentation, decision records and guidance they can extend without you.

Essential experience

- You have been the accountable solution or platform architect for systems that went into production, and have led engineers through building them.
- You have delivered cloud platforms into production in a regulated environment and taken designs through formal architecture and risk governance.
- You know a major cloud platform in depth: networking, identity, secrets, Kubernetes and managed services. Azure is strongly preferred.
- You have hands-on experience with API gateways, identity and delegation using OAuth and OIDC, and policy as code.
- You work with infrastructure as code, GitOps and software supply-chain controls, and understand how they underpin reproducible environments, conformance tests and release assurance.
- You have designed systems that must produce audit evidence and fail safely: durable records, immutable storage, separation of duties and deny-by-default access. You have sound judgement about retries, partial failure, idempotency, identity propagation and recovery.
- You write clear architecture decision records and can explain and defend a design to senior architects, risk owners and engineers.

Nice to have

- Delivery in financial services or banking.
- LLM or agent platforms in production, including model gateways, agent orchestration and protocols such as MCP and A2A.
- Audit, evidence retention or AI risk controls, including EU AI Act, PRA or FCA expectations.
- Products in this space such as Kong, Open Policy Agent or Microsoft Foundry.

Practical details

- Hybrid working and client-site attendance will depend on the engagement.
- You will need to complete the background and security checks required by the client.

description:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job

Design, build, and scale production-grade AI systems that power the next generation of intelligent commerce.

You will work at the intersection of Software Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build AI-native products, agentic systems, and platform capabilities used by Mirakl customers and internal teams.

This is a freelance position based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 1 day of remote work per week.

 

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to transform the way our internal teams work, and to have a significant impact on the agentic side of our Saas products.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You'll Do

1. Design & Build AI Systems

  • Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems for both Mirakl internal operations.
  • Develop solutions leveraging: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Multimodal AI and Evaluation frameworks.
  • Architect complex agentic workflows including tools, memory, retrieval, planning, and guardrails.
  • Rapidly prototype new capabilities and evolve them into scalable, reliable AI production systems.

2. Integrate Across the Stack

  • Connect AI systems to internal platforms, business applications, and data sources across the company.
  • Enable AI agents to interact with systems such as CRM, data platform, Drive, Jira, support tools, and internal knowledge bases.
  • Design robust orchestration layers between models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, and business workflows.
  • Ensure reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability across the entire AI stack.

3. Iterate for Impact

  • Partner with end users, business teams, Product Managers, and Engineers to identify high-value opportunities for AI.
  • Run pilots and experiments, gather qualitative and quantitative feedback, and measure business impact.
  • Analyze usage patterns, failure modes, costs, latency, and performance metrics.
  • Continuously improve accuracy, reliability, adoption, and user experience through data-driven iteration.

4. Ensure Quality, Security & Reliability

  • Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, validation layers, and monitoring systems.
  • Design AI systems that are secure, explainable, and production-ready.
  • Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements.
  • Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices.

5. Drive Adoption & Enablement

  • Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers.
  • Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations.
  • Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company.
  • Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce.

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL

  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models

  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases

  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

What Makes You Successful

  • Strong engineering mindset: able to design reliable and scalable systems
  • Strong AI expertise: able to translate the latest AI capabilities into production products
  • Strong product mindset: able to balance technical excellence with business impact
  • Focus on measurable outcomes, not technical complexity

Success Metrics

  • Product adoption and business impact
  • Performance and reliability of AI systems
  • Quality of AI outputs and evaluation metrics

You'll Love This Job If you have 

  • 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or related fields
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience building production AI systems using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents
  • Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and retrieval systems
  • Experience evaluating AI systems and improving model performance
  • Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments
  • Strong communication skills in English
  • Curiosity, pragmatism, and passion for building AI products

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

  • A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.
  • An initial 1h30 technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.
  • 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

  • Discover our company culture and values

  • Here is a product teaser

  • Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle

  • Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest

  • Articles on our A round (techfundingnews, Maddyness, les echos, our blog)

Context

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer patient calls, book and reschedule appointments, triage emergencies, and free up administrative staff so care teams can focus on care. The product is live and used daily in hundreds of healthcare facilities, just a few months after launch.

We are scaling fast: our target is €1M of signed ARR per month by the end of December 2026. The liberal segment (private practices and groups, ~€10–30k ARR per account) needs to contribute heavily.

This is a full-cycle new-business role: you own everything from cold outreach to signature, and you build your own territory.

Your mission

Generate €400k ARR in year one in new business on the liberal segment, owning the full cycle from prospecting to signed deals.

Expected outcomes

1 month:

  • Get up to speed on our pitch, our product, and our market (types of centers, buying journey…)

  • Make your first prospecting calls, demos, and initial sales conversations

  • Close your first simple deals independently.

3 months:

  • Build a stable pipeline, with at least 30 active opportunities at different stages

  • Improve our call scripts and email sequences

  • Work closely with the Ops team to ensure smooth deployments

  • Identify weak signals from the field and feed into the product roadmap

  • Full autonomy by month 3 on pitch, product, ICP, and qualification

6-12 months:

  • Manage complex sales cycles (groups, multi-site, multiple stakeholders)

  • Contribute to structuring our sales playbook

  • Participate in training new Sales hires (onboarding, coaching, sharing learnings)

What the role looks like day to day

Build your own pipeline

  • Generate qualified meetings across every sales channel: cold calling first, plus email, LinkedIn, events, and networking

  • Create your own network and get referred to new decision-makers

  • Run phoning, email campaigns, and inbound screening from day one

Own the full sales cycle

  • Deep discovery, sharp pitch, and efficient closing with practice and group decision-makers

  • Master the Vocca sales playbook to move deals stage to stage

  • Work closely with Ops to ensure smooth deployments (~1 month post-signature)

Make the engine better

  • Keep Attio (CRM) spotless and your week tightly planned across prospecting, meetings, and networking

  • Surface field signals into the product roadmap and improve our scripts and sequences

What sales look like on the liberal segment

  • Deal size from 15K to 30K

  • 1 month sale cycle

  • ICP : group of independent practitioners

This role is for you if

The prerequisites:

  • You build qualified pipeline from cold. You've done real cold calling on cold targets : people you're interrupting, not warm inbound or an existing book you upsell. You know how to create a network and earn referrals from new decision-makers.

  • You've run SMB/mid deals end to end. You've personally sourced and closed your own deals for at least 6 months, on fast, slightly pushy cycles (€10–20k average basket). You listen actively, you're convincing and assertive, and you're comfortable being pushy.

  • You have a solar, high-energy presence with the gravitas to deal with doctors: they need to be won over, so we want sharp closers. You adapt your posture and vocabulary from group GMs to individual practitioners with the same professional posture.

What we'll evaluate in interviews:

  • Demanding with yourself, highly coachable: your track record shows you don't settle for the status quo (academic, athletic, or professional over-achievement; you hit or beat your targets). No ego : you take feedback, apply it next time, and stay curious about a sector you may not know yet.

  • Team-first: you put collective success before personal recognition. Problem solver, not problem builder. You question yourself when things don't work.

  • Rigor, discipline, organization: you plan your week, arrive prepared and on time, keep the CRM discipline tight. You're reliable.

Requirements:

  • 1–3 years of B2B SaaS sales with genuine cold prospecting + closing experience

  • Native-level French and good written and spoken English for internal communication

  • Top-tier background: a strong school, or a demanding company

  • Entrepreneurial mindset

Nice to have:

  • Experience in healthcare / healthtech, or selling a product with regulatory constraints

  • Grounding in sales theory (you've read the fundamentals)

  • Familiarity with Attio, Notion, Slack, Apollo

This role is NOT for you if

  • You've only ever been a BDR/SDR booking meetings, or you've only "sold" by upselling a warm existing portfolio. This role is cold sourcing + closing from scratch.

  • You optimize for individual recognition over team outcomes.

Perks and Benefits

  • Equity (BSPCE)

  • Executive contract (cadre) on a forfait-jours basis, with ~8–12 RTT days per year (depending on the year's public holidays).

  • Hybrid rhythm from Paris: 3-4 days at the office, 1-2 day per week remote.

  • MacBook provided.

  • Meal vouchers: €9 per working day (55% covered by the company).

  • EGYM Wellpass (Gymlib).

  • Health insurance: 50% of Alan covered.

  • Public transport: 50% of Navigo covered.

  • Annual offsite and multiple team events throughout the year.

Hiring process

  1. Discovery interview (30 min, video) — Talent Acquisition Manager

  2. Manager fit interview (30 min, video) — Alexandre, Head of Sales

  3. Track record + case study (1h) — Alexandre and Nathan (Senior AE)

  4. Founders / culture fit (1h, on site) — Eliott, CEO and/or Hugo, CTO + coffee with the team

  5. Reference checks

  6. Offer

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca?

  • An entrepreneurial adventure, with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

  • A product already live, with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI)

  • A true scaling phase, with everything still to build

  • Real responsibilities from day one

We hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about our opportunities but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

Most ERP deployments are people moving data around for a year. Incumbents quote six figures for it, and the client gets the same software they had, just newer. This is not a product or a sales role, you are a deployment strategist. In one project, you replace a company's ERP and you put AI agents to work inside it.

Since day one, the founders have run every deployment themselves. Clients are now coming in faster than we can handle, and we need someone to own deployments. What you'll do

  • Use the tools engineers build for you. Our engineers build the tools that let you deploy on your own: AI-assisted data migration from the client's old ERP and Excel files, and a builder for screens and agents. You tell them what slows you down, they make it disappear.

  • Agentify your own work. On top of the tools our engineers build, you create your own agents for the deployment itself: configuration checks, test scenarios, training material, status reports. Every manual step you repeat twice becomes an agent for the next deployment.

What you bring

You bring the energy to deploy AI at scale in industrial companies. You learn fast from discovery, and you're as comfortable with founders and leadership teams as with operators on the shop floor.

  • You've worked around manufacturing or food operations: lots, BOMs, production orders, campaigns

Talent beats checklists. If you're intrigued, apply anyway.

Beyond client work, you will help build the firm: scoping and estimating new projects, interviewing engineering candidates, and contributing to internal AI initiatives and experimentation. 

Work environment : engineering culture and stack 

We are building a small, highly skilled delivery team that shares engineering patterns and goes deep on a focused stack. Our aim is to make AI and technology transformation practical for mid-sized companies, within their budgets, teams and operating realities. Reusing proven foundations across projects lets us deliver faster, with consistent quality and a clear path to business value. 

The stack below is our default, not a constraint: we adapt to client environments and adopt new tools when the benefit is clear. 

  • Ways of working: Git, pull requests, code reviews, automated tests and CI/CD. Monitoring, evaluations and tracing ship with every AI application.

Requirements

  • Solid grounding in APIs, data modelling, storage and pipelines, and practical experience with cloud services and infrastructure as code. 
  • Strong engineering habits around code review, automated testing and CI/CD, and the judgement to make architecture decisions and guide other engineers. 
  • Comfort in unfamiliar client environments: clarifying ambiguous requirements and discussing scope, commitments and trade-offs with senior stakeholders. 
  • Commercial sense: you care whether what you build moves operational and financial results.

Experience in consulting or client-facing delivery, business process automation, or transformation in mid-sized or PE-backed companies would be valuable. A degree in engineering, Computer Science or a related field is welcome, as is equivalent practical experience.

  • Ownership and variety: lead projects end to end across different industries and problems, working directly with business owners, investors and leadership teams.

This is an opportunity to join a fast-growing, partner-led consulting platform at a pivotal moment in its development.

You will work on high-impact AI, Technology and Transformation engagements, advising private equity funds, portfolio companies and executive leadership teams on critical investment and transformation decisions.

As Singulier x OMMAX build a leading European AI management consulting platform, you will help shape how AI, technology, data and business strategy come together to create lasting value for clients.

title: Software Engineer (Golang), Managed K8s
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

THE TEAM

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

We run it all on our own metal, our own network, our own datacenters — which means when something breaks, the fix is ours to write.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on.

THE ROLE

You will build our Kubernetes product end to end: a metal-to-on-demand platform built on in-house infrastructure, with GPU support for training, inference, and general-purpose compute.

Kubernetes is our product, not just our platform — we run it on infrastructure we own end to end. You will decide how the control plane scales, how GPUs get scheduled, and how quickly a rack of bare metal becomes an on-demand cluster a customer can use. The decisions you make here shape how our infrastructure scales from today's footprint to a gigawatt, and how we turn frontier AI research into production systems used by millions.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

title: Senior Cosmetic Chemist
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Cosmetic Chemist for our KEUNE Beauty Solutions team. You combine excellent formulation skills with the confidence to tackle development projects independently. You will remain closely involved in hands-on laboratory work while taking responsibility for assigned projects, guiding fellow medior and junior chemists, and working directly with clients and cross-functional teams to bring high-performing products to market.

At KEUNE, we develop and manufacture not only our own professional haircare products but also products for KEUNE Beauty Solutions (KBS), our private label division. Through KBS, we partner with beauty brands worldwide, offering end-to-end solutions from formulation development and manufacturing to the delivery of finished products.

MISSION

  • Lead assigned new product development projects from brief to commercialization, taking ownership of technical execution, deliverables, timelines, and follow-up in line with the NPD process.

  • Develop and optimize haircare, hairstyling, and hair color formulations through hands-on laboratory work, ensuring product performance, safety, quality, and regulatory compliance.

  • Act as technical reference for assigned projects: review client briefs, clarify requirements, identify risks, and translate expectations into a clear development plan.

  • Participate in and lead technical discussions with clients, working alongside Project Management and Commercial teams to align expectations, feasibility, and next steps.

  • Provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level chemists working on shared projects, while maintaining ownership for project outcomes.

  • Plan, organize, execute, document, and follow up on submissions, stability, safety, and performance testing, ensuring decisions and results are properly tracked.

  • Proactively identify potential delays or technical challenges, communicate them early, and drive practical solutions with the relevant stakeholders.

  • Support scale-up, first production runs, and troubleshooting in collaboration with Production and Quality Control.

  • Stay informed about market trends, emerging ingredients, and technologies, and turn insights into relevant innovation concepts and proposals for clients.

  • Apply appropriate instrumental and analytical methods to evaluate formulations, substantiate performance, and support technical decisions.

YOU

  • Master's degree in Chemistry, Cosmetic Science, or a related field.

  • At least 7 years of relevant cosmetic formulation and development experience, with strong expertise in hair products.

  • A proven track record of developing and successfully launching cosmetic products.

  • Strong hands-on formulation skills, paired with the ability to organize and tackle multiple development activities.

  • A proactive, independent, and accountable working style: you take initiative, follow through on commitments, and know when to escalate issues.

  • Confidence in leading technical client conversations, challenging or clarifying briefs constructively, and managing expectations together with cross-functional colleagues.

  • Ability to guide junior and mid-level chemists.

  • Excellent communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, including the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Curiosity about innovation, new ingredients, and opportunities to improve products and ways of working.

  • Eligible to work in the Netherlands



OUR OFFER

  • A sustainably-conscious employer;

  • Travel allowance

  • 27 vacation days per year (based on full-time employment);

  • Relocation support

  • A good pension plan;

  • A competitive salary;

  • 8% holiday pay;

  • And never have a "bad hair day" again thanks to staff discounts on the entire Keune collection!

  • Attention to your mental well-being through unlimited access to OpenUp

  • Participation in group classes at Personal Fitness Soest

KEUNE

We are a family business with a long-term vision, where science is at the heart of everything we do. Our story begins in 1922, in Amsterdam. Today, KEUNE belongs to one of the fastest growing brands in professional hair care products. From our headquarters in Soest, KEUNE products are developed, produced and distributed worldwide to more than 85 countries. And we have no intention of slowing down! Every year we open a new site of our own. We produce in a sustainable and animal-friendly way and are B Corp-certified. But KEUNE is not just about creating beautiful products - it's about our story and our vision.  KEUNE is led by Philip Berlijn, who is focused on building a strong brand and creating a corporate culture that is all about collaboration, sustainability and showing character

OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

We are committed to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive work environment. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. We do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, nationality, religion or belief, age, disability, neurodiversity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know, and we will work with you to support your participation.

title: Senior Accountmanager Zorg & ICT
description:
Je opent nieuwe deuren bij zorgorganisaties en bouwt vanuit vertrouwen aan nieuwe samenwerkingen.

Wil jij bijdragen aan dienstverlening in de zorg die er echt toe doet? Krijg jij energie van het leggen van nieuwe contacten en het omzetten van een eerste gesprek in een duurzame samenwerking? En geloof jij oprecht dat goede digitale zorg het verschil maakt voor patiënt en zorgprofessional? Dan willen we jou graag leren kennen.

Bij Beter Healthcare draait accountmanagement niet in de eerste plaats om de cijfers. Het draait om mensen, vertrouwen en trots zijn op wat je doet, en om de sterke drive om de zorg én Beter Healthcare stap voor stap vooruit te helpen. Elke dag weer.

Wat je gaat doen

Als (Senior) Accountmanager ben jij voor nieuwe zorgorganisaties vaak de eerste kennismaking met Beter Healthcare. Je richt je op ziekenhuizen, GGZ- en VVT-organisaties en samenwerkingsverbanden waar we nog niet of nauwelijks werken. Je verkoopt geen product, maar dienstverlening: advies, projectmanagement, interim-inzet en implementatie, samen met de consultants die de inhoud brengen.

Je zoekt actief kansen op, weet klant behoeften niet alleen te identificeren maar ook te sturen en laat je niet uit het veld slaan door een nee. Tegelijk verkoop je niets wat niet past: je begint bij echte interesse in de klant en zijn uitdagingen. En je bent een echte teamspeler. Eerst het team, daarna jijzelf. Geen groot ego, geen solist. Je groeit hard mee met ons bedrijf, helemaal in lijn met onze missie: hoe meer we groeien, hoe groter onze positieve impact op de zorg.

Jouw werkzaamheden omvatten onder andere:

·       Je brengt de markt in kaart, kiest doelorganisaties en bouwt een gerichte pipeline op;

·       Je legt contact met CIO's, CMIO's, managers informatievoorziening, inkopers en bestuurders, via je eigen netwerk en actieve acquisitie;

·       Je verkent in gesprekken wat er echt speelt en vertaalt dat samen met consultants naar een passend voorstel;

·       Je stelt offertes op en onderhandelt over inzet, tarieven en voorwaarden;

·       Je volgt aanbestedingen en raamovereenkomsten en coördineert inschrijvingen;

·       Je vertegenwoordigt Beter Healthcare op netwerkevenementen, congressen en vakbijeenkomsten, op een manier die past bij onze waarden: betrokken, betrouwbaar en bekwaam;

·       Je rapporteert over pipeline, forecast en kansen aan het managementteam en hebt dat gewoon goed op orde.


Wie jij bent

Je bent geen typische verkoper. Je bent een ondernemende verbinder: iemand die nieuwe kansen ziet, deuren durft te openen en mensen en organisaties oprecht wil begrijpen. Herken jij jezelf hierin?

·       Je haalt energie uit het binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten en hebt het doorzettingsvermogen dat daarbij hoort;

·       Je hebt een intrinsieke drive om bij te dragen aan betere zorg door digitalisering;

·       Je bent nieuwsgierig en leergierig: de wereld van zorg en ICT blijft je boeien en je houdt je kennis actief bij;

·       Je bent een echte teamspeler en zet het gezamenlijke resultaat boven je eigen ego;

·       Je hebt minimaal acht jaar ervaring in de verkoop van dienstverlening, zoals consultancy, interim of detachering, in de zorg-ICT;

·       Je hebt een trackrecord in het binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten en kent de inkoop- en aanbestedingsprocessen in de zorg;

·       Je beschikt over een actief netwerk bij zorgorganisaties, bij voorkeur op het niveau van CIO, CMIO, IM-management of bestuur;

·       Je hebt hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau;

·       Je communiceert helder en overtuigend in het Nederlands, mondeling en schriftelijk.

Wat je van ons mag verwachten

Bij Beter Healthcare kom je terecht in een werkomgeving die draait om groei, vertrouwen en samenwerking. Je kunt rekenen op:

·       Een goed salaris dat we bepalen op basis van jouw kennis en ervaring;

·       Sterke secundaire voorwaarden, zoals een leaseauto, bonusregeling, pensioen, laptop en telefoon;

·       Een rol met echte impact: jij opent de deuren waardoor Beter Healthcare kan groeien en de zorg kan verbeteren;

·       Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en invloed op onze commerciële koers;

·       Ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen, zowel commercieel als inhoudelijk;

·       Kennisgroepen, intervisies en ontwikkelmogelijkheden om continu te blijven leren;

·       Interactieve kwartaalbijeenkomsten met collega's op inspirerende locaties;

·       Een hecht team van gedreven healthcare consultants dat altijd met je meedenkt;

·       Een actieve personeelsvereniging voor wie het leuk vindt om samen dingen te ondernemen;

·       Heel veel plezier in een prachtig team.

Over Beter Healthcare

Beter Healthcare is een consultancybureau op het snijvlak van zorg en ICT. We ondersteunen zorgorganisaties bij de digitalisering van hun processen en dragen zo bij aan een toekomstbestendige zorg. We zijn al met zo'n 100 IT healthcare specialisten en we groeien hard: niet als doel op zich, maar omdat onze klanten ons nodig hebben en onze aanpak werkt.

Sinds 2012 helpen we zorgorganisaties met advies, projectmanagement en beheer. Onze kracht is dat we niet alleen adviseren, maar ook samen met klanten oplossingen succesvol implementeren. Onze consultants kennen de zorg van binnenuit, en dat maakt echt het verschil.

Beter Healthcare is onderdeel van IG&H, een toonaangevend adviesbureau dat verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor de resultaten van zijn werk. Met de eigen ‘Make Strategy Work’-methodologie richt IG&H zich op digitale transformaties. Binnen IG&H Health werken we samen met teams die gespecialiseerd zijn in onder meer strategy consulting, data en AI, security en managed cloudservices.

Voel jij een “ja”?

Zie jij jezelf hierin terug en wil je met jouw energie en talent bijdragen aan de groei van Beter Healthcare én aan betere zorg in Nederland? Vul dan het sollicitatieformulier in. We ontmoeten je graag!

title: Senior Partner Solutions Engineer - EMEA
Senior Google Ads Specialist | International E-commerce | Remote ASAP
description:
ennovationHUB is a rapidly growing international e-commerce group operating in the home & living category, with a strong focus on furniture. From our hubs in Belgrade, Barcelona, and London, we serve customers across the UK, North America, EU, and APAC.

As we work toward €160m+ annual revenue by 2027, we are looking for a Senior Google Ads Specialist to join us ASAP and take ownership of Google Ads performance for one of our portfolio brands, with direct accountability for growth, efficiency, and profitability.

This is not a typical agency PPC role focused on managing a handful of campaigns. You will join a multi-brand international e-commerce group with significant advertising budgets, multiple markets, and a clear view of how your work influences revenue and profitability.

Google Ads is central to our growth strategy. Working across multiple countries and brands brings both complexity and opportunity. We are looking for people who enjoy working with large datasets, identifying performance opportunities, and consistently improving results through testing, analysis, and execution.

You will collaborate closely with our Head of Performance Marketing, creative team, and data specialists to ensure campaigns perform well today and continue to scale efficiently as the business grows.

  • Take ownership of Google Ads performance for one e-commerce brand across multiple international markets

  • Manage and optimise Google Ads campaigns across Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and other relevant campaign types

  • Monitor and improve key performance metrics including ROAS, CPA, conversion rate, revenue, and profitability

  • Be directly accountable for growth, efficiency, and performance within your portfolio

  • Identify growth opportunities across products, categories, markets, and audience segments

  • Analyse campaign data and turn insights into actionable recommendations

  • Conduct account audits and implement ongoing optimisation initiatives

  • Work closely with developers and analytics teams to ensure accurate tracking and measurement

  • Collaborate with creative and content teams to improve ad performance and landing page effectiveness

  • Support budget planning, forecasting, and performance reporting

  • Stay current with platform developments, AI-driven advertising features, and industry best practices

  • Contribute to testing strategies and experimentation frameworks that improve long-term account performance

You will be joining a business where Google Ads already delivers results. Your role is to build on that success by identifying opportunities, improving efficiency, and scaling what works. We operate in a competitive e-commerce environment where even small improvements can have a significant impact.

You will work alongside experienced colleagues who move quickly and care about results. We value people who think independently, challenge assumptions with data, and take ownership of outcomes. This is not a support or reporting role. You will be trusted to make decisions, own results, and directly influence the growth of the business.


This role is strictly for candidates with in-house e-commerce experience. Applicants whose primary Google Ads experience comes from agencies, consultancies, or freelance work will not be considered.

We are looking for people who have owned performance outcomes within an e-commerce business, where success is measured by revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, and long-term growth rather than client management and campaign delivery. You should have experience working directly within a commercial business and feel comfortable taking responsibility for results, beyond simply providing recommendations.

Our Ideal Candidate Will Have:

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns

  • Proven hands-on experience managing Google Ads for an e-commerce business, with direct responsibility for performance and profitability

  • Strong experience with Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns

  • Proven experience working as part of an in-house e-commerce team rather than as an agency, consultant, or freelancer

  • Comfortable analysing large datasets and identifying actionable insights

  • Strong understanding of attribution, tracking, and performance measurement

  • Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and Google Merchant Center

  • Highly analytical with strong attention to detail

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities

  • Curious, proactive, and focused on continuous improvement

  • Able to take ownership and make decisions independently

  • We are actively pushing AI and automation across the business, so you need to be comfortable working in that direction and not resistant to change

  • Senior, but practical

  • Data-driven without becoming overly theoretical

  • Comfortable taking ownership and making decisions

  • Naturally curious and always looking for performance improvements

  • Focused on outcomes rather than activity

  • Able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution

  • Motivated by building and scaling rather than simply maintaining campaigns

  • Available to start immediately / ASAP

We are investing in strengthening our presence there and expect it to become an increasingly important location for our team over time. Our wider team works across London, Belgrade, Barcelona, Frankfurt, Oxfordshire, Istanbul, and Guangzhou.

The role involves travel approximately every 4-8 weeks to Belgrade, Barcelona, London, or other team locations for planning sessions, workshops, team gatherings, and strategic discussions. While most work takes place remotely, we value spending time together in person, particularly as the company continues to scale.

This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to make a meaningful contribution to scaling an international e-commerce business over the coming years.

In Our Culture at ennovationHUB, We Value:

  • Accountability over excuses

  • Execution over talk

  • Clarity over politics

  • Learning through doing

We welcome people from diverse backgrounds. What matters most is the quality of your work, taking ownership, and helping the business move forward.

Je ondersteunt Project Managers bij het monitoren en verbeteren van projectresultaten, terwijl je tegelijkertijd bijdraagt aan een hoogwaardige financiële verslaggeving, een betrouwbare jaarafsluiting en een succesvolle accountantscontrole. MVRDV is een wereldwijd erkend bureau voor architectuur en stedenbouw, met hoofdkantoor in Rotterdam en vestigingen in Shanghai, Parijs, Berlijn en New York. Opgericht in 1993 door Winy Maas, Jacob van Rijs en Nathalie de Vries, ontwerpt MVRDV innovatieve, sociaal verantwoorde en duurzame architectuur die de toekomst vormgeeft. Project Control

description:
About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The opportunity: Full Stack Engineer

As a Full Stack Engineer, you will take primary ownership of our frontend experience while being capable of making the backend changes needed to unblock yourself and your team. You'll work closely with Backend Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and stakeholders to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-performance products end-to-end, from pixel to API.

Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam.

What you'll do in this role

  • Design, develop, and maintain frontend components in Angular (and Lit HTML where applicable), ensuring optimal performance, responsiveness, and usability.

  • Own the integration layer between frontend and backend: consume and contribute to OpenAPI-defined APIs, handle data contracts, and wire up microservices cleanly.

  • Make targeted backend changes, new endpoints, tweaks to existing services, minor data model updates, so you can ship features without always depending on a dedicated backend engineer.

  • Contribute to architectural discussions across the full stack, from UI component structure to API design and data access patterns.

  • Participate actively in code reviews, providing feedback on both frontend and backend code quality, adherence to standards, and performance.

  • Mentor and support junior engineers across the stack.

  • Stay current with evolving frontend and full-stack best practices.

What you bring to the table

  • 3+ years of experience in frontend or full stack engineering.

  • Strong proficiency in Angular and experience with component-based frameworks such as Lit HTML.

  • Solid understanding of responsive design, UX/UI principles, and a keen eye for design detail.

  • Proven experience integrating with APIs and microservices, you understand HTTP, REST conventions, auth flows, and error handling deeply.

  • Working proficiency in Python, enough to navigate a FastAPI codebase, add or adjust endpoints, and write Pydantic models and SQLAlchemy queries.

  • Familiarity with relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) at the query and schema level.

  • Experience with containerised workflows using Docker.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills; comfortable working independently and collaboratively.

  • Strong English communication skills and ability to work across disciplines.

  • Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflow.

  • Familiarity with LLM API integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) and an understanding of the UX patterns specific to AI-powered features.

What success in the first 6 months looks like

  • You've built trust with Backend, DevOps, and Product peers and taken clear ownership of 2–3 frontend domains, including their design system consistency and API integration contracts.

  • You've delivered frontend features end-to-end, from UX design discussion through Angular implementation, API wiring, tests, and documentation, without needing hand-holding at either layer.

  • You've unblocked yourself (and others) by making safe, well-reviewed backend changes: adding an endpoint, adjusting a response model, or optimising a query, rather than waiting in a queue.

  • You've raised frontend quality: responsive across devices, accessible, consistent with our design system, and validated against real API contracts rather than mocks.

  • You've contributed to meaningful observability on the frontend, error tracking, performance budgets, and linked them to backend SLIs where relevant.

  • You've shared knowledge through documentation, code reviews, and mentoring, so the team's frontend capability grows with you.

Current tech stack

We're fully cloud-native on AWS, with a lean, API-first product development approach.

Frontend: Angular · Lit HTML · Headless Wagtail · WordPress

Backend: Python · FastAPI · Pydantic · SQLAlchemy · MySQL · Neo4j

Platform: AWS · Kubernetes · Terraform · Docker · GitHub Actions · ruff · UV · pre-commit · Renovate

Our platform runs on Kubernetes-managed services and Terraform for infrastructure as code. We continue expanding capabilities in knowledge graphs (Neo4j) and modern data access patterns.

What we offer:

  • Impactful work that helps patients gain access to potentially lifesaving treatments. 

  • International work environment, scale-up energy and a flat organizational structure that encourages creativity and accountability. 

  • Competitive salary, annual performance bonus and an Employee Stock Option Plan. 

  • Great career development opportunities in a fast-growing company.  

  • Learning and development budget alongside internal knowledge sharing sessions. 

  • Attractive pension plan, full premium covered by myTomorrows. 

  • Hybrid working model. 

  • Policies to support working parents. 

  • Healthy lunch at the thriving Amsterdam office.  

  • Unlimited access to professional guidance by certified psychologists via OpenUp  

  • Enjoy monthly events hosted by our vibrant Culture Club as well as an annual ‘myTomorrowland’ company-wide celebration! 

Equal opportunities

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

title: Engineering Manager, Billing & Monetization
description:
About the role

Every customer's path through DataSnipper, from first sign-up to first agent run to renewal, runs on systems your team owns. We are hiring an Engineering Manager in our Amsterdam office to lead Billing & Monetization: how customers get in, what they are entitled to, and how AI usage turns into revenue.

Why DataSnipper?

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empowers those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.


For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output must be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand-new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

The Scope

  • Onboarding & offboarding: sign-up, trials, tenant and workspace provisioning, and the first-run experience. Getting a new firm from contract to value, fast.

  • Licensing & entitlements: seats, plans, feature access and limits across the Excel add-in and Alwin, for self-serve users and global enterprise contracts alike.

  • Metering & billing: real-time usage and credit consumption for our agentic products, through to invoicing, payments and revenue reporting.

What You Will Do

  • Lead through outcomes, not tasks. Set clear goals and trust the team to find the how.

  • Make the team measurably better. Raise the bar, grow engineers into bigger problems, and address performance directly.

  • Own the technical direction of the full customer lifecycle platform, and stay close enough to the code to make the hard calls credibly.

  • Treat onboarding as a product. Measure activation and time-to-value, and remove friction with Product and Design.

  • Continuously improve on the admin experience to delight and empower our internal users.

  • Turn commercial strategy into software. Partner with Product, Finance, Sales and Customer Success to shape pricing, packaging and licensing models.

  • Set the bar for AI-assisted engineering. Not just shipping faster, but taking on harder problems, and shaping how DataSnipper engineering uses AI.

  • Grow the scope. Expand ownership and stand up new teams as the area grows.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years leading engineering teams, on top of 5+ years as a software engineer

  • An empowerment style of leadership and a track record of building high-performing teams

  • Experience building billing, licensing, entitlement or onboarding systems at scale, ideally usage- or credit-based

  • Strong fundamentals in software architecture, distributed systems, APIs and cloud-native development

  • Experience running production systems where financial correctness matters

  • Strong product aptitude: you challenge framing, make roadmap trade-offs, and care about activation and conversion as much as uptime

Mission of this role

Getting equipment to and from an event, on time and in one piece, is one of the most critical things our customers do, and one of the hardest. Heavy, specialised, often fragile gear. Fixed vehicle and crew capacity. Round trips rather than one-way drops. Our customers solve this every week, mostly with spreadsheets, phone calls and hard-won instinct.

Transport is a priority on our roadmap, and we're bringing in dedicated ownership to make sure we deliver on it: how customers plan loads, sequence stops and optimise routes across their fleet. This role owns that outcome from the ground up. You'll start by getting close to customers to find the first slice of the problem they'll genuinely want to have solved, ship it, and build the roadmap from there.

Which features ship is yours to decide. You'll be shaping the domain and its roadmap, with the freedom to define how the product takes form. That's a rare amount of ownership for a PM, building something new from first principles, with real trust in how you get there.

What you'll do

  • Own Transport end to end: Running the full release train for your value stream: discovery, scoping, design, development, launch and post-launch tracking.

  • Run customer discovery yourself, in the field: Talk to rental companies about how they plan, staff and execute transport today: warehouse-to-venue routing, multi-stop and multi-vehicle loads, load order, crew and vehicle capacity, and the constraints that make equipment transport harder than generic delivery routing.

  • Define the first sellable increment. Find the smallest thing customers will genuinely pay for, ship it, and be able to explain why that slice was the right first bet.

  • Build and own a sequenced, evidence-based roadmap with the Head of Product, aligned to company goals and product strategy. And explain the prioritisation to sales, support and management so they can plan against it.

  • Translate routing and logistics complexity into buildable scope: multi-stop optimisation, time windows, vehicle and crew capacity, mapping and routing APIs, and the build-vs-buy decisions that come with them.

  • Define success before you build it: Every feature carries a business goal, product briefs stay current, a live dashboard goes up at launch, and you drive go-to-market together with Product Marketing, Support, Sales and Content & Community.

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years as a Product Manager in B2B SaaS.

  • You've owned a product area end to end. From discovery through launch and post-launch tracking, not a backlog-only PO role.

  • You're comfortable with operationally complex problems: routing, scheduling, fleet or capacity planning, supply chain, field service. A logistics background is a plus, not a must.

  • You work from data. You can show how you set a success metric, what you did when it was missed, and how you make the business case behind a product call.

  • You've run customer discovery yourself, not through a research team, and you can make and defend scope calls on partial evidence.

Nice to haves

  • Product experience in route optimisation, fleet management, field service or supply chain / TMS, or hands-on experience with mapping and routing APIs and platforms (Google Maps Platform, HERE, Mapbox, route-optimisation engines).

title: Network Engineer
description:
About the role

Help build the networks connecting SkyNRG’s offices and future production sites!

As we scale Sustainable Aviation Fuel production, secure and reliable connectivity between our IT and operational environments becomes increasingly critical. We are looking for a Network Engineer (IT/OT) to design, build, and operate the network architecture supporting our Amsterdam headquarters, first production facility, and future sites.

This is a hands-on role with real influence over how our network landscape develops, from routing, switching and Wi-Fi to firewalls, IT/OT segmentation, and secure remote access.

Reporting to the IT Operations & Infrastructure Manager, the role works closely with IT, security, plant engineering, and automation partners.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and operate IT and OT network infrastructure at headquarters and production sites, from Purdue Level 3 upward and at the boundary with plant control systems

  • Manage and optimize our Fortinet (IT) and Palo Alto (OT) firewall environments, including rule sets, segmentation, and the industrial DMZ

  • Operate Cisco Catalyst switching and Meraki wireless at our production sites, alongside the office network at headquarters

  • Implement and maintain secure remote access for employees and vendors, including zero trust access

  • Deploy and operate Nozomi Networks for OT asset visibility and threat detection, and integrate network and OT logs into our SIEM (Microsoft Sentinel)

  • Support incident response together with our security team and managed SOC provider, and contribute to NIS2 compliance activities

This is an opportunity to build an IT/OT network from the ground up rather than maintain a legacy landscape. You will work with a modern technology stack, have real influence over architecture decisions, and see the direct impact of your work on our operational reliability and cybersecurity maturity.

The position is based at our headquarters in Amsterdam. Expect regular travel to the production site during construction and commissioning, becoming occasional once the site is in operation.

Your profile

As a growing company in a rapidly evolving industry, we are looking for people who embrace change and are motivated to actively contribute to building and scaling our business. You are someone who feels comfortable in an entrepreneurial environment, takes ownership, and thrives when things are still developing.

  • Experience integrating network and OT logs into a SIEM, preferably Microsoft Sentinel
