title: Reliability & Maintenance Engineer | DSL-01
description:
Please note: For this role proficiency in both Dutch and English is required.


Reliability & Maintenance Engineer | DSL-01

As Reliability & Maintenance Engineer DSL-01, you are responsible for building and continuously improving the facility's maintenance, reliability, and asset integrity framework. Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you help ensure the plant operates safely, reliably, and efficiently.

The role starts with a strong Maintenance Engineering focus. Your priority will be to help establish the maintenance and reliability foundation of DSL-01 by answering a fundamental question: "how do we maintain our assets safely, reliably, and efficiently throughout their lifecycle?"

You will translate reliability studies, equipment criticality assessments, and integrity requirements into practical maintenance plans, inspection programmes, spare parts strategies, and asset management processes.

As the facility moves into stable operations, the focus gradually shifts towards Reliability Engineering, where you will use asset health monitoring, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement to prevent failures and improve long-term asset performance.

Working closely with operations, maintenance, engineering, and external specialists, you will help reduce technical risk and improve asset reliability from day one.

You will:

  • Develop and continuously improve maintenance, inspection, and asset integrity strategies

  • Translate reliability studies, FMECA analyses, and engineering data into practical maintenance plans within the CMMS/EAM system

  • Act as owner of the asset register from a maintenance, reliability, and integrity perspective

  • Support the implementation and continuous development of the facility's CMMS/EAM system

  • Drive reliability improvements through asset health monitoring, KPI analysis, and predictive maintenance techniques

  • Lead Root Cause Analyses (RCA) and implement sustainable corrective actions

  • Monitor and improve reliability performance indicators such as MTBF, MTTR, availability, and inspection compliance

  • Support asset improvement, modification, and long-term replacement strategies throughout the asset lifecycle

Your profile

As a growing company in a rapidly evolving industry, we are looking for people who embrace change and are motivated to actively contribute to building and scaling our business. You are someone who feels comfortable in an entrepreneurial environment, takes ownership, and enjoys turning complex technical challenges into practical solutions.

You recognize yourself in the following:

Must have

  • Fluent in Dutch and English

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant engineering discipline (i.e. electrical or mechanical)

  • 5+ years of experience in Reliability Engineering, Maintenance Engineering, Asset Integrity, or Asset Management

  • Experience with RCM, FMEA/FMECA, RCA, and maintenance strategy development

  • Experience with CMMS/EAM systems such as SAP PM, Maximo, or IFS

Preferred

  • Experience in chemical, petrochemical, energy, or other process industries like food or FMCG

  • Experience with CMMS/EAM implementation or optimisation

  • Experience with predictive maintenance and condition monitoring

  • Knowledge of ATEX, PED, and asset integrity management

About DSL-01

DSL-01 is SkyNRG’s frontrunning renewable fuels facility in Delfzijl, Netherlands. The plant will produce Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) from residual fats and greases using the HEFA (Hydrotreated Esters and Fatty Acids) pathway, with additional renewable products like butane, propane, and naphtha as by-products.

DSL-01 is the first facility in Europe dedicated entirely to SAF and its by-products. Once operational, it will produce 100,000 tonnes of SAF and 35,000 tonnes of sustainable by-products per year, cutting greenhouse gas emissions by around 80% compared to conventional jet fuel.

Construction started in 2026, with first fuel expected in 2028. The project includes the main facility, pipelines, and temporary work areas. At DSL-01, you will be part of a team building a state-of-the-art industrial plant from the ground up, contributing to a truly sustainable energy future.

Environmental and social responsibility are at the heart of DSL-01. We follow international frameworks and Dutch regulations to manage impacts on people, nature, and local communities. Safety, sustainability, and collaboration guide everything we do.

 

What we offer

As DSL-01 is still being built, many aspects of the plant, roles, and benefits are still being shaped. Our HR team is actively defining the full compensation and benefits package specifically for the Delfzijl facility. You can be assured that the final offer will be highly competitive and designed to reward your expertise, contribution, and impact as we bring this pioneering SAF plant to life.

We are committed to offering an attractive total package to ensure we attract the best talent in the market. This includes a competitive salary, performance-based incentives, and a range of benefits that support your personal and professional growth.

 

Is this you?

At DSL-01, you will work in a dynamic, innovative environment where technical curiosity, problem-solving, and teamwork are valued. You will engage with operators, engineers, and managers across disciplines, helping to bring a pioneering renewable fuels facility to life while making a real impact on the planet.

Are you ready to help build a plant from the ground up? Join a pioneering force in sustainable aviation and help create a cleaner, more sustainable future.

title: Supply Chain Planner | DSL-01
description:
Supply Chain Planner | DSL-01

Werk mee aan een van de eerste grootschalige SAF-fabrieken in Europa. Je draagt bij aan de bouw van DSL-01 in Delfzijl: een fabriek gericht op de productie van Sustainable Aviation Fuel en bijproducten.

Je wordt onderdeel van een ervaren team waarin jouw expertise direct bijdraagt aan een veilige en succesvolle realisatie van het project.

 

Over de functie

Als Supply Chain Planner krijg je de kans om vanaf de basis mee te bouwen aan de supply chain van DSL-01. Jouw werk helpt de basis te leggen voor een betrouwbare operatie van een van Europa's eerste grootschalige productiefaciliteiten voor Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF).

Je stapt op een uniek moment in een groeiende organisatie.

Voor de start van de fabriek:

  • Help je mee de supply chain-organisatie van DSL-01 op te bouwen, inclusief de processen, systemen en werkwijzen die nodig zijn voor operational readiness.

  • Draag je bij aan de inrichting van ERP-systemen, supply chain-processen en de voorbereiding van een veilige, betrouwbare en efficiënte operatie.

Na de start van de fabriek:

  • Speel je een belangrijke rol in de dagelijkse supply chain-operatie, van grondstoffen- en productieplanning tot afstemming met leveranciers en afnemers.

  • Zorg je samen met interne en externe stakeholders voor een stabiele supply chain die een veilige en continue productie ondersteunt.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van productie-, supply- en offtakeplanningen voor de korte, middellange en lange termijn.

  • Vertalen van productiebehoeften naar materiaalvereisten en afstemmen van beschikbaarheid met leveranciers, Procurement en sourcing-teams.

  • Coördineren van planning tussen Production, Engineering, Maintenance, Procurement en commerciële stakeholders.

  • Signaleren van risico's, verstoringen en capaciteitsbeperkingen en ontwikkelen van passende scenario's en oplossingen.

  • Leveren van analyses en inzichten ter ondersteuning van het Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP)-proces.

  • Actief bijdragen aan de inrichting, validatie en optimalisatie van ERP-systemen en supply chain-processen.

  • Ondersteunen van processen rondom traceability, certificering en mass balancing.

  • Initiëren en leiden van verbeteringen op het gebied van planning, systemen en werkwijzen.

  • Fungeren als inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor complexe planningsvraagstukken tijdens operational readiness en de opstart van de fabriek.

Deze rol biedt een unieke combinatie van operationele verantwoordelijkheid en de kans om een nieuwe supply chain-organisatie mee vorm te geven.

 

Jouw profiel

Je bent analytisch sterk, neemt eigenaarschap en voelt je comfortabel in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt. Je bent in staat verschillende belangen bij elkaar te brengen en durft beslissingen te nemen wanneer informatie beperkt of onvolledig is.

Wat breng je mee?

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau.

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Supply Planner, Production Planner, Material Planner of in een vergelijkbare rol binnen een productieomgeving.

  • Een sterk begrip van supply chain-processen en ERP-systemen.

  • Uitstekende analytische vaardigheden en het vermogen om inzichten te vertalen naar acties en besluitvorming.

  • Een proactieve, resultaatgerichte houding en een sterk gevoel van eigenaarschap.

  • Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement in een complexe operationele omgeving.

  • Het vermogen om prioriteiten te stellen en beslissingen te nemen onder onzekerheid.

  • Goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels.

Additionele vaardigheden/ervaring

  • Ervaring binnen de proces- en maakindustrie.

  • Ervaring met ERP-implementaties, systeeminrichting of user acceptance testing.

  • Ervaring met het opstarten van nieuwe productielocaties of operationele organisaties.

  • Kennis van traceability, certificering, mass balancing, dangerous goods of waste management.

Over DSL-01

In Delfzijl bouwen we aan DSL-01, een fabriek van SkyNRG voor hernieuwbare brandstoffen. Hier produceren we Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) uit reststromen zoals gebruikte vetten en oliën, met HEFA-technologie. Daarnaast maken we bijproducten zoals butaan, propaan en nafta.

DSL-01 wordt de eerste fabriek in Europa die volledig gericht is op SAF en bijbehorende duurzame bijproducten. Als de fabriek in bedrijf is, produceren we jaarlijks 100.000 ton SAF en 35.000 ton bijproducten. Daarmee verminderen we de uitstoot van broeikasgassen met circa 80% ten opzichte van fossiele kerosine, gemeten over de hele keten.

De bouw is gestart in 2026 en de eerste productie staat gepland voor 2028. Het project omvat de fabriek zelf, bijbehorende leidingen en tijdelijke werkterreinen. Je draagt direct bij aan de realisatie van een nieuwe industriële fabriek en de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart.

description:
Are you an experienced System Architect with a passion for intelligent building management systems, industrial automation, and safety-critical applications? At Deerns, you will have the opportunity to work on innovative and challenging projects that contribute to a smarter, safer, and more sustainable future. Read on and discover how you can make an impact.

The challenge 

The System Architect for Intelligent Building Management Solutions and Industrial Automation plays a crucial role in designing integrated automation solutions for both buildings and industrial processes. This position involves developing safe, efficient, and future-ready systems that connect various installations, such as HVAC, lighting, access control, gas safety, and industrial process control. You will work closely with project teams, suppliers, and end-users to create innovative and sustainable solutions that meet the highest safety standards.

Your responsibilities include: 

  • Developing automation architectures: Design scalable solutions for intelligent building management and process automation, including gas detection systems, safety mechanisms, and process control.

  • System integration: Connect installations using protocols like BACnet, Modbus, KNX, and industrial standards such as OPC UA and PROFIBUS.

  • Gas safety and process safety: Develop solutions for gas detection, emergency shutdowns, ventilation integration, and fail-safe control systems for industrial environments.

  • Specification and standards management: Implement relevant standards for intelligent building management solutions, process automation, and safety systems, such as IEC 61511 (functional safety) and ATEX regulations.

  • Process optimization: Analyze and optimize industrial processes and systems to enhance efficiency, safety, and sustainability.

  • Stakeholder management: Collaborate effectively with various stakeholders, including clients, end-users, engineers, and project managers, ensuring solutions meet both functional and technical requirements.

  • Continuous learning and development: Stay updated on the latest innovations in smart technologies and automation, applying these to develop improved, future-proof solutions. • Technological consulting: Identify innovations to enhance performance and reliability in intelligent buildings and industrial environments.

  • Documentation and communication: Prepare technical documentation and communicate effectively with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders.

Required Skills and Competencies:

  • Extensive knowledge of intelligent building management solutions, gas safety systems, and industrial process control.

  • Expertise in communication standards and protocols such as KNX, BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA, and PROFIBUS.

  • Proficiency in designing fail-safe systems and safety-critical applications.

  • Experience with IT networks and cybersecurity in automation environments.

  • Strong analytical skills and problem-solving abilities.

  • Flexibility and the ability to continuously adapt to technological advancements.

  • Excellent communication skills to clearly present complex technical issues

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation Technology, or a related field.

  • Relevant experience in intelligent building management solutions, industrial automation, and safety-critical systems. This role combines technological innovation with safety-critical applications. As a System Architect, you will develop integrated solutions that maximize comfort, safety, efficiency, and sustainability in both buildings and industrial processes.

We offer 

  • A position of 32-40 hours per week with a salary to match. 

  • Challenging projects for leading clients in the Netherlands and internationally. 

  • A work environment in which innovation and sustainability are put into practice daily. 

  • Attention to your own development and vitality with ample training and development opportunities, bicycle and sports arrangements, flexible working hours, 33 vacation days and the possibility of purchasing additional days. 

  • Hybrid working, where you have the opportunity to alternate between working from home and the office. 

  • A team where cooperation and collegiality are priority, and where we interact informally. 

  • Sustainability is in our genes. This is expressed, for example, in a mobility policy where health and sustainability are most important. Many of our offices are located near public transport hubs, cycling is encouraged, and your travel expenses are reimbursed 100% on the basis of public transport. 

 

About Deerns 
As an independent engineering firm, Deerns specializes in consultancy, design and implementation supervision in the fields of installation engineering, building physics, energy supply and sustainability. Our areas of expertise contribute to sustainable, intelligent and future-proof buildings that optimally support our clients' processes. We are responsible for designing the installations and realizing good comfort and a pleasant climate in a wide variety of buildings; from offices, to airports and from hospitals to data centers. 
 

In addition, Deerns has been named a World Class Workplace for 2026!

title: Hoofdmonteur Warmtepompen
description:

We groeien hard. Tot nu toe worden al onze warmtepompen geïnstalleerd door externe partners, maar daar komt verandering in. We gaan onze eigen installatieteams opbouwen en zoeken daarom een Hoofdmonteur Warmtepompen die hierin het voortouw neemt.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Hoofdmonteur ben je verantwoordelijk voor de installatie van onze warmtepompen bij klanten thuis. Je begint met het leiden van ons eerste interne installatieteam en helpt ons om de komende jaren onze eigen installatiecapaciteit verder uit te bouwen.

  • Je stemt waar nodig af met onze werkvoorbereiders en collega's op kantoor over planning, materialen en technische uitdagingen.

Je bouwt mee aan ons interne installatieteam

  • Je begeleidt en traint nieuwe monteurs en helpt hen om zelfstandig installaties uit te kunnen voeren.

  • Je denkt mee over het aannemen van nieuwe collega's en hoe we ons installatieteam verder kunnen uitbreiden.

  • Je helpt onze installatiestandaarden en werkwijzen verder te ontwikkelen.

  • Je signaleert wat er in de praktijk beter of slimmer kan en neemt initiatief om dit te verbeteren.

  • Je deelt feedback vanuit het veld met onze engineers, werkvoorbereiders en productontwikkelaars, zodat we onze producten en installaties continu kunnen verbeteren.

Wie zoeken wij?

We zoeken iemand die zijn vak goed verstaat, verantwoordelijkheid neemt en het leuk vindt om anderen beter te maken. Je hoeft niet eerder een heel team te hebben opgebouwd, maar je moet wel zin hebben om die uitdaging aan te gaan.

  • Je hebt ruime ervaring met het installeren van warmtepompen, cv-installaties of andere verwarmingssystemen. Ervaring met warmtepompen heeft een sterke voorkeur.

  • Je hebt een goede technische basis in installatietechniek, elektrotechniek en/of werktuigbouwkunde.

  • Je kunt zelfstandig installaties uitvoeren, technische tekeningen lezen en onverwachte problemen oplossen.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het begeleiden van andere monteurs, of bent klaar om die verantwoordelijkheid op je te nemen.

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en veilig en vindt het belangrijk om goed werk af te leveren.

  • Je communiceert makkelijk met klanten en collega's en kunt technische zaken begrijpelijk uitleggen.

  • Je neemt initiatief, denkt in oplossingen en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor het eindresultaat.

  • Je spreekt goed Nederlands en hebt rijbewijs B.

Een relevante mbo-opleiding en certificeringen zoals VCA, NEN 3140 of CO-vakmanschap zijn mooi meegenomen. Heb je nog niet alle benodigde certificaten? Dan kijken we samen wat je nog kunt behalen.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een salaris van €4.000 tot €6.000 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van je ervaring.

  • Een sleutelrol in ons bedrijf: je wordt de eerste Hoofdmonteur van ons interne installatieteam en helpt dit verder uit te bouwen.

  • Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid: je krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken over hoe we installeren, samenwerken en nieuwe monteurs opleiden.

  • Goed materiaal: een volledig uitgeruste werkbus en professioneel gereedschap.

  • 26 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen op basis van 40 uur, met de mogelijkheid om te kiezen voor een hogere beloning in plaats van ADV.

  • Een goede pensioenregeling volgens de cao Metaal & Techniek.

  • Mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen, zowel technisch als in het begeleiden en aansturen van een team.

  • Een betrokken team met korte lijnen, weinig bureaucratie en regelmatig leuke activiteiten, van borrels en teamuitjes tot onze jaarlijkse wintersport.

Waarom DeWarmte?

Bij DeWarmte geloven we dat verduurzaming pas echt werkt als het voor iedereen bereikbaar en aantrekkelijk is. Daarom ontwikkelen we slimme, betaalbare warmtepompen die we zelf ontwerpen en assembleren.

We zijn een groeiend bedrijf waar veel gebeurt en waar je echt invloed hebt op hoe we dingen aanpakken. We houden van mensen die initiatief nemen, samenwerken en niet wachten tot iemand anders een probleem oplost.

Als Hoofdmonteur krijg je de kans om vanaf het begin mee te bouwen aan onze eigen installatieorganisatie. Je werkt zelf aan mooie technische installaties, leidt nieuwe monteurs op en helpt bepalen hoe we dit in de toekomst op grotere schaal gaan doen.

Klaar om samen met ons iets op te bouwen?

Solliciteer en kom kennismaken. We vertellen je graag meer over DeWarmte, onze warmtepompen en onze plannen voor het interne installatieteam.

title: PLC Software Engineer - The Netherlands
description:
Ready to build the software behind real-world renewable energy installations?

At Bright Renewables, your PLC software doesn’t stay behind a desk. You’ll see it come to life in complex industrial installations for renewable gas and CO₂ technologies.

As a PLC Software Engineer, you’ll be involved in the complete automation lifecycle - from software design and programming to testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimization.

You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to technical decisions, help shape our automation standards, and work alongside experienced colleagues as part of an international software engineering team of around 10 engineers. Together, you’ll collaborate across the Netherlands, Latvia, and Poland to develop and deliver reliable, innovative automation solutions.


Why this role?

You’ll get the opportunity to:

  • Own your solutions - contribute to software solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from design and programming to testing and commissioning;

  • Work on real installations - solve automation challenges in complex renewable energy plants;

  • Have technical influence - contribute to software standards, templates, concepts, and ways of working, within a team that values collaboration and embraces innovative ideas from everyone;

  • Choose what works for you - work 32 or 40 hours per week, with flexible starting times and opportunities to work from home;

  • Make an impact - use your automation expertise in technologies that contribute directly to the energy transition.

What will you do?

As a PLC Software Engineer, you design, develop, test, and commission PLC and SCADA control systems for technologies such as gas upgrading and CO₂ liquefaction.

You report directly to the Manager E&I and Software and work closely with Electrical Engineers, Process Engineers and fellow Software Engineers.

Depending on your experience, you’ll also have the opportunity to take more technical ownership, contribute to software concepts and standards, and support colleagues with complex automation challenges.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Designing, programming, testing, and commissioning PLC and SCADA systems;

  • Developing control software for gas upgrading, CO₂ liquefaction, and other renewable energy technologies;

  • Taking ownership of your software from engineering through commissioning;

  • Testing and troubleshooting software during commissioning and operation;

  • Analyzing and resolving software and control-related issues in existing installations;

  • Implementing software updates and optimizations;

  • Supporting Service Engineers with more complex automation and software questions;

  • Contributing to software standards, templates, and automation concepts;

  • Working closely with Electrical Engineers, Software Engineers, and other technical disciplines;

  • Sharing knowledge and supporting colleagues within the engineering team.


What do you bring?

We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving technical challenges and wants to take responsibility for their own engineering work.

Ideally, you have:

  • A completed technical education in automation, mechatronics, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related field;

  • Several years of experience in PLC/SCADA engineering within an industrial environment;

  • Hands-on experience in PLC programming, ideally with Siemens S7 and TIA Portal, combined with knowledge of WinCC SCADA, industrial communication networks, and remote access solutions.

  • Experience with commissioning and troubleshooting industrial installations;

  • A good understanding of automation architectures and industrial control systems;

  • Good command of English, both spoken and written;

  • Knowledge of OT security is a plus.

What’s in it for you?

We want to give you the technical freedom and working environment to do your best engineering work.

You can expect:

  • A competitive salary based on your experience and technical background;

  • The option to work 32 or 40 hours per week;

  • An excellent pension scheme;

  • A commuting allowance of €0.23 per kilometer, in accordance with our employment conditions;

  • A high level of autonomy and responsibility;

  • Plenty of opportunities for technical and professional development;

  • An international engineering environment with both experienced professionals and engineers earlier in their careers;

  • The opportunity to work with renewable energy technologies and contribute directly to the energy transition;

  • A bike lease program and rewards for cycling to work;

  • A modern, sustainably built working environment in Hengelo.

About Bright Renewables

Bright Renewables develops and delivers technologies for renewable gas and CO₂ capture, providing solutions from engineering and realization through to service and maintenance. Our installations convert biogas into renewable natural gas and capture, purify, and liquefy CO₂ for industrial reuse.

We are part of HoSt Group, a family-owned Dutch company operating internationally in renewable energy technology.

For you, that means working on international projects with the opportunities of a global organization, while keeping the short communication lines, technical freedom, and personal approach of a family-owned company.

Interested?

Apply by submitting your CV and motivation through the application button. Within 14 days, we’ll let you know whether we’d like to invite you for an interview.

Would you first like to know more about the technology, team, or day-to-day work?

Contact Wybren Broersma, Manager E&I and Software, or Natalia Wisniewska, Corporate Recruiter, at +31 88 460 90 80.

Build software. See it running. Make an impact on renewable energy.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Who are we?

Gain is the Private Markets Super App, a connected global platform transforming how leading investors, advisors, and corporates source, evaluate, and execute deals. By combining investment-grade intelligence, AI-powered workflows, and proprietary data in one unified platform, Gain enables top deal teams to move faster, reduce risk, and build conviction with confidence.

Gain is trusted across more than $1 trillion of private capital, used by 100% of MBB and Big Four firms, and by 80% of the world’s top 20 M&A advisory houses.

Recognized for fast innovation and impact, Gain has been named both US and EU Data Provider of the Year by PE Wire, awarded Global Financial Market Review’s Best Use of AI in Finance, and ranked in Sifted’s Top 100 Fastest-Growing Companies, the Forbes 1000, and the Deloitte Technology Fast 50. Gain operates globally with offices in New York, London, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Warsaw, and Bangalore.


How we work

  • Predicting what isn't published. Many private companies publish little or no financial detail. Across a database of more than 5 million companies, we predict revenue and EBITDA from sparse labels, and we predict whether and when a company will be bought or sold, which is a time-to-event problem with censored data.

  • Agents on a messy web. Our agents search, navigate and extract company data points from sources that contradict each other, then decide which source to trust before committing to an answer.

  • Quality that holds while everything underneath moves. We're provider-agnostic. Model choices follow the evals, and we switch LLMs when the numbers say so. That only works if the evals are trusted.

What will you do?

The work is roughly half LLM agents and half custom ML, leaning slightly toward agents.

  • The design of our agent pipelines: architecture, tools, and which model for which task. You'll shape the technical direction with our AI Lead.

  • The evaluation behind agents and models: offline reference sets, live production evals, and the call on whether an improvement is real.

  • Our prediction models for financials and deals: features, validation, retraining, and knowing when a simpler model wins.

  • Getting work into production: trace where pipelines fail and fix the weakest links first, with compute, memory and model cost in view.

  • Raising the bar in the team through design reviews, pairing, and an eval-first habit that sticks.

In your first six months you'll own the evals for our agent pipelines, propose where we invest next, and ship measurable improvements to both the agents and the prediction models.

Who are you?

  • You've built and owned ML systems in production for years, typically 6+ in ML or software engineering.

  • In the last 1–2 years you've shipped LLM agents or pipelines that real users depend on, not demos.

  • You have modelling judgement. You've dealt with leakage, distribution shift and calibration on real data.

  • You measure before you claim. You can build an evaluation set and tell an honest improvement from a lucky one.

  • You care about the user outcome more than the technique. Ideas without a clear customer benefit don't get built here, however interesting.

  • Nice to have: time-to-event modelling, noisy or conflicting data sources, financial or private-company data. No finance background needed.

The team

You'll join our Data & AI team of six and report to Renan, our AI Lead who's been building production models for >10 years. Our engineering team runs the infrastructure, and you shape what runs on it.

The stack

  • Core: Python (async, fully typed with Pydantic) and FastAPI

  • LLMs: multiple providers behind our own provider-agnostic layer, with Pydantic AI for typed agents.

  • Evals and observability: Pydantic Evals and Logfire

  • Data: PostgreSQL with pgvector

  • Cloud: GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud Tasks), Docker, GitHub Actions

What do we offer?

  • Competitive base salary and annual bonus linked to your performance / OKRs

  • Attractive benefits including health & wellbeing allowance, work-from-home budget, learning & coaching benefits, etc. 

  • Flexible hybrid working model with 3 days per week in our Amsterdam office 

  • Healthy work-life balance allowing for planability and personal commitments 

  • Chance to grow with the company gaining increasing responsibilities, supported by lots of coaching and a feedback-driven approach 

  • Tremendous learning and career progression opportunities 

  • International environment with hubs in New York, London, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Warsaw, and Bangalore

  • Culture of trust, ownership and standard of excellence and a fun working atmosphere with regular outings and events 

  • Post product-market fit and aspiring unicorn status - this is an excellent time to join & grow with us!

Does this sound like a perfect match?

We are proud of our wonderful product and believe it has lots of potential. We are growing fast and having fun while building our platform and company. Does this sound like a team you would like to become a part of? Click ‘Apply’ and submit your CV, we are excited to get to know you and show you what we do!

Wat ga je doen

title: Senior Uitvoerder kabels & leidingen Railinfra
description:
Ambitie          
Jij zorgt dat het buiten gebeurt. Veilig, volgens afspraak en met een team dat weet wat het moet doen.

Als senior uitvoerder kabels & leidingen werk je aan ondergrondse infra rond het spoor en op stations door heel Nederland. Ook als de planning verandert of de situatie buiten anders blijkt dan gedacht. Je krijgt daarbij te maken met onder andere telecom, data, elektriciteitsleidingen en glasvezel. Werk waarbij veiligheid, goede afstemming en de juiste beslissing op het juiste moment het verschil maken.

Dit ga je doen 
Jij zorgt dat het buiten gebeurt. Veilig, volgens afspraak en met een team dat weet wat het moet doen. Als uitvoerder 3 kabels & leidingen stuur je medewerkers, specialisten en onderaannemers aan en houd je grip op planning, kwaliteit en kosten.

Je werkt aan ondergrondse infra binnen onze railprojecten, zoals telecom, data, elektriciteitsleidingen en glasvezel. Je stuurt één of meerdere projecten tegelijk aan en houdt het overzicht, ook als het anders loopt dan gepland. Je gaat:

  • je team aansturen en motiveren, met duidelijke afspraken en ruimte voor vakmanschap;

  • veiligheid vooropzetten en collega's stimuleren risico’s en verbeteringen te delen;

  • plannen en bijsturen, prioriteiten stellen en knopen doorhakken als dat nodig is;

  • kwaliteit en kosten bewaken, inclusief het meer- en minderwerk;

  • schakelen met betrokken partijen, van je team en collega's tot ProRail, OV-bedrijven en netbeheerders;

  • verbeteringen aanjagen door kritisch te kijken, te luisteren en goede ideeën om te zetten in actie.

Je hoeft niet overal zelf naast te staan. Maar als het erop aankomt, weet jij wat er buiten speelt, ben je er en neem je een besluit.


Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en langetermijnvisievormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.

Dit verwachten wij van jou
Je bent een ervaren uitvoerder die overzicht houdt en duidelijk communiceert. Je weet wanneer je ruimte kunt geven en wanneer jij degene bent die een beslissing moet nemen. Voor deze rol breng je mee:

  • relevante ervaring met het voorbereiden en uitvoeren van ondergrondse infraprojecten;

  • ervaring met het aansturen van medewerkers, specialisten en onderaannemers;

  • een technische basis, bijvoorbeeld vanuit civiele techniek, elektrotechniek of werktuigbouwkunde;

  • een scherpe blik op veiligheid, kwaliteit, planning en kosten;

  • het vermogen om rustig te blijven, prioriteiten te stellen en beslissingen te nemen;

  • de communicatieve kracht om verschillende partijen bij elkaar te brengen;

  • bereidheid om te werken wanneer het spoorwerk daarom vraagt, ook buiten reguliere werktijden.

We verwachten niet dat je ieder probleem zelf oplost. Wel dat je ervoor zorgt dat problemen op tafel komen, de juiste mensen betrokken zijn en er uiteindelijk een besluit wordt genomen.

Waarom Dura Vermeer Railinfra?      
Hier krijg je de ruimte om je vak uit te oefenen én verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Je organiseert je werk met veel zelfstandigheid en krijgt mogelijkheden om jezelf via opleidingen verder te ontwikkelen.

En je werkt niet zomaar aan kabels en leidingen. Jouw werk is onderdeel van railprojecten waarin verschillende technische disciplines samenkomen. Dat vraagt om samenwerken, vooruitkijken en beslissingen nemen als het buiten anders loopt dan gepland.

Veilig werken staat daarbij voorop. In hoe je het werk organiseert, je team aanstuurt en de keuzes die je buiten maakt.


Wij hebben oog voor jou

Dura Vermeer is een grote organisatie waarin je veel kunt leren en waarin je kansen hebt om je ambities vorm te geven. Daarbij hechten we veel waarde aan opleiding, ontwikkeling en eigen initiatief.   • Voor verse vaders: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens je (aanvullende) geboorteverlof.

  • Een zeer goede beloning wanneer je de nachten of weekenden gaat werken

  • Veel aandacht voor jouw groei, met onze eigen Dura Vermeer academie en een vergoeding in tijd en geld voor zowel vak- als loopbaangerichte opleidingen.

description:
Dein Purpose

Wir betreiben unsere Hosting-Plattform auf eigener Hardware und bauen sie gerade grundlegend neu: Kubernetes auf Bare Metal, alle Ebenen vom Kernel bis zur Plattform in eigener Verantwortung. Du gibst deinem Team dabei die technische Richtung. Deine Urteilskraft kommt aus dem Betrieb, also aus echten Störungen und Kundenproblemen. Daraus entscheidest du im Team, bringst Vorhaben spürbar voran und lässt deine Kolleg*innen fachlich mitwachsen. Personalverantwortung hast du nicht, dafür umso mehr fachlichen Einfluss.

Deine Skills:

  • Du gehst fachlich voran, ohne disziplinarisch zu führen. Du machst Komplexität für Kolleg*innen auf jedem Level greifbar und nimmst sie auf dem Weg mit, durch Feedback, Wissenstransfer und ständiges Sparring.

  • Du beherrschst mindestens eine Ebene richtig tief, ob Kernel, Storage, Netzwerk oder Container-Runtime. Die übrigen verstehst du gut genug, um Wechselwirkungen zu erkennen. Du weißt, wie Kubernetes auf eigener Hardware läuft und was passiert, wenn es das nicht tut.

  • Du analysierst Störungen bis zur Ursache, erkennst Muster hinter wiederkehrenden Problemen und definierst sinnvolle Monitoring- und Alerting-Regeln.

  • Software-Engineering: Du baust Plattformkomponenten und Automatisierung selbst, idealerweise in Go, und kannst die Lösungen anderer fachlich bewerten.

Herausforderungen, mit denen wir uns gerade beschäftigen:

  • Multi-Tenant-Hosting unter echter Last: Tausende Kunden-Workloads teilen sich unsere physischen Server – präzise Ressourcensteuerung (cgroups, Namespaces), CPU-/Memory-Scheduling sowie Storage- und Netzwerk-Performance auf Systemebene gehören zum Alltag.

  • Automatisierter Node- und Cluster-Lifecycle: Vom Provisionieren der Hardware über Kernel- und Runtime-Updates (CRI-O, crun) bis zu unterbrechungsfreien Rollouts im laufenden Betrieb.

  • Eigene Operatoren und Plattform-Services: Statt gemanagte Cloud-Dienste zusammenzustecken, entwickeln wir unsere Kubernetes-Controller, APIs und die Integration in Storage und Netzwerk (CNI, BGP) selbst.

Das bieten wir dir:

Tiefgang statt Standard

Wir arbeiten mit zukunftsweisenden Technologien und bauen Systeme, wenn nötig, lieber selbst, statt auf Fertiglösungen zu setzen. Das bringt Herausforderungen und ein technisches Niveau, das nicht alltäglich ist und dich fachlich weiterbringt.

Expertise, die ihresgleichen sucht

Du diskutierst auf fachlich höchstem Niveau, teilst dein Wissen und lernst gemeinsam mit anderen Experten. Unsere Expertise geben wir nicht nur intern , sondern auch gerne auf Konferenzen, Camps und in der Tech-Community weiter und gestalten so die Zukunft der Branche mit.

Wir lieben Tech

Bei uns triffst du auf Menschen, die Tech genauso feiern wie du. Diese Leidenschaft leben wir im Alltag – und darüber hinaus. Ob Open-Source-Engagement, Community-Arbeit oder der Support von Tech-Events: Wir sind aktiv dabei und bringen uns ein.

Technologische Verantwortung

Deine Expertise zählt. Du prägst Entscheidungen und bleibst nicht beim Offensichtlichen stehen. Du bekommst den Raum, deine Ideen umzusetzen, Systeme mitzugestalten und Verantwortung zu übernehmen – auf Augenhöhe und mit Rückhalt.

Technik trifft Menschlichkeit

Bei uns findest du die coolsten Kolleg*innen, jede Menge Humor und echten Team-Spirit. Zusammenarbeit ist für uns ein fester Teil des Daily Business. Auch nach Feierabend gibt es jede Menge Möglichkeiten, ob Fußball, Padel oder D&D - wer Lust hat, ist dabei.

Rundum-sorglos-Setup

Bei uns soll´s dir richtig gut gehen. Freie Hardwarewahl? Check. Standardpaket an Benefits? Klar. Vitamine, Koffein & H2O? Safe. Und obendrauf: Unbefristeter Vertrag, Gleitzeit, 30 Urlaubstage, bAV , Schulungsangebote und ein faires Gehalt.



Deine Aufgaben:

  • Architekturentscheidungen triffst du gemeinsam mit unserer Systemarchitektur und ihr bindet euch bei allen Ideen, Projekten und Veränderungsprozessen gegenseitig frühzeitig ein

Täglich fahren Millionen Autos durch Deutschland, und in den meisten bleibt Platz ungenutzt. Wir ändern das.

MUVN ist ein digitaler Transportmarktplatz. Wir bringen Fahrer:innen mit freiem Laderaum mit Menschen und Unternehmen zusammen, die etwas transportieren müssen. Günstiger, versichert, ohne Umweg.

Wir bauen gerade an mehreren Dingen gleichzeitig: einem neuen Produkt für gewerbliche Versender, Piloten mit großen Marken, neuen Strecken, Integrationen. An jedem dieser Themen arbeiten mehrere Menschen aus mehreren Bereichen, und keiner von ihnen hat den vollen Überblick über alle anderen.

Genau dafür gibt es diese Stelle. Du weißt zu jeder Zeit, wo jedes Projekt steht, was als Nächstes ansteht und wo es gerade klemmt. Eine Frage zum aktuellen Sprint, und du kannst sie beantworten. Eine Frage zu einem Partnerprojekt, und du gehst auf die Leute zu und sorgst dafür, dass am Tag X alles steht.

Du bist kein Product Owner und musst nicht entwickeln können. Du musst verstehen, worum es geht, grob einschätzen können, was etwas bedeutet, und Dinge über die Ziellinie bringen.

Hierfür suchen wir dich ab dem 15.11.2026 als Verstärkung für unser Team in Köln 🚀

Aufgaben

  • Überblick über alle Projekte

Du führst die Timeline über Marktplatz, unser Produkt für gewerbliche Versender, Integrationen und Partnerprojekte. Status, nächster Meilenstein, offene Entscheidungen, Risiken. Alles an einem Ort, aktuell, und für jeden im Team in zwei Minuten auffindbar.

  • Themen aktiv vorantreiben

Du wartest nicht auf Statusmeldungen, du holst sie dir. Freundlich und hartnäckig, bis erledigt wirklich erledigt heißt.

  • Abhängigkeiten und Termine

Du erkennst früh, wo sich Themen gegenseitig blockieren, über Tech, Marketing, Operations und externe Partner hinweg. Und du eskalierst konkret: nicht "das wird knapp", sondern "wenn X bis Freitag nicht steht, verschiebt sich Y um zwei Wochen".

  • Launches und Piloten

Du planst und begleitest den Start neuer Produkte, Features und Partnerprojekte. Wer liefert was bis wann, was muss am Tag X stehen, was lernen wir danach. Und du baust Checklisten, die beim zweiten Mal besser funktionieren als beim ersten.

  • Schnittstelle zu Tech

Wir sind ein technisches Produkt, deshalb hängt vieles an unserem CTO. Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen ihm und den laufenden Projekten. Du verstehst genug vom Thema, um in einem Kunden- oder Partnergespräch grob einzuschätzen, was etwas bedeutet, und um die richtige Rückfrage zu stellen.

  • Ziele und Rhythmus

Du hältst den Takt: Zyklen, Check-ins, Reviews, sichtbarer Fortschritt. Die Ziele setzen die Gründer:innen und die Verantwortlichen. Dass sie nachgehalten werden, liegt bei dir.

  • Meetings und Entscheidungen

Für deine projektübergreifenden Runden bereitest du vor und nach: Agenda, Unterlagen, Ergebnisse, To-dos mit Verantwortlichem und Datum. Entscheidungen dokumentierst du so, dass sie zwei Wochen später nicht neu verhandelt werden.

  • Externe Partner

Agenturen, Pilotpartner, Dienstleister. Du steuerst die Zusammenarbeit: Lieferungen, Termine, Feedbackschleifen.

  • Prozesse und KI

Wiederkehrendes standardisierst du mit Vorlagen und Checklisten. Du arbeitest KI-first: Statusberichte, Protokolle, Recherche und Dokumentation baust du mit KI. Was dabei rauskommt, prüfst du. Die Richtigkeit gehört dir, nicht dem Tool.

Qualifikation

Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im Projekt- oder Programmmanagement, gerne in einem Startup, einer Agentur oder einem digitalen Produktumfeld. Du hast schon einmal ein Projekt mit mehreren Beteiligten und einem harten Termin über die Ziellinie gebracht, ohne selbst die fachliche Arbeit gemacht zu haben.

Du bist nah dran an digitalen Produkten. Tiefe Technikkenntnisse brauchst du nicht, aber du musst Sachzusammenhänge verstehen und grob einschätzen können, was ein Wunsch bedeutet, bevor du ihn zusagst.

description:
Jobbeschreibung

Warum gibt es diese Rolle - und warum jetzt?

Lovebetter wächst in eine neue Phase. Wir haben eine klare Mission, starke Inhalte, eine etablierte Marke und zahlreiche Möglichkeiten, noch mehr Männer zu erreichen und nachhaltig zu wachsen.

In den vergangenen Jahren haben wir unterschiedliche Marketingkanäle aufgebaut, Partnerschaften entwickelt und wertvolle Erfahrungen gesammelt. Jetzt wollen wir diese Aktivitäten noch besser miteinander verbinden, neue Wachstumschancen erschließen und unsere Ideen schneller in die Umsetzung bringen.

Dafür suchen wir dich.

Als Growth & Marketing Manager bist du eine zentrale operative Kraft in unserem Marketing. Du verbindest kreatives Denken mit analytischem Verständnis, entwickelst eigene Ideen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Konzepten konkrete Kampagnen, Tests und Ergebnisse werden.

Diese Rolle ist bewusst breiter als ein klassischer Marketingjob. Du wirst nicht nur einen einzelnen Kanal betreuen, sondern in ganz unterschiedlichen Bereichen mitarbeiten, eigenständig Verantwortung übernehmen und neue Themen vorantreiben.

Du musst dafür nicht alles bereits können. Entscheidend ist, dass du neugierig bist, schnell lernst, lösungsorientiert denkst und Lust hast, Dinge selbst in die Hand zu nehmen.

Wofür Lovebetter steht

Wir lösen sexuelle Probleme wie vorzeitigen Samenerguss oder Erektionsprobleme mit Männern und befähigen sie, ihre innere Stärke, sexuelle Zufriedenheit und Lebensqualität von innen heraus zu transformieren.

Unsere Arbeit wirkt weit über den Einzelnen hinaus: auf Partnerschaften, Familien und kommende Generationen.

Wir suchen jemanden, der unsere Mission mitgestalten möchte, Verantwortung übernimmt und versteht, dass wirkungsvolles Marketing Kreativität, analytisches Denken und konsequente Umsetzung verbindet.

Deine Mission als Growth & Marketing Manager

Du machst Lovebetters Marketing vielseitiger, effizienter und wachstumsstärker.

Du entwickelst Marketingideen, setzt Kampagnen um, betreust bestehende und neue Wachstumskanäle und erkennst anhand von Daten, was funktioniert und wo wir besser werden können.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem CMO, unseren Content-Produzenten, Agenturen und externen Partnern zusammen.

Du übernimmst eigenständig Projekte – von der ersten Idee über die operative Umsetzung bis zur anschließenden Auswertung. Dabei bewegst du dich selbstverständlich zwischen kreativen, analytischen und organisatorischen Aufgaben.

Besonders wichtig: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand für jede Herausforderung eine Lösung vorgibt. Du recherchierst, probierst aus, eignest dir neue Fähigkeiten an und findest Wege, Dinge umzusetzen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Marketingkampagnen entwickeln und umsetzen: Du planst und realisierst kanalübergreifende Marketingmaßnahmen, entwickelst kreative Ansätze und begleitest Kampagnen von der Idee bis zur Erfolgsauswertung.
  • Neue Wachstumskanäle erschließen: Du identifizierst neue Möglichkeiten, unsere Zielgruppe zu erreichen, recherchierst Potenziale, entwickelst erste Tests und hilfst dabei, erfolgreiche Ansätze systematisch auszubauen.
  • Ambassador Marketing und Kooperationen vorantreiben: Du entwickelst unser Ambassador-Programm weiter, recherchierst und gewinnst passende Partner, betreust Kooperationen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Beziehungen messbare Marketingmaßnahmen entstehen.
  • Content und Creatives mitgestalten: Du entwickelst Themen, Hooks, Texte und Kampagnenideen, erstellst Briefings und arbeitest mit unseren Content-Produzenten an Inhalten für unterschiedliche Plattformen und Marketingkanäle.
  • CRM und E-Mail-Marketing betreuen: Du setzt Newsletter und Kampagnen um, entwickelst Segmentierungs- und Reaktivierungsansätze und unterstützt dabei, bestehende Kontakte gezielter anzusprechen.
  • Marketingperformance analysieren und optimieren: Du behältst relevante KPIs im Blick, analysierst Kampagnen, Content und Funnels, erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und leitest konkrete Maßnahmen daraus ab.
  • Websites und Landingpages weiterentwickeln: Du übernimmst kleinere Anpassungen an unseren digitalen Angeboten und unterstützt bei Tests und Optimierungen. Wenn du dafür ein neues Tool wie WordPress lernen musst, arbeitest du dich eigenständig ein.
  • Marketingprojekte und Partner koordinieren: Du hältst laufende Projekte zusammen, koordinierst interne und externe Beteiligte und sorgst dafür, dass Aufgaben zuverlässig und termingerecht umgesetzt werden.
  • KI und Automatisierung sinnvoll einsetzen: Du nutzt moderne KI-Tools für Recherche, Content, Analysen und operative Aufgaben und entwickelst Ideen, wie wir unsere Marketingprozesse kontinuierlich verbessern können.

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

  • Abwechslung statt Silodenken: Du arbeitest nicht ausschließlich an Content, Performance oder Analytics, sondern lernst unterschiedliche Marketingdisziplinen kennen und verbindest sie miteinander.
  • Eigenverantwortung statt langer Abstimmungswege: Du bekommst Raum, eigene Ideen einzubringen, Entscheidungen vorzubereiten und Projekte selbstständig voranzutreiben.
  • Kreativität trifft Zahlen: Du kannst neue Kampagnenideen entwickeln und anschließend anhand konkreter Ergebnisse nachvollziehen, ob sie erfolgreich waren.
  • Lernen gehört zum Job: Du musst nicht jedes Tool und jeden Marketingkanal bereits kennen. Wir schätzen Menschen, die sich Herausforderungen stellen und neue Fähigkeiten selbstständig aufbauen.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem CMO: Du erhältst Einblicke in strategische Marketingentscheidungen und bist eng an der Weiterentwicklung unseres Marketings beteiligt.
  • Persönliche Entwicklung und Perspektive: Du wächst mit deinen Aufgaben und hast die Möglichkeit, mit der Weiterentwicklung von Lovebetter zunehmend Verantwortung für größere Projekte, Prozesse und perspektivisch auch Menschen zu übernehmen.

Dein Impact

Wenn du deinen Job exzellent machst, entsteht:

  • ein Marketing, in dem gute Ideen schneller in konkrete Maßnahmen umgesetzt werden
  • ein Ambassador- und Kooperationsprogramm, das kontinuierlich wächst und messbare Ergebnisse liefert
  • neue Marketingkanäle, die strukturiert getestet, bewertet und weiterentwickelt werden
  • bessere Kampagnen und Inhalte durch die Verbindung von Kreativität und datenbasierten Erkenntnissen
  • optimierte Funnels, CRM-Kampagnen und digitale Kontaktpunkte, die mehr qualifizierte Leads erzeugen
  • effizientere Prozesse durch Eigeninitiative, Automatisierung und den sinnvollen Einsatz von KI
  • ein Marketing-Team, das schneller, selbstständiger und wirkungsvoller arbeitet

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns, dich kennenzulernen.

Schick uns keine Standardbewerbung.

Erzähl uns lieber:

  • welche Marketingprojekte oder Kampagnen du bereits eigenständig umgesetzt hast
  • wann du dich zuletzt in ein völlig neues Thema oder Tool eingearbeitet hast und was daraus entstanden ist
  • wie du kreative Ideen entwickelst und herausfindest, ob sie tatsächlich funktionieren
  • welche Aufgaben du schon übernommen hast, obwohl du sie vorher noch nie gemacht hattest
  • und warum du glaubst, dass genau du Lovebetters Marketing mit Kreativität, Eigeninitiative und Umsetzungskraft auf das nächste Level bringen kannst

Stellenanforderungen

Wen wir suchen (und wen nicht)

Diese Rolle passt zu dir, wenn …

  • du bereits praktische Erfahrung im digitalen Marketing gesammelt und idealerweise Kampagnen oder Projekte eigenständig umgesetzt hast
  • du sowohl kreativ als auch analytisch denkst und Spaß daran hast, zwischen unterschiedlichen Aufgaben zu wechseln

title: Principal Engineer - Quality Assurance
description:
YOUR FUTURE, ON DEMAND

The ideal blend of stability and flexibility. A genuinely human employer that cares for people and the planet. True autonomy to shape what comes next, for us and you. This is the perfect platform to take your career where you want.

Back in 2005, we pioneered Europe’s first TV streaming service. Today, we're a leading TV streaming provider with millions of monthly users, and since 2021 we've been ClimatePartner-certified. Over 200 colleagues of 47 nationalities. We’re the grown-up start-up, helping to shape a better future since day one.That hasn’t changed, even if the world has. We’re friendly, international, inclusive – and our people say we’re reliable and transparent, too. It’s why they trust us and believe in what we do.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a Principal Engineer QA as a senior individual contributor. You will define how quality risk is assessed, measured, and gated across the full streaming path - and embed that craft into engineering teams, who own day-to-day tests and suite health.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Quality strategy & risk - Build and maintain a living risk model for the streaming chain. Raise effort where failure hurts most. Make coverage vs. speed and pre-release vs. production trade-offs explicit with product and eng.
  • Release constraints & quality gates - Define what “releasable” means for backend, middleware, and clients - including how continuous backend/middleware delivery is gated relative to client store cadences (web/TV/mobile). Keep gates fast, trustworthy, and hard to bypass.
  • Rollout practice (build with the teams) - Define and establish staged rollout, canary, and rollback strategies together with eng and SRE/ops. Own the definition; establish and operate them collaboratively.
  • Test architecture - Set the pyramid and ownership boundaries (unit through E2E, performance, playback/stream validation) so each layer has a clear home inside eng. Drive cross-stack design that exercises real policy and format decisions.
  • Incident & reliability partnership - Join major quality incidents with a quality lens; strengthen production feedback for streaming health; turn escapes into durable tests, monitors, gate changes, and rollout improvements.
  • Tooling & automation standards - Set practical standards for frameworks, CI integration, test data, environments, and reporting so teams share patterns with clear ownership and measurable ROI.
  • AI-enabled quality engineering - Define where AI raises quality leverage: test generation and maintenance, risk-based test selection, failure triage, and incident analysis. Set standards for AI-assisted testing and shape quality expectations for AI-authored code as delivery speed and change volume increase.
  • Mentoring & influence - Embed quality craft into eng: risk-based testing, quality in PRs, middleware policy and multi-platform client testing. Socialize lightweight, strong-default standards (definition of done, flake policy, critical-path coverage). Influence design reviews when quality risk is material.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

  • Org-wide quality strategy, risk model, and whole-stack standards
  • Release constraints and quality gates; definition of “releasable”
  • Definition of staged rollout/canary/rollback strategies (to be established with partners)
  • Test architecture principles and automation norms
  • Cross-stack escape analysis and quality debt for gates and tooling
  • Embedding quality craft in engineering; influencing high-risk designs
  • Standards for AI-assisted testing and quality expectations for AI-authored code

WHO YOU’LL PARTNER WITH

  • Engineering - They implement and own tests/suites in services and clients; you set architecture, gates, and standards, and build quality practice into delivery.
  • Product - Journey and tenant/feature priority; acceptance of residual risk within the gates you define.
  • SRE / Ops - Establish and operate rollout strategies together; production signals, incident response, capacity/reliability.
  • Platform/tooling - CI, environments, shared frameworks, observability for quality signals.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Track record as a senior IC in quality engineering (or equivalent) for complex, multi-service products - ideally streaming, media, or similarly high-availability consumer platforms
  • Experience designing whole-stack quality strategy: backend services, configuration/policy layers, and multi-platform clients
  • Ability to define and land test architecture (pyramid, ownership, cross-stack integration/contract/playback-style validation) that engineering teams can run and own
  • Strong influence without authority: you raise the bar inside eng teams, socialize standards, and hold the line on gates without managing a QA org
  • Strong software engineering skills at senior level or above; you write production-quality code, not just test scripts
  • Designing and coding for testability, and building automation as a first-class engineering product
  • Deep familiarity with CI/CD, with a track record of making pipelines faster and more reliable
  • Hands-on experience applying AI to quality engineering, with judgment on where it reduces risk and where it adds noise
  • Comfort partnering on incidents and turning production failure modes into durable quality improvements
  • Practical judgment on automation: enough to protect risk, not so much that brittle suites block the org
  • Bonus:
    • Hands-on engineering background with video ingest, encoding/packaging, playback, or multi-tenant config/policy surfaces
    • Work across web, TV, and mobile client quality risk (device/OS/store constraints)

WHY JOIN US?

At Zattoo, you’re always on firm ground with real freedom to explore. You’ll have the support and opportunity you need to go far, while you’re helping us create a sustainable and entertainment-filled future for all.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

  • Reward: strong market competitive salary
  • Recharge: 30 days vacation plus public holidays
  • Regulate:trust based flexible working hours and the option for remote work worldwide for up to 8 weeks per year

Plus:

  • We’re sharing: Free access to the best streaming experience on the market
  • We're developing: Your own development budget, German classes and Zattoo all-company hack days
  • We’re inclusive: ‘Zattooies’ are a fun, engaged, and diverse team made up of 47 nationalities
  • We’re healthy: Health checks, mental wellbeing support, team sports and more!
  • We’re responsible: We are carbon neutral, an active employee Green team, discounted BVG tickets and free bike rentals
  • We’re sociable: A calendar of events with fireside chats, lunches, in-house bar, BBQ’s, monthly socials, summer party and an annual off-site event

For a young company in the rapidly growing AI implementation market, we are looking for a Tech Lead, starting as soon as possible, ideally in early November. The company runs LLM-based systems in production: content generation pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) on internal documents, and automated workflows closely integrated with their business systems. The entire stack is built on TypeScript and Next.js.

These systems are already live. As Tech Lead, you take ownership of them, increase their reliability and quality, and expand them to new use cases, while being technically responsible for a team. The role brings together applied LLM engineering and solid backend engineering in TypeScript. Training or fine-tuning foundation models is not part of the job.

Stack: TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, Postgres with pgvector, Docker, Azure, Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, Vercel AI SDK.

What you’ll do

  • Technical responsibility for the team, including architecture decisions and code reviews

  • Technical guidance for the team and point of contact for non-technical colleagues

  • Take over and maintain the existing LLM pipelines: review the current architecture, identify failure modes, prioritise fixes, and refactor and extend the systems without disrupting production

  • Own the RAG systems from end to end: document ingestion and parsing, chunking, indexing, hybrid retrieval (BM25 and vector), query rewriting, reranking and grounded generation with citations

  • Implement and maintain chunk-level access control, index freshness and tenant isolation across all retrieval systems

  • Develop content generation pipelines that deliver consistent quality at scale, including human review steps

  • Build and run automated workflows against internal and third-party business systems (ERP, CRM, email, internal APIs), with durable and idempotent execution, retry and dead-letter handling, and approval steps for irreversible actions

  • Set up an evaluation framework for systems that currently run without one: golden datasets based on real production failures, retrieval metrics and more

  • Implement observability along the entire request path

  • Optimise cost and latency through prompt caching, batching, model routing and smaller models where it makes sense

  • Identify where deterministic logic is the better choice and implement it accordingly

  • Work directly with non-technical colleagues to define and validate automated processes

What you bring

  • Professional experience with at least one LLM-based system in production, including responsibility for its operation and incident handling

  • Advanced TypeScript and Node.js skills: strict typing of non-deterministic model output, async and concurrency patterns, streaming responses, structured error handling

  • Production experience with Next.js: App Router, route handlers, server actions, streaming to the client

  • Proven track record of taking over and improving existing codebases under production traffic

  • Hands-on retrieval expertise: hybrid search, choosing embedding models, cross-encoder reranking, metadata filtering, permission-aware retrieval and structured diagnosis of poor retrieval quality

  • Experience working with real-world documents: PDFs with tables, scanned material, DOCX, HTML, including layout-aware parsing, OCR and evidence-based chunking

  • Structured outputs and tool calling are part of your daily work: JSON Schema, Zod or similar runtime validation, function calling, handling malformed or partial output, context window management

  • Experience designing and running LLM evaluations

  • Experience with LLM tracing and evaluation tools in a TypeScript codebase (e.g. Braintrust, Langfuse, Promptfoo, OpenTelemetry or Arize Phoenix)

  • Familiarity with Postgres including vector search (pgvector or a comparable vector store), Docker, Git, CI/CD and at least one major cloud platform

  • Practical experience with the Anthropic and/or OpenAI TypeScript SDKs

  • Confident communication in English, German is a plus

Nice to have

  • Durable workflow execution for long-running, unattended processes (Temporal, Inngest or similar)

  • Agent orchestration in production, tool calling, recovery, multi-step workflows (Vercel AI SDK, LangGraph, Mastra, Claude Agent SDK, MCP TypeScript SDK)

  • Experience integrating enterprise systems such as ERP or CRM platforms like SAP

  • Security and data protection in LLM systems, defences against prompt injection and data exfiltration, PII handling, GDPR-compliant design, EU-hosted or self-hosted inference

  • Azure DevOps, Pipelines, Repos and Boards

We have multiple SANS Instructors working at NVISO, our staff has presented at popular hacking conferences (BlackHat, BruCON, OWASP, etc) and all of our technical staff can acquire deep technical security certifications (GSE, GXPN, GREM, GCFA, OSCP, etc);

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Every order through those stores is a fan buying something from an artist they care about. Customer Services is where that relationship is won or lost.

The Role

You'll answer customers across our artist stores, resolve order, delivery and returns issues end to end, and feed what you learn back to the wider e-commerce team so problems get fixed at the source.

What we are looking for

You bring professional experience in customer service, clear communication skills, and a practical approach to resolving support requests in a fast-paced environment.

Customer support

  • Respond to customer tickets by email and chat through Gorgias, across multiple artist stores and in each store's tone.

  • Manage returns, exchanges, refunds and reships, including damaged and faulty items, collecting photo evidence and processing returns through Loop Returns.

  • Resolve complaints fairly and within our service standards (acknowledgement within 2 working days, resolution within 14 calendar days), escalating to the CS Lead where needed.

  • Apply UK and EU consumer rights correctly, including the 14-day cancellation period and its exceptions.

Working with the wider team

  • Chase stock and fulfilment issues with the warehouse and Product team, and flag anything that needs a reship or a hold on stock.

You'll need to stay calm and accurate under pressure, prioritise the tickets that matter most, and occasionally flex your hours around a launch.

Skills and experience

Essential

  • At least 1 year in customer service, ideally for an e-commerce or retail brand.

  • Clear, warm written English and German, with the judgement to adjust tone for different artists and fanbases.

  • Comfortable working a busy ticket queue and hitting response times.

Desirable

What we offer

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Web + Infrastructure)
description:
Searoutes makes the emissions data that shippers use to run and reduce their
logistics. It is an operational problem before it is an environmental one, and
in our hands it is mostly an engineering one.

We are hiring a senior engineer who works across our web frontend and our
infrastructure — the same two codebases, in the same week. Someone who ships a
product screen on Monday, changes an identity-provider flow on Wednesday, and
considers those the same job.

We are looking for a broad profile rather than a specialist. The next year is
mostly platform work with a user-facing edge — user management, API gateway
management, payments, SEO, and a great deal of compliance, GDPR and ISO 27001.

If you are passionate about the environment, proactive and pragmatic in getting
things done, and love to work in a complex but fascinating industry where you
learn every day — then this is the place for you.

The work in front of us

Some of the items on our tech roadmap for the coming year. Bets are picked a
cycle at a time and shared out, so you would take the ones that suit you and
grow into the rest.

  • Product and marketing UI in React — multi-brand, WCAG AA, strong on
    technical SEO, fast enough to hold a performance budget.
  • User management and identity — Keycloak realms, organisation hierarchies,
    partner brokering, and the entitlement model in the app.
  • API gateway work in APISIX — routes, plugins and auth policy as code.
  • Payments and billing.
  • ISO 27001 and GDPR — access control, change management, audit logging,
    observability and alerting, consent and retention.
  • The infrastructure underneath — Pulumi in TypeScript, Docker Swarm on
    Hetzner, Cloudflare at the edge, Tailscale for all engineer and CI access.
  • Third-party integrations — usually the seam between two systems that were
    never designed to meet.

Nobody arrives fluent in all of that, and we are not expecting it. We want
someone strong across a good part of it, comfortable being new to the rest, and
used to working things out — with a team and with agents, rather than alone.

Also in daily use: Postgres and PostGIS, Valkey, ClickHouse; Vite, Tailwind and
Radix; Jest and Playwright; GitHub Actions; HAProxy. Most of what we write is
TypeScript, strict — though our core API is Java and Spring, and the identity
layer has Java in it too, so how far you go into that side is up to you.

How we work

LLM-native, in the codebases you would work in. They are built around
agent-assisted development rather than merely tolerant of it — the conventions,
the tooling and the review gates all assume it. Agents do most of the
implementation and much of the review; humans design, verify and approve. What
we are really hiring for is judgement over output you did not write by hand:
knowing what to specify, what to check, and what to throw away. The bar did not
move when the tooling did.

Shape Up, and you own what you take. Roughly three weeks of building, then a
week of cooldown, with bets chosen at a betting table. We are small enough that
an area becomes yours quickly — you make the calls inside it and you answer for
how it turns out. We hand out problems, not the steps that solve them.

Remote first, with most of the team in Europe and everyone together in person at
least twice a year. Significant technical decisions get written down, and a
green build is never on its own enough to merge.

Requirements

You'll thrive here if you have…

  • Senior full-stack experience — you have owned features from the browser to
    the machine they run on.
  • A track record of taking something and running with it — a domain, a
    migration, a subsystem you took on, decided and stayed accountable for.
  • Taste. You can tell a good design from a merely plausible one, and you
    will reject work that functions but is not right — your own, and an agent's.
  • React beyond the client — server rendering, static generation, data
    loading and hydration; you know what runs where and why it matters.
  • TypeScript at strict — typed boundaries, and an instinct for when types
    are carrying real weight.
  • Infrastructure as code — Pulumi ideally; Terraform if you are ready to
    pick up Pulumi.
  • Containers and Linux in production — not writing a Dockerfile, but
    debugging a service on a machine you have to SSH into.
  • Postgres beyond queries — backup and restore, migrations, what a schema
    change does under load.
  • Wholehearted LLM-assisted development — you use coding agents daily, have
    opinions about steering them, and review their output as critically as a
    colleague's.
  • Integration instincts — third-party APIs, webhooks, OAuth/OIDC, and
    patience for other people's undocumented edge cases.
  • A working day that overlaps ours: based within CET ±3.
  • Fluent in English, our working language.

Nice to have

  • Identity and API gateways in depth — Keycloak, OIDC, SAML brokering, APISIX.
  • Compliance from the inside — an ISO 27001 certification lived through, or GDPR
    beyond a cookie banner.
  • Payment systems, billing models, or PSP integrations.
  • Observability and alerting — Prometheus, Grafana or equivalent.
  • Experience in the maritime, logistics or freight industry.
  • Familiarity with emissions accounting frameworks (GHG Protocol, GLEC, EU
    ETS..).

Benefits

As part of our team, you will:

  • 🌱 Have a chance to re-shape the future of climate in the logistics.
  • 👩‍💻 Be empowered to deliver your best work remotely, and get a stipend to set
    you up.
  • 🏄‍♂️ Have a flat hierarchy, where you will have direct access to the founders
    and won't be tied up in politics.
  • 🎓 Have a high degree of learning and ownership in a dynamic environment.
  • 🏝 Take part in our team-building events.

description:
Transforming factory scans into digital reality

At RIIICO, we're reimagining how factories adapt to change. Our AI-powered software makes complex production environments editable, interactive, and collaborative, turning manufacturing planning into something anyone can engage with, not just the experts.

We’re looking for a 3D Data Operator to help power the foundation of our digital factory experiences. No point cloud experience needed, just an eye for detail and curiosity about 3D.

In this role, you'll work at the intersection of 3D reality and AI, transforming raw point cloud data into accurate digital twins of real-world production environments. From data preparation to model generation and delivery, you'll help ensure quality, consistency, and continuous improvement across our data pipeline.

Your daily work

  • Process 3D scan data (point clouds) and transform it into usable digital factory models using our internal tools and workflows.

  • Run basic pipeline commands for data preparation and AI processing.

  • Configure and verify model outputs to ensure quality, consistency, and usability for downstream applications (e.g., Nvidia Omniverse, Siemens Plant Simulation and others).

  • Collaborate with AI-assisted tools to validate and correct automated results.

  • Flag and troubleshoot anomalies or edge cases in raw or processed data, and document issues clearly (e.g., as Git issues).

  • Track and report your weekly processing output.

  • Continuously improve workflows and documentation based on team feedback and real-world challenges.

What we are looking for

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to reliably handle repetitive tasks with care.

  • Self-motivated and dependable: you take responsibility and get things done.

  • Comfortable following defined workflows and standards, and asking for help when something is unclear.

  • Team player with a proactive mindset: you enjoy working in a collaborative team.

  • Fast learner: no prior experience with point clouds required; you're comfortable picking up new tools and workflows quickly.

  • Basic digital literacy: you're confident navigating structured software tools, browser-based interfaces and Microsoft Office.

  • Bonus: Familiarity with 3D environments (e.g., through gaming, CAD, or similar), or a general spatial intuition.

  • English is a must; proficiency in German is a plus for clear communication with the team.

  • Please note: A valid work permit or residence permit for Germany is required for this position.

This is a 12-month fixed-term position, with the opportunity to extend or move to a permanent contract based on performance and business development.

Benefits

  • Additional vacation days

  • Flexible working hours

  • Hybrid office culture

  • Public transport subsidy

Why You Should Join

  • Build something that makes a tangible difference in the world's most important sector: manufacturing.

  • Help shape a product that is being built from first principles.

  • Collaborate with a sharp, hands-on team that values speed, clarity, and ownership.

  • Backed by top international investors and preparing to scale.
