At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here.

France is one of the most important flexibility markets in Europe. This role is critical to accelerating Axle’s growth in France.

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the French market.

This is a role that spans both sales and go to market. You’ll be responsible for both winning new partners (OEMs, utilities, platforms, etc.) and making those partnerships succeed over time.

This is a multifaceted, client-facing role with a strong technical component. You will own the full commercial lifecycle and should be comfortable moving between strategic conversations, commercial negotiations, onboarding and account growth.

You will speak native-level French and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

This role will own:

  • Winning new business

  • Go-to-market strategy and execution

  • Client onboarding and implementation support

  • Account management and expansion

What you will be doing

  • Owning Axle’s commercial results for the French market (pipeline, revenue and partner success)

  • Building and managing a strong pipeline of partners across key segments (OEMs, energy retailers, installers, platforms, etc.)

  • Owning new customer acquisition end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, setting our partners up to generate meaningful revenue

  • Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing considerations, customer segmentation and launch strategies

  • Managing post-implementation relationships with clients after go-live, driving continuous improvement and opportunity to deepen engagement or grow the account

  • Acting as a conduit between partners and engineering teams creating fast, structured feedback loops that help translate field insights into meaningful product enhancements

  • Building and refine scalable sales and partner processes that support repeatable growth across different customer segments

  • Tracking performance, pipeline, and outcomes, using data to prioritise effort and continuously improve commercial effectiveness

  • Operating with low structure and high ownership: remove friction, avoid bureaucracy, move fast

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

You’ll be based in France. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

  1. Initial interview

  2. Take-home exercise

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

About the role

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach in France.

At the core of our market expansion plans is market analysis. To maximise future revenue, we spend a lot of time understanding the value of flexibility in power markets around the world.

We are looking for a technical individual (data scientist, analyst or engineer) with strong knowledge of the French electricity markets and an instinct for commercial value.

You will become Axle’s internal expert on French power markets: understanding the market rules, modelling the value, and building relationships with system operators and regulators. We’re scrappy about method and rigorous about conclusions.

You will speak fluent French and English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing

  • Developing a deep understanding of French energy markets and grid dynamics to understand how trading, compensation, penalties and cash flow work

  • Jumping on the phone with grid operators, regulators and market stakeholders to validate hypotheses and make sense of data

  • Building and optimising models of wholesale/NEBCO, capacity, balancing, ancillary services and local flexibility markets in France to forecast what different assets can earn

  • Sizing the revenue opportunity across markets and products to shape where we expand next

  • Building and evaluating different strategies for cycling a battery or load-shifting an EV charger

  • Monitoring and shaping energy regulation to accelerate the growth of flexibility.

This is an opportunity to gain unique domain expertise and build the quantitative case for first-of-a-kind projects across the world.

What we think you need to be successful

  • Deep quantitative and modelling ability (Python, SQL)

  • Exceptional communication and the ability to turn data into actionable commercial insights

  • Comfort moving fast and making decisions in an evolving environment

  • Deep knowledge of French electricity markets (NEBCO, Mécanisme de Capacité, Mécanisme d’Ajustement, ancillary services…)

  • Relationships with regulators, grid operators and other stakeholders (CRE, DGEC, RTE, Enedis, etc.) are a plus

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Wil jij impact maken bij toonaangevende enterprise klanten op het gebied van Cloud technologie?
Als Cloud engineer help je klanten hun digitale transformatie te versnellen door cloudoplossingen te ontwerpen, te realiseren en te optimaliseren. Je schakelt makkelijk tussen strategisch meedenken en operationele uitvoering, en werkt nauw samen met Itility’s Managing Consultants en Cloud engineers. Krijg je hier energie van? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!


Wat jij gaat doen

Je werkt in een projectteam van bevlogen professionals aan het ontwerpen, implementeren en verbeteren van Cloud omgevingen. Samen met je collega-consultants werk je aan innovatieve projecten bij grote klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren.

Jouw werkzaamheden bestaan o.a. uit:

  • Het coachen van klanten en collega’s in het gebruik van Cloud technologie en DevOps-werkwijzen

Daarnaast organiseert onze Cloud Community tech hours waarin we kennis delen, oplossingen en tools demonstreren, en samen specifieke certificaten behalen.

Daar hoort natuurlijk ook een aantrekkelijk arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket bij. Naast een salaris dat past bij jouw ervaring, achtergrond en potentie, kun je rekenen op:

Dit ben jij

Jij bent iemand die graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt, snel schakelt en altijd zoekt naar de beste oplossing. Je weet de brug te slaan tussen technologie en business, en bent in staat om complexe onderwerpen helder over te brengen. Daarnaast beschik je over:

title: Project manager (Senior)
description:
Ben jij een ervaren project manager die impact wil maken binnen een snelgroeiend softwarebedrijf? Wil jij het verschil maken bij klanten op het gebied van personeelsplanning en personeelskrapte? Heb jij de kennis en vaardigheden om projecten efficiënt te managen en tegelijkertijd de klanttevredenheid hoog te houden? Wil jij jouw ervaring inzetten om het team te versterken en samen optimale resultaten te behalen? Dan kijken we ernaar uit om je te ontmoeten!  
 
Werken bij een van de Top 3 spelers in Workforce management in Nederland en bijdragen aan snelle ontwikkeling in het buitenland? 
Bij Intus helpen wij onze klanten en hun medewerkers met slimmer plannen. Hierdoor dragen we bij aan het oplossen van één van de belangrijkste maatschappelijke uitdagingen: personeelskrapte. 

Onze producten brengen flexibiliteit en efficiëntie in het planningsproces en dat is fijn voor iedereen. Onze klanten kunnen onze medewerkers optimaal inzetten, terwijl we tegelijkertijd bijdragen aan meer werkgeluk en een gezonde werk-privé balans. Een win-win voor iedereen! 
 
Als project manager bij Intus speel je een cruciale rol in projecten bij onze diverse klanten in verschillende markten zoals zorg, overheid, industrie en logistiek. Je structureert en realiseert meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd van begin tot het eind. Dit kan gaan om het begeleiden van onze klanten bij het volledig implementeren van onze software InPlanning bij een nieuwe klant of het begeleiden van een complexe transformatie in het applicatielandschap bij een bestaande klant. Ook interne projecten kunnen onderdeel van de werkzaamheden zijn. Dankzij jouw vermogen om draagvlak te creëren en overzicht te behouden, help je klanten en zorg je voor een efficiënt verloop van de projecten.  
 
Je maakt deel uit van een team van project managers en consultants die verantwoordelijk zijn voor alle projecten in Nederland. Als project manager ben jij tijdens een project hét aanspreekpunt voor de klant, met betrekking tot de voortgang, planning, kwaliteit, budget en uitvoering. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s (o.a. implementatie consultants en technisch consultants) om de projecten te realiseren, en daarnaast heb je ook regelmatig contact met je collega-project managers, accountmanagers, technisch consultants en product owners. Kortom, een boeiende functie in een dynamische werkomgeving!  

 
Als project manager begeleidt je projecten van A tot Z wat betekent dat je de volgende verantwoordelijkheden hebt:  

  • Opstellen van een Plan van Aanpak en een implementatieagenda.  

  • Plannen van projectwerkzaamheden van consultants.  

  • Zorgdragen voor een goede samenwerking tussen alle interne en externe stakeholders van het project.  

  • Tijdig signaleren en rapporteren van risico's, op basis waarvan je een concrete aanpak voorstelt op basis waarvan besluitvorming kan plaatsvinden.  

  • Bewaken van kaders waaronder projectdoelen, kwaliteit, budgetten en planningen.  

  • Verzorgen van maandrapportages en voorbereiding van de facturatie richting de klant.  

  • Overzicht behouden over meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd.  


  • Je hebt uitgebreide werkervaring als project manager, bij voorkeur in de gezondheidszorg.

  • Je hebt een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding.  

  • Je hebt een pro-actieve werkhouding en neemt verantwoordelijkheid.  

  • Je bent een echte teamspeler en weet hoe je effectief stakeholders kunt betrekken.  

  • Je werkt gestructureerd en hebt een helikopterview.  

  • Je bent resultaatgericht, maar verliest de kwaliteit niet uit het oog.  

  • Je bent gedreven, slim, analytisch en bent in staat op verschillende niveaus te denken en te handelen.  

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal op professioneel niveau, mondeling en schriftelijk. Beheers je daarnaast ook nog Duits? Dan is dat de kers op de taart! 

  

Bij Intus hechten we veel waarde aan een informele, maar professionele werksfeer. Maar er is meer dat ons bijzonder maakt! Hier is ons DNA in een kort overzicht:  

  • Trots; op ons product, onze klanten én onze collega’s!   

  • Goede vibe; een gezellige sfeer waar iedere mening telt.   

  • Open cultuur; jazeker, met korte lijnen en weinig hiërarchie.   

  • Collegialiteit; we helpen elkaar en hebben lol met elkaar. Heb je een last-minute vraag? Je vindt altijd iemand die wil helpen.   

  • Ambitieus; wat we tot nu toe hebben gedaan is geweldig, maar we zijn nog lang niet klaar!   

  

En verder bieden we:

title: Senior SOC Analyst
description:
Scope of Impact

Actively participates with other seniors in SOC activities by providing knowledge and insight on more complex client cases. Provides ideas and concrete input for process and efficiency improvements. Actively participates in overall team- and workflow-improvement projects.

Expertise

In-depth knowledge of the operational use of security monitoring tools (SIEM, EDR). Ability to assess complex logs, recognise patterns, and derive actionable insights. Actively develops both technical and soft skills, and stays current with changes in the field. A credible voice and source of knowledge in the department.

Autonomy and Contribution Style

Full autonomy during complex SOC escalations. Skills and confidence to coordinate the team’s response. Collaborates with, and gives guidance to, the team on arising issues. Once fully onboarded, demonstrates the ability to handle Tier 3 shifts.

Complexity

High complexity: oversees entire projects and influences cross-functional teams; decisions impact the department and adjacent areas. Creates clear, structured, reproducible documentation that informs stakeholders of risks, findings, and recommended actions. Recognises higher-level security issues and resolves them independently; supports junior members in resolving theirs.

Leadership

No formal leadership responsibilities. Actively coaches more junior team members to share knowledge and grow as a team.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor security alerts and perform initial triage; classify (false positive, true positive, uncertain) and close out confirmed false positives correctly

  • Take full ownership of escalated and the most complex alerts: root-cause analysis, log correlation, validating assessments, determining next steps

  • Own client communication for assigned alerts, including difficult or high-risk escalations from more junior analysts, to a consistent quality standard

  • Independently execute containment actions across impact levels; approve escalations from more junior analysts

  • Own the team’s overall workload and service-level adherence day to day; pull in support or escalate when targets are at risk

  • Answer cross-department questions on security operations; improve documentation and working instructions for junior levels

  • Mentor junior and mid-level colleagues

  • Identify patterns across multiple cases and escalations that point to systemic detection gaps or false-positive sources, and turn them into structured input for the detection content owners — not one-off flags

  • Contribute to team projects and process/efficiency improvements

Not in scope at this level, or ever, on this track

  • Incident response casework — a separate specialisation

  • Detection rule ownership, detection engineering, and threat hunting — owned by a separate team

Requirements

  • 4+ years hands-on SOC/security operations experience

  • Proven ability to own and drive the team’s SLA/workload independently

  • Strong client communication in high-risk situations

  • Track record mentoring junior colleagues

  • Solid log analysis and EDR platform experience; familiarity with major cloud platforms

  • Language fluency matching the client base supported; English internally; Dutch and/or German required or strongly preferred depending on client-facing exposure

Growth path

From here, the role forks: an individual-contributor track (Staff-level, then an optional cross-functional Principal role), or a people-leadership track (Team Lead).

About Eye Security

Eye Security provides cybersecurity with embedded cyber insurance solutions for organisations across Europe. Headquartered in the Netherlands, 200+ FTEs and growing internationally. We combine 24/7 detection and response with hands-on incident response to keep SMEs protected.

title: Quantitative Researcher - 2027 Graduates
description:
At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge?

As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly.

This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job.

Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices.

What You'll Work On

You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include:

  • Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events
  • Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them
  • Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading
  • Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise
  • Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible
  • Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales
  • Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models
  • Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper
  • Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems
  • Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge

No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist.

What Success Looks Like

Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. It's measured by the quality of the ideas you discover and what those ideas enable.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious.

  • Degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, operations research or machine learning
  • No active backlogs
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++
  • Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization, with experience in machine learning, statistical modelling or data analysis, whether through coursework, research or personal projects
  • Comfort working with large, complex datasets, and strong analytical thinking
  • A passion for applying quantitative thinking and rigorous research to solve open-ended problems in markets
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly

Prior exposure to quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, competitive mathematics or machine learning is valuable, but we care more about how you think than whether you've worked in finance before.

Our Culture

More than specific tools or techniques, we care how you think. We look for people who are curious enough to keep asking why, analytical enough to separate signal from noise, persistent enough to pursue difficult problems, intellectually honest enough to abandon an idea when the evidence says so, and humble enough to keep learning.

At Graviton, researchers sit alongside technologists on specialized trading teams that operate with significant autonomy. You'll have meaningful ownership of research problems from day one: forming your own hypotheses, challenging existing approaches and following the evidence wherever it leads, with the infrastructure and datasets to test ideas at scale, competitive compensation, and a culture where the best idea wins regardless of who proposed it.

Markets are among the most complex systems humans have ever created, and they never stop changing. Neither should our thinking. Every day, someone asks a better question and finds an answer nobody had. That someone could be you.

title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Samen met de CEO en COO werk je aan de verdere strategische en financiële ontwikkeling van de organisatie. Als CFO vertaal je de ondernemingsstrategie naar concrete groeikansen door schaalbare verdien- en prijsmodellen te ontwikkelen. Per markt, regio, entiteit, businessunit en klantsegment analyseer je waar kansen liggen, op basis van verwachte klantwaarde, omzetpotentieel, kosten, marge, cashflow, risico en schaalbaarheid. Deze inzichten verwerk je in businesscases waarin zowel het perspectief van de klant als van Voortman Steel Machinery naar voren komen.

 

Daarnaast ontwikkel je heldere investeringskaders en breng je passende financieringsmodellen in kaart die aansluiten op de aard van de activiteiten en de internationale context. Daarbij weeg je beschikbare financieringsopties zorgvuldig af op impact, liquiditeit en rendement. Op basis daarvan adviseer je de board over prioriteiten en zorg je dat middelen terechtkomen bij de initiatieven die het meest bijdragen aan de strategische en financiële doelstellingen van Voortman Steel Machinery. Als onderdeel hiervan bepaal je ook onder welke financiële en organisatorische voorwaarden pilots kunnen worden gestart en opgeschaald. Met heldere go/no-go-momenten per fase zorg je ervoor dat de ontwikkeling en implementatie van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen niet sneller gaat dan wat de organisatie kan adopteren. Daarnaast monitor je de financiële resultaten van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen en bepaal je of de uitrol moet worden versneld, voortgezet, bijgestuurd of afgeschaald. Tegelijkertijd borg je dat contracten allesomvattende afspraken en een evenwichtige risicoverdeling bevatten, evenals uitvoerbaar zijn in alle landen waar Voortman Steel Machinery actief is. Zo werk je gericht aan verdien- en prijsmodellen die commercieel aantrekkelijk, financieel gezond en schaalbaar zijn.

 

Als CFO draag je actief bij aan de verdere internationale groei van Voortman Steel Machinery. Hiervoor ontwikkel je strategische, financiële en organisatorische plannen, zodat per markt en internationale entiteit helder is welke inrichting het beste past bij de gewenste groei. Daarbij verzorg je de afstemming tussen verschillende afdelingen en entiteiten, zonder de lijnverantwoordelijkheid van collega's over te nemen. Tevens bewaak je per land en internationale entiteit het rendement, de cashflow, het werkkapitaal en houd je zicht op financiële, juridische, fiscale, contractuele en compliance-risico’s.

Ook de financiële besturing en beheersing van Voortman Steel Machinery valt onder jouw verantwoordelijkheid. Je bent internationaal eindverantwoordelijk voor consolidatie, planning & control, reporting, accounting, treasury, audit, tax, vennootschapsbelasting en interne beheersing. Aansluitend zie je toe op het opstellen van correcte en transparante rapportages per internationale entiteit. De dagelijkse coördinatie van deze verschillende activiteiten en de aansturing van de Finance-afdeling wordt verzorgd door de Finance-director, waarmee je nauw samenwerkt. Jij fungeert als sparringpartner, stuurt bij waar nodig, bewaakt de strategisch richting van de Finance-afdeling, verzorgt correcte governance en behandeld onderwerpen met board impact. Tevens ben je het gezicht van Voortman Steel Machinery richting banken, verzekeraars, accountant en andere financiële stakeholders.

 

Wat maakt deze rol uniek?

In deze rol krijg je de kans om zichtbaar richting te geven aan de volgende groeifase van Voortman Steel Machinery. Je komt terecht in een organisatie waar ondernemerschap, innovatie en slagkracht samenkomen: ideeën worden niet alleen verkend, maar ook scherp getoetst op waardecreatie, rendement, risico en schaalbaarheid. Daarmee krijg je ruimte om jouw financiële expertise en strategisch vermogen in te zetten bij het ontwikkelen van nieuwe proposities, het onderbouwen van businesscases en het bepalen van investeringskeuzes die impact hebben op de internationale groei van de organisatie. Dit maakt de functie nadrukkelijk méér dan een traditionele CFO-rol: je bewaakt niet alleen de financiële basis, maar bent medebepalend in hoe Voortman Steel Machinery commerciële kansen vertaalt naar gezonde, schaalbare en toekomstbestendige groei.

 

Positie binnen de organisatie

Voortman Steel Machinery ontwikkelt machines, software en serviceoplossingen waarmee staalverwerkende bedrijven hun productieprocessen automatiseren en optimaliseren. Het hoofdkantoor is gevestigd in Nederland. Dankzij vestigingen in verschillende landen kan effectieve lokale ondersteuning worden geboden. De recent geopende, grootschalige productielocatie in de Verenigde Staten laat zien hoe de organisatie internationaal blijft groeien. Tevens vindt in Engeland hoofdzakelijk de ontwikkeling van onze LogicSteel-software plaats. Daarnaast bezit Voortman wereldwijd diverse sales & service-hubs.

 

Als CFO vorm je samen met de CEO en COO de board van Voortman Steel Machinery, geef je met hen richting aan de ontwikkeling van het Global Management Team en de organisatie als geheel. Jouw focus ligt op het vertalen van de ondernemingsstrategie naar concrete kansen voor nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen. Hierbij werk je intensief samen met de afdeling Product Management, dat verantwoordelijk is voor het identificeren en ontwikkelen van software-, machine- en serviceproposities. Als CFO ben je eindverantwoordelijk voor de Finance-afdeling en werk je nauw samen met de Finance Director, die de dagelijkse internationale operationele aansturing van de afdeling verzorgt. Tevens rapporteren de HR-Manager en Trade Compliance Officer aan jou. De HR-Manager is (mede) verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen van de HR-strategie en het borgen van de operationele uitvoering. Daarnaast ziet de Trade Compliance Officer erop toe dat de organisatie voldoet aan de relevante wet- en regelgeving. Daarbij bewaakt de Trade Compliance Officer onder andere de inhoudelijke juistheid en werking van ingezette maatregelen.


Wat wij bieden?

Bij Voortman Steel Machinery kom je terecht in een écht familiebedrijf met een informele, betrokken en ondernemende cultuur. Mensen kennen elkaar en lijnen zijn kort. Er is volop ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, initiatief te tonen en ideeën verder te brengen. Onze kernwaarden ondernemerschap, vakmanschap, passie voor technologie, toewijding en samenwerking vormen daarbij de basis voor hoe we werken en met elkaar omgaan. Je ziet ze terug in de trots waarmee we hoogwaardige technologie ontwikkelen, in de manier waarop teams elkaar versterken en in de gezamenlijke drive om klanten vooruit te helpen. Zo ontstaat een werkomgeving waarin ambitie, betrokkenheid en werkplezier op een natuurlijke manier samenkomen.

 

Naast een professionele, ondernemende en loyale werkomgeving krijg je bij ons:

  • Een marktconform salaris, passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • Een passende pensioenregeling bij ASR, waarbij jij en Voortman samen pensioenkapitaal opbouwen;

  • Een leaseauto voor zakelijk en privégebruik;

  • Een sleutelrol in het realiseren van onze strategie met internationale impact;

  • Werken in een moderne omgeving op onze Voortman Campus in Rijssen;

 

Wat breng je mee?

Wij zoeken een ondernemende, strategische en daadkrachtige CFO met een afgeronde masteropleiding in Finance, Economie, Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting. Een titel als RA, RC of CPA is een must. Je hebt minimaal vijf jaar ervaring als CFO, Divisie-CFO, Senior Finance Director, Head of Finance of Director Corporate Finance, bij voorkeur binnen een internationale original equipment manufacturer (OEM), industrieel technologiebedrijf, technisch complexe B2B-organisatie of top-tier consultancybureau. Ervaring binnen een ondernemend familiebedrijf of een organisatie van vergelijkbare omvang en complexiteit is daarbij een pré. Daarnaast heb je ervaring met aansturen van een finance-afdeling of -team. Verder voldoe je aan het volgende profiel:

 

  • Strategisch en analytisch vermogen: je beschikt over sterk analytisch en strategisch vermogen en hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het doorgronden van complexe data en businessmodellen. Je weet informatie te vertalen naar heldere strategische en financiële logica, logische transparante aannames en goed onderbouwde besluitvorming. Je bent in staat om richting te bepalen, langetermijndoelen te formuleren en de organisatie daarin mee te nemen.

 

  • Businessmodelinnovatie: je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het in kaart brengen van groeikansen en het ontwikkelen van nieuwe (schaalbare) verdien-, prijs- en contractmodellen. Deze weet je te onderbouwen met solide businesscases en scenarioanalyses. Daarnaast heb je ruime ervaring met het ontwikkelen van financieringsmodellen en het inrichten van kapitaalallocatie op basis van het (verwachte) rendement, risico’s en strategische bijdrage.

 

  • Besluitvaardig en resultaatgericht: je bent besluitvaardig en kunt tijdig en doordacht keuzes maken op basis van beschikbare informatie. Als je éénmaal een keuze hebt gemaakt, durf je achter je keuze te blijven staan. Je beschikt over overtuigingskracht, kunt draagvlak creëren en interne en externe stakeholders zorgvuldig meenemen in strategische veranderingen. Tevens stuur je actief op concrete resultaten en realiseer je aantoonbare positieve financiële impact.

 

  • Verandervermogen en omgevingsbewustzijn: je hebt ervaring met het realiseren van interne veranderingen en de implementatie van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen, evenals het tijdig bijsturen daarvan. Tevens ben je sterk in het vertalen van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen naar heldere, beheersbare processen en rollen. Daarbij zorg je voor een gestructureerde stapsgewijze implementatie en ben je sterk in het meenemen en begeleiden van collega’s tijdens veranderingen. Ook onder druk en in complexe situaties blijf je rustig, behoud je overzicht en kun je snel schakelen. Tevens heb je een scherp oog voor verhoudingen, kun je belangen goed afwegen en anticipeer je tijdig op ontwikkelingen. Daarbij heb je een goed begrip van culturele en organisatorische verschillen in een internationale context.

 

  • Verbindend vermogen en communicatie: je bent betrokken en weet duurzame professionele relaties op te bouwen en te onderhouden met interne en externe stakeholders, zoals banken, accountants en verzekeraars. Je communiceert helder, informeert betrokkenen tijdig over relevante ontwikkelingen en bent benaderbaar. Je weet complexe onderwerpen begrijpelijk over te brengen en stemt je communicatie af op verschillende gesprekspartners. Daarnaast beschik je over sterke Nederlandse en Engelse communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

 

  • Inspirerend leiderschap: jouw leiderschap is gericht op groei, vertrouwen en ontwikkeling. Je weet medewerkers te coachen, te inspireren en richting te geven, terwijl je ruimte geeft voor eigenaarschap en verantwoordelijkheid. Daarbij stuur je bij waar nodig, stimuleer je samenwerking en help je collega’s hun potentieel te benutten. Zo draag je bij aan een omgeving waarin mensen zich betrokken voelen en werken aan gezamenlijke doelen.

 

  • Onafhankelijke en reflectieve houding: je hebt een onafhankelijke, kritische en constructieve houding, staat open voor feedback, kunt je eigen handelen kritisch evalueren en wilt continu blijven leren.

 

Nieuwsgierig?

Ben jij dé ondernemende en daadkrachtige Chief Financial Officer (CFO) die strategie weet te vertalen naar waarde, nieuwe verdienmodellen tot leven brengt, internationale groei mede realiseert en de organisatie met visie en resultaatgerichtheid stuurt? Solliciteer dan nu en word onderdeel van onze organisatie! Na ontvangst beoordelen wij jouw sollicitatie en nemen we binnen twee werkdagen contact met je op. Zijn wij net als jij positief, dan nodigen we je graag uit voor een eerste sollicitatiegesprek op locatie. Bij een positieve uitkomst volgt een tweede en mogelijk derde sollicitatiegesprek. Ter voorbereiding op het derde sollicitatiegesprek willen we je vragen een assessment te maken, waarmee meer inzicht wordt verkregen in jouw cognitieve capaciteiten, drijfveren en persoonlijkheid. Met jouw goedkeuring bespreken we vervolgens de uitkomsten, behandelen we een casus en wordt een referentie- en achtergrondcheck uitgevoerd. Wil je eerst meer weten over de functie, Voortman Steel Machinery of sollicitatieprocedure, neem dan contact op met Guus Regelink via of 0626393850.

title: Sales Director (International), OTE €150.000 per year | Breda
description:
You hit targets. But what you really want is to build.

You know how to deliver ARR targets. What really gets you going is building a sales organisation that’s ready for the next stage of growth. Sound like you? Read on.

  

Your role
As Sales Director, you’re the CCO’s operational and tactical right hand on sales management. The CCO holds ultimate responsibility for the group result and the strategic relationships. You make sure we deliver our ARR targets, day in, day out. You keep the sales team sharp, focused and on track. Customer Success and expansion also fall under your leadership.

This is explicitly more than running today’s team. You help build tomorrow’s. You translate the group’s growth strategy (vertical specialisation, internationalisation and portfolio expansion) into the commercial capacity and structure we’ll need next. You also help build the playbook that lets sales teams from new acquisitions integrate smoothly into the group.

You report to the CCO. Together with the CCO and the Marketing Director, you form the Commercial MT (CMT). You also work closely with the Leadership Team (LT).

Day to day, you and the Marketing Director make sure the commercial disciplines work together seamlessly: from lead to pipeline to revenue. You make clear agreements on MQLs, SQLs and forecasting. That collaboration has to be ultra-tight.

What you’ll do
Revenue & results

You’re operationally responsible for delivering the group’s ARR targets, day in, day out. That covers new business, upsell and cross-sell, and retention and expansion through Customer Success.

You translate the commercial strategy (set with and by the CCO and the Commercial MT) into concrete sales goals, targets per country and team, and an actionable sales plan.

You drive pipeline, conversion and forecast accuracy. You own the sales funnel from SQL to closed-won, and the expansion funnel within our existing customer base.

You’re responsible for pricing and deal structure within the agreed framework, in line with our margin and growth targets.

Leadership & team
+ You lead and further professionalise the sales team (about 15 FTE) day to day, across all countries where Whitevision operates. That includes visiting our offices and teams at the various locations.
+ You directly lead Customer Success (currently 2 FTE) as part of the broader sales and expansion motion. As the team grows, this structure can grow with it.
+ You decide on team structure, capacity and how accounts and verticals are divided, to fit our international growth.
+ You coach, develop and recruit sales professionals. You also own onboarding and enablement for new colleagues.
+ You drive individual and team performance with clear KPIs and a healthy rhythm of 1:1s, forecast reviews and pipeline meetings.

Building & integrating
+ You set up and safeguard scalable sales processes, CRM and tooling that grow with a fast-growing, international buy-and-build organisation.
+ You own the sales methodology, from qualification through negotiation to closing. You make sure every country and team applies it the same way.
+ You (co-)develop and execute the playbook for integrating sales teams of newly acquired companies: one sales methodology, one CRM, one way of working.
+ You spot operational bottlenecks in the commercial organisation and resolve them.

Collaboration & execution
+ You work closely with the Marketing Director on lead follow-up, campaign ROI, events, partners and a consistent go-to-market.
+ You support the CCO in the commercial execution of strategic partnerships, including AFAS, 4PS, Exact and other partners.
+ You report on sales performance, pipeline and risks to the CCO and the Commercial MT.
+ You travel regularly to our international teams and customers.

About Whitevision

Whitevision is a fast-growing SaaS organisation. We specialise in intelligent document processing and automating document-intensive workflows. Through an ambitious buy-and-build strategy, we’re bringing several software companies together into one strong, international platform. We’re active across Europe, and the US is likely next.

Our mission is clear: build one strong, recognisable and scalable company. One Company. The coming years are all about international growth, integration and commercial professionalisation. For this next phase, we’re looking for a Sales Director who doesn’t just deliver results, but also builds the organisation that makes the next stage of growth possible.

"At Whitevision, we provide a solution that genuinely helps people move forward in their organizations. It enables them to work more efficiently and effectively, allowing them to make a greater impact. Our team is stable and consists of a great mix of experience, personalities, and backgrounds. That diversity is one of our strengths. We also enjoy spending time together outside of work, whether it's a game of padel or a limoncello workshop." Erik, Sales Manager 


What you bring
+ 2–4 years of sales management experience, including at least one year in an end-responsible role (Sales Director or Head of Sales) in B2B SaaS or software.
+ A successful track record of at least 4 years as an individual contributor in SaaS sales.
+ A proven track record of hitting MRR/ARR targets and scaling a sales team in a fast-growing environment.
+ Experience (co-)building a sales organisation. You’ve put structure, process and capacity in place for the next phase, not just run an existing team.
+ You’re data- and process-driven. You build processes, rhythm and discipline, and you steer on data and forecasts.
+ An affinity for Customer Success and retention, alongside new business sales.
+ Experience leading sales teams across multiple countries and cultures. You’re a leader people want to follow, and the teams you’ve led will tell you so.
+ Experience in a scale-up or buy-and-build SaaS environment is a strong plus.
+ You’re a natural sparring partner for marketing. You think in terms of the full funnel, not just your own team.
+ Excellent English. Good Dutch is a plus, as is fluency in a third European language.

Our Whitevision way of working is built on respect, decisiveness, commitment and ambition. These core values are an excellent match with your personality and the way you approach your work. 

 

 

What we offer
+ OTE of €150,000 per year, depending on your experience. We’ll discuss the split, accelerators and caps on the variable part together.
+ A company car, laptop, mobile phone and a solid pension plan.
+ An executive role with direct, operational impact on our commercial result and on building a fast-growing international SaaS organisation.
+ Close collaboration in a small, decisive Commercial MT: the CCO, the Marketing Director and you.
+ The chance to help build tomorrow’s Sales and Customer Success organisation, including integrating new acquisitions.

 

Ready to drive our commercial engine?
Are you the Sales Director who’ll drive Whitevision’s commercial engine? Can you see yourself forming the Commercial MT with the CCO and the Marketing Director? Then we’d love to hear from you.

Excited? Get in touch. We’re curious to hear your story. Want to know more about this vacancy? Call us on +31 (0)76 560 7820.

title: Director of Pricing & Monetization
description:
The world of payment processing is rapidly evolving, and businesses are looking for loyal and strategic partners, to help them grow.

Meet Nuvei, the Canadian fintech company accelerating the business of clients around the world. Nuvei's modular, flexible and scalable technology allows leading companies to accept next-gen payments, offer all payout options and benefit from card issuing, banking, risk and fraud management services. Connecting businesses to their customers in more than 200 markets, with local acquiring in 50 markets, 150 currencies and 700 alternative payment methods, Nuvei provides the technology and insights for customers and partners to succeed locally and globally with one integration.

At Nuvei, we live our core values, and we thrive on solving complex problems. We’re dedicated to continually improving our product and providing relentless customer service.   We are always looking for exceptional talent to join us on the journey!

Your Mission 

We are looking for a Director of Pricing & Monetization, who will be responsible for defining and executing the company's pricing strategy to maximize revenue growth, profitability, and market competitiveness. This leader will develop scalable pricing frameworks, design bundled product offerings, lead willingness-to-pay research, and establish a data-driven approach to pricing across products, industries, customer segments, and geographies. The role sits at the intersection of Commercial, Marketing, Finance, Data Analytics & Product, ensuring pricing decisions balance customer value, competitive positioning, profitability, and growth objectives. 

Responsibilities 

Pricing Framework Development 

  • Design and maintain the company's enterprise-wide pricing framework. 
  • Develop attribute-based pricing models across products, industries, geographies, customer segments, and risk profiles. 
  • Establish pricing governance, policies, guardrails, and decision-making frameworks. 
  • Create methodologies for standard pricing, exception pricing, strategic discounts, and deal approvals. 
  • Define pricing architecture for new products and market launches. 

Bundling & Monetization Strategy 

  • Design and implement bundled product and service offerings that maximize customer value and company profitability. 
  • Identify opportunities to unbundle and re-bundle products to improve monetization and customer segmentation. 
  • Develop packaging strategies across core products, value-added services, premium features, and subscriptions. 
  • Partner with Product Management to create tiered "Good-Better-Best" pricing structures. 
  • Measure bundle performance and continuously optimize package economics. 

Willingness-to-Pay & Customer Research 

  • Lead willingness-to-pay studies and pricing research programs. 
  • Develop segmentation models based on customer value perception and purchasing behavior. 
  • Conduct customer interviews, surveys, conjoint analysis, Van Westendorp studies, and other pricing methodologies. 
  • Identify pricing drivers by industry, customer size, region, and product category. 
  • Translate customer insights into actionable pricing recommendations. 

Market & Competitive Intelligence 

  • Build and maintain a competitive pricing intelligence program. 
  • Monitor competitor pricing structures, packaging strategies, discounting practices, and market trends. 
  • Conduct benchmarking analyses to evaluate pricing position versus competitors. 
  • Identify emerging monetization strategies and disruptive pricing models. 
  • Provide executive recommendations on pricing actions required to maintain market competitiveness. 

Pricing Analytics & Optimization 

  • Develop pricing elasticity models and price-volume curves. 
  • Establish analytical frameworks to measure profitability, margin performance, and pricing effectiveness. 
  • Evaluate revenue impact of pricing changes before deployment. 
  • Track pricing KPIs and identify opportunities for revenue optimization. 
  • Support AI-driven and data-driven pricing initiatives. 

Cross-Functional Leadership 

  • Partner closely with Product, Finance, Commercial, Revenue Operations, Marketing, and Data teams. 
  • Influence product roadmap decisions through monetization insights. 
  • Support executive leadership on strategic pricing investments and initiatives. 
  • Lead pricing councils, governance forums, and strategic pricing reviews. 
  • Manage and develop a high-performing pricing team. 

Qualifications 

  • 8+ years of experience in Pricing, Strategy, Product Management, Revenue Management, Consulting, or Commercial Excellence. 
  • 4+ years leading pricing strategy or monetization initiatives. 
  • Demonstrated experience building pricing frameworks and governance models. 
  • Strong background in market research and willingness-to-pay methodologies. 
  • Experience designing pricing bundles, packaging strategies, and commercial offers. 
  • Experience driving pricing transformations in complex organizations. 

Preferred Experience 

  • Payments, fintech, SaaS, software, technology, telecommunications, financial services, or marketplace experience. 
  • Experience with CPQ platforms, pricing systems, and revenue management tools. 
  • Knowledge of advanced pricing analytics, AI-driven pricing, and revenue optimization. 

Benefits

Nuvei is an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates collaboration and innovation and is committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace. The team at Nuvei is comprised of a wealth of talent, skill, and ambition. We believe that employees are happiest when they’re empowered to be their true, authentic selves. description:
IHR START BEI PRAXISEINS.

Sie haben Medizin studiert, um Patienten zu behandeln und nicht um Formulare auszufüllen, KV-Anfragen zu beantworten und IT-Ausfälle zu managen? Als inhabergeführter und staatlich unterstützter Gesundheitsversorger hat PraxisEins es sich zum Ziel gemacht, die hausärztliche Versorgung zu sichern und dabei Qualitätsmedizin zu ermöglichen!

In unseren modernen Hausarztzentren können Sie sich ganz auf die Medizin konzentrieren. Wir legen Wert auf moderne Diagnostik, digitalisierte Abläufe, ärztliche Fortbildung, ein gutes Teamgefüge und ärztlichen Austausch im Team.

WAS WIR IHNEN BIETEN:

  • Medizin im Mittelpunkt: Sie fokussieren sich auf die Behandlung Ihrer Patienten – den Rest übernehmen wir!

  • Qualitätsmedizin: Unsere Standorte verfügen über modernste Diagnostik und digitalisierte Praxisabläufe; ein kollegialer Austausch ist uns wichtig

  • Attraktive Vergütung und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: Sie erhalten ein übertarifliches Gehalt - bei sehr guter Leistung bietet sich in unserer Gruppe die Möglichkeit des Aufstiegs zur ärztlichen Leitung mit einem attraktiven Partnerschaftsmodell

  • Strukturierte Fortbildung: Mit den organisierten Qualitätszirkeln unserer PraxisEins-Akademie bieten wir Ihnen leitlinienkonforme interne Fortbildungen

  • Lebenslanges Lernen: Fortbildungstage und eine finanzielle Förderung für ärztliche Fortbildungen sind bei uns eine Selbstverständlichkeit

  • Vereinbarkeit mit der Familie: Keine Pflicht-Dienste und 35 Tage Urlaub (inkl. Fortbildungstagen) - zudem bestehen Möglichkeiten für Teilzeitmodelle und (bei Interesse) Videosprechstunden im Home-Office

IHRE AUFGABEN:

  • Sie fokussieren sich auf die Patientenversorgung und bringen sich als Teil des Praxisteams ein

IHR PROFIL:

  • Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Facharztausbildung der Allgemeinmedizin oder Inneren Medizin

  • Sie konnten (idealerweise) erste Erfahrungen im niedergelassenen Bereich sammeln

  • Sie haben (idealerweise) bereits hausärztlich relevante Fortbildungen oder Zusatzbezeichnungen absolviert (z.B. Psychosomatische Grundversorgung, Diabetologie, Hypertensiologie, Palliativmedizin)

Über PraxisEins

PraxisEins ist ein staatlich unterstützter Gesundheitsversorger mit einem Fokus auf den Bereichen der hausärztlichen Versorgung, Diabetologie und Schmerztherapie.

Unsere Mission

Versorgung sichern - Qualitätsmedizin gewährleisten. Als PraxisEins wollen wir die Primärversorgung zukunftsfähig machen – mit digitaler Unterstützung, klaren Prozessen und einem Umfeld, in dem Ärztinnen und Ärzte Medizin wieder mit Freude ausüben können!

PraxisEins ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert und Vielfalt schätzt. Wir freuen uns über alle Bewerbungen und bearbeiten diese völlig unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religionszugehörigkeit, Hautfarbe, Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Familienstand oder Behindertenstatus. Zur besseren Lesbarkeit wird in dieser Stellenanzeige das generische Maskulinum verwendet.

title: Associate Director- Sustainability & Impact (Lyon, France)
description:
Location : Lyon, France

About ARCHIMED:

With offices in Europe, North America and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare industries. Its mix of operational, medical, scientific and financial expertise allows ARCHIMED to serve as both a strategic and financial partner to healthcare businesses. Prioritized areas of focus include Biopharma Products, Consumer Health, Healthcare IT, In Vitro Diagnostics, Life Science Tools & Biologic Services, MedTech, and Pharma Services.

ARCHIMED helps partners internationalize, acquire, innovate and expand their products and services. ARCHIMED manages €8 billion across its various funds, including the largest healthcare-only private equity fund raised by a European-based General Partner. Since inception, ARCHIMED has been a committed Impact investor, both directly and through its EURÊKA Foundation.

The Team

• An international team (with more than 30 nationalities) with complementary education and experience in the investment, medical, scientific, strategic and operational sectors

• Composed of alumni from: INSEAD, Berkeley, Georgetown, Bocconi, HEC Paris, Ponts et Chaussées, ESSEC, Imperial College, Dartmouth, etc.

• Professional backgrounds: Private Equity (3i, Siparex, USS Ltd, Barings, capiton), Consulting (A.T. Kearney, Bain, McKinsey), M&A (Lazard, EY, KPMG, PwC), Industry (Biotronik, Cerba, Pharmacy, Veterinary)


Your Role

Portfolio engagement and value creation

  • Lead portfolio engagement on Sustainability and Impact (S&I), providing hands-on support to portfolio companies and tracking S&I progress across ARCHIMED’s portfolios through dashboards, KPIs, and supporting processes.
  • Lead select portfolio value creation projects, collaborating with deal teams as well as guiding and project managing S&I interns where required.
  • Develop and oversee the execution of actionable S&I roadmaps for each portfolio company, with targets and milestones based on the company’s materiality analysis and aligned with ARCHIMED’s S&I strategy, partnering with third-party technical experts when necessary.
  • Influence portfolio company management to advance their roadmaps through technical guidance and sharing of best practices.

Investment process

  • Act as the bridge between deal teams and external providers during due diligence, critically assessing findings to confirm that each target is consistent with ARCHIMED’s S&I strategy and fund obligations.
  • Work with all ARCHIMED functions to review and improve how S&I is integrated into investment decision making.

Data, reporting, and compliance

  • Establish the tools and framework to collect, monitor, and coordinate S&I data across funds, enabling timely, accurate, and consistent reporting, and select third-party technical experts when necessary.
  • Analyze and interpret S&I data and substantially contribute to the production of ARCHIMED’s annual S&I report in line with industry standards and frameworks, turning data into clear narratives.
  • Contribute substantially to regular reporting to investors and to mandatory disclosures on fund S&I performance, ensuring credibility and transparency.
  • Monitor regulatory developments in ARCHIMED’s locations and sectors of focus, and help ensure compliance with sustainability-related requirements.

Center of excellence and capability building

  • Establish an S&I center of excellence across funds and portfolio companies, with tools, reports, and training materials that share guidance and best practices.
  • Provide expert guidance and S&I training to management, investment, and investor relations teams to deepen integration across the business.

Requirements

  • At least 10 years’ experience building and executing sustainability strategies, preferably in private equity.
  • Proven hands-on leadership, initiative, and project management skills, with strong problem-solving ability.
  • Robust knowledge of S&I frameworks and disclosures, including SFDR, SASB, CSRD, EDCI, PMDR, and the UN SDGs.
  • Strong command of impact measurement methodologies, including developing and reporting on impact metrics.
  • Strong attention to detail, with the ability to build coherent sustainability narratives and proofread content.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, with the adaptability to engage C-suite executives internationally.
  • Proven team player, able to build working partnerships and promote collaboration with a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Ability to coach junior team members, sharing knowledge and giving regular feedback.
  • Pragmatic, constructive, creative, and solution-oriented, with a positive mindset and the ability to work under varied pressures.

title: Head of Performance Marketing – Meta Ads (m/w/d)
description:
❗️ Lies das, bevor du weiterscrollst: Das hier ist nichts für Einsteiger und nichts für Leute, die einen entspannten Job suchen. Wir suchen eine Marketing-Maschine: jemanden, der liefert, skaliert und uns zeigt, wie es geht, nicht andersherum.

Wenn du das bist, bekommst du bei uns Verantwortung, Freiraum und eine erfolgsabhängige Vergütung ohne Limit 🔥💸 Ob fest angestellt oder als Freelancer: Wichtig ist, dass du liefern kannst.

Wir sind ein junges, 2016 gegründetes E-Commerce Startup aus Minden. Wir vertreiben physische und digitale Produkte im Kosmetik-Nageldesign Bereich. 💅 Mit dem Lynis Nailshop und der Lynis-Nailacademy wollen wir schnell weiter wachsen. Im Marketing steckt das größte Potenzial, und genau dort fehlt uns die Person, die es hebt.

Du baust unser Performance Marketing auf Meta und das Team dahinter eigenständig auf. Wir geben dir Ziele, Budget und Vertrauen. Den Fahrplan bringst du mit. Am Anfang arbeitest du mit unserem bestehenden Team. In 12 Monaten steht unter deiner Führung ein eigenes Marketing-Team mit 3–5 Leuten. Dein Baby ist alles, was Marketing betrifft: Media Buying auf Meta, Funnels, Offers, Creatives, Zahlen und Menschen. Du entscheidest, wir erwarten Ergebnisse.

Aufgaben

  • Meta aufbauen und skalieren: Du erkennst Chancen auf Meta, testest Zielgruppen, Kampagnen und Creatives und skalierst, was funktioniert. Und stoppst sofort, was nicht funktioniert.

  • Funnels & Advertorials: Du baust performanceorientierte Funnels inklusive Advertorials und Landingpages und holst entlang des gesamten Funnels alles raus (Full-Funnel-Optimierung, CRO, A/B-Tests).

  • Offer-Creation: Du entwickelst Offers, die sich verkaufen: für neue Zielgruppen und für Bestandskunden.

  • Creatives & Copywriting: Du steuerst Ad-Scripting, Creative-Entwicklung und Copywriting und weißt, was konvertiert.

  • KPIs & Controlling: Du lebst in den KPIs. Du analysierst alle Produkte und Kampagnen, optimierst laufend und steuerst Agenturen so, dass sie liefern.

  • Team aufbauen und führen: Du stellst in den nächsten 12 Monaten ein eigenes Marketing-Team mit 3–5 Leuten zusammen, gibst Ziele vor, forderst Leistung ein und entwickelst deine Leute weiter. Bis dahin greifst du auf unser bestehendes Team zurück. Du entscheidest, wen du brauchst.

Klingt nach deinem Ding? Dann los! 🤝

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige, nachweisbare Erfahrung im Performance Marketing, am besten im E-Commerce/D2C. Du nennst uns Zahlen, wir keine Ausreden.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Media Buying auf Meta, Funnels, Advertorials, Offer-Creation und KPIs aus eigener Praxis, nicht nur aus Kursen

  • Keine Angst vor Zahlen: Du hast bereits hohe Werbebudgets eigenverantwortlich gesteuert.

  • Führungserfahrung, oder klar belegbar, dass du ein Team aufbauen und führen kannst

  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung, Tempo und Entscheidungsstärke: Du wartest nicht auf Anweisungen

  • Du packst selbst an, wo es nötig ist, und scheust Arbeit nicht

  • Von Vorteil: Shopify, JTL-Warenwirtschaft, Adobe Premiere/Illustrator/Photoshop und Erfahrung im Nageldesign-Bereich

Das ist nichts für dich, wenn du auf Ausbildung oder Anleitung wartest, einen ruhigen Job mit festen Feierabendzeiten suchst oder Ergebnisse lieber erklärst, als sie zu liefern.

Das ist genau dein Ding, wenn du Zahlen liebst, ein Team führen und mit ihm gewinnen willst und sagst: „Gebt mir Verantwortung und Freiraum, ich liefere.“

Benefits

  • Erfolgsabhängige Vergütung ohne Limit: Wir messen unser Marketing sauber. Du wirst direkt an dem beteiligt, was du erreichst. Je mehr du bewegst, desto mehr verdienst du. Als Angestellte:r mit Fixgehalt plus Beteiligung, als Freelancer mit Honorar plus Beteiligung.

  • Volle Verantwortung: Hauptverantwortliche:r für Marketing, mit Entscheidungsfreiheit über Strategie, Kanäle und Budget und deinem eigenen Team

title: Technical Business Development Intern (Emerging Verticals) (f/m/d)
description:
Description

QuantumDiamonds is building the world's first commercial quantum sensing tools for chip failure analysis. Our Quantum Diamond Microscope (QDm) images magnetic fields with micrometer resolution, and that capability could matter far beyond semiconductors. As our Technical Business Development Intern for Emerging Verticals in the Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development, you help us find out where.

Working directly with our project lead for Emerging Verticals, who mentors you, you explore new application fields for widefield magnetic imaging. You dig into the science and the markets behind them, talk to potential customers and users, and help turn promising ideas into first feasibility studies with our magnetic field imaging system. You see how a deep tech company decides where its technology goes next, and help shape that decision.

This is a full-time internship for 6 months, starting as soon as possible.

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join Quantum Diamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

 
 

What will you do

  • Map and evaluate application areas for magnetic field imaging beyond semiconductors: key players, customer segments and structured comparisons of use cases.

  • Review scientific literature and patents to understand the state of the art, competing measurement methods, and where NV-based imaging offers a real advantage.

  • Prepare and join discovery conversations with researchers and companies to understand their measurement challenges, and keep contacts and opportunities up to date in our CRM.

  • Support feasibility studies with our experts, from defining suitable samples to interpreting first measurement results.

  • Turn your findings into clear deliverables such as application one-pagers, decision memos, and presentations.

 

What is expected of you

  • Enrolled in or recently graduated from a degree program in physics, engineering, materials science, chemistry, biophysics, or a related natural science or engineering field, ideally with some Python exposure.

  • Available full time for 6 months, starting as soon as possible.

  • Curiosity about how a new measurement technology can solve problems in fields you may not know yet.

  • Clear writing and structured analysis: you turn a pile of papers and conversations into a one-page recommendation.

  • AI tools are part of how you research, analyze and write, and you check their output the way you check your own.

  • Fluent in English. On-site in Munich.

Business studies or first experience in market research, consulting, or a startup is a plus, not required.

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

  • Mentoring: An experienced colleague from the team mentors you throughout your internship.

  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 24 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

At SAP Fioneer we believe in building the future of financial services. Join us on a transformative journey as a part of our Graduate Program L.I.F.T = Level up in Fioneer Technology! 

You will embark on a journey to kickstart your career within a global software company with a start-up mentality. Here, you'll be tackling real tasks and contributing to impactful projects from day one. Immersing yourself in a dynamic environment, whether it's engaging with clients or diving into product development. We believe in your potential, providing ample time for learning and growth, ensuring that you become fully productive as soon as possible.  

This is an extremely unique advantage of being part of the SAP Family with the advantages of a start-up like fast growing organization: the freedom to create and entrepreneurial ways of working in a talent-centric organization with great career opportunities arising. 

This is your chance to work with passionate professionals and the best experts in the industry - have an impact, create true value. So what are you waiting for, check out what it takes to become part of our L.I.F.T Program! 

What will I be doing?

Start your career in software quality assurance and testing while working on innovative cloud-based solutions built on the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP). As a Graduate Quality Assurance & Test Engineer, you will help ensure the quality, reliability, security, and performance of applications across the Customer Portal, Document Management, and Monitoring modules. You will learn modern testing methodologies, collaborate closely with developers and product teams, and gain hands-on experience with SAP technologies, automation, and emerging AI-driven solutions.

Your Responsibilities

  • Support the planning, execution, and documentation of testing activities for the Customer Portal, Document Management, and Monitoring modules
  • Assist in setting up and maintaining test and development environments, including test simulators for integration scenarios with external systems
  • Create and maintain test cases and test scenarios for SAP BTP applications and services built with RAP and CAP
  • Support testing of authentication and authorization functionality to ensure secure access management
  • Work with anonymized and synthetic test data in line with data protection and security requirements
  • Help validate functional and non-functional requirements, including performance, accessibility, privacy, and security standards
  • Identify, document, and track software defects while collaborating with development teams to support resolution
  • Participate in integration, user acceptance, and release testing activities
  • Support automated testing and regression testing to help ensure software quality before releases
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within an agile development environment

Requirements

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related field, or expected graduation within the next few months
  • Foundational knowledge of software testing gained through university projects, internships, working student roles, or personal projects
  • Interest in software quality assurance, test automation, and cloud technologies
  • Basic understanding of software development concepts and modern application architectures
  • Strong attention to detail and a structured, analytical approach to problem-solving
  • Ability to work collaboratively in agile and cross-functional teams
  • Good written and spoken English skills
  • Eagerness to learn and develop expertise in SAP technologies and quality engineering practices

Nice to have:

  • Initial exposure to software testing tools or test automation frameworks
  • Basic knowledge of SAP BTP, RAP, or CAP through coursework, internships, or personal learning
  • Familiarity with concepts related to authentication, authorization, or application security
  • Understanding of accessibility standards and inclusive software design principles
  • Exposure to performance testing, security testing, or penetration testing concepts
  • Interest in Artificial Intelligence, Agentic AI, or intelligent automation solutions
  • German language skills are beneficial but not required

Benefits

  • Diverse career paths in Development, Consulting, Co-Innovation, and Sales 
  • No rigid paths here – we believe in growing together 
  • Embrace our ethos: Own it, become it 
  • Find work-life balance with both on-site and remote options. 
  • Drive direct impact and create true value. 
  • Enjoy competitive compensation, a fast-paced learning path and mentorship

Deployment Strategist - German Speaking
description:
About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Deployment Strategist to join our team. In this role, you'll partner with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) across the full deployment lifecycle, from first discovery conversation to live production. You'll lead use case discovery and scoping with senior customer stakeholders, ship prototypes hands-on to prove value early, then stay close to the build through delivery to bring the strategic, business-value lens to every decision. You're the partner who keeps the work pointed at the highest-impact outcomes, ready to pick up the keyboard alongside the FDE when the moment calls for it.

We're looking for engineers with strategic instincts: people who can write code, but whose deepest strength is the strategic, opinionated lens they bring across every phase of a deployment - spotting where value lives, scoping it realistically, and partnering with engineers to capture it from prototype to production.

At HappyRobot, there's no role seniority or hierarchy. We operate as a team of builders. We execute, we build, we own, and we care deeply about our customers and their success.

What You'll do

  • Strategic Leadership and Use Case Discovery: Partner with Global and Regional C-Level executives and VPs to assess AI opportunities and prioritize the highest-impact use cases. Lead curiosity-driven discovery that surfaces the workflows where AI creates the most business value, well beyond what the customer thought to ask for. Build the trusted relationships that let you present findings and challenge assumptions at the most senior levels, keeping technical delivery aligned with their business priorities.

  • Scoping: Frame impact versus effort with rigor on both axes. On business value, pressure-test the realistic upside, question whether the use case as posed will actually deliver the most impact, and explore whether reframing it or pivoting to an adjacent process would unlock more. The art is deeply understanding how to maximize value of this use case for the customer, not just delivering what was asked for. On technical effort, map integrations, data, and platform constraints, and surface the edge cases and dependencies that shape timelines. Land on a plan that's realistic on both.

  • Prototyping: Build prototypes and demos hands-on. Use our platform and AI-powered coding tools to test ideas end-to-end at light scope. Prove value early, before the customer commits.

  • Program Management: Coordinate work across the active deployments in an account. Be the escalation point for the customer and the watchout partner for the FDE. Stay close enough to the build that you both understand the use case deeply, spot opportunities to capture more value, and catch when work is drifting from the highest-impact path.

  • Prioritization: Sequence use cases within an account so each deployment compounds the next. Make the call on what gets built when, what gets parked, and where to invest discovery and building time.

  • Customer Partnership: Be the main business-side point of contact for the account. Build trust with operational and executive stakeholders day-to-day. Translate AI capabilities into language they can act on.

  • Onsite Embedding: Travel onsite for kickoffs, mapping sessions, and key moments where being on the ground changes the outcome.

  • Product Feedback Loop: Bring field signal back to Product and Engineering. Identify reusable patterns, common edge cases, and where the platform needs to evolve.

Must Have

  • Background that mixes technical depth with strategic instinct, and a real history of building things. Common paths include engineering (Computer Science, electrical, industrial, systems), data science, founding a tech startup, product management, or technical / strategic consulting.

  • Comfortable coding -mostly Python- using LLMs and AI-powered tools like Claude Code to ship prototypes fast.

  • Working understanding of APIs, integrations, and how AI agents sit inside enterprise workflows.

  • Strategic instinct: ability to spot the business value behind a workflow and translate it into impact, effort, and prioritization terms a C-level can act on.

  • Excellent communication skills with both executives and operators. Comfortable translating between business and technical without losing either side.

  • Proven ability to prioritize ruthlessly across multiple workstreams and drive outcomes, not just activity.

  • Founder mindset: highly independent, takes ownership, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

Why join us?

  • Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

  • Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

  • Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

  • Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

  • Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

Our Operating Principles


Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.
