title: Enterprise Account Executive - German Speaking
description:
Ready to Take on a New Challenge in Enterprise Sales?

Are you a driven, energetic sales professional looking for your next big adventure? Do you thrive on taking ownership, unlocking strategic accounts, and closing complex, high-value deals in a fast-paced environment? Are you excited by cutting-edge technology in a dynamic industry, and motivated by the opportunity to make a measurable impact; not just on your career, but on the world?

If so, we want to hear from you.

Where You’ll Make an Impact:

  • As an Enterprise Account Executive, you’ll join our high-performing EMEA sales team, reporting to the Regional Sales Manager and VP EMEA. You'll take full ownership of your territory and become a trusted advisor to stakeholders across the Crypto and Financial Services landscape.

  • You’re not just here to sell, you’re here to transform how leading enterprises combat crypto crime with Elliptic’s industry-leading compliance and investigation solutions. You’ll gain deep product expertise and apply your understanding of evolving global and regional regulations to build compelling business cases that speak directly to our customers’ pain points.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone looking for a role where you can make an impact not just on the company you work for but also on the market you work in. Fascinating and challenging work is the norm - working at Elliptic is never boring!

What you will do:

  • Run the full enterprise sales cycle, from pipeline generation to deal closure, across a territory with massive potential and that has considerable inbound interest.

  • Proactively identify, engage, and convert strategic enterprise accounts (including pre-defined targets and new prospects).

  • Develop and execute multi-threaded sales strategies to engage diverse stakeholders (compliance, legal, risk, procurement, tech, C-level).

  • Handle 5-, 6- and 7-figure deal cycles with skill, creativity, and precision leveraging persuasion, influence, and value based selling techniques.

  • Drive account expansion through timely up-sell and cross-sell opportunities, maximizing value delivered to our customers.

  • Partner with global peers to collaborate on multi-region and strategic global accounts with long-term growth potential.

  • Collaborate with internal sales engineers, product experts, customer success, and marketing, as well as partner channels, to expand your reach and velocity.

  • Stay ahead of industry shifts and translate emerging challenges into opportunities for Elliptic’s solution suite.

  • Represent Elliptic at key industry events and conferences to strengthen relationships and identify new prospects.

  • Be an ambassador of the Elliptic brand, living our values of curiosity, trust, and action in every interaction.

What you will achieve in the first 6 months:

  • Completed Elliptic's product certifications and onboarding processes.

  • Mapped your territory, identified your top 20 target accounts, and built a qualified pipeline of at least 3x your quarterly quota through a combination of inbound, outbound, and partner-sourced opportunities.

  • Identified upsell or cross-sell motion in an existing Elliptic account in your territory and have it actively in play to build a qualified pipeline of at least 2x of your quarterly quota through proactive whitespace mapping and engagement in collaboration with the Customer Success Managers.

  • Run complete discovery cycles with at least 10 enterprise prospects, using the Value Pyramid to connect client pain points to our solutions, applying MEDDPPICC to qualify or disqualify with confidence, and have a clear view of what you're walking away from and why.

  • Progressed at least 2 opportunities to late-stage negotiation and closed your first deal, demonstrating you can manage the full enterprise cycle from initial engagement through legal and procurement.

  • Built multi-threaded relationships across your strategic accounts - compliance, risk, and C-suite - not just a single champion per account.

  • Earned a reputation internally with your SE, CS, marketing, and partner team as a well-prepared, collaborative account owner who closes the loop and uses internal resources without wasting them.

You will be a great fit here if you are:

  • A driven, tenacious “hunter” who thrives on owning their number and finding creative ways to exceed it.

  • Experienced in B2B enterprise SaaS and/or DaaS sales within RegTech, FinTech, and/or Crypto.

  • A proven track record of consistently closing successful enterprise deals across multiple years and companies.

  • Comfortable leading complex, long-cycle and large deals involving multiple stakeholders, but also agile enough to take on quick-close 5-figure deals.

  • Commercially curious, you ask smart questions, seek to understand the "why" behind a customer’s problems, and use those insights to tailor impactful solutions.

  • Confident, consultative, and persuasive, able to build strong stakeholder relationships at all levels, from mid-level managers to C-suites.

  • A collaborative team player, independent yet never a “lone wolf.” You value and engage support from your pack.

  • Agile, resourceful, and fearless, you see opportunity where others see blockers and know how to create inroads where none appear to exist.

  • Willingness to travel to customers and industry events and conduct business face to face.

Our ideal candidate has:

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills and the ability to establish meaningful relationships with C-suite and executive stakeholders.

  • Technical acumen with the ability to establish credibility with technical decision makers.

  • Driven and solutions-oriented: you know how to navigate roadblocks and keep deals moving forward.

  • Familiarity with the MEDDPPICC methodology and Value Based Selling.

  • Proficiency in CRM systems (HubSpot or similar), LLMs and other AI-driven prospecting and work efficiency tools.

  • Passionate about generative AI and excited to help customers navigate a rapidly evolving industry.

Bonus Points for:

  • An existing network of connections across the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) space.

  • Fluency in French, German, Spanish, or Italian.

  • A proven use case and understanding of agentic AI is a strong plus.

Ultimately we are looking to hire those who want to be the future leaders in the industry, super intrigued by Crypto and have an awesome mindset to learn so if you don’t meet all the criteria still do apply!

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary

  • Share Options

  • Holiday - 25 days

  • Private Health Insurance

  • Collaborative, flexible and friendly environment: We understand that flexibility is the key to maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

  • Social events, which include regular team lunch on us, quarterly full day events and an annual company 3-day event - this year these are taking place virtually

  • Personal training budget & LinkedIn Learning subscription

We know Diversity and Inclusion is much deeper than just hiring, but it’s important for us to mention it here. title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
About pplwise

pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

About our client: Filics

Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Supply Chain Manager (m/f/d) at Filics, you will build the supply chain that takes the robots into series production.

About the role

This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.
Filics robots are built from hundreds of components. Many come from a single source, and most aren’t under contract yet. Moving from prototypes to series production, one missing part can stop the whole line. Your job is to build a robust supply chain from scratch. It needs to know exactly what Filics depends on, secure those parts before they become a risk, and hold up as volumes grow, all while production is already running. You take full ownership of how every component is sourced, secured and managed.
You’ll work closely with Engineering, which owns the technical specs and qualifies suppliers and alternative components. Assembly depends on reliable supply to plan builds. Leadership sets volume commitments based on your analysis.

What you’ll do

  • Identify critical dependencies, lock in availability through supplier contracts, and qualify alternatives so no single source can stop production

  • Set up the ERP and the systems the supply chain runs on, including supplier quality tracking

  • Define clear quality criteria for suppliers and components together with Engineering

  • Give the assembly team the forward visibility they need to plan builds

  • Turn supply analysis into input for Leadership’s volume commitments

  • Once supply is robust, reduce component prices toward a leaner bill of materials

About you

  • Several years in supply chain, procurement or sourcing for hardware products (e.g. robotics, automotive, machinery, electronics)

  • Proven experience moving products from prototype to series production

  • A solid grasp of BOMs, component sourcing, supplier qualification and supplier quality

  • Strong negotiation skills and experience closing supplier contracts

  • A hands-on, structured approach: you prioritize well, work comfortably without defined processes, and deliver

  • Clear, concise communication in English and German

What Filics offers

  • Full ownership of a function you build yourself, with direct impact on getting the robots into series production

  • A small, ambitious team where initiative leads to responsibility

  • Work on a first-of-its-kind product in intralogistics

  • An on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to Engineering and Assembly

Sound like you? Apply with your CV.

description:

So löst sich Filics von der klassischen Staplerlogik und setzt einen neuen Standard für Effizienz. Das kleine Team packt selbst mit an und löst schwierige Probleme mit exzellenter Ingenieursarbeit. Verantwortung bekommt, wer Initiative zeigt und zuverlässig liefert. Als Supply Chain Manager (m/w/d) bei Filics baust du die Lieferkette auf, mit der die Roboter in Serie gehen.

Über die Rolle

Die Position ist onsite bzw. hybrid in München angesiedelt, nah an Engineering und Montage.
Die Roboter von Filics bestehen aus hunderten Komponenten. Viele davon kommen von nur einem Lieferanten, und die meisten sind noch nicht vertraglich abgesichert. Auf dem Weg vom Prototyp in die Serienfertigung kann ein einziges fehlendes Teil die ganze Linie stoppen. Deine Aufgabe ist deshalb, eine robuste Supply Chain von Grund auf aufzubauen. Sie soll genau wissen, wovon Filics abhängt, Risiken frühzeitig absichern und mit steigenden Stückzahlen mitwachsen, und das alles, während die Produktion bereits läuft. Du übernimmst die volle Verantwortung dafür, wie jede Komponente beschafft, abgesichert und gemanagt wird.
Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Engineering zusammen. Engineering verantwortet die technischen Spezifikationen und qualifiziert Lieferanten und alternative Bauteile. Die Montage braucht eine verlässliche Versorgung, um Builds zu planen. Die Geschäftsführung legt auf Basis deiner Analysen die Volumenzusagen fest.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Kritische Abhängigkeiten identifizieren, Verfügbarkeit über Lieferantenverträge sichern und Alternativen qualifizieren, damit keine Single-Source-Abhängigkeit die Produktion stoppt

  • ERP und die Systeme aufbauen, auf denen die Supply Chain läuft, inklusive Tracking der Lieferantenqualität

  • Gemeinsam mit Engineering klare Qualitätskriterien für Lieferanten und Komponenten definieren

  • Der Montage die Vorausschau geben, die sie für die Planung der Builds braucht

  • Supply-Analysen in Entscheidungsgrundlagen für die Volumenzusagen der Geschäftsführung übersetzen

  • Sobald die Versorgung steht, Komponentenpreise senken und die Stückliste (BOM) schlanker machen

Über Dich

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Supply Chain, Einkauf oder Sourcing für Hardware-Produkte (z. B. Robotik, Automotive, Maschinenbau, Elektronik)

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung auf dem Weg vom Prototyp in die Serienfertigung

  • Fundiertes Verständnis von Stücklisten, Komponentenbeschaffung, Lieferantenqualifizierung und Lieferantenqualität

  • Ausgeprägtes Verhandlungsgeschick und Erfahrung im Abschluss von Lieferantenverträgen

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise mit Hands-on-Mentalität: Du setzt die richtigen Prioritäten, arbeitest gern ohne festgelegte Prozesse und lieferst

  • Klare, präzise Kommunikation auf Deutsch und Englisch

Das bietet Filics

  • Volle Verantwortung für eine Funktion, die du selbst aufbaust, mit direktem Einfluss darauf, dass die Roboter in Serie gehen

  • Ein kleines, ambitioniertes Team, in dem Initiative zu Verantwortung führt

  • Arbeit an einem Produkt, das es in der Intralogistik so noch nicht gibt

  • Eine Onsite- bzw. Hybrid-Rolle in München, nah an Engineering und Montage

TEAMSPIRIT & TEAMEVENTS: Freu dich auf eine kollegiale Atmosphäre mit flachen Hierarchien, jede Menge Spaß und großartigem Teamspirit sowie regelmäßige Teamevents wie gemeinsame Sportsessions, Grillabende oder einfach nur ein Feierabenddrink an deiner Station.

CAMPER BUDGET: Du bekommst eine jährliche Freimiete für unsere Camper, damit du den #happyroadsurfing Lifestyle selbst erleben kannst.

DISCOUNTS UND BENEFITS: Nutze unsere Corporate Benefits Plattform, die Travel Industry Card und Family & Friends Rabatte.

Du hast langjährige Erfahrung im Flottenmanagement, Fuhrparkmanagement oder als Werkstattleiter:in und willst Verantwortung für eine Flotte von über 4.000 Campern und Wohnmobilen übernehmen? Dann suchen wir dich als Head of Fleet (intern: Market Fleet Manager) für die Region DACH – mit Budget- und Personalverantwortung für über 40 Stationen.

Die Rolle – deine Leidenschaft

Als Head of Fleet bzw. Market Fleet Manager – DACH bist du ein zentrales Mitglied des DACH Operations Leadership Teams, berichtest direkt an den Business Director – DACH und arbeitest eng mit den Regional Operations Managern zusammen.

Du führst alle Regional Fleet Manager in den 5 DACH-Regionen und verantwortest indirekt die Fleet Manager, Kfz-Mechatroniker:innen und Techniker:innen, Damage Detection Experts und Ersatzteil-Spezialist:innen für über 4.000 Fahrzeuge an mehr als 40 Stationen.
Deine Mission: Fahrzeugverfügbarkeit, Reparaturdurchlaufzeiten, Kosteneffizienz und Qualität im gesamten Markt voranzutreiben – damit unsere Flotte reibungslos läuft und unser Betrieb Höchstleistungen bringt.

  • Du verantwortest das Budget für Instandhaltung, Wartung, Reparatur und Fahrzeugtransfers (Budgetverantwortung) und stellst kosteneffiziente, hochwertige Reparaturen im gesamten Markt sicher, etwa durch Reparaturstrategie, Werkstattnetzwerk und Ersatzteilbestand

  • Du legst auf Basis von Schadensberichten und operativen Prioritäten die Reparaturstrategie für jedes Fahrzeug fest und steuerst das Schadensmanagement

  • Du sicherst eine hohe Fahrzeugverfügbarkeit, indem du Werkstattkapazitäten, Terminplanung und Ersatzteillogistik koordinierst

  • Du baust das interne und externe Werkstattnetzwerk inkl. Lieferanten- und Dienstleistersteuerung auf und optimierst es, um Durchlaufzeiten und Kosteneffizienz zu verbessern

  • Du führst und entwickelst die Fleet-Teams an den Stationen (Fleet Manager, Techniker:innen, Damage Detection Experts) und sorgst für konstante Leistung und technische Kompetenz, hohe Schadenserkennungsquoten und einen passenden Ersatzteilbestand

  • Du verfolgst zentrale KPIs wie Reparaturkosten, Reparaturdauer und Genauigkeit der Schadenserkennung und treibst strategische Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung voran

Was du brauchst, um mit uns die Welle zu reiten

  • Studium oder Ausbildung im Maschinenbau, in der Fahrzeugtechnik (z.B. KFZ-Meister:in, KFZ-Mechatroniker:in, Techniker:in, Ingenieur:in) oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Bereich

  • Mehr als 8 Jahre Erfahrung im Flottenmanagement, Fuhrparkmanagement, in Instandhaltung/Reparatur oder als Werkstattleiter:in

  • Mehr als 5 Jahre direkte Führungserfahrung mit Personalverantwortung, idealerweise in einem technischen und operativen Umfeld (z.B. Autovermietung, Nutzfahrzeuge, Leasing, Autohaus, Logistik).

  • Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und Budgetkompetenz mit Fokus auf Effizienz und Qualität

  • Souveräne Führungspersönlichkeit mit hervorragenden Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten.

  • Du fühlst dich in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld mit mehreren Standorten wohl; Reisen zu internen Stationen und externen Dienstleistern innerhalb des Marktes sind erforderlich

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Wartungs- bzw. Flottenmanagementsystemen bzw. ERP-Systemen (z. B. SAP, Oracle)

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

title: Regionalleiter Werkstatt & Instandhaltung (m/f/d) - North-East
description:
Why roadsurfer?

  • TEAM SPIRIT & TEAM EVENTS: Look forward to a collegial atmosphere with flat hierarchies, lots of fun and great team spirit, as well as regular team events such as joint sports sessions, pizza & beer evenings, etc.

  • PERSONAL DEVELOPMENT: We support your personal and professional development through an individual Growth Plan and our Inhouse Academy

  • CAMPER BUDGET: You get an annual camper budget to experience the #happyroadsurfing lifestyle for yourself

 

As Regional Fleet Manager you are a key member of the Regional Leadership Team, reporting directly to the Market Fleet Manager, assigned to the Regional Operations Manager of your region.


You’ll lead all Technicians within your region, with indirect oversight of Fleet Managers and Damage Detection Experts for ca. 1000 vehicles at 10 Stations.
Your mission: drive fleet availability, repair turn-around, cost efficiency, and quality across region — keeping our fleet running smoothly and our operations performing at their best.

 

The role - your passion

  • Own the Maintenance, Repair and Fleet Transfer budget and ensure cost-efficient, high-quality repairs across the region such as Repair Strategy, Workshop Network, Spare Parts Inventory

  • Define repair strategies per vehicle based on damage reports and operational priorities.

  • Maintain strong vehicle availability by coordinating workshop capacity, scheduling, and spare parts flow.

  • Build and optimize the internal and external workshop network to improve turnaround times and cost efficiency.

  • Lead and develop fleet teams at the station (technicians, fleet managers, damage detection experts) ensuring consistent performance and technical capability, damage detection rates and sparte parts inventory.

  • Track key KPIs such as repair cost, time, and damage detection accuracy and driving strategic initiatives to drive continuous improvement.

 

What You Need To Surf The Wave With Us

  • Degree or Apprenticeship in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Technology, or similar technical field.

  • 5+ years of experience in fleet management, maintenance, repair, or workshop management.

  • 3+ years of direct people management experience, preferably in a technical and operational environment

  • Strong analytical and budgeting skills with a focus on efficiency and quality.

  • Confident leader with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, multi-site environment; travel to internal stations and external vendors within the region required.

  • Fluency in German and English, written and spoken

  • Proficient in maintenance or fleet management systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle).

Your Salary
We ❤️ transparency. The salary range for this position is between 55,000 EUR and 60,000 EUR gross per year. We are currently introducing salary bands in our job descriptions to ensure that all employees are treated fairly. Once we get to know each other better during the application process and can assess your skills and experience more precisely, we will work together to determine which level within the salary band is the best fit for you. In an annual feedback meeting, your salary will be reviewed at least once a year.

 

Ready to surf?

title: Chief of Staff
description:
About BoWatt

BoWatt is building agentic requirements and system engineering software for manufacturing. We believe AI will reach PhD-level engineering capability within the next 10 years. This will unlock massive value across several complex manufacturing industries. Cars. Planes. Rockets. Factories. Chips. Medical devices. All will be engineered with agents.

 

We bootstrapped BoWatt to €500k+ ARR before raising our first round. BoWatt is backed by tier-1 investors, including Atlantic Foodlabs, Buildery (CDTM affiliates), and Prequel Ventures, along with angels from Cohere and Luminovo.

 

You’ll join a small, exceptional team of startup builders, driven by innovation and execution. Over half the team are former founders across DeepTech AI, psychedelics, and gaming. We’ve studied and worked at top institutions and companies like Stanford, TUM, Google, EA, and YC-backed AI startups.

The role

  • Partner with our CEO, Steven, to set priorities, make trade-offs, and ensure the company stays focused on the work that matters most

  • Take on whatever's breaking, slowing us down, or the bottleneck to our growth

  • Drive important projects from definition through execution, working across fundraising, product, engineering, sales, customer success, people, and operations

  • Own and improve key people operations, including hiring plans, recruiting processes, onboarding, team development, and company culture

  • Impactful culture and energy setter across the company. Build deep relationships with everyone, be an "always on" context connector across the company.

  • Take ownership wherever the company most needs it. The scope of the role will evolve alongside BoWatt

You

  • Exceptional Generalist: you are an exceptional generalist who can quickly understand unfamiliar problems and turn ambiguity into a clear plan

  • Clear communicator: you write clearly, speak confidently, and know how to get to the point

  • High judgment: you have strong judgment and know how to prioritize when everything feels important

  • Speed: you thrive in a fast-moving startup environment where responsibilities are broad, priorities can change, and there is significant freedom to shape how the company operates

  • Team-oriented: you build trust across different teams and can align people without relying on formal authority

  • Ambitious: You set a high bar for yourself and care deeply about outcomes

 

What we offer

  • Competitive salary based on experience

  • Participation in BoWatt’s Founders Pool: 5–10% virtual equity package

  • 25 vacation days/per yr, plus public holidays

  • Company retreats

  • WellPass membership

The Founders Pool

BoWatt’s Founders Pool is a dedicated virtual-equity pool for a small group of early team members who take responsibility for building and leading a major part of the company.

 

We created it because we want the people building BoWatt alongside us to participate meaningfully in the value they help create. These are not narrow execution roles with finished playbooks. You will own your vertical with co-founder-like autonomy and accountability: setting the standard, building the function, and being responsible for its results.

 

As our founding Customer Success hire, you will participate in the Founders Pool (5-10%) and have the opportunity to build Customer Success from the ground up. The precise allocation, vesting structure, and plan terms will be discussed transparently during the interview process.

 

Interview process

  • 20 min Screening interview

  • 90 min Case interview

  • 60 min Culture fit interview

  • Reference calls

  • Offer

We aim to complete the interview process within 14 days.

title: AI & Engineering Lehrkraft/Coach (all genders)
description:
Jobbeschreibung

Wir launchen aktuell ein neues, spannendes Trainingsprogramm: AI for Project Engineering – Teil einer umfassenden AI Academy, mit der wir Engineering-Teams fit für die KI-Ära machen, und suchen aktuell Verstärkung für unser Team.

Als KI & Engineering Lehrkraft/Coach bist Du die tägliche Anlaufstelle für unsere Lernenden: Du beantwortest ihre Fragen zu AI-gestützter Softwareentwicklung, gängigen AI-Architekturen, MCP und Systemintegration und hilfst ihnen in Sandbox-Übungen, Hackathons und Client-Implementierungsprojekten weiter, wenn sie nicht mehr weiterkommen. Komplexere fachliche Fragen und Grenzfälle gibst Du an unseren Senior Coach weiter, der die Kick-off- und Closing-Events leitet, die Abschlussprojekte bewertet und die Trainingsinhalte verantwortet.

Durch den engen, täglichen Kontakt zu den Lernenden bekommst Du ein sehr gutes Gefühl dafür, wo es typischerweise hakt – dieses Feedback gibst Du direkt an den Senior Coach und das Learning-Team weiter. Diese Rolle passt gut zu Dir, wenn Du gerne Menschen unterstützt und Dich perspektivisch in Richtung Senior Coach, Learning & Development oder AI-Enablement weiterentwickeln möchtest – ganz ohne jahrelange Senior-Engineering- oder Curriculum-Design-Erfahrung.

Schwerpunkte Deiner Rolle

  • Fachliche Beantwortung der alltäglichen Fragen der Lernenden (schriftlich und mündlich) zu AI-gestützter Softwareentwicklung, gängigen AI-Architekturen, MCP und Systemintegration – als erste Anlaufstelle; komplexere Fälle bzw. Grenzfälle eskalierst Du an den Senior Coach

  • Unterstützung der Lernenden in Sandbox-Übungen, Hackathons und Client-Implementierungsprojekten, wenn sie nicht weiterkommen – Du hilfst beim Entblocken, nicht bei der inhaltlichen Konzeption

  • Durchführung individueller Coaching-Sessions zu Debugging, Code-Review-Grundlagen und Testautomatisierung

  • Teilnahme an Digital Workshops und Hackathons als Support-Präsenz vor Ort

  • Rückmeldung an den Senior Coach und das Learning-Team, wo Lernende häufig hängen bleiben – als Input für die Qualitätssicherung, nicht in eigener Verantwortung

  • Unterstützung beim Onboarding neuer Teammitglieder

Das bringst Du mit

  • Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar – oder fundierte praktische Erfahrung ohne Studienabschluss

  • 1–3 Jahre Erfahrung als Software-Entwickler:in/Engineer (Junior bis Mid-Level, nicht Senior)

  • Praktische Erfahrung im Einsatz von AI-Coding-Copiloten (z. B. GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) in echten Projekten – eigene Architektur von agentenbasierten/RAG-Systemen ist nicht erforderlich, sicherer Umgang und Erklärbarkeit schon

  • Arbeitswissen zu zentralen Software-Engineering-Praktiken: Testing, Debugging, grundlegendes CI/CD, Docker-Grundlagen

  • Hohe Service-Orientierung, Empathie, Geduld und klare Kommunikation – das zählt hier besonders, da Du die primäre Lernenden-Schnittstelle bist

  • Hands-on-Mentalität, Teamgeist, Belastbarkeit und Flexibilität

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1)

Nice to have (kein Muss)

  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit LLM-APIs, RAG, Agentenarchitekturen oder MCP (auch auf Hobby-/Projektebene)

  • Informelle Lehr-, Mentoring-, Pairing- oder TA-Erfahrung mit weniger erfahrenen Entwickler:innen

  • Grundlegendes Bewusstsein für AI-Governance-Themen (EU AI Act, Responsible AI) – hilfreich, aber erlernbar

  • Erfahrung mit Cloud-Deployment

Das bieten wir Dir

Arbeitskultur

Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten Multiverse StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.

Ownership

Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Workation

Bis zu 10 Tage pro Jahr kannst Du von überall aus der EU, dem EWR und der Türkei arbeiten.

Raum für Austausch

Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander.

Weiterentwicklung

Absolviere unsere Online-Trainings, wachse in Deine Rolle als KI & Engineering Coach hinein und entwickle Dich Schritt für Schritt in Richtung Senior Coach oder AI-Enablement weiter.

title: Information Security Expert (all genders)
description:
Kertos is the fastest-growing compliance startup in Europe. Following our €14M Series A, backed by leading VCs and business angels, we are building the compliance engine for Europe – faster, smarter, and more automated than ever. With customers like Enpal, Flink, Personio, and Blacklane, leading companies trust our AI-native platform that automates compliance, scales effortlessly, and makes organizations audit-ready in record time. The market is growing by 20% every year, fueled by regulations like GDPR, NIS2, DORA, and the AI Act. We are perfectly positioned to establish Kertos as the European compliance champion. There has never been a better moment to join our team. Come shape the future of compliance in Europe with us.

Deine Mission bei Kertos

Mit deiner Expertise im Bereich Informationssicherheit wirst du ein essentieller Teil unseres Teams. Du bringst dein Fachwissen bei der Betreuung und Beratung unserer Kunden ein und wirkst intern als Architekt*in unserer Prozesse mit, um sie skalierbar zu machen. Unsere Vision ist es Europas führende Compliance Automatisierungslösung zu werden - dafür brauchen wir deine Unterstützung! Werde Teil unseres Teams in dieser spannenden Wachstumsphase und transformiere die Compliance-Welt mit uns.

Dein Aufgabenbereich

  • Du begleitest Kertos-Kunden ganzheitlich bei der Einführung, Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung von Informationssicherheits-Frameworks und unterstützt sie dabei, regulatorische und organisatorische Anforderungen nachhaltig umzusetzen.

  • Mit deiner Expertise in Informationssicherheitsthemen (ISO 27001, SOC2, TISAX, NIS2) bist du nicht nur eine vertrauenswürdige Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden, sondern unterstützt auch unser Produkt- und Sales-Team bei allen Fragen.

  • Als Bindeglied zwischen unseren Kunden und unserem Produktteam nutzt du direktes Kundenfeedback, um kontinuierlich Produktverbesserungen und neue Features zu identifizieren.

  • Du gestaltest unsere internen Prozesse mit, damit sie mit unserem Unternehmen und den Kundenanforderungen wachsen können.

 

Deine Skills, Motivation und Mentalität, die dich erfolgreich machen

 

  • Du hast erfolgreich dein Studium im Bereich Cyber Security, Wirtschaftsrecht, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem ähnlichen Fachgebiet abgeschlossen und bereits mehrjährige Berufserfahrung gesammelt, idealerweise in der Beratung.

  • Du kennst dich bestens mit verschiedenen Informationssicherheits-Frameworks wie ISO 27001, SOC2, TISAX und/oder NIS-2 aus.

The Account Director will own that inbound pipeline and convert it, while simultaneously self-sourcing additional new business.

This role also involves working alongside channel partners in B-end enterprise deals where Bandwidth's carrier capability is required to complete the solution. This is a collaboration motion, not a channel management role - the AD works with partners to close specific deals, not to recruit or develop the partner base.

The right candidate brings 10+ years of enterprise sales experience, credibility within the Salesforce or CCaaS ecosystem, and the commercial instinct to operate across a dual motion: partner-referred inbound and self-sourced outbound. title: Senior Analyst, Lending Models
description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

The Modelling team sits within the Credit Portfolio Management (CPM) function and is at the heart of building the measurement and decisioning models behind Allica’s lending products. The team builds and owns the bank’s IFRS9 model estate (including PD, LGD, SICR and economic response models), the statistical and machine learning models and credit policy rules used for automated underwriting, and the credit-linked GenAI solutions used to automate processes.

Role Description

This role will be part of the team building, implementing, monitoring and optimising two sets of models: the IFRS9 impairment models that measure our credit risk and support accurate reporting to auditors and investors, and the decisioning models and policy rules behind automated lending, which are critical to delivering fast, consistent and well-controlled credit decisions and a better customer journey as the bank grows.

The role requires the technical ability and practical mindset to take models and decisioning changes from initial problem definition through data identification, cleansing and analysis to model development, implementation and ongoing monitoring. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between structured model development and fast-paced ad-hoc analysis, working closely with Finance, Credit Risk, Underwriting, Collections, Product, Data, Engineering, Capital Markets and Model Risk colleagues. They will communicate complex concepts clearly to stakeholders with different levels of technical expertise and work with third-party suppliers where required. We are looking for a hands-on modeller who can turn data into reliable, scalable solutions, and help make data a key strength for the bank.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Take a hands-on role in the design, build, implementation and continuous refinement of the bank’s credit risk models, spanning the full suite of IFRS9 impairment models (PD, LGD, SICR and economic response) and the statistical and machine learning models that support automated lending decisions.

  • Develop and deploy models in Python across the full model lifecycle, including data preparation, feature engineering, model fitting, validation, implementation and ongoing performance assessment.

  • Perform ad-hoc analysis to optimise credit policy rules and decisioning flows, using rule-firing, decision and outcome data to identify redundant, overlapping or mis-calibrated rules.

  • Produce regular monitoring, covering population stability, discriminatory power, calibration, and segment and vintage performance, as well as decision rates and alignment with underwriting outcomes for decisioning models.

  • Recalibrate or redevelop models as portfolio experience matures, comparing predicted and actual outcomes and adjusting model scaling, score cut-offs or policy thresholds where evidence of drift or mis-calibration exists.

  • Lead root-cause investigations into model, rule or decisioning-flow underperformance by tracing issues through decision logs, data lineage, feature calculations, production pipelines and implementation logic.

  • Build well-controlled, reproducible modelling processes and drive improvements to the data, tooling and infrastructure required for future model development and deployment.

  • Document models, rules, assumptions, limitations and changes to a high standard, supporting governance, independent review and validation, and stakeholder review.

  • Work closely with Credit Risk, Finance, Underwriting, Collections, Product, Data and Engineering teams to track model requirements and translate business needs into practical solutions, while complying with all mandatory policies and maintaining a strong internal control environment.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • You have at least 5 years’ hands-on risk modelling experience, applying statistical modelling techniques such as logistic and linear regression, as well as machine learning models, to solve practical business problems.

  • You are comfortable with large data sets, and data extraction and manipulation using Excel, SQL, Python & BI tools.

  • You have a proven track record with Python coding, and are comfortable using GenAI tools to increase coding productivity.

  • You have a good understanding of IFRS9, credit and lending concepts, preferably in commercial lending.

  • You are driven, self-motivated and passionate about building great solutions for the bank.

  • You can work independently and are flexible to adapt quickly to changing priorities within a very dynamic environment.

  • You work well with stakeholders across the business, and collaboratively within the team.

  • You have strong skills in writing technical documents as well as business-focused documents to get buy-in from various stakeholders.

  • Experience of implementation of models into software applications is highly desirable.

Prior experience in this area matters for this role. If you believe you are a strong fit for the role, but don’t quite meet one of the requirements above – if you think you can suitably overcome that, then please apply anyway.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

title: Manager: Compliance Advisory and Data Protection
description:
About Griffin

Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.

We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.

Learn more about what we do

Our culture

We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture.

The Team

You'll join our Service guild and work across first line operations, sales and produt. Working closely with Protect (our second line) you'll be the first person dedicated to compliance within the team. You'll define what great compliance solutions look like. Then implement them , keeping Griffin's products and customer outcomes in shape as we grow.

The opportunity

We want compliance and data protection built into how we design, sell and run our products. As our hands on DPO and compliance adviser, in the first line (the teams who run the business and own its risks), you'll bring regulatory expertise to help our operations, commercial and product teams do exactly that. With card issuing and other launches coming up, there's plenty to get stuck into.

What success looks like

In your first year, you’ve taken ownership of our data protection agenda. You’ve gone looking for ways to improve, made the changes happen, and given our senior leaders an honest picture of where we stand. You’ve sought out our operations, sales and product teams and shown them that working with you makes things smoother, not slower. Now they bring you in early by default. You’ve guided at least one major launch, like card issuing, from first idea to go live. And you’ve put clear governance and outcome monitoring in place for our live products, so Protect (our second line risk and compliance team) sees fewer surprises and finds a stronger compliance foundation.

To do this you'll be involved in:

  • Product development: turning regulation into clear requirements, customer journeys, T&Cs and fair value assessments, from first idea through product approval to launch, with data protection built in from the start.

  • Product lifecycle management: keeping live products compliant through periodic fair value assessments, outcome monitoring, reviews, changes and closures.

  • Sales: helping our commercial team check early whether potential partners fit our risk appetite, and reviewing sales material.

  • Marketing: working on marketing materials, both ours and our customers’, to make sure they comply with regulation and our own policies, and that our financial promotions are properly challenged.

  • Service (Operations): building regulatory and data protection requirements into how Service works day to day, with procedures and controls people actually use.

  • Regulatory change: working out what new rules mean for us, and making sure the right teams make the right changes on time.

  • Issues and reporting: investigating and fixing compliance issues, including personal data breaches, and reporting clearly on compliance risks and customer outcomes.

  • Working with second line (Protect): bringing them in early, sharing the evidence they need, and acting on their challenge.

  • Data protection: being our Data Protection Officer (DPO), which means:

    • advising our teams on their obligations, including data protection impact assessments (DPIAs) and transfer risk assessments (TRAs)

    • monitoring and auditing how well we comply with the UK GDPR, other data protection laws and our own policies

title: Support Engineer
description:
Support Engineer

Edinburgh

Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operating system for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgement matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by over $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

The role

We’re hiring a Support Engineer to provide fast, thoughtful and technically rigorous help to Wordsmith customers.

You’ll own technical questions and incidents from first response through to resolution. You’ll understand what the customer is trying to achieve, reproduce reported behaviour, investigate the underlying cause and explain the outcome clearly.

This is more than scripted customer support. You’ll be expected to investigate application behaviour at a technical level, including reading logs and tracing issues through the product and its codebase. Where appropriate to your experience, you may also propose and submit code fixes through our normal engineering review and release process.

Wordsmith supports customers globally through a follow-the-sun model. You’ll work the standard hours for your region and hand over unresolved issues clearly to colleagues in other regions. There is no routine expectation that you work another region’s hours.

What you’ll do

  • Own technical support requests — triage, investigate and resolve customer questions and incidents from first response to confirmed resolution.

  • Diagnose problems thoroughly — gather the right context, reproduce reported behaviour, inspect logs and data, and trace issues through the product and codebase.

  • Resolve technical issues — correct configuration or usage problems directly and collaborate with Engineering when a product or infrastructure change is required.

  • Contribute code fixes where appropriate — depending on your experience, propose and submit well-tested fixes through the standard engineering review and deployment process.

  • Communicate clearly — give customers timely and accurate updates, explain technical issues without unnecessary jargon and set honest expectations.

  • Manage escalations — bring in Engineering, Product or other specialists when needed while retaining ownership of the case and its communication.

  • Support global handovers — document investigation, impact, current status and next actions so colleagues in another region can continue work without losing momentum.

  • Protect service quality — recognise high-impact incidents quickly, follow the appropriate escalation process and contribute to incident reviews.

  • Build customer knowledge — create and maintain troubleshooting guides, known-issue documentation and help-centre content.

  • Reduce repeat problems — identify patterns in support demand and recommend improvements to the product, documentation, tooling and customer experience.

  • Improve support operations — help develop service levels, escalation paths, reporting and technical-support processes as the function scales.

What we’re looking for

  • Experience in technical support, product support, software engineering, solutions engineering or another customer-facing technical role.

  • Strong diagnostic ability — you can work methodically from symptoms to root cause rather than relying on guesswork.

  • A working understanding of modern web applications, APIs, authentication, integrations and common browser or network issues.

  • Experience using diagnostic information such as application logs, monitoring tools, browser developer tools and database queries.

  • Enough familiarity with software code to navigate a codebase, follow application logic and use it to investigate reported behaviour.

  • Clear customer communication — you can remain calm under pressure, set expectations honestly and explain complex issues at the right level of detail.

  • Strong ownership — you remain responsible for moving an issue forward even when other teams need to contribute.

  • Sound prioritisation — you can assess urgency and customer impact and recognise when an issue requires immediate escalation.

  • Care and precision — you document what you tested, avoid unsupported conclusions and confirm that the customer’s problem has actually been resolved.

  • Interest in AI systems — you’re curious about how AI-enabled products behave and comfortable investigating issues that may not always be deterministic.

  • No legal background is required, but you should be motivated to learn how in-house legal teams work.

Desirable, but not essential

  • Experience writing and debugging production software.

  • The ability to create automated tests and submit code fixes for engineering review.

  • Experience supporting AI-enabled or data-intensive applications.

  • Familiarity with incident-management and observability tools.

How we work

We’re an in-person team based in Edinburgh. You should expect to work from the office as your default.

We support customers globally using a follow-the-sun model. You’ll work the normal hours agreed for your region and create clear handovers when an issue needs to continue beyond them. Any exceptional on-call or out-of-hours arrangements would be agreed and communicated separately.

We set a high bar, move quickly and give people meaningful ownership. Support is a core part of the product experience, and we expect it to be technically credible, responsive and human.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, Transformation and Customer Success. Customer Success owns adoption and customer health; Transformation owns implementation; Account Management owns renewals and commercial growth; and Support Engineering owns technical investigation and resolution.

Why Wordsmith

You’ll support a fast-growing product used for important work inside some of the world’s most ambitious organisations.

Because we’re building in a new technical category, the problems are interesting. You’ll work across software behaviour, integrations, data and AI systems rather than following a script.

You’ll have the opportunity to shape our support tooling and operating model, influence the product through direct customer evidence, and develop towards senior support engineering, support leadership, solutions engineering or product engineering.

title: Software Engineer
description:
About Foundation Health

Foundation Health is an AI operating system for pharmacy - built by a team who lived the problem firsthand, not one that came to healthcare from the outside. Every day, prior authorizations delay prescriptions, pharmacists lose hours to paperwork instead of patients, and prescriptions slip through the cracks between health systems. We believe thoughtfully applied AI can finally change that - deep, integrated infrastructure that streamlines how care is coordinated, purpose-built for the complexity of specialty pharmacy.

We're building toward a world where pharmacy teams spend their time on patients, not paperwork - where AI handles the routine so clinicians can focus on what only humans can do. Getting there takes the right people. We're looking for curious, ambitious folks who want to help solve healthcare's hardest problems - for our patients, our partners, and each other.

The team: AI-native by design

Our VP of Engineering comes from DeepMind/Google, and we're building with AI from day one, both in the product and in how we engineer. We use AI tools to move faster, automate repetitive work and spend more time on problems that need real engineering judgement.

What you'll actually be doing

  • Designing and building the back-end systems that connect pharmacies, health systems and insurers

  • Solving hard distributed-systems problems: event-driven workflows, retries, idempotency, data consistency and failure recovery

  • Owning substantial features from the initial problem through architecture, build, deployment and production

  • Making pragmatic technical decisions as we scale, without overengineering for problems we don't have yet

  • Building AI-powered capabilities into a live product, where reliability and correctness matter as much as speed

  • Working directly with product and engineering leadership to shape the roadmap, architecture and what we build next

Manchester: where our core engineering team works

Our core engineering team is based in Manchester city centre. We're in the office together 1–2 days a week to work through hard problems and debate technical decisions. The rest of the week, work wherever you're most effective.

Not in Manchester yet? If you'd consider relocating, we can help with the move.

Why you'd leave your current role

  • Your work reaches real users. We're live with enterprise customers, so what you ship gets used, not lost in a backlog.

  • Interesting engineering problems. We're connecting fragmented healthcare systems, where data integrity and correctness really matter. This isn't a CRUD app with an AI feature bolted on.

  • Real ownership. You'll shape solutions, challenge assumptions and influence the roadmap and architecture. We want you making important technical decisions, not just implementing someone else's.

  • No legacy baggage. We're on a modern Node.js, TypeScript and GCP stack. You don't need to know it already. We care far more about the systems you've built than the tools you used.

  • Equity. You'll own a stake in the company you're helping build.

What we do care about

  • Strong engineering judgement. You can take an ambiguous problem, work out what matters, make sensible trade-offs and deliver without every step mapped out.

  • Back-end depth. You've built and operated production systems and know what happens beyond the happy path: distributed systems, databases, performance, observability and failure recovery.

  • Ownership beyond the code. You think about how a feature behaves in production, how customers use it and what could go wrong. You've made technical decisions with real consequences and can explain why you made them.

  • A builder's mindset. You've taken meaningful projects from idea to reality, at work or in your own time, and can explain the decisions and trade-offs you made.

  • Curiosity about AI. You've built AI products, use AI to improve how you work, or are actively exploring what's possible. You don't need to be an ML researcher.

  • Strong fundamentals. You reason from first principles and pick up unfamiliar tech quickly. A degree in Computer Science, Maths, Physics or Engineering is useful, but depth of engineering ability matters most.

Interested?

The funding's in place, the product is live and customers are asking for more than we can build. We're hiring engineers in Manchester to help close that gap.

  • Lead negotiator: runs the table, controls pacing and concessions, and stays separate from the delivery owner. This is the seat you'll usually hold.

  • Commercial and pricing lead: builds the should-cost model and covers pricing structures, benchmarking, and total cost of ownership (TCO).

  • Legal and contracts counsel: covers liability caps, intellectual property (IP) ownership, indemnities, termination, data protection, and step-in rights.

  • Technical and solution architect: tests feasibility, scope, service levels (SLAs), and integration and security claims.

  • Operations and service owner: brings realistic requirements, transition plans, and governance from the business.

  • Finance and procurement: covers payment terms, currency and indexation, and audit and benchmarking rights.

  • Risk, security, and compliance: handles regulatory, data residency, and resilience requirements.

🚀 What you'll own

  • Lead negotiation of multi-year technology and outsourcing agreements worth $250m to $1bn+ in total contract value, from selection through signature.

  • Set the commercial playbook: pricing structures, walk-away positions, a concession log, and fallback positions on liability, service levels, and exit.

  • Agree one position before you sit down. Rank priorities as must-have, trade, or give, and define your walk-away point (your best alternative to a negotiated agreement, or BATNA).

  • Structure deals that fit the risk: fixed price, time and materials, outcome-based, and gain-share, with volume bands, rate cards, indexation, and price-down glide paths.

  • Decide which risks to transfer, share, or keep, and put a price on each one.

  • Negotiate core billing and Customer Information System (CIS) replacements, including migration plans, regulatory change, service levels, and exit terms.

  • Define scope precisely: baseline, assumptions, dependencies, and exclusions. Most disputes start here, so you'll settle them before signature.

  • Plan the exit from day one: lock-in, data portability, step-in rights, and termination assistance.

  • Build competitive tension, keep alternatives alive, and manage timing, such as a vendor's quarter-end.

  • Bring Delivery and Operations into the deal early, so the contract works in practice.

  • Lock in key-personnel clauses, so the vendor's A-team doesn't sell while the B-team delivers.

  • Set up governance, benchmarking, and audit rights that keep working after signature, and track change requests, renewals, and exit costs alongside the headline price.

  • Recruit and grow the team: energy-billing experts, a migration lead, SaaS counsel, and regulatory specialists, with a clear capability model and a RACI (who's responsible, accountable, consulted, and informed).

  • Coach executive sponsors on leverage and timing, and run negotiation war-gaming before the big moments.

  • Step in early when a deal or migration drifts, and reset milestones, scope, and commercials to get it back on track.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party

title: Engineering Manager
description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY.

The Role

You'll be a player-coach engineering leader with a spike in technical strategy, you'll own engineering delivery for your team end-to-end - from developing exceptional engineers to solving some of our most difficult engineering problems & setting technical direction.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll spend roughly 20% of your time contributing code and 80% leading your team, with that ratio shifting as we scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build, hire, and develop a high-performing engineering team

  • Help set technical direction and architecture decisions

  • Work with the engineering to tackle some of our most difficult problems

  • Own engineering delivery with an emphasis on velocity

  • Collaborate closely with Product on roadmap and prioritisation

  • Write code when needed so you'll stay close to the product

The Opportunity

We are in the unique situation that our commercial traction is ahead of our product. You’ll play a leading role in moving towards automation in a way that enables us to rapidly scale with increased complexity and specific customer nuances.

About You

  • You have extensive experience in architecting enterprise-level systems, delivering on ambitious product visions, and building world class engineering teams.

  • You have worked at high-growth businesses, and might have previously started your own company.

  • You are highly analytical, and thinking proactively through the implications of your decisions, but also have high conviction and understand the importance of moving at pace and shipping often.

  • You have previously led engineering at a company from its earliest stages, and don’t shy away from the manager role - you know what great looks like, and want to help engineers grow.

Essential Experience

  • 8+ years software engineering experience

  • Track record of hiring and developing strong engineers

  • Strong production systems background - you've built and scaled things that matter, and you’ve done something hard and lived to tell the tale

  • Proven experience in distributed systems

  • Experience operating autonomously in small, high-velocity environments - ideally in a startup

  • Experience working in a data-focused company or closely alongside a data engineering/ML team - data is core to what we're building at Kernel, and you will play a key role in shaping how we grow that capability

Nice-to-Have:

  • Scaled an engineering team through a growth phase (5 → 20+ engineers), or from Series A to Series C

  • Technical depth across the stack: NodeJS, Postgres, TypeScript, Kubernetes AI-driven or data-heavy product experience

  • Understanding of LLMs (e.g., RAG, prompt engineering, evals)

  • CRM data models or workflow automation knowledge

  • Hands-on Data Engineering or ML Engineering experience - as data becomes an increasingly large part of what we do, this would be a great asset for us to have

⚠️ This role may not be for you if you:

  • Insist on shipping pixel-perfect code

  • Prefer managing from a distance without technical involvement

  • Need extensive process and structure before making decisions

❌ This role is definitely not for you:

  • If you over-rely on AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code) to the point where you don’t read or understand your own code

  • If you on the other hand don’t understand how these tools (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.) can be force multipliers for senior engineers if used correctly

  • If you prefer fully remote work

  • If you don’t like early-stage startup pace

  • If you’re seeking a purely ‘hands-off’ role

Tech Stack

  • Backend: AWS, NodeJS, TypeScript, Postgres, Clickhouse, Kubernetes

You don't need to know everything, but you should be comfortable diving into any part of the stack.

Informations clés

  • Type de contrat : Freelance ou CDIC

Contexte de la mission

Dans le cadre d'un programme de construction d'une nouvelle usine industrielle à l'international, prévu sur la période 2028-2032, nous recherchons un profil expérimenté pour intervenir en phase amont d'analyse des besoins et de pré-FEED (Front-End Engineering Design).

La mission consiste à réaliser un audit approfondi de deux usines de production existantes, l'une en France et l'autre en Amérique du Nord, afin d'identifier les bonnes pratiques, les axes d'amélioration et les besoins des différents services.

L'objectif est de recueillir et de formaliser l'ensemble des exigences techniques, fonctionnelles et opérationnelles dans un cahier des charges aussi complet que possible, afin de sécuriser les futures phases d'ingénierie, de conception et de construction de la nouvelle usine.

Missions

  • Réaliser un audit fonctionnel et opérationnel de deux usines de production existantes, situées en France et en Amérique du Nord.

  • Analyser les installations, les méthodes de fonctionnement et les organisations en place afin d'identifier les bonnes pratiques, les points faibles et les axes d'amélioration.

  • Organiser et animer des groupes de travail avec l'ensemble des services concernés, notamment :

    • Maintenance

    • Exploitation et production

    • Process industriels

    • Traitement de l'air

  • Conduire des entretiens et des réunions de travail, notamment à distance via Teams, afin de faire émerger les besoins, contraintes et attentes de chaque service.

  • Challenger les interlocuteurs pour identifier les besoins explicites et implicites, anticiper les problématiques et garantir l'exhaustivité des exigences.

  • Recueillir, analyser et consolider les retours d'expérience des deux sites existants.

  • Identifier les exigences techniques, fonctionnelles, organisationnelles et opérationnelles à intégrer dans la conception de la future usine.

  • Définir les besoins d'industrialisation et les exigences relatives aux process de production.

  • Élaborer et structurer un cahier des charges (CDC) complet et détaillé, intégrant les besoins de l'ensemble des parties prenantes.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
Vestiaire Collective is the leading global platform for desirable pre-loved fashion and a pioneer in transforming how people consume fashion.
 
Our mission is simple: make circular fashion the norm, not the exception.
Through technology, expertise, and a highly engaged global community, we enable millions of people to buy and sell fashion in a more sustainable way.

About the role : 

As a Senior Analytics Engineer, you will play a key role in our data ecosystem by modelling raw datasets into clear, reliable, and scalable data products that power strategic decision-making across the business.

Beyond core development, you will drive data reliability, elevate our technical standards, and experiment with AI-assisted tools to streamline modern data workflows.

• Own analytical data products throughout their lifecycle, from initial design and delivery through continuous improvement, evolution, and retirement, while considering performance, maintainability, and cost.

• Contribute to the evolution of the engineering foundations supporting Analytics Engineering, including CI/CD, orchestration, monitoring, deployment, and tooling version upgrades, in collaboration with Data Platform Engineering.

• Take ownership of projects from design through delivery and communicate technical decisions and trade-offs clearly.

• Explore and apply AI-assisted engineering tools across the data development lifecycle, including ingestion, transformation, testing, documentation, and deployment.

• Help define and embed Analytics Engineering best practices, fostering a culture of quality, ownership, documentation, testing, and continuous improvement across the team.

 

Who you are : 

• 3-5 years of relevant experience in Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, BI Engineering, or a similar role, with hands-on experience designing, deploying, and maintaining large-scale, efficient ETL, ELT, or reverse ETL pipelines.

• Strong SQL and data transformation skills(DBT), including complex transformations and modular, reusable data models.

• Experience with Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, or another modern data warehouse, with awareness of performance and cost considerations.

• Experience with Airflow or a comparable tool for job orchestration, scheduling, and dependency management.

• Experience using Python for data processing, workflow automation, or developing data tooling.

• Experience with version controlling (GitHub), CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, and observability.

• Ability to work autonomously, manage dependencies, and take accountability for data products and technical initiatives beyond their initial delivery.

• Ability to make and clearly communicate technical decisions and trade-offs.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Practical experience or strong interest in applying AI-assisted engineering tools to data development.

• Strong problem-solving mindset and commitment to engineering quality.

• Prior exposure to e-commerce platforms, two-sided marketplaces, or high-volume AdTech ecosystems is a plus.

 

What We Offer

  • Purpose-driven work at scale
    Join a company reshaping the fashion industry towards circularity, you directly contributes to reducing waste and extending the life of luxury items.
  • High-impact scope & ownership
    Work on products used globally, where your decisions have immediate, measurable impact on millions of users across 70+ countries.
  • A truly international environment
    Collaborate with a diverse team of 50+ nationalities across Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore, and Ho Chi Minh City.
  • Career acceleration in a fast-moving scale-up
    Take ownership early, grow fast, and shape your path, as an expert or a future leader.
  • Learning & growth as a priority
    Dedicated budget, continuous feedback culture, and opportunities to work on cutting-edge topics (AI, marketplace dynamics, scalability, etc.).
  • Flexible ways of working
    Hybrid model (typically 2 days remote per week), with trust and autonomy at the core of how we operate.
  • Give back through action
    2 paid days per year to support a cause of your choice and actively contribute to positive impact beyond your day-to-day role.
  • Competitive compensation & benefits
    Including bonus, health coverage, lunch vouchers, Gym-Pass, and additional legal perks depending on your location.

We are looking for an Alliance & Delivery Manager to own Orakl's pharma partnerships after signature: the partner relationship, the delivery of each research program, and the growth of each account.

Orakl runs research programs for pharmaceutical companies on its virtual patient cohorts, combining compound screening, multi-omics and O-Predict analyses on the partner's assets. Several programs run in parallel on the same wet-lab and dry-lab teams, and the portfolio is growing. Delivery quality directly drives renewals and follow-on contracts.

This is a high-ownership, partner-facing role. You are the partner's main contact, you are accountable for delivery across our wet-lab and dry-lab teams, and you grow existing accounts. You will also scale our delivery processes and tooling: project tracking, capacity planning and partner reporting, automated wherever possible.

You will work closely with the Scientific Program & Operations Lead, Business Development, the Wet Lab, Data Science and Computational Biology leads, and Product. Map decision-makers, priorities and expectations for their asset, run the steering committees, attend key international conferences a few times per year and present results alongside our scientific teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Who You Are

  • An owner: you take responsibility for outcomes across teams you do not manage, and you make explicit trade-offs when programs compete.

Why Join Orakl

title: Senior Marketing Manager
description:
Who we are

Yubo is the instantly social, social app: the leading real-time social discovery platform where you can meet new people for friendship, crushes and community. Our mission is to help young adults find community - whoever they are, wherever they are and whenever they feel social. That's why we’re building a more spontaneous and human social world, one based on interaction, exploration and possibility.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow. Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission.

As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

We also work closely with the broader technology industry to share our knowledge and NGOs create industry-leading child protection standards.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role

We are looking for a Senior Marketing Manager to turn Yubo's brand ambition into brilliant, effective marketing, from major campaign moments to paid and owned-channel activity, and the smaller tests that help us learn what works.

Reporting to the Director of Brand & Communications, you will translate Yubo's brand strategy into an executable US marketing programme. You will lead integrated brand campaigns, own campaign and paid-media planning and management, and build and manage influencer capabilities.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who can move comfortably between strategic thinking and execution. You will challenge plans constructively, make recommendations grounded in insight and data, and work closely with Creative, PR, Product, UA, Data, Trust & Safety and Legal to deliver marketing that builds the brand and drives growth.

The role will focus on the US first, with scope to contribute to expansion into new markets as Yubo's marketing activity grows.

This is a freelance position on a 6-month contract, with a target start of Q4 2026.

Your responsibilites

Turn strategic priorities into impactful marketing activity

  • Lead the development and execution of Yubo's priority brand campaigns in the US, from insight and strategy through briefing, delivery, optimisation and reporting.

  • Translate Yubo's positioning, audience priorities and seasonal moments into cultural marketing activity that earns attention amongst Gen Z.

  • Develop integrated channel plans across paid, earned and owned activity, working closely with PR and Creative to ensure every channel plays a clear role.

  • Own campaign budget planning and day-to-day management, partnering closely with UA on paid-media strategy and optimisation.

  • Explore new, less traditional ways for Yubo to reach and engage people, challenging default channel choices and designing approaches that make marketing work harder.

Establish brand marketing operations and measurement

  • Establish effective working rhythms across Brand, Creative, PR, Product, UA and Data, from briefing and approvals to reporting and learning.

  • Work closely with Data and UA to analyse performance and make clear, evidence-based optimisation recommendations.

  • Build clear measurement plans so every campaign, test and experiment informs future investment and potential expansion into new markets.

  • Identify, recommend and deliver smaller tests and experiments that help Yubo learn quickly and improve future investment.

Build influencer, social and community activity

  • Build the plans, operating models and internal capability needed to deliver consistently strong influencer activity and integrate it into wider campaign plans.

  • Manage influencer agency relationships, negotiating cost-effective partnership models that maximise impact and effectiveness.

Who you are

You are an experienced brand marketer with strong consumer instincts and a genuine interest in youth culture. You know how to turn a positioning and a business objective into a campaign people notice, and how to turn campaign results into smarter decisions next time.

You are as comfortable building a strategic recommendation as you are writing a brief, reviewing creative, shaping a media plan, interrogating performance data or getting into the practical detail needed to make work happen. You don't wait for perfect information or a fully formed process; you create clarity, bring people together and move work forward.

You will bring:

  • A breadth of experience in brand and integrated marketing, ideally in a high-growth tech, consumer app, entertainment, lifestyle or youth-culture business.

  • A track record of developing and delivering integrated campaigns across paid, owned and earned channels, working closely with cross-functional partners.

  • An understanding of the US market and how 18–24-year-olds engage with brands, culture and social platforms.

  • Experience owning campaign and paid-media planning and management, ideally in close partnership with performance marketing, creative and comms teams.

  • Confidence analysing campaign performance and translating data into clear optimisation and investment recommendations.

  • Experience working closely with creative teams to develop strong campaign platforms, briefs and work that is both strategically sharp and creatively ambitious.

  • A curiosity for less traditional channels, partnerships and approaches, with the creativity to test new ways of reaching people and maximise earned attention above what we buy.

  • A proactive, autonomous and highly collaborative working style.

Within a month, you will

  • Get up to speed on Yubo's brand, product, US market and audience.

  • Meet your key stakeholders across Brand, Creative, PR, Product, UA and Data.

  • Review current campaign activity, budgets and ways of working.

  • Start shaping the US marketing calendar and briefs with the Director of Brand & Communications.

Within 3 months, you will

  • Be leading delivery of Yubo's US campaigns, with briefs, channel plans and budgets in place.

  • Have established the operating model between Brand, UA, Creative, PR, Product and Data.

  • Be building the campaign measurement framework.

  • Have started shaping Yubo's influencer marketing approach, including early agency conversations.

Within 6 months, you will

  • Have delivered Yubo's priority US brand campaigns end to end, from strategy through reporting.

  • Have embedded the cross-functional operating model and measurement framework.

  • Have established influencer marketing at Yubo, with agency partnerships operating.

  • Have delivered key tests and experiments, with recommendations to inform 2027 priorities.

The recruitment process

  • First call with Nicolas, Talent Acquisition

  • A technical test with Alex, our Brand Director

Our approach to privacy & safety

As part of your role, you may handle tools and features involving personal data. We expect all employees to demonstrate strong awareness of privacy and safety issues, and to actively support our Privacy & Safety by Design efforts.

Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact.

 

Here’s how we live our mission every day:

You own the impact: Step up, adapt, and make it matter

Unconventionally Smart: Hack with intent, borrow smart, build better

Be Bold & Resilient: Raise your head, break barriers, keep moving forward

One team, one mission: No egos, no passengers, just shared wins

 

Trust & Flexibility: Our hybrid model calls for only two office days a month; the rest is up to the rhythm that works best for you.

 

Enjoy Top-notch Benefits

Culture is central at Yubo, hence the numerous benefits:

Cool Workplace: enjoy our amazing Parisian office and our many hybrid work options

Team Activities: participate in get-togethers, events, and team-building activities

Family-Friendly: we support parents with childcare options and family-friendly policies

Wellness Programs: benefit from comprehensive health insurance, wellness programs, sports classes, and mental well-being initiatives
