title: Graphene Photonics Device Reliability Testing Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

 

The Role

We are seeking a Device Reliability Testing Engineer to drive reliability qualification, failure analysis, and accelerated life testing for our integrated graphene photonics products. In close collaboration with Design Enablement, Process Integration, and Product Quality, you will establish robust test methodologies to validate device reliability, and long-term stability in accordance with industry standards.

You will play a key role in transitioning our technology from prototype to production- qualified products, ensuring that graphene photonics meet the performance and robustness requirements of high-volume deployment.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Design and execute wafer-level device reliability test plans for graphene- based photonic devices (DC bias, RF endurance, thermal cycling, long-term stability)

  • Identify and investigate the physical mechanisms of graphene-related failure modes.

  • Characterize and monitor key performance metrics, including extinction ratio, insertion loss, bandwidth retention, energy efficiency, dark current stability, responsivity degradation over device lifetime

  • Drive structured root cause investigations using FMEA/8D methodologies and feed findings back to Design and Process teams

  • Work together with product and quality teams to reach compliance with industry standards (JEDEC, OIF, IEC, IEEE) and generate qualification and reliability documentation

Your Qualifications

  • Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or Photonics Engineering

  • Hands-on experience in semiconductor device physics, optoelectronics, or reliability engineering

  • Hands-on experience in photonic device characterization and reliability testing

  • Experience with high-speed RF testing (>40 GHz) and VNA-based S- parameter measurements.

  • Experience with advanced test equipment such as VNA, real-time and sampling oscilloscopes (50+ GHz), lightwave component analyzers (LCA), optical spectrum analyzers, and probe stations.

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

description:
Über uns:

Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen.

Wir laden dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben – indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit deinem Wissen und deinen Fähigkeiten kannst du beweisen, dass Dinge anders – und besser – gemacht werden können.

Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist.

Unsere Technology:

Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz.

Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau.

Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie.

Die Rolle

Als Werkstudent/in im Bereich Fördermittelmanagement erhältst du spannende Einblicke in die Schnittstelle zwischen Finance, Projektförderung und Digitalisierung. Du unterstützt unser Finance-Team bei öffentlich geförderten Forschungsprojekten und arbeitest an Themen wie Reporting, Datenaufbereitung und Prozessoptimierung.

Bei uns kannst du Finance nicht nur im Tagesgeschäft kennenlernen, sondern auch aktiv mitgestalten: Wir hinterfragen bestehende Abläufe, entwickeln neue Prozesse und nutzen moderne Technologien wie KI, um unsere Arbeit effizienter zu machen.   • Mitgestaltung digitaler und KI-gestützter Prozesse zur Automatisierung und Optimierung unserer Finance-Abläufe

  • Mitarbeit bei der Einführung unseres neuen ERP-Systems und der Weiterentwicklung unserer Daten- und Reportingstrukturen

Das bringst du idealerweise mit

  • Du hast gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse und gehst sicher mit MS Office, insbesondere Excel, um

  • Du bist IT-affin, lernst gerne Neues und hast Interesse an Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und KI. Kenntnisse in SAP sind ein Plus

Unsere Kultur

Menschen vor Prozessen. Bei Black Semiconductor ist Flexibilität der Schlüssel - wir sorgen dafür, dass sich die Arbeit dem Leben anpasst und nicht umgekehrt. Wir setzen uns für die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben ein, damit Karrieren sinnvoll und bereichernd sind. title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Commercial (f/m/d)
description:
About Cosuno

Construction is a €14 trillion industry that still runs on email, spreadsheets and scanned PDFs. Cosuno is replacing that with AI. General contractors tender their projects on our platform to more than 250,000 subcontractors, and our agentic AI matches the right firms, flags anomalies in bids and benchmarks every price against 6.5 million data points from over €136 billion in processed bid volume. Every tender makes the AI smarter. The results are measurable: general contractors cut costs by around 6 %, subcontractors win 22 % more volume, and every new general contractor customer this year has chosen our AI product. Founded in Berlin in 2019 and backed by Cherry Ventures and Spark Capital with over €40 million raised, we are now scaling Sales, Customer Success and Marketing with that capital. That is where you come in.

Your mission

As our Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Commercial, you make sure every seat in Sales, Customer Success and Marketing goes to someone exceptional. You report to Fritz Cramer, Co-CEO, and work closely with our VP Sales, Head of SC Sales, Head of Customer Success and Marketing Lead. That means real ownership: you shape how Cosuno hires, not just who.

What you will achieve in your first 12 months

  • You hire 25 people across Account Executives, Customer Success and Inside Sales Managers, owning every process from intake to signed contract.

  • You build warm pipelines before roles open, so we hire through sourcing and referrals instead of agencies.

  • You turn every role into a clear scorecard and give hiring managers structured interviews they actually use.

  • You relaunch our referral programme and turn our team into our best talent scouts.

  • You make hiring measurable with a monthly dashboard on time-to-hire, conversion and source of hire.


What the job really looks like

  • A large part of your week is active sourcing and candidate conversations. If you prefer managing agencies, this role is not for you.

  • You run several commercial processes in parallel, with ambitious hiring managers who want great people fast.

  • There is no large TA team and no finished playbook. You build the processes while you hire.

  • You push back when a profile or a decision is not right. We want you to.


What you bring

  • At least 4 years of recruiting experience, of which at least 2 years in-house at a high-growth B2B SaaS company, hiring SDRs and Account Executives.

  • A track record you can prove in numbers: hires made, time-to-hire and offer acceptance rate. You steer your pipeline by data, not gut feeling.

  • Proven sourcing skills: you have filled roles through direct outreach and can show what worked.

  • Structured assessment: you run scorecard-based interviews and can tell real sales talent from a good pitch.

  • Strong closing skills: you win top candidates against competing offers and counteroffers.

  • Strong stakeholder management: you advise hiring managers and challenge them when it matters.

  • Fluent German and English, written and spoken.


Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, Clay or Lusha.

  • You use AI tools and automation in sourcing and outreach.

  • Curiosity about construction or other traditional industries.


What we offer

  • Salary: €70,000–90,000 gross base salary per year, depending on experience, plus a variable component of 25 % of your base salary at 100 % target achievement, tied to hires who successfully complete their probation period.

  • AI at the core: you work with Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, Clay and Lusha, and you have a budget to test new tools.

  • Learning budget for your professional development.

  • Time off: 25-30 vacation days per year.

  • Flexibility: fully remote within Germany or from our office in Berlin-Kreuzberg, with flexible hours.

  • A great team: open and international, with regular off-sites and team events.

  • Stability: permanent contract in a well-funded company.


Our hiring process (max. 3 weeks)

  1. Intro call with Vivien (People Lead), 30 minutes, video.

  2. Career deep-dive with Fritz (Co-CEO) 30 minutes, video.

  3. Live case study: together with two of our hiring managers (Basti, Kornelius or Caspar), you work through a sourcing case for a fictional SDR role, 60 minutes, preferably in our Berlin office.

  4. References: with your consent only, we speak with 2–3 hiring managers you have recruited for in previous roles.

  5. Offer.

From your first call to our decision, the process takes no longer than 3 weeks.


Your contact: Vivien Littmann, People Lead


We welcome applications from everyone who brings the skills for this role, regardless of background or circumstances. If you need any adjustments during the process, just let us know.

title: Senior Google Ads Specialist | International Ecommerce | Berlin ASAP
description:
ennovationHUB is an expanding international e-commerce group specialising in the home & living sector, with furniture at the core of our offering. Through our hubs in Belgrade, Barcelona, and London, we serve customers throughout the UK, North America, the EU, and APAC.

As we work towards €160m+ in annual revenue by 2027, we are seeking a Senior Google Ads Specialist to join us as soon as possible. You will lead Google Ads performance for one of our portfolio brands, taking direct responsibility for revenue growth, advertising efficiency, and profitability.

About the opportunity:

You will be part of an international business operating multiple e-commerce brands, with substantial advertising investment across several markets. Working at this scale means your decisions will directly influence revenue and commercial results.

Google Ads already plays a significant role in our growth. We are looking for someone who enjoys navigating international e-commerce, working with large datasets, and uncovering opportunities that deliver measurable improvements.

Working alongside our Head of Performance Marketing, creative team, and data specialists, you will use analysis, experimentation, and hands-on optimisation to develop this established channel further. Your focus will be on maintaining strong current performance while supporting efficient growth over time.

What you will be responsible for:

  • Own Google Ads performance across international markets for one of our e-commerce brands

  • Run and optimise Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and other relevant campaign formats

  • Monitor and improve core performance measures, including ROAS, CPA, conversion rate, revenue, and profitability

  • Drive growth and improve advertising efficiency across your assigned portfolio

  • Uncover opportunities within product ranges, categories, markets, and audience groups

  • Turn campaign insights into clear recommendations and practical next steps

  • Conduct account reviews and introduce continuous performance improvements

  • Work with developers and analytics colleagues to maintain accurate tracking and reliable measurement

  • Collaborate with creative and content teams to strengthen advertising effectiveness and landing page results

  • Contribute to budget allocation, forecasting, and performance reporting

  • Stay informed about platform updates, AI-powered advertising capabilities, and industry best practices

  • Help develop structured tests and experiments that strengthen account performance over time

The impact you can make:

Our Google Ads campaigns already generate results. You will build on that foundation by uncovering further opportunities, improving efficiency, and scaling successful approaches.

In a competitive e-commerce environment, even small improvements can make a significant commercial difference. You will connect campaign decisions to business outcomes and remain accountable for their impact.

You will collaborate with experienced colleagues who work quickly and place a high value on execution. We welcome independent judgment, evidence-based decisions, and constructive questions about existing approaches. You will have the trust to make decisions and directly support the company’s growth.


In-house e-commerce experience is a requirement for this position. Candidates whose Google Ads experience is primarily gained through agencies, consultancy, or freelance work will not be considered.

We are looking for someone who has owned performance within an e-commerce company, with results evaluated through revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, and sustained growth.

You should understand how campaign performance connects to wider commercial goals and be comfortable taking responsibility for both decision-making and implementation.

What you will bring:

  • A minimum of 2 years of practical experience managing Google Ads campaigns

  • A proven record of managing Google Ads within an e-commerce business, with direct accountability for results and profitability

  • Extensive practical knowledge of Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns

  • Experience working as part of an in-house e-commerce team

  • The ability to analyse large datasets and identify opportunities that can be put into practice

  • A solid grasp of attribution, tracking, and performance measurement

  • Working familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and Google Merchant Center

  • Strong analytical skills and a thorough approach to detail

  • Fluency in spoken and written English

  • The ability to adapt to shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment

  • A curious, proactive approach and a commitment to ongoing improvement

  • Confidence operating independently, making decisions, and owning the results

  • A readiness to use AI and automation as we continue introducing them across the business

  • Availability to start immediately or as soon as possible

Your working style:

You bring senior-level judgment while staying actively involved in campaign execution and performance. You draw clear conclusions from data and translate those findings into practical action.

You want to understand what drives results and regularly look for ways to improve them. You can move comfortably between longer-term planning and daily optimisation while keeping business growth and commercial outcomes in focus.

You enjoy developing and scaling campaigns, accepting responsibility for their performance, and helping an established channel continue to grow.

International collaboration and travel:

Our team works across London, Belgrade, Barcelona, Frankfurt, Oxfordshire, Istanbul, and Guangzhou. As the company grows, we are continuing to invest in our team presence.

The role includes travel approximately every 4–8 weeks to Belgrade, Barcelona, London, or other team locations. These visits provide time for joint planning, workshops, team gatherings, and strategic discussions.

Most work takes place remotely, complemented by regular opportunities to collaborate and plan together in person as the business scales.

This is a long-term opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to the growth of an international e-commerce group.

Our culture at ennovationHUB:

We value:

  • Taking ownership and following through on commitments

  • Turning plans into action

  • Communicating clearly and directly

  • Building knowledge through hands-on experience

We welcome people from different backgrounds who care about the quality of their work, take responsibility for their contribution, and help the business progress.

description:
Our mission and why it matters

We are on a mission to make humans the strongest security layer.

We don't just simulate risks. We build the tools that detect and stop them.

Why this role matters

The DACH region is currently our largest growth market in EMEA, generating an incredible amount of pipeline. With a highly certified product and an exceptional service that customers genuinely love, we have laid a strong foundation. We are now looking for a highly self-motivated Senior Account Executive who excels at taking those enterprise opportunities, multi-threading to economic buyers, and guiding them successfully through complex procurement cycles. You will be joining a team that has already proven it can support companies in seeing the value of the service, making this a prime opportunity to drive significant revenue rather than a speculative territory. Crucially, as our business results grow, you will be instrumental in helping us lay the groundwork for our future local hub in the Hamburg area.

What you’ll own and drive

You will take full ownership of the sales cycle for enterprise accounts in the DACH market, expertly guiding deals from initial pipeline through complex procurement to closed-won. Driving multi-threaded deals is second nature to you, as you reach economic buyers early and confidently hold the line on price objections. You will lead POC-led selling initiatives with real, concrete exit criteria to ensure successful outcomes, all while partnering closely with an SDR to prioritize opportunities and maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene with customer-owned next steps.

What success looks like

• In your first 3 months you'll be fully onboarded, deeply understand our qualification framework, and have a few opportunities moving past the initial stages with real, dated next steps.

• By month 6, you'll operate independently, managing an active pipeline, progressing opportunities consistently to late stage pipeline, and building your new business ARR towards quota.

What makes you thrive here

You have native-level or full business proficiency in German, alongside strong working proficiency in English, and several years of experience as a closing AE in B2B SaaS. Specifically, you have a proven track record of taking deals through procurement in fast-paced software or licensing sales, rather than just generating them. You bring a strong commercial backbone and comfort with multi-threading to an economic buyer before a proposal ever goes out. Above all, you have a team-first mindset with forecast honesty—you own your pipeline and embrace a collaborative, winning-together attitude.

You are a true self-starter who is phenomenal at what you currently do, taking pride in driving significant impact as a senior individual contributor.

To support our near-future vision of opening a physical hub in Germany, we are looking for candidates who are ideally already based in the wider Hamburg region.

Bonus points if you also bring experience with 3 to 6 month enterprise buying cycles and committees, or prior exposure to regulated DACH verticals like manufacturing, healthcare, or financial services. A background in cybersecurity, GRC, or compliance software is highly valued, as is a habit of leveraging technology creatively in your daily workflow.

Who you’ll work with

You will be a key part of our EMEA Sales Team, reporting to our EMEA Head of Sales. This DACH-focused role is working in a highly supportive AE group focusing on the EMEA market. We are committed to a collaborative culture but you will also be given independence to run your opportunities. You will find a team that asks for something back on every concession, owns their forecast misses honestly, and truly lives by a team-first standard that shows up in how we actually operate, rather than just as an aspiration on a slide.

What you can expect from us

• Compensation: Monthly fixed base salary of € 6000 - € 7000 depending on your experience (plus a 50/50 base and commission model featuring accelerated earnings for the first 12 months). You may notice varying salary ranges for roles with similar titles across Hoxhunt; this is because each range is grounded in our role leveling and reflects the seniority, scope, and impact expectations required for that specific role and team, and we operate with a low hierarchy.

• Working ways: You will start by working remotely from the Hamburg region. However, as we are planning to build a hub in Hamburg in the near future, this will eventually transform into a hybrid role. You will enjoy a flexible work setting with opportunities to travel and connect with the broader team.

• High performance meets high humanity: We bring an incredibly driven, high-impact energy to our work, but we leave our egos at the door. You will be surrounded by wildly talented, dedicated colleagues in an environment built on extreme kindness, support, and psychological safety.

• Authentic trust & autonomy: We hire great people and trust them to do great work. You will find a culture free of micromanagement, giving you the autonomy to take real ownership, drive impact, and shape things early on.

• A product you can be proud of: It is incredibly rare in cybersecurity to build a multi-award-winning product that end-users genuinely love. You will join a fast-paced, technically sophisticated team making a real, measurable impact against cybercrime, backed by strong financial stability and growth.

• The perks that matter: Alongside this amazing community, you will enjoy extensive healthcare with other benefits tailored for our team in Germany.

To ensure your personal data is handled securely and in compliance with GDPR, we only accept applications submitted through our application form. We cannot process applications sent via other channels, such as email or LinkedIn messages.

Our Recruitment Process

  1. Interview with Talent Acquisition (remote, 30 min)

  2. Interview with EMEA Head of Sales (remote, 45 min)

  3. Take-home assignment and panel (on-site in Helsinki, 90 min)

  4. Reference checks and offer

About Hoxhunt

Hoxhunt was founded in 2016 by four visionaries. Today we are a global team of +300 amazing Hoxhunters advancing a truly AI-native category leader in human risk management, with key hubs in the United States, the United Kingdom, Singapore, and Finland. We are proud to be an award-winning, fast-growing software company, recognized by G2 and Gartner, named to TIME Magazine's list of the World's Top EdTech Companies, and featured for our innovation in major publications like Fast Company, TechCrunch, Forbes, and Inc.

As a multi-product company, Hoxhunt goes beyond traditional security awareness. title: Operations Manager

Industrial labor is one of the most acute bottlenecks in the global economy. Operators are expensive, hard to retain, and working in environments that are increasingly unsafe. The shortage is structural. The window to solve it is now.

What We're Looking For

 

Essential

title: GTM Operations Manager
description:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile.

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance.

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

The role

We’re looking for a GTM Operations Manager to build and improve the workflows that connect our go-to-market teams.

A promising account signs up. Does the right person find out, with enough context to act? A customer becomes eligible for a new product. Do they receive useful guidance? A data sync fails overnight. Do we catch it before it affects a campaign, account handoff, or business decision?

You’ll help make those things work reliably.

You’ll join an existing GTM Operations team, working closely with @Nathan Bellehsen on Salesforce and Sales systems and @Masha Tsaryk on Marketing and customer-lifecycle systems. Your initial focus will be lead handoffs and lifecycle execution: the data, automation, quality checks, and reporting that turn customer signals into useful action.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role. You’ll own agreed projects from understanding the problem through building, testing, rollout, and ongoing improvement. Experienced teammates will provide context, help set priorities, and partner with you on architectural decisions. Within that direction, we expect you to make progress independently and flag problems early.

Our stack includes Salesforce, Customer.io, Clay, Looker, automation tools, and a growing set of AI workflows. You don’t need to know every tool. You do need to understand how systems connect and enjoy figuring out why something isn’t working.

Why we’re hiring for this role now

RevenueCat’s GTM organization is growing across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Growth. We’re developing more deliberate ways to identify promising accounts, help customers adopt our products, and turn successful one-to-one work into programs that reach many more people.

Our operations team already supports the systems behind that work. We need more capacity to take important workflows from “this could work” to something dependable that people use every day.

You’ll help us ship those improvements while making the existing operation easier to run: fewer manual handoffs, clearer ownership, more trustworthy data, and less time spent solving the same problem twice.

What you’ll be responsible for

  • Own selected GTM workflows end-to-end. Translate a business problem into a practical solution, agree how success will be measured, build and test it, and stay responsible after launch.

  • Make lead and account handoffs dependable. Build and improve enrichment, qualification, routing, alerts, and follow-up visibility. Help ensure important signals reach a named owner, and make missed or failed handoffs visible.

  • Put lifecycle programs into production. Partner with Marketing and Customer Growth on audience definitions, triggers, exclusions, data syncs, campaign QA, and measurement. Turn repeatable requests into workflows and templates teammates can use.

  • Keep data connected and usable. Trace how account, contact, and product-usage data moves between systems. Investigate stale records, duplicates, mismatched relationships, and failed syncs; fix what you can and work with the relevant system or Data owner on deeper issues.

  • Build automation that holds up in everyday use. Test realistic scenarios and edge cases, monitor failures, and make it clear how to recover when something breaks. Bring consequential changes to the relevant system owner before rollout.

  • Use AI where it improves the work. Build or improve workflows for tasks such as enrichment, research, qualification, and quality checks. Evaluate the output, understand the failure modes, and measure whether the result saves time or improves quality.

  • Make what you build understandable and useful. Document your workflows, enable the people using them, gather feedback, and improve adoption. Share knowledge so another teammate can operate and troubleshoot your work. Keep documentation current as workflows change, and fill gaps in the existing processes you take on.

  • Make operational performance visible. Build and maintain reports that help teams understand workflow health, handoff gaps, campaign execution, and adoption. Work with senior Ops teammates and Data on consistent definitions.

What you’ll need to be successful

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in GTM, revenue, marketing, sales, or customer operations.

  • Practical Salesforce experience. You understand objects, relationships, fields, flows, and how data moves through the system. You have built or changed things yourself.

  • Experience building in a marketing automation platform such as Customer.io, HubSpot, Marketo, Braze, or Iterable, including segmentation, triggers, and integrations.

  • Experience building something useful with AI. You can explain the problem, your contribution, how you checked the result, what failed, and what you changed. A sanitized walkthrough is welcome; we don’t expect confidential work from a previous employer.

  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical judgment. You can trace a problem across systems, check your assumptions against data, and distinguish a symptom from its cause.

  • Ownership and follow-through. You can take an agreed problem, work through ambiguity, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver without needing every step assigned.

  • Clear written communication. You keep stakeholders informed, document decisions, and explain technical problems in language others can act on.

  • Care for the details. You think about the wrong audience, missing record, duplicate trigger, or failed handoff before it becomes someone else’s problem.

  • Learning agility and adaptability. You can transfer what you know to unfamiliar tools and adjust your plan when priorities change, while keeping commitments and stakeholders informed.

Ideally, you

  • Have worked in a product-led or usage-based business with both self-service and Sales-assisted customers.

  • Have connected CRM, marketing automation, customer-success, or product-usage systems.

  • Can use SQL, APIs, webhooks, or lightweight scripts to investigate data and connect tools.

  • Have improved adoption of an internal tool or replaced repeated manual work with a maintained workflow.

  • Have supported customer onboarding, product adoption, lifecycle education, or account-coverage programs.

What success looks like

Within the first month, you’ll:

  • Learn how customers move through RevenueCat and how our GTM teams support them.

  • Map an initial workflow with @Nathan Bellehsen and @Masha Tsaryk, including its data sources, owners, dependencies, and common failure points.

  • Ship your first useful improvement as part of RevenueCat’s “first ship” tradition.

  • Agree your initial ownership area and a prioritized set of problems to solve.

Within the first three months, you’ll:

  • Own the day-to-day operation of an agreed set of lead and/or lifecycle workflows.

  • Deliver an improvement from scoping through rollout, with clear documentation and stakeholder feedback.

  • Establish baseline measures and monitoring for the workflows you own.

  • Give another teammate enough context to support your work when you’re away.

Within the first six months, you’ll:

  • Demonstrate measurable improvement in a core workflow, such as fewer missed handoffs, faster campaign delivery, fresher data, or less manual effort.

  • Turn recurring operational requests into reusable processes.

  • Show that the people your workflows serve are using them successfully, and improve what isn’t working.

Within the first twelve months, you’ll:

  • Independently deliver projects across systems within your areas of ownership.

  • Have a track record of reliable workflows, useful automation, and improvements that make GTM teams more effective.

  • Help shape the next priorities using evidence from users, operational performance, and customer needs.

  • Be developing deeper expertise and taking on progressively more complex work.

What we offer:

  • Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator

  • 10-year window to exercise vested equity options

  • A fully remote environment designed around autonomy and flexibility

  • 4-5 weeks of flexible time off annually

  • Paid desk at a co-working space

  • Workspace budget and continuous learning stipend

Interviewing at RevenueCat

Our interview process is rigorous on purpose. We want to be sure that everyone we bring on is genuinely excited about this work, aligned with how we operate, and ready to meet our high bar for performance. Curious what that actually looks like? Read more in our blog post on how we hire at RevenueCat, including tips to help you succeed.

Vega was founded by former investors at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world’s leading technology and financial services firms - including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. How we do it

Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you:

What we look for:

title: Software Engineer (Data)
description:
Our Mission

We’re not your average benefits platform – we’re the driving force that uplifts people’s lives. Our technology connects the entire benefits ecosystem, creating better outcomes for employers, employees, brokers, and providers.

Our mission is clear: to build a world where everything works at its best, ensuring every employee gets the support they need to thrive—both at work and beyond.

Your Mission

As our Software Engineer (Data), you’ll build and run the pipelines, orchestration, and infrastructure that move data across Ben: in from our product and the tools we use, in from our customers, and back out to them again. It’s the plumbing the whole company and our customers depend on, and it has to stay reliable. We serve global enterprise customers with strict security and reliability requirements.

You’ll own real work from day one. You’ll have a strong team of cross functional engineers alongside you, room to grow into harder problems, and the freedom to do the job your way.

What you’ll be working on

  • Own everything that flows into Ben: build and maintain the ingestion pipelines that bring data into our warehouse, with Fivetran for managed sources and custom pipelines where we need them.

  • Keep everything running on time: own the orchestration that keeps data moving on schedule and recovers cleanly when something breaks.

  • Scale and manage our data infrastructure: build and manage our data infrastructure as code with Terraform, using mainly AWS services.

  • Connect Ben to every system our customers run: build enterprise-grade pipelines and connectors for our customers, bringing their data in, for example from HR and payroll systems, and getting accurate data back out to them, reliably and securely, even at the volumes large customers bring.

  • Build the data layer our agents act on: help connect our data to the AI agents and services we're building, including through MCP connectors, so they get the right context at the right time.

  • Shape what we build: work with product and other stakeholders to scope problems and agree on simple but scalable solutions.

  • Build it to enterprise standard: build to current security practice, for example the OWASP Top 10 and the AWS Well-Architected Framework.

Behind the scenes

Ben runs on Python 3, Django, PostgreSQL, and React, on AWS.

Our data platform today is built around Fivetran, AWS DMS or custom pipelines for ingestion, dbt for transformation, PostgreSQL on AWS RDS as the warehouse, and n8n or AWS Lambda for automation between systems. We manage our infrastructure as code with Terraform and use different AWS services depending on requirements.

We have adopted frontier level agentic development practices and continue to push the envelope of what’s possible with current technologies.

  • Strong experience with Python and SQL.

  • A few years building and running production data pipelines that other people relied on.

  • Comfortable with infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform, and hands-on with AWS, for example Lambda, ECS, Glue, S3, RDS.

  • A good grasp of ETL/ELT and orchestration.

  • Experience building or running data integrations and connectors, especially ones that other companies or customers depend on, is a real plus.

  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: clean code, sensible design, and tests you can rely on.

  • You keep security in mind when you build applications and configure infrastructure, and you know what enterprise customers expect of their data.

Nice to have, not essential:

  • Experience working on customer-facing data integrations such as HRIS or payroll feeds via SFTP and in EDI format

  • Experience with MCP server development, or different ways of preparing data for AI agents such as ontology modelling, context, knowledge graphs, and semantic layers.

We don't expect all of it. We do expect curiosity about it.

Why join us?

Ben's customers are large enterprise employers, and the hundreds of thousands of people who work for them rely on us to get their benefits right, every time. That depends on data moving accurately between their systems and ours, every cycle. You get to work on the data infrastructure that makes this run like clockwork.

At the same time, Ben is an AI-native organisation. Agents are already doing a lot of impactful work here, and they can only do it on data they can trust. That raises questions a dashboard never had to answer. How fresh does this need to be for an agent to act on it? How do you match the same entity across tools? How do you control what an agent is allowed to see? Very few engineers have answered those in production. You'd be one of them.

You'll take ownership of large, complex problem spaces, help design how they scale, and build an agentic layer few engineers have built anywhere yet, and you'll see the impact of it: Ben supports hundreds of thousands of people across 30+ countries.

The Sparta Code

Understanding is non-negotiable

Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.

The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed.

Ask for forgiveness, not for permission

Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not.

90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned.

Fall in love with the problem

The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to.

Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working.

It's your fault. Lucky you.

If it's on you, it's in your control.

True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.

Conflict is a gift

Honesty is an expression of care.

Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it.

You report to our Head of Financial Crime and work alongside the fraud recovery and chargebacks lead. You partner with Product, Payments, Engineering, Customer Support and Compliance on every launch. description:
Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.

Why we're hiring

  • We're past product-market fit and growing 2x year on year, almost entirely through word of mouth, Google and AI search. Around 70 new leads land each month without a growth engine behind them, and you'll play a pivotal role in building one alongside the founders.

  • You'll sit in the founders' office, working directly with Paddy on whatever moves the number most, from partnerships and events to building something that brings in 50 qualified leads in a month.

  • The goal is 7,000 deals a year. Getting there depends on more of the right people finding us.

What you'll build

You'll work directly with Paddy, our co-founder, with the freedom to try things fast and the backing to scale what works

  • Growth mechanisms: Lead magnets, micro products, tools and campaigns that bring syndicate leads and fund managers to Odin. You build the actual thing with AI, not a strategy deck about it. Think a calculator every new fund manager bookmarks, or a tool that turns a syndicate lead's first deal into a week's work instead of a month's. Ship it, see what works, double down.

  • Partnerships: Co-investors, syndicate networks, accelerators and fund admins already talk to the people we want to reach. You find the ones who can send us the right people and get them live.

  • Events: Pitch nights, GP-LP mixers and founder dinners for a community that backs everything from AI labs to small nuclear reactors. You'll turn that into new customers.

  • Referrals and repeat: Our existing customers already come back again and again. You'll build the ways they bring others with them.

  • Special projects: The founders' office gets the problems that matter and don't have an owner yet. You'll pick them up, work out what's true and get them done.

What we're looking for

How we work

  2. Speed begets speed: We work fast. Speed compounds, it's the best form of defensibility, and it's energising to be around. If you work slowly, or tolerate slow work around you, you do not belong at Odin.

description:
About us

EggAI is a fast-growing AI consulting and development startup. We build agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients. We are growing in several European markets.

The role

You will lead our clients through the organisational and operational changes needed to establish a shared AI platform. The platform has two parts: an AI Control Plane that governs what agents may do and records the evidence, and a managed AI Runtime where the agents run. Both integrate with the client's identity, security, delivery and audit services, and both need owners, approval routes and support arrangements on the client side.

You will own delivery outcomes from mobilisation through production release and operating handover, acting as the client sponsor's day-to-day counterpart. The role reaches across engineering, business leadership, security, risk, compliance and operations. You will bring these groups together to agree how the platform is governed and supported, and what evidence they need for assurance in a regulated environment.

You will lead an EggAI delivery team with a mix of Platform Engineering roles and skills. Client application teams develop the business use cases; you lead AI platform delivery and the changes needed for teams to adopt and operate it.

Why this role

Most organisations are still working out how to let AI agents act safely in production: who approves what an agent may do, how its actions are evidenced, and who answers when something goes wrong. There is no settled playbook yet, especially in regulated industries. In this role you will help write it. The operating models, approval routes and assurance practices you design with our clients will shape how they run agentic AI for years, and they will become the basis of how EggAI delivers across Europe.

You will work at the point where AI capability meets enterprise reality, with direct access to client sponsors and EggAI leadership, and with real influence over how a growing company builds its delivery practice.

Responsibilities

- Own the delivery plan and milestones, keeping commitments achievable within the agreed scope, budget and team capacity.
- Secure the client commitments that delivery depends on. Agree who will provide access, complete service changes and make decisions, then resolve delays with the responsible teams.
- Design the target operating model with the client. Define who owns the platform service, maintains policies and software, supports the runtime and approves changes, with agreed escalation routes.
- Run milestone acceptance. Submit evidence for each milestone, secure recorded client decisions within agreed review periods and escalate overdue or disputed decisions.
- Lead change control with the sponsor and EggAI leadership. Agree scope, capacity, cost and date changes, including proposals for additional services or extended support, before committing the team.
- Secure production readiness. Confirm the service owners and funded operating cover from the operating model are in place before go-live, escalating any gap that prevents release.
- Lead go-live coordination and the intensive support period after release. Bring client operations and application teams together to resolve incidents and agree when normal support can take over.
- Lead platform adoption and training with the technical team, preparing client teams to use shared controls and follow the agreed delivery processes.
- Run operating handover through practical exercises. Secure acceptance of ongoing duties and agree any further support needed before the current engagement ends.
- Give sponsors a clear account of progress and delivery risks through weekly delivery reviews, regular demonstrations and sponsor reviews. Report spending, forecast work and adoption results so they can make timely decisions.

 What You Bring

- You have led technology programmes into production in a regulated environment, including operational readiness and handover to receiving teams.
- You have designed and introduced operating models, turning agreed responsibilities into working approval, support and service-management processes.
- You have led delivery across engineering teams, client departments and external partners, including influencing senior sponsors and resolving competing priorities.
- You have managed budgets and contractual scope in client delivery, including negotiating changes and shaping additional work.
- You understand cloud platforms, security and service operations well enough to challenge plans and dependencies with technical specialists.
- You communicate clearly and can lead workshops that turn disagreement or uncertainty into decisions and action.

Nice to have

  • AI platforms or agentic AI.

  • Platform engineering, identity, security controls or audit and assurance work.

  • Cloud platform delivery using Azure (preferred), AWS or Google Cloud, and AI platform services such as Microsoft Foundry.

  • German is a strong advantage, as many of our clients are in the DACH region.

Practical details

- Hybrid working and client-site attendance will depend on the engagement.
- You will need to complete the background and security checks required by the client.

  • Esprit d'équipe - vous savez collaborer et tirer le meilleur parti des personnes qui vous entourent. Vous êtes capable de travailler efficacement à tous les niveaux de Deliveroo et de réussir avec et par les autres.
  • Optimiste et dynamique - vous apportez de la fraîcheur, de l'énergie et de la passion dans l'équipe. Vous contribuez à créer un environnement de travail unique, propice aux nouvelles idées et agréable pour les autres personnes impliquées.

Nous offrons un environnement de travail dynamique et stimulant, où vous aurez l'opportunité de développer vos compétences et de contribuer activement à notre mission de devenir la référence en matière de bien manger. Rejoignez notre équipe exceptionnelle dès maintenant et faites partie de cette aventure passionnante !

La vie chez Deliveroo :

Notre équipe est en forte croissance, notre impact très important, et nous cherchons à répondre aux questions les plus stimulantes du moment. Nous progressons rapidement, nous explorons toujours de nouvelles idées et nous sommes très transparents quant aux décisions que nous prenons et à ce qui motive nos choix.

Il y a tellement de questions que nous souhaitons résoudre, et encore plus que nous n'avons pas encore rencontrées. Comment les données et la technologie peuvent-elles aider les restaurants à développer leur activité à mesure que les habitudes des consommateurs évoluent ? Chez Deliveroo, ces questions ne sont que quelques-uns des défis ambitieux auxquels nous nous efforçons de répondre – et il n'y a aucun projet qui ne peut pas devenir le vôtre. 46 000 à 58 000 € brut annuel fixe, selon expérience, auxquels s'ajoutent une rémunération variable et un dispositif d'intéressement.

title: Guest Service Officer H/F
description:
CHAMP D'APPLICATION DU POSTE

Le/La agent(e) du service client (Guest Service Officer), doit assurer un service de première ligne irréprochable en prenant en charge l’enregistrement des clients ainsi que la gestion des accès aux lounges avec précision, professionnalisme et efficacité. Le/La collaborateur-rice contribue activement au bon fonctionnement de l’espace en accompagnant les clients, en assurant les contrôles de zone, en gérant les flux et les files d’attente, tout en identifiant et en escaladant rapidement les problématiques liées au service ou à la maintenance.

Il/elle participe également au développement du chiffre d’affaires en promouvant et en vendant les offres lounges, les campagnes ponctuelles, les partenariats ainsi que les adhésions au programme Smart Traveller. Enfin, il/elle veille au respect des standards opérationnels en appliquant rigoureusement les procédures internes (SOP), en garantissant l’exactitude des transactions, en optimisant l’utilisation des ressources et en assurant un haut niveau d’hygiène ainsi que la confidentialité des clients.

RESPONSABILITÉS DU POSTE

  • Gérer efficacement le processus d'enregistrement des invités, en garantissant l'exactitude des droits des invités, le respect des consignes d'admission et la transmission d'une première impression bienvenue.
  • Accueillir, recevoir et remercier les invités à la réception avec professionnalisme, courtoisie et excellence du service.
  • Assister les clients lors de leurs demandes.
  • Adresser rapidement les demandes des clients, en faisant remonter les questions complexes ou les préoccupations de service au responsable du lounge, si nécessaire.
  • Effectuer des contrôles de routine dans les espaces de détente — tels que les zones de salon, buffet, aires de repos, et signaler immédiatement les problèmes d'entretien ou de propreté.
  • Promouvoir activement les services proposés pour soutenir les objectifs de génération de revenus.
  • Encourager et inscrire les clients au programme Smart Traveller (ST) en expliquant les avantages et en veillant à une bonne compréhension des informations lors de l'inscription.
  • Suivre les procédures d'objets perdus en documentant avec précision les objets, en assurant une manipulation sécurisée et en informant le superviseur.
  • Répondre de manière professionnelle aux appels téléphoniques, aux e-mails et aux communications internes, en veillant à une assistance rapide et à des informations claires.
  • Gérer les transactions de points de vente, les reçus, les bons et les paiements sans espèces avec précision et conformément aux directives financières et aux procédures opérationnelles standard.
  • Aider aux efforts de contrôle des coûts en utilisant de manière responsable la papeterie, les formulaires et les matériaux opérationnels et en signalant les gaspillages inutiles.
  • Maintenir la confidentialité des informations des clients en permanence.
  • Soutenir la préparation opérationnelle en aidant à la gestion des files d'attente, à l'affluence des foules, aux procédures d'ouverture/fermeture.
  • Collaborer avec le responsable de service/lounge pour maintenir un flux de service fluide et respecter les normes internes PPG.
  • Participer à des réunions d'équipe, des sessions de formation et des audits qualité afin d'améliorer la prestation des services et les connaissances opérationnelles.
  • Effectuer toutes les tâches supplémentaires assignées par le superviseur ou le responsable des opérations.

Cette liste est non exhaustive

EXIGENCES DU POSTE

  • Une première expérience en hôtellerie, restauration
  • Bonnes compétences interpersonnelles et de communication
  • Bonne maîtrise de l’anglais et du français
  • Une autre langue parlée serait un plus
  • Capable de travailler de manière autonome comme en équipe
  • Bonne gestion du stress

Conditions particulières :

Flexibilité horaire, incluant une disponibilité lors des périodes de forte activité, des jours fériés et des week-ends

Lieu du poste : En présentiel

Ce que nous vous offrons

Rejoignez un groupe international en pleine croissance, dans un environnement premium au cœur de l’aéroport Nice Côte d’Azur.

Un CDI stable avec des plannings sans coupure

Un bonus annuel de performance à partir d’un an d’ancienneté

Une mutuelle et une prévoyance

La prise en charge à 50 % des transports en commun ou une place de parking à l’aéroport

Une indemnité repas pour chaque journée travaillée

Un uniforme fourni

Des formations tout au long de votre parcours

De réelles opportunités d’évolution au sein d’un groupe international

Un programme de reconnaissance des collaborateurs

Rejoignez-nous !

Chez Plaza Premium Group, nous sommes convaincus que la qualité de l’expérience client repose avant tout sur l’engagement et le savoir-faire de nos équipes.

Si vous aimez le contact humain, le travail en équipe et les environnements dynamiques, rejoignez-nous et participez à offrir à nos voyageurs une expérience agréable et de qualité au sein de notre lounge.

Plaza Premium Group s’engage en faveur de l’inclusion et de la diversité. Toutes les candidatures sont les bienvenues, y compris celles des personnes en situation de handicap.

title: Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines - 60%
description:
À propos de FPP Industries

FPP Industries poursuit son développement et souhaite aujourd’hui structurer davantage sa fonction Ressources Humaines.

Dans ce contexte, nous créons un poste de Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines à 60 %, directement rattaché à la Direction générale.

L’enjeu : construire une gestion RH à la fois fiable, structurée et humaine, capable d’accompagner durablement le développement de l’entreprise.

Pourquoi ce poste existe

Jusqu’à présent, les différents sujets RH ont été pris en charge sans fonction RH dédiée.

Avec le développement de l’entreprise, nous souhaitons désormais franchir une nouvelle étape : fiabiliser l’administration du personnel, structurer nos pratiques RH et offrir aux collaborateurs comme aux managers un interlocuteur clairement identifié.

Il s’agit donc d’une création de poste.

Vous rejoindrez une fonction qui a déjà un cadre et des responsabilités définis, mais dans laquelle de nombreux processus restent à structurer et à faire évoluer.

Votre mission

Votre mission sera de structurer, administrer et faire vivre les Ressources Humaines de FPP Industries, en garantissant une gestion fiable du quotidien tout en construisant progressivement les pratiques RH dont l’entreprise aura besoin pour poursuivre son développement.

Vous serez le référent RH opérationnel de l’entreprise et travaillerez en lien direct avec la Direction, les managers, les collaborateurs ainsi que les partenaires externes.

Vos responsabilités principales

Garantir une administration RH et une paie fiables.
Vous prenez en charge le suivi administratif des collaborateurs, de leur arrivée à leur départ : contrats et avenants, absences, congés, périodes d’essai, visites médicales, échéances et dossiers individuels. Vous collectez et contrôlez les variables de paie, établissez les bulletins de salaire et sécurisez leur remise dans les délais.

Piloter les recrutements et les intégrations.
Vous accompagnez les managers dans la définition de leurs besoins, rédigez et diffusez les offres, présélectionnez les candidatures, réalisez les premiers entretiens et coordonnez le processus jusqu’à l’intégration des nouveaux collaborateurs.

Développer les compétences.
Vous identifiez les besoins avec les managers, organisez et suivez les formations et contribuez progressivement à construire une vision claire des compétences disponibles et à développer dans l’entreprise.

Accompagner les managers et les collaborateurs.
Vous devenez un interlocuteur RH accessible au quotidien. Vous accompagnez les managers dans leurs problématiques humaines, organisez les campagnes d’entretiens et contribuez à identifier suffisamment tôt les situations nécessitant une attention particulière.

Structurer et améliorer les pratiques RH.
Vous fiabilisez les données, construisez les indicateurs utiles au pilotage, formalisez les processus et proposez des améliorations concrètes pour simplifier le fonctionnement RH et l’expérience collaborateur.

Accompagner la mise en conformité liée au développement de l’entreprise.
Vous contribuerez notamment aux chantiers liés au CSE, au DUERP et à la structuration progressive de la démarche RSE, en lien avec la Direction et l’évolution de l’entreprise.

Ce que nous attendons de vous

Indispensable

Vous disposez de bases solides en administration du personnel et droit social français.

Vous êtes capable de prendre en charge la production des bulletins de salaire, tout en sachant solliciter un prestataire ou un conseil externe lorsqu’une situation nécessite une expertise technique ou réglementaire particulière.

Vous savez conduire un recrutement, accompagner une intégration et travailler avec des managers sur leurs problématiques RH quotidiennes.

Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils bureautiques et suffisamment structuré(e) pour tenir des données, documents et échéances RH avec un haut niveau de fiabilité.

La confidentialité, la rigueur et la fiabilité sont pour vous non négociables.

Votre manière de travailler

Ce poste conviendra particulièrement à une personne qui apprécie autant faire fonctionner le quotidien que construire ce qui n’existe pas encore.

Vous aimez comprendre avant d’agir, structurer, documenter et améliorer.

Vous êtes capable d’avancer de manière autonome dans votre périmètre tout en sachant identifier les décisions qui nécessitent un arbitrage de la Direction.

Vous savez écouter sans perdre votre neutralité, accompagner sans vous substituer au manager et challenger avec tact lorsqu’une situation le nécessite.

Vous êtes également à l’aise dans un environnement où la fonction RH continuera à évoluer avec le développement de l’entreprise.

Ce que nous vous offrons

Vous rejoignez FPP Industries au moment où la fonction RH se structure réellement.

Vous ne reprendrez donc pas simplement un poste existant : vous aurez l’opportunité de contribuer directement à la construction et à l’amélioration de nos pratiques RH.

Le poste offre un lien direct avec la Direction, une réelle autonomie dans l’organisation du quotidien RH et un périmètre susceptible d’évoluer progressivement avec le développement de l’entreprise et du groupe.

Nous recherchons avant tout une personne souhaitant construire une fonction utile, pragmatique et proche du terrain.

Informations pratiques

Lieu : Le Cannet, France
Taux d’activité : 60 %
Contrat : CDI
Contexte : création de poste
Rattachement : Direction générale
Management direct : aucun dans un premier temps
Entrée souhaitée : 1er janvier 2027

Processus de recrutement

Notre objectif est de prendre le temps de vérifier l’adéquation réciproque entre votre manière de travailler, la réalité du poste et le fonctionnement de FPP Industries.

Les différentes étapes du processus et leurs délais vous seront présentés clairement dès les premiers échanges.

Envie de construire cette fonction avec nous ?

Si vous aimez les Ressources Humaines à la fois pour leur exigence administrative, leur dimension humaine et leur rôle dans la structuration d’une entreprise, nous serons heureux de découvrir votre candidature.

description:
🌿 D'abord, quelques mots sur nous

Chez Nature Occitane, nous avons une conviction : les plus beaux voyages ne sont pas forcément ceux qui nous emmènent le plus loin.

Ce sont ceux qui nous invitent à découvrir un territoire autrement, à prendre le temps, à rencontrer ceux qui y vivent et à profiter pleinement de ce que la nature nous offre.

C'est autour de cette idée que j'ai créé Nature Occitane en 2012.

Aujourd'hui, nous sommes une petite équipe de passionnés qui imagine, conçoit et organise des voyages à pied, à vélo et multiactivités, en liberté ou accompagnés.

De la Provence à la Catalogne, du canal du Midi aux Cévennes, nous aimons les beaux tracés, les bonnes adresses, les rencontres authentiques et les expériences dont nos voyageurs se souviennent longtemps.

Nous aimons aussi travailler avec des partenaires locaux, défendre un tourisme plus respectueux des territoires et imaginer des voyages qui donnent envie de partir autrement.

Nature Occitane a grandi, et nous avons encore beaucoup d'idées pour la suite : de nouvelles destinations, de nouveaux séjours, des voyages bas carbone en Europe et l'envie de devenir une référence du slow tourisme.

Pour écrire cette prochaine étape, nous recherchons une personne qui aura envie de s'investir pleinement dans notre aventure.

🚀 Votre fiche de poste

1. Vous serez avant tout sur le terrain commercial.

  • Conseiller nos voyageurs et leur proposer les séjours qui leur correspondent.

  • Construire des devis, assurer les relances et concrétiser les réservations.

  • Piloter notre activité commerciale avec des indicateurs simples : ventes, taux de transformation, chiffre d'affaires et marges.

  • Faire évoluer nos méthodes pour améliorer l'expérience client et notre efficacité.

2. Vous ferez grandir notre petite équipe commerciale.

  • Accompagner et faire progresser une collaboratrice.

  • Organiser les priorités et fluidifier le suivi des demandes.

  • Partager vos bonnes pratiques, encourager les initiatives et cultiver l'entraide.

  • Installer une dynamique à la fois exigeante, positive et tournée vers les résultats.

3. Vous participerez activement à notre développement marketing.

Nous lançons un nouveau site internet et souhaitons accélérer notre visibilité.

Vous contribuerez notamment à :

  • Développer notre référencement naturel (SEO), avec environ une journée dédiée chaque semaine.

  • Piloter nos campagnes publicitaires Google Ads avec notre prestataire.

  • Améliorer nos pages séjours et notre parcours de réservation.

  • Participer aux newsletters, aux contenus et aux actions de fidélisation.

  • Identifier les meilleures opportunités pour attirer de nouveaux voyageurs.

4. Vous garderez un pied dans la création de voyages.

Parce que chez nous, la vente et la production sont intimement liés.

Vous pourrez contribuer à améliorer nos séjours, partager les attentes des voyageurs et participer ponctuellement à la création de nouvelles expériences, aux côtés de notre équipe de production.

Nous vivons au rythme des saisons. La haute saison privilégie la vente et le suivi des voyageurs ; les périodes plus calmes permettent d'approfondir le marketing et et de contribuer davantage à la production.

Les priorités sont définies ensemble, avec une réelle autonomie dans l'organisation du travail.

🌟 Le profil que nous recherchons

Nous ne recherchons pas un CV parfait ni une personne qui coche toutes les cases.

Nous recherchons surtout une personnalité.

Quelqu'un de curieux, enthousiaste, fiable, qui aime les relations humaines, les défis et le travail bien fait.

Vous pourriez vous reconnaître dans ces quelques phrases :

  • Vous avez une vraie fibre commerciale.

  • Vous connaissez le monde du voyage et savez conseiller des clients exigeants.

  • Vous avez déjà accompagné ou managé une petite équipe.

  • Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils numériques, les CRM et les chiffres.

  • Le marketing digital vous intéresse et vous en connaissez les fondamentaux.

  • Vous savez prendre des initiatives, vous organiser et aller au bout de vos projets.

  • Vous aimez la randonnée, le vélo, les voyages ou simplement la découverte de nouveaux territoires.

  • Vous êtes à l'aise en anglais professionnel.

Et surtout, vous avez envie de vous engager dans une entreprise à taille humaine, où votre travail aura un impact visible.

Nous accordons autant d'importance à votre état d'esprit et à vos valeurs qu'à vos compétences.

🌞 Pourquoi rejoindre Nature Occitane ?

✨ Une équipe à taille humaine, passionnée, bienveillante et engagée.

🏕️ Des voyages qui ont du sens, conçus avec soin, au plus près des territoires et de ceux qui les font vivre.

🌊 Un cadre de travail privilégié, entre mer et montagne, dans les Pyrénées-Orientales.

🌱 Une entreprise indépendante et en croissance, où les idées peuvent rapidement devenir des projets concrets.

💡 Une réelle autonomie, de la confiance et la possibilité de proposer, expérimenter et améliorer nos méthodes.


📍 Conditions du poste

  • Localisation : Alénya (66), à proximité de Perpignan.

  • Télétravail : 1 jour par semaine, le poste nécessitant un management de proximité.

  • Avantages : titres-restaurant, mutuelle d'entreprise.

  • Prise de poste : à convenir.

✉️ Envie de nous rejoindre ?

Si vous vous reconnaissez dans cette annonce, nous serions ravis de faire votre connaissance.

Envoyez-nous votre CV, mais surtout quelques mots pour nous expliquer ce qui vous donne envie de rejoindre Nature Occitane.

Pas besoin d'une lettre de motivation interminable ou d'un discours formaté.

Nous préférons une candidature sincère, qui nous permette de comprendre qui vous êtes, ce qui vous anime et ce que vous aimeriez construire avec nous.

Au plaisir de vous rencontrer !

title: Senior Security Engineer - Remote
description:
About Us

Parity is one of the world’s most experienced companies building the core infrastructure behind blockchain — the system that allows information and value to be shared securely without needing an intermediary. We’re laying the foundation for a better web which respects the freedom and data of individuals, and empowers developers to build better, more trustworthy online services.


Our remote-first, global team develop open-source software that anyone can use or improve. This includes Polkadot, Polkadot SDK, and Kusama — key parts of the Web3 tech stack, the next generation of the internet. Our mission is to make Polkadot the most active and innovative community in blockchain, powering a new era of connected and decentralised applications.

About the Team

Parity’s Security Engineering team is at the forefront of protecting the Polkadot ecosystem by designing and implementing secure software, auditing code for vulnerabilities, and building cutting-edge ML tools to automate security analysis. We work closely with development teams to embed security best practices across our open-source stack, ensuring that our blockchain infrastructure is robust, resilient, and secure by design.

About the Role

As a security-focused software engineer, you will go beyond traditional application security - you’ll audit and ideally write secure Rust code where needed, conduct deep manual and automated code audits, and leverage machine learning to enhance security across our ecosystem. This is an opportunity to shape the security landscape of the next generation of decentralized applications and protocols.

  • Assist in developing Secure Software – Write and optimise Rust code to build security-critical components and tools.

  • Code Auditing & Vulnerability Analysis – Perform deep manual and automated code reviews to identify and mitigate security vulnerabilities.

  • ML-Powered Security – Design and implement machine learning models for automated security analysis, anomaly detection, and threat mitigation.

  • Bug Bounty & Vulnerability Management – Manage bug bounty submissions, triage security reports, and collaborate with ethical hackers to resolve issues.

  • Secure Development Best Practices – Work with engineering teams to integrate security best practices into the software development lifecycle.

  • Threat Modeling & Risk Assessment – Identify and assess security risks in our blockchain infrastructure, smart contracts, and core software.

  • Stay Cutting-Edge – Research and implement the latest advancements in secure coding, ML-driven security, and blockchain security.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience with secure coding practices and memory safety concepts.

  • Background in code auditing, vulnerability analysis, or exploit development.

  • Experience triaging and resolving bug bounty reports.

  • Knowledge of machine learning techniques applied to security (e.g., anomaly detection, fuzzing, automated threat detection).

  • Familiarity with cryptographic principles, blockchain security, or decentralized systems.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and an offensive security mindset.

If you're excited about writing secure software, auditing code, and pioneering ML-driven security solutions for Web3, we’d love to hear from you!

About Working With Us

Joining Parity means joining team mates who are genuinely excited about the impact their projects are having, and the opportunity to grow alongside some of the brightest minds in the Web3 space! You’ll work remotely and flexibly, while still getting to meet your team mates throughout the year at team and company-wide retreats.

Upon receiving an offer, all candidates undergo a background check through Zinc, our trusted third-party provider. Team members will be taken on as a contractor via our UK entity. View our Applicant Notice to see how we use your data.

Parity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome diversity in our global team and care about everyone in our collective feeling included and welcome.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer - EMEA
description:
Seeq builds advanced analytics software that unlocks insights from industrial process data—empowering companies in sectors like pharmaceuticals, oil & gas, chemicals, and power generation to optimize operations and drive business value.

As a remote-first company since our founding, we’re built for collaboration across time zones. Our engineering and customer-facing teams thrive in a supportive, agile environment that emphasizes curiosity, learning, and continuous improvement.

Analytics Engineers at Seeq serve as trusted technical advisors to our customers, helping them solve complex process challenges and maximize value from our software. You’ll work directly with end users to design scalable, high-impact analytics solutions that drive engagement, adoption, and tangible business outcomes.

 

Key Duties & Responsibilities:

As a key customer-facing team member, you will participate in the following activities:

 Customer Technical Adoption 

  • Serve as the customer’s trusted technical advisor by building relationships with champions and end-users through solution design, implementation guidance, and technical mentorship.
  • Leverage customer relationships to perform constant discovery and uncover high-value, high-impact use case opportunities directly linked to the customer’s critical business workflows and objectives.
  • Collaborate with the customer and account team to develop and execute strategic plans for adoption of Seeq and completion of key use cases addressing business objectives.
  • Advise customer champions and end-users to implement and operationalize the use cases to deliver a high return on investment for the customer. Occasionally may require hands-on delivery to accelerate a customer’s high value use case.
  • Upskill Seeq’s partner ecosystem to be an extension of the Analytics Engineering team to provide support globally and in localized languages. 

Product Expertise 

  • Be a product expert, maintaining knowledge of how to implement and troubleshoot solutions in the platform, including integrations with other systems.
  • Identify gaps in Seeq's capabilities required to meet customer needs and give feedback to the product organization to influence the product roadmap.
  • Ability to assess and position Seeq’s benefits relative to competitive products in the marketplace or in the customer’s ecosystem.
  • Work with the product team to design, implement, and test new functionalities that meet customer needs.

 Industry Expertise 

  • Build trust with customers through the application of industry-specific knowledge and awareness, including market and use case trends specific to their area. 
  • Collaborate with internal teams (including industry principals, product marketing, and solution consulting) to influence industry-specific strategy.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in a technical field such as chemical, mechanical, electrical, or industrial engineering; degrees in operations research, data analytics, or applied math will be considered.
  • Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in process engineering, reliability engineering, technical pre-sales engineering (SaaS business, OT space preferred), or other related industry fields.
  • Deep technical expertise in one or more industrial process manufacturing verticals and a sound understanding of broad market drivers and business priorities.
  • Examples of industrial process industries are chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power & utilities, metals & mining, food & beverage, pulp & paper, etc.
  • Empathy with and experience in the difficulties involved in trying to solve real-world business and industrial challenges involving dense time-series process data with inadequate or overly complex analytics tools, such as Excel, MATLAB, Python, BI tools, or otherwise.
  • Responsive and adept at building trust and rapport with customers, prospective customers, partners, and internal multidisciplinary teams.
  • Effective and influential technical communicator. Enjoys dissecting, articulating, and translating a combination of customer-stated and customer-implied needs. Able to communicate with subject matter experts, managers, directors, and C-level audiences.
  • Creative ability to develop and propose technical solutions leveraging the latest features and capabilities in the software and broader technology landscape. Programming experience in Python and/or other programming languages is a plus.
  • Ability to independently prioritize work based on account team strategy, customer business needs, and Seeq company objectives.
  • Prior experience using Seeq is highly preferred.
  • Python programming skills is a plus.
  • Broad knowledge of the SaaS industrial analytics ecosystem is a plus (e.g., Azure, AWS, Databricks, AVEVA, Aspen Tech, IOTA, Cognite, C3.ai, Palantir, etc.).

Benefits

Seeq is a remote-first (only) company founded by serial entrepreneurs. Our executive team and board of directors have extensive experience with successful startup ventures in high-growth environments.

We are founded on the idea that companies need better solutions for quickly and easily getting business insight from their industrial process data. Our mission is to provide software and services that convert that data into meaningful information that the business can use to improve profitability.

We have a wonderful, kind-hearted, talented team that loves to collaborate, lead by example, and exceed our customers’ expectations. We are certified as a great place to work, an emerging startup, the Technology Fast 500, and Inc. Magazine's Best Places to Work.

The Perks of Working at Seeq

  • Competitive salary
    • €111,000 - 129,000 depending on experience.
    • Variable bonus
  • Benefits:
    • Unlimited PTO
    • Generous home office allowance
    • The best co-workers (we've analyzed the data, so we know it's true.)
    • Pet-friendly workspace (your dog will be so happy to have you home)
    • You love your job!

Seeq provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics.

You must be authorized to work in the country in which you reside. Seeq does not sponsor US F1 or H-1B work visas
