title: Marketing & Communications Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Du möchtest nicht einfach Marketing machen. Du möchtest etwas bewegen.

Du hast Freude daran, Dinge aufzubauen, Menschen zusammenzubringen und aus guten Ideen etwas Konkretes zu machen? Du bist neugierig, stellst Fragen und probierst auch mal neue Wege aus? Und Du findest, dass gute Ergebnisse am besten gemeinsam entstehen?

Dann könnten wir gut zusammenpassen.

Wir suchen keinen Menschen, der einfach nur einen Marketingplan abarbeitet. Wir suchen jemanden, der mitdenkt, Verantwortung übernimmt, Dinge hinterfragt und Lust hat, mit uns etwas zu gestalten.

Dabei glauben wir an klare Worte, gegenseitiges Vertrauen und hohe Ansprüche an unsere Arbeit. Wir nehmen unsere Aufgaben ernst – uns selbst aber nicht immer. Und wir sind überzeugt, dass Professionalität und Menschlichkeit zusammengehören.

Über OIXIO

OIXIO gehört zu den führenden IT-Anbietern Estlands – einem Land, das wie kaum ein anderes in Europa für gelebte Digitalisierung und einen hohen Stellenwert von Cybersecurity steht.

Was dort über viele Jahre gewachsen ist, bringen wir jetzt verstärkt nach Deutschland: technologische Kompetenz, pragmatische Lösungen, direkte Zusammenarbeit und die Überzeugung, dass gute Digitalisierung vor allem eines tun muss – funktionieren.

Mit OIXIO erminas verbinden wir diesen estnischen Spirit mit unserer langjährigen Erfahrung mit deutschen Hidden Champions im Mittelstand und unserer lokalen Basis in Oldenburg. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir Unternehmen dabei, ihre IT sicher, verlässlich und zukunftsfähig aufzustellen – von Cybersecurity und IT-Infrastruktur über Business-Anwendungen und Cloud bis zu Daten, KI und Industrial IoT.

In Deutschland stehen wir mit unserer gemeinsamen Geschichte noch am Anfang – und kaum jemand kennt hier bisher unseren Namen. Genau deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der das ändern will und lieber etwas aufbaut, als eine fertige Rolle zu übernehmen.

Die Aufgabe

Als Marketing & Communications Manager Deutschland machst Du OIXIO bei mittelständischen Industrieunternehmen bekannt und vertrauenswürdig – vor allem in Norddeutschland und Nordrhein-Westfalen – und schaffst die Gespräche, auf denen unser Vertrieb aufbaut.

Du entwickelst unsere Botschaften für den deutschen Markt und übersetzt unser Angebot in klare Geschichten für IT, Produktion und Geschäftsführung.

Gemeinsam mit unserem Sales Account Manager steuerst Du gezielte Kampagnen für eine definierte Liste von Zielunternehmen und machst aus Interesse konkrete Gespräche.

Du baust die Präsenz von OIXIO auf LinkedIn auf – für das Unternehmen sowie für unsere Expertinnen, Experten und Geschäftsführung.

Du pflegst Kontakte zu Fach- und Regionalmedien und platzierst Artikel, Fachbeiträge und Kundengeschichten.

Du organisierst eigene Veranstaltungen – vom Kundenfrühstück im Werk über Webinare bis zu Roundtables – und wählst die Messen und Netzwerkveranstaltungen aus, auf denen wir präsent sind.

Du erstellst Inhalte, die überzeugen: Case Studies, One-Pager, Präsentationen, Videos und Webinhalte – gemeinsam mit unseren Fachleuten in Deutschland, Estland und Litauen.

Du misst, was wirkt – Website-Besuche, Anfragen, Veranstaltungsteilnahmen, aktivierte Zielunternehmen und Vertriebstermine – und steuerst Deine Aktivitäten in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM.

Unsere Themen: Cybersecurity, Informationssicherheit, Managed IT Services, Microsoft Business Central/NAV-Modernisierung, Prozessdigitalisierung, Industrial IoT, Cloud, Daten und KI.

Was Du mitbringen solltest

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing oder in der Unternehmenskommunikation, idealerweise mit IT-Services, Managed Services, Industrieautomation, Beratung oder Business-Anwendungen.

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge darin, Sichtbarkeit aufzubauen und Nachfrage zu erzeugen – gerne auch als erste oder einzige Marketingverantwortliche in einem Unternehmen oder Markt.

  • Erfahrung mit Kampagnen für konkrete Zielunternehmen und mehrere Entscheiderinnen und Entscheider auf Kundenseite.

  • Gutes Verständnis für mittelständische Unternehmen, besonders im industriellen Umfeld, und die Fähigkeit, technische Themen verständlich zu erklären.

  • Starke Schreibkompetenz, sicherer Umgang mit LinkedIn, CRM und Web-Analytics, sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und sehr gutes Englisch.

  • Du kennst die wichtigsten Werkzeuge des modernen B2B-Marketings und weißt, wie Du ihre Wirkung misst. Ob Dynamics 365, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Analytics, SEO-Tools oder KI: Entscheidend ist für uns nicht, dass Du jedes Tool bereits beherrschst, sondern dass Du weißt, was Du erreichen willst, und Dich schnell in neue Werkzeuge einarbeiten kannst.

  • Flexibler Wohnort in Norddeutschland, sofern regelmäßige persönliche Treffen mit dem Team in unserem Büro in Oldenburg gut möglich sind; Reisebereitschaft deutschlandweit, gelegentlich auch nach Estland und Litauen.

Was gut zu uns passt

  • Du hast Freude daran, Dinge aufzubauen. Ein komplett bestelltes Feld brauchst Du nicht – im Gegenteil: Du erkennst Möglichkeiten, entwickelst Ideen und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, daraus etwas zu machen.

  • Du bist neugierig auf Menschen, Unternehmen und Technologien und willst verstehen, bevor Du kommunizierst.

  • Du schätzt Flexibilität, möchtest aber nicht ausschließlich im Homeoffice arbeiten. Der persönliche Austausch im Team, mit unseren Kunden und mit der Presse ist Dir wichtig.

  • Du kannst die Stärke und Erfahrung einer etablierten internationalen IT-Gruppe nutzen und gleichzeitig mit uns herausfinden, was davon für den deutschen Mittelstand wirklich relevant ist.

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, aber nicht als Einzelkämpfer. Bei uns ist Marketing Teamsport: Gute Ergebnisse entstehen gemeinsam mit Vertrieb, Consultants, Technik und Geschäftsführung.

  • Du misst Deinen Erfolg at Gesprächen und Kunden – nicht an Likes – und versprichst nichts, was unser Team nicht halten kann.

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role
At Samsara, we're looking for a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to help turn growing Telematics products into major businesses. Our new product bets include routing and workforce management for physical operations.
The portfolio has paying customers and early traction. You'll help shape what comes next, working directly with customers to understand their operations, test ideas and build solutions they choose to use. You'll stay close to the work through production, customer adoption and scale.
This is a technical leadership role with substantial hands-on engineering. You'll define important problems and make product and technical decisions alongside Product, Design and Engineering partners. You'll bring the judgement to move forward when requirements are incomplete, and the influence to align other teams around a clear direction.

What you will do

  • Work directly with customers and customer-facing teams to understand unmet needs, test assumptions and identify opportunities worth pursuing. Agree on success measures with Product and Design before investing in a solution.
  • Lead ambiguous initiatives end to end, from discovery and prototypes through production rollout, adoption and iteration. Use customer feedback and product data to decide what to improve, expand or stop.
  • Write and ship code on the critical path. Work across services, APIs and customer-facing experiences as the problem requires, combining technical depth with the ability to learn unfamiliar parts of the product.
  • Set technical direction for your area and align the teams needed to deliver it. Make pragmatic architecture choices that support rapid learning today and reliable growth over time.
  • Own the production quality of what you build. Design for correctness, reliability and performance, plan safe rollouts, and use operational evidence to address the constraints that emerge as usage grows.
  • Increase the effectiveness of the engineers around you through design and code reviews, mentoring senior engineers, and removing recurring obstacles to delivery. Share context and decisions so others can move independently.

About the role:

In this role, you will: 

  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

What you will bring

  • A track record of shipping customer-facing products and growing them beyond their initial launch. You can explain your contribution to measurable outcomes such as adoption, revenue growth, retention, customer efficiency or cost to serve.
  • Strong product judgement. You have worked directly with customers, clarified poorly defined problems and made decisions using evidence, including changing direction when an initial idea did not work.
  • Deep hands-on software engineering ability, with recent experience designing, implementing and operating production systems. You can move from a prototype to maintainable software and explain the trade-offs along the way.
  • Experience scaling products and the systems behind them. You know how to identify the next constraint, balance speed with reliability, and make technical investments that support customer and business growth.
  • Technical leadership across team boundaries. You have built alignment without formal authority, made other engineers more effective, and communicated difficult choices clearly to technical and business partners.

Experience that could be useful
Experience building B2B software through an early growth stage, or working on routing, workforce management or other software for physical operations. We value evidence of learning a complex customer domain and delivering results; previous industry experience is helpful, rather than essential.


What success looks like
Customers adopt the capabilities you help build and can see the benefit in their day-to-day operations. The products remain dependable as usage grows. Your technical decisions support measurable business progress, and the teams around you can deliver more effectively because of your work.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. title: Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

 

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: CEO, AI Stockbroking
description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

About the Role

The CEO - AI Stockbroking will build and own an AI-native stockbroking business. The role combines brokerage infrastructure and market expertise with AI-native research, discovery and trading experiences.

What you will be doing

  • Define the AI Stockbroking proposition, product roadmap and business model.

  • Build AI-native experiences across stock discovery, research, trading, portfolio management and market information.

  • Own P&L, funded accounts, assets, trading activity, revenue and unit economics.

  • Build the brokerage product and underlying trading, custody and market infrastructure.

  • Work deeply with product, engineering and AI teams on product capabilities and execution.

  • Own brokerage, custody, market data and other key partnerships.

  • Build the core team and drive licensing, regulatory readiness and market expansion.

What you will need

  • Deep experience in stockbroking, brokerage, trading or consumer investing.

  • Direct ownership of a meaningful brokerage or trading product, business or P&L.

  • Strong understanding of brokerage economics, trading infrastructure, markets and regulation.

  • Strong product judgement and understanding of how AI can improve stock discovery, research and trading workflows.

  • Experience building and scaling technology products and teams.

  • Hands-on operating capability. Able to work directly through product flows, brokerage infrastructure, economics and execution.

description:
Management Accountant

📍 Location: Hybrid – London office and home working

💼 Type: Full-time

📅 Start Date: Immediate

💰 Salary: £45k to £60k

About Cooper Moss Rutland

Cooper Moss Rutland (CMR) is an independent, award-winning project controls consultancy supporting some of the UK's most complex construction and infrastructure programmes.

We provide specialist expertise across project controls, planning, cost, risk, change, reporting and data, working across rail, highways, aviation, defence, nuclear, energy and water.

We are a growing business with an ambitious outlook. Our culture is collaborative, entrepreneurial and focused on delivering high-quality work for our clients, while creating an environment where our people can develop and make a genuine impact.

The Role

We are looking for a Management Accountant to take ownership of the core financial processes that underpin our growing business.

This is a hands-on role covering the mechanics of our finance function: month-end close, accruals, reconciliations, VAT, the timesheet-to-invoice process and the production of accurate, timely management accounts.

You would be joining a function that has grown quickly and has room to improve. We want someone who will run the core processes reliably and then make them better, rather than accepting them as they are. You would be the in-house finance lead, working with our external accountants and, where needed, senior finance support.

This would suit someone who is qualified or nearly qualified, has strong technical accounting fundamentals and enjoys being close to the detail while also understanding the wider commercial picture.

Key Responsibilities

Month-End & Management Accounts

  • Own and manage the month-end close process from start to finish.

  • Prepare accurate and timely monthly management accounts.

  • Prepare and post month-end journals, including accruals, prepayments and other adjustments.

  • Reconcile balance sheet accounts and investigate and resolve discrepancies.

  • Provide clear financial information and commentary to the leadership team.

  • Prepare monthly cash flow forecasts and support the annual budgeting cycle.

Revenue, Billing & WIP

  • Own the timesheet-to-invoice process, from approved timesheets through to invoices issued.

  • Raise client invoices in line with each client's billing arrangements, which vary considerably by client and by platform.

  • Maintain revenue accruals and monitor unbilled work, keeping WIP and the cash conversion cycle under control.

  • Run credit control and follow up overdue balances.

  • Monitor timesheet submissions and chase employees for missing or incomplete timesheets ahead of each month-end.

Accounts Payable, Payments & Cash

  • Manage the accounts payable process, ensuring supplier invoices are accurately recorded and appropriately authorised.

  • Maintain accurate supplier records and resolve supplier queries and invoice discrepancies.

  • Process employee expenses and company credit card transactions, checking them against policy and chasing missing receipts.

  • Prepare and process supplier payment runs.

  • Support cash flow management and ensure key payment obligations are met on time.

VAT & Compliance

  • Prepare and submit VAT returns accurately and on time.

  • Ensure VAT treatment is applied correctly across transactions.

  • Support the year-end accounts process and CMR's external accountants.

  • Work with the external accountants (and any fractional senior finance support) on year-end, tax and technical accounting matters, escalating judgement calls rather than deciding them alone.

Financial Control & Reporting

  • Perform regular bank, control account and balance sheet reconciliations.

  • Identify errors, inconsistencies and control issues and take ownership of resolving them.

  • Support the development and maintenance of appropriate financial controls and processes.

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • Qualified or nearly qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).

  • Strong understanding of accounting fundamentals and double-entry bookkeeping.

  • Practical experience of month-end accounting and preparation of management accounts.

  • Experience with accruals, prepayments, journals and balance sheet reconciliations.

  • Experience preparing or supporting VAT returns.

  • Strong Excel skills and experience with Xero or a similar accounting system.

  • A proactive approach, with the confidence to investigate issues rather than simply flagging them.

  • At least two years' experience working in industry rather than solely in practice.

  • Experience of timesheet-based, multi-client billing and credit control.

  • Experience working as the sole or lead finance person, or the confidence to do so.

Desirable

  • Experience within professional services, consultancy, construction or another project-based business.

  • Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting and cash flow reporting.

  • Previous experience working in a growing SME environment.

The Person

We're looking for someone who is hands-on, organised and commercially aware.

You'll be comfortable getting into the detail, but you won't lose sight of the bigger picture. You will take pride in getting the numbers right, meeting deadlines and maintaining a finance function that the wider business can rely on.

You'll be comfortable in a growing business where not everything is perfectly established, and willing to say when something isn't working rather than quietly working around it.

Most importantly, you'll be someone people can trust with the numbers.

What You'll Get at CMR

  • The opportunity to play a key role in the finance function of a growing consultancy.

  • Exposure to the wider commercial and operational side of the business.

  • Support for your continued professional development and qualification.

  • A flexible/hybrid working environment.

About You

If you're a qualified or nearly qualified accountant looking for a role where you can take genuine ownership, work closely with senior stakeholders and play an important part in a growing business, we'd love to hear from you.

Come and help us build the finance function that supports the next stage of Cooper Moss Rutland's growth.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

UiPath’s Intelligence Document Processing drives understanding of the documents and messages on which a business runs: invoices, claims, contracts, customer emails. We use frontier LLMs to turn all of that into structured data that automations and AI agents can act on. You'll be building the product that does it: the ingestion and extraction pipelines, the APIs customers build their operations on top of, and the systems that make those models useful, fast and trustworthy at enterprise scale.

Increasingly that work is agentic. What you build is what lets AI agents ingest, understand, retrieve and reason over enterprise documents at volume, without giving up accuracy, security or governance.

It's a product engineering role with complex systems and LLM-in-production problems underneath it. The same service handles a customer's first ten documents and another's ten million, runs in our cloud and inside a bank's own air-gapped datacentre, and has to be good enough that a business will act on its output. Knowing how well the models are actually doing, and what to do when the answer is "not well enough", is a large part of the job.

You'll write in several languages here, and pick up new ones as the problem demands. We care much more about how you think than about what you've written it in. We're looking for someone who loves building things, learns fast, and wants to own product outcomes rather than tickets.

 

What you'll do at UiPath

  • Work with engineers, product managers and customers to design, build and operate the AI systems behind UiPath's document processing products.

  • Build across the pipeline: ingestion, parsing and extraction, indexing and retrieval, and the evaluation that tells us any of it is working.

  • Take features from idea to production and stay with them, measuring whether they actually worked, and improving them when they didn't.

  • Solve genuinely hard problems in concurrency, latency and distributed systems, so the platform holds up under high-volume production workloads.

  • Build for environments we don't control: multi-cloud, on-premises, air-gapped, and under strict security and compliance requirements.

  • Use coding agents as a serious part of your toolkit, and help the team get better at it. Where to trust them, where not to, and how to keep quality high as the tooling changes underneath us.

  • Work with teams across UiPath and across locations to innovate and build best-in-class document processing, and occasionally with customers directly. Because the fastest way to understand a product is to watch someone use it.

  • Contribute to our engineering culture: mentor, review, hire, and push back when something isn't good enough.

 

What you'll bring to the team

  • A solid track record (7+ years) building and operating large-scale commercial services that real customers depend on.

  • Strong programming ability and the confidence to pick up whatever language a problem calls for. You'll meet Python, Rust and C# here, but we don't expect you to arrive knowing them all.

  • Real-world experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS or GCP) and containerised deployment on Kubernetes. You understand how production systems get shipped, monitored and scaled, not just written.

  • Comfort with data at scale: SQL, and the trade-offs between different storage and search systems.

  • Experience working with coding agents, and opinions about them, What responsible use looks like, where they earn their keep and where they cost you, and how you keep evaluating them in an ecosystem that changes every few months.

  • An appreciation for tools that catch bugs before runtime — type systems, tests, and designs that make bad states unrepresentable. Especially in the age of coding agents.

  • A pragmatic grasp of computer science fundamentals. We care about solving real problems with the right data structure, not reciting one from a textbook.

  • Experience shipping LLM-backed products to production is a strong plus: prompting, evaluation, and everything else that turns a model into a feature people will trust.

  • Familiarity with document processing is a plus: OCR, layout, and the messy reality of documents as they actually arrive.

  • An opinion on what makes good code and good architecture, and the ability to argue it, including against us.

  • You're a builder and a problem-solver at heart.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

The Risk Squad owns credit risk and fraud for iwocaPay, iwoca's Buy Now Pay Later product for businesses. The aim is to lend to every business likely to repay, and to spot the ones that aren't.

The squad works across three areas:

  • Lending decisions. Building and improving the automated credit model.

  • The portfolio. Tracking losses, chargebacks, and seller performance, and deciding which segments to grow or pull back from.

  • New products. Designing the risk side of each one before it launches.

The squad is small and new – two data scientists, a risk analyst and a risk lead.

The role

As a Data Scientist in the Risk Squad, you'll co-own every credit model with the other data scientist and review one another's work. The job is mostly supervised ML on tabular data, with a fair amount of data engineering as the squad moves onto its own pipelines. You'll start on the automated credit model and take on the invoice financing models over time. You can also test ideas with iwoca's other lending data science teams, who work on similar credit problems.

You'll choose what to work on and write the plans you deliver. Much of the squad's work happens in iwocaPay's product and strategy meetings, so your models shape the roadmap. You'll also help set up how the squad works – what it monitors, and the guidelines it follows.

Live project examples:

  • Model architecture. Rethinking the model around how iwocaPay actually lends: overlapping facilities, short terms, and a growing set of products a customer can use.

  • Blending datasets. Bringing more iwocaPay-specific data into the models while still drawing on iwoca's larger core lending dataset, through methods such as transfer learning.

  • Invoice financing. Building a credit risk model from scratch for a new product on a segment iwoca hasn’t lent to before. Plus finding the modelling opportunities elsewhere in the funnel, like in our offers...

The requirements

Essential:

  • Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field – typically a degree or Master's in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or similar. You reason about uncertainty and calibration as first-order concerns.

  • Production ML. You have built supervised ML models on tabular data end to end – exploration, training, deployment, and monitoring.

  • Ownership. You work well in a small, early-stage team where priorities move quickly. You build what you need as you go, and take loosely defined problems from framing to a landed decision.

  • Judgement. You know when a model is good enough to go live, and when it needs more work. You critically evaluate model output – yours, a colleague's, or an LLM's – and can explain why a choice is right.

  • AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered without it – a modelling pipeline, a prototype, or a tool others use. You judge where it helps and where it doesn't.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in product, risk, and leadership.

Bonus:

  • Domain experience. You have worked in credit risk modelling or lending.

  • Non-linear methods. You have used gradient boosting or neural networks on tabular data in production.

  • Combining datasets. You have used transfer learning, domain adaptation, or similar methods on data sources of different size and relevance.

  • Data engineering. You have built data pipelines and managed datasets alongside your modelling work.

  • Coding. You can write code for analysis. The squad works in Python.

The salary

We expect to pay from £60,000 to £80,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Über uns:

Die Elbphilharmonie und Laeiszhalle Betriebsgesellschaft mbH ist die Betreiberin der Elbphilharmonie sowie der über 100 Jahre alten Laeiszhalle. In beiden Häusern finden neben den hauseigenen »Elbphilharmonie Konzerten« auch Konzerte externer Konzertveranstalter statt, zusammen etwa 1.000 Veranstaltungen pro Jahr. Die Abteilung Technik ist dem Unternehmensziel der umfassenden serviceorientierten Dienstleistung verpflichtet. Als erster Anlaufpunkt in den Bereichen Veranstaltungs- und Hausbetriebstechnik ist sie in der Lage einen umfassenden Veranstaltungsservice auf dem neusten Stand der Technik anzubieten.

Dein Arbeitsort ist überwiegend die Laeiszhalle. Die Arbeitswege sind leider nicht durchgehend rollstuhlgerecht und daher für Menschen mit Mobilitätseinschränkungen nur eingeschränkt oder gar nicht zu bewältigen. Die Arbeitsplätze sind nicht rollstuhlgerecht ausgestattet. Gerne informieren wir dich über die vorhandenen Barrieren.

  • 6 Wochen Urlaub pro Kalenderjahr

  • Cafeteria mit Ausblick auf den Hamburger Hafen

Die Elbphilharmonie und Laeiszhalle Betriebsgesellschaft mbH verfolgt offensiv das Ziel der beruflichen Gleichstellung von Frauen und Männern und der Diversität. Wir sind bestrebt, die Vielfalt unserer Gesellschaft in unserer Organisation abzubilden und arbeiten an einem diskriminierungssensiblen Arbeitsumfeld. Wir glauben an die Stärke divers aufgestellter Teams und freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Personen, die uns durch andere Perspektiven und Erfahrungshorizonte ergänzen. Bewerbungen von BIPoC und Menschen mit Migrationshintergrund sind eindeutig erwünscht.

In dem Bereich, für den diese Stelle ausgeschrieben wird, sind Frauen im Sinne des Hamburgischen Gleichstellungsgesetzes unterrepräsentiert. Bewerbungen von Frauen werden daher ausdrücklich begrüßt. Sie werden bei gleicher Eignung, Befähigung und fachlicher Leistung vorrangig berücksichtigt. Bewerbungen schwerbehinderter beziehungsweise gleichgestellter Menschen im Sinne des SGB IX sind eindeutig erwünscht. Sie werden bei gleicher Eignung besonders berücksichtigt.

Wir haben dein Interesse geweckt?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt mit aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse) ausschließlich über unser Online-Bewerbungsformular. Die Bewerbungsfrist endet am 29.10.2026.

About us

Lea and Jonas scaled two of Europe's leading construction tech companies - Capmo and alcemy - and saw firsthand the challenges holding the industry back. Now they're tackling the root cause: the 50% of construction work still lost to manual data handling.

Kuro is building the AI foundation for construction. We're reimagining how construction professionals get work done and make decisions by leveraging AI to augment back-office workflows and make core data accessible. We are not pursuing marginal improvements, but a step change for construction.

After one year on the market, leading construction enterprises with a combined annual construction volume of >€40 billion use Kuro every day to automate workflows and make faster, better decisions. Learn more: Join Kuro - Berlin

Set the technical direction

  • Write and review RFCs. The technical roadmap for the next two to three quarters is yours.

  • Make the build-or-buy decisions: which models we use, and which retrieval and orchestration stack we build on.

Raise the bar for the team

  • Mentor engineers: Review their designs and their code.

Work on the construction ontology & project graph

Your profile

Why Kuro

You’ll join at a point when customer demand is proven, but our product and platform are still yours to shape. You’ll own customer-facing features end to end while building the foundations beneath them, from ingestion pipelines and workflow infrastructure to our construction ontology and project graph.

As Kuro grows, you can grow with it, whether as a leading individual contributor, technical leader or people manager.

title: Field Service Engineer – Semiconductor Equipment (f/m/d)
description:
Description

Our quantum sensing technology is already operating in customer environments across Taiwan, the United States, and Europe. As our installed base grows and we move from first deployments to repeat orders, ensuring the reliability and performance of every system becomes increasingly important.

As our Field Service Engineer, you'll take hands-on ownership of our systems throughout their operational lifecycle — from installation and commissioning to preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair.

You'll work directly with leading semiconductor foundries, IDMs, and OSATs, ensuring our systems operate reliably and consistently meet their specifications. You'll collaborate closely with our Engineering and Applications teams, combining technical problem-solving with a strong customer focus.

This is also an opportunity to help shape our global service function from an early stage, introducing the processes, tools, and standards that will support our growing international installed base.

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join Quantum Diamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

What will you do

  • Install, commission, and qualify our quantum sensing systems at customer sites across Europe, the US, and Asia, working closely with our Munich-based engineering teams.

  • Perform preventive maintenance, calibration, troubleshooting, and repairs across optical, laser, mechanical, electronic, and software subsystems.

  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues systematically, collaborating with Engineering and R&D when deeper technical expertise is required.

  • Take ownership of system reliability and technical service, working closely with Field Application Engineers who focus on measurement execution and customer applications.

  • Manage spare-parts availability for your installed base, including inventory tracking, consumption planning, replenishment, and coordination of service logistics.

  • Document service activities, technical findings, and root causes, feeding recurring issues and improvement opportunities back into Product Development.

  • Build trusted relationships with customers by providing clear technical communication, reliable support, and professional service in demanding semiconductor environments.

  • Help establish and continuously improve our global service processes, including maintenance procedures, troubleshooting guides, documentation, and training materials.

What is expected of you

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience as a Field Service Engineer, Equipment Engineer, or in a comparable technical service role, ideally working with semiconductor, optical, laser, inspection, or metrology equipment.

  • Strong practical troubleshooting skills across complex electromechanical systems, ideally combining optics, lasers, precision mechanics, electronics, and control software.

  • Experience working in semiconductor fabs, cleanrooms, or similarly demanding technical environments, with an understanding of relevant safety and operating procedures.

  • Familiarity with laser safety and interlocked systems, or willingness to complete the necessary technical and safety qualifications.

  • Experience with spare-parts management, service documentation, and ERP or service ticketing systems is an advantage.

  • A structured, independent, and solution-oriented approach to technical challenges, even when working under time pressure.

  • Strong communication skills and a customer-focused mindset, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly and build trust with different stakeholders.

  • Willingness to travel internationally for approximately 80% of your working time, primarily supporting customer installations across the US, Europe, and Asia.

  • Fluency in English; German, Mandarin, Japanese, or Korean would be a plus.

  • A degree in Engineering, Physics, Mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent technical training and relevant practical experience.

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

  • Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills.

  • Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together.

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

Über uns

QuantumDiamonds GmbH mit Hauptsitz in München entwickelt und fertigt Halbleiter-Inspektionssysteme auf Basis von Quantensensorik. title: AI Builder — Working Student
description:
EggAI Labs · Working Student · In Person (Tübingen, Germany)

Designing lifecycle evaluation for nondeterministic domain-specific AI systems.

EggAI Labs

We're opening the EggAI Labs in Tübingen. The Labs purpose is to test new AI capabilities, identify what works, how they'd improve delivery, and then build assets to support teams and clients. EggAI's mission cannot be achieved through one-off client projects alone and the Labs is the way to adapt and scale.

As part of the first cohort, you will join a small peer group and work directly with EggAI's CAIO, a Tübingen alumnus. You will also collaborate with our engineering, product, and project leads, who will bring you insights from client problems, help you understand their context and challenge your solutions for them. Your fellow AI Builders will be deliberately chosen to span different passions and strenghts. You will have room to explore and be expected to turn that exploration into something useful. This is not a client-facing role.

The problem: EvalOps

How do we prove an AI system acts as expected under various conditions?

We will explore EvalOps: the methods and tools used to check whether domain-specific AI systems meet their behavioral requirements. Among the key challenges for operating AI systems are nondeterminism, ground-truth curation, evaluation metric-design, latency and costs. EvalOps need to overcome all of them in a disciplined way.

These questions will guide the initial work:

  • Regression suites: How can domain experts turn traces, code, and prompts into useful evals in a way that scales?

  • Coverage estimation: How can we quantify the gaps between an eval suite and the range of expected agent behaviors?

  • Live monitoring: Is it possible to detect anomalous behaviour in production with a similar precision to regression evals?

  • Eval analysis: How much evidence is enough to act (e.g., deploy, debug, roll back a feature, choose a different model)? You will help refine them, test approaches, create assets, and pose new questions.

The role

As an AI Builder, you will take an open EvalOps problem from investigation to a working prototype, ready to be tested. Whatever your focus, you will be expected to take a problem through to a useful result. Here is what that means in practice:

  • Research emerging AI and evaluation capabilities and distinguish substance from hype.

  • Understand the user, workflow, domain, and organisational problem around the work.

  • Evaluate usefulness, quality, safety, and reliability with appropriate evidence.

  • Communicate decisions and learning clearly.

  • Create assets that other people can understand, use, and improve.

  • Code and build end to end.

This shared foundation leaves room for different strengths and interests. Each AI Builder will then develop greater depth in one of three pillars.

Three pillars, different passions

Pillar

Driving question

Possible EvalOps focus

Product

What should we build?

Workflows and interfaces that help domain experts create evals, inspect traces, understand results, and make decisions.

Engineering

How should we build it?

Dependable and scalable evaluation infrastructure, trace processing, monitoring, and governance tooling.

Data Science

How do we know it works?

Coverage measures, sampling strategies, scoring methods, statistical tests, anomaly detection, and reasoning under uncertainty.

We expect every AI Builder to develop a practical foundation across all three pillars and to pursue greater depth in the one that most strongly matches their passion.

What we value

  • Problem obsession. A difficult question captures your curiosity. You keep returning to it, pursue ideas without waiting for instructions, and care deeply about finding an answer that works.

  • Initiative and follow-through. You turn uncertainty into something you can investigate, test, and improve—and stay resourceful when the first approach fails.

  • Evidence of making things work. Show us something you created, the decisions you made, and what you learned along the way.

  • Independent judgment. You test new capabilities yourself, distinguish evidence from enthusiasm, and change your mind when the findings warrant it.

  • Generosity in collaboration. You explain your thinking, seek candid feedback, act on it, and help others make progress. 

What is required

  • You are pursuing a Master’s degree.

  • You can write code and turn an idea into working, tested software.

  • You can work from Tübingen and communicate fluently in English, our company language.

Relevant fields include Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Physics, Bioinformatics, Computational Neuroscience, Medical Informatics, Quantitative Data Science, Cognitive Science. We also welcome candidates from other disciplines who can demonstrate strong problem-solving and practical technical ability.

What you will gain

  • Industry insight. Learn what works and what breaks in real enterprise AI systems, with access to problems from EggAI’s client work

  • Meaningful ownership. Take an EvalOps problem from investigation to a working, evaluated solution, with freedom to shape the approach.

  • Close mentorship. Work directly with EggAI’s Chief AI Officer and sharpen your judgment through feedback from engineering, product, and project leads.

  • Room to develop. Deepen your strengths, learn from peers with complementary perspectives, and use modern AI-development tools on unresolved problems.

  • A say in the Lab’s direction. Help establish its working practices, propose new questions, and influence what it pursues next.

  • Competitive compensation, including recognition for exceptional contributions, and a potential path to a full-time EggAI role after graduation.

How to apply

A short cover letter is required.

Your CV tells us what you have done so far, but we're also interested in the why. Use the letter to explain why you made those choices, what drives you, and why the AI Builder role at EggAI Labs feels like the right next step in your career. 

We are looking for exceptional students, and excellence takes many forms, e.g., academic results, research or ambitious projects. Whatever form yours takes, show us the appropriate evidence, be it grades, publications, something you've built or other evidence of impact.

This is an in-person role in Tübingen. We can only consider candidates who live within commuting distance.

title: Senior Accountant – Finance Operations (m/f/d)
description:
About us

EggAI is a fast-growing, 100% remote AI consulting and development startup based in Munich. We build agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients. We are growing in several European markets at the same time, are actively building our internal structures — and are looking for someone to help shape this growth phase.

Your role

You are our go-to person for day-to-day accounting. You make sure every receipt, invoice and expense ends up in the right place — cost center, account, country — and you prepare everything so that our external tax advisor can book without back-and-forth. You work across several European countries, with employees and freelancers, and with local payroll providers. We don’t have fully established processes yet, so you won’t just follow a playbook: you spot gaps, think the process through and set it up yourself. You work closely with our Head of Finance, who owns controlling, forecasting and reporting, and with our external tax advisor, who handles ongoing bookkeeping, annual financial statements and German payroll. You ideally bring your own experience from a tax advisory firm or a similar environment.

Your responsibilities

 

● Preparatory bookkeeping: Pre-code receipts and prepare them for ongoing bookkeeping by our tax advisor

● Receipt and invoice management: Collect receipts and incoming invoices, review them, and consistently follow up on open items

● Correct allocation: Make sure expenses are assigned to the correct cost center and the correct account in the chart of accounts

● Travel expenses across Europe: Manage per diems (meal allowances), mileage allowances and comparable expense rules across countries for our teams in Europe

● Employees & freelancers across Europe: Know the Europe-wide controlling and accounting topics that apply to employees and freelancers — or get up to speed on them quickly

● International payroll interface: Manage local payroll providers and salary payments

● Cash flow: Think along on cash flow structures & reporting, and keep them up to date

● Process setup: Independently think through and set up finance processes and structures in an international, growing environment

What you bring

Must have

● 4+ years of professional experience in finance & accounting

● German at a fluent professional level (C1/C2), including German accounting and tax terminology; English at least B1, as our team is diverse and English is often the working language

● Very good DATEV skills and solid understanding of the chart of accounts and correct account assignment

● Flexibility with tools: you quickly find your way around other systems such as Odoo

● You have owned finance and accounting topics end-to-end, without day-to-day guidance

● You are comfortable in gray areas and make good decisions even without complete information

Nice to have

● Completed commercial vocational training or a degree with a focus on finance, accounting or controlling

● Understanding of how a balance sheet should be structured to be meaningful for investors — ideally through your own experience in a tax advisory firm or similar environment

● Exposure to controlling topics such as cost centers, forecasts or project margins

● Motivated, proactive and creative personality with a hands-on mentality — you want to shape things, not just administer them

Why EggAI?

● 100% remote work in an international, highly motivated team

● Flat structures and direct access to the Head of Finance and the founders — short paths, fast decisions

● Freedom to shape: you help build the finance infrastructure of an AI scale-up from the ground up

● Insight into one of the most dynamic growth fields in tech and into building a company across Europe

Sounds like you?

We'd love to hear from you!

If your profile looks like a good match we'll be in touch to organise a first stage interview.

Please note, due to the high volume of candidates, we cannot offer personalized feedback to each candidate.

title: Staff Digital Media Manager (w/m/d) Programmatic & Social
description:
Über IONOS

Bei IONOS verwalten wir nicht nur Server, wir prägen mit unseren Lösungen die digitale Zukunft für über 6,2 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden weltweit. Als Europas führender Hosting-Anbieter und Pionier für unabhängige Cloud-Lösungen bauen wir eine Infrastruktur der nächsten Generation: von souveränen Cloud-Architekturen und hochperformanten GPU-Clustern bis hin zu integrierten KI-Automatisierungstools.

Was uns antreibt: Digitale Entscheidungsfreiheit für Europa und echter Impact für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU) sowie Großunternehmen. Wir arbeiten in agilen Teams, setzen auf transparente Strukturen und glauben daran, dass Exzellenz und Innovation nur mit echtem Teamgeist entstehen.

Bereit für Deinen nächsten Schritt? Werde ein Teil von IONOS und wachse mit uns.

Du kennst Programmatic in- und auswendig und willst Deinen Kanalbereich nicht nur steuern, sondern verantworten? Bei uns gestaltest Du Programmatic Video, CTV und Paid Social für unsere Brand-Kampagnen über mehrere Marken und Märkte und machst sie mit KI-Workflows schneller und besser.

Aufgabenbereich

  • Du verantwortest Programmatic Video, CTV, Online Video und Paid Social für unsere Brand-Kampagnen über mehrere Marken und Märkte, von der Kanalstrategie über das Setup bis zur laufenden Optimierung.
  • Du entwickelst die Budget- und Kanalplanung für Deine Kanäle inklusive Performance-Forecasts und bringst Deine Empfehlungen in die übergreifende Mediaplanung ein.
  • Du verhandelst und steuerst Deals mit Streaming-Publishern und Vermarktern, z. B. Private Marketplaces, Programmatic Guaranteed und Direct Deals.
  • Du definierst Standards für Tracking, Taxonomie und Testing in Deinen Kanälen, etwa für Brand-Lift- und Creative-Tests, und sorgst dafür, dass alle Märkte sie einhalten.
  • Du baust und betreibst KI-gestützte Workflows für Setup, Reporting und Optimierung, von der ersten Idee bis zum laufenden Betrieb.

Qualifikationen

  • Mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung im digitalen Media-Management auf Agentur- oder Unternehmensseite mit Schwerpunkt Programmatic Video, CTV oder Online Video.
  • Fundierte Hands-on-Erfahrung mit DSPs wie DV360 oder The Trade Desk, mit CM360 und Adservern sowie mit Paid Social Video auf Meta, YouTube und TikTok.
  • Tiefes Verständnis von Video-Inventar, Auktionsmechaniken, Deal-Typen und CTV-Besonderheiten wie Frequency Capping und Viewability.
  • Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Budget- und Kanalplanung über mehrere Märkte inklusive Forecasting und Reporting mit BI-Tools wie Looker oder Tableau.
  • Du hast eigene Automatisierungen mit KI-Tools gebaut, die im Arbeitsalltag laufen, und kannst Beispiele zeigen.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, da du Deals mit deutschen Publishern und Vermarktern verhandelst und betreust, sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse, denn Englisch ist unsere Alltagssprache in der Zusammenarbeit mit Teams über Marken und Märkte hinweg.

Benefits

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten durch Vertrauensarbeitszeit.
  • An einigen Standorten eine bezuschusste Kantine und verschiedene kostenfreie Getränke.
  • Moderne Büroflächen mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung.
  • Diverse Mitarbeiterrabatte für Aktivitäten und Produkte.
  • Mitarbeiterevents wie Sommer- und Winterfeiern, sowie Workshops.
  • Zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Verschiedene Gesundheitsangebote, wie Sport- und Gesundheitskurse.

Hinweis zur Bewerbung

Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von z. B. Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität, körperlichen Merkmalen, Familienstand oder einem anderen sachfremden Kriterium nach geltendem Recht.

title: Senior Sales Manager – Mobile Performance Advertising
description:
About REPLUG

REPLUG is a Mobile Revenue Growth partner that helps companies turn mobile into a measurable driver of revenue, customer value, and long-term business growth.

From global app publishers to established brands looking to unlock more value from mobile, we partner with companies that want to grow more efficiently, reduce dependency on saturated acquisition channels, and build sustainable growth.

Our work combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution across App Store Optimization, Paid User Acquisition, CRM, measurement, and mobile growth consulting.

We are looking for a Senior Sales Manager to win new business for REPLUG’s performance advertising offering, working directly with the co-founder.

Your focus will be helping app advertisers acquire users through performance-based campaigns, including fixed CPI/CPA models, OEM advertising, and alternative acquisition channels.

This is a senior individual contributor role with ownership of the full sales cycle. You will identify opportunities, open conversations, understand advertisers’ growth challenges, and turn qualified prospects into active clients.

We are looking for someone with a hunter mentality and the commercial judgment to build lasting business. You know how to create your own pipeline, earn the attention of experienced buyers, and move deals forward.

Your responsibilities

Generate new business

  • Build and manage your own pipeline through targeted outbound, industry relationships, referrals, and relevant inbound opportunities.

  • Identify app advertisers whose acquisition objectives, budgets, and technical setup fit our performance advertising offering.

  • Develop relationships with decision-makers across user acquisition, growth, and marketing teams.

Own the full sales cycle

  • Lead discovery calls to understand acquisition challenges, existing channel mix, performance targets, and buying criteria.

  • Build proposals that connect our offering to the advertiser’s business objectives.

  • Negotiate pricing and commercial terms, balancing client expectations with profitable business for REPLUG.

  • Own follow-ups and deal progression through to signature and campaign handover.

Sell with a strong understanding of delivery

  • Explain our traffic sources, buying models, measurement approach, and campaign requirements clearly.

  • Work with our supply and operations teams to validate opportunities and set realistic expectations around performance and scale.

  • Ensure a clear handover covering agreed KPIs, budgets, attribution requirements, and commercial commitments.

Improve how we sell

  • Keep HubSpot updated with accurate opportunities, next steps, and revenue forecasts.

  • Use results and prospect feedback to improve targeting, outreach, and proposals.

  • Share market intelligence with the founders and delivery teams, including advertiser needs, competitor positioning, and emerging opportunities.

Represent REPLUG

  • Attend relevant industry events to develop relationships and generate business.

  • Build a credible presence in the mobile advertising ecosystem through informed conversations and consistent follow-through.

What you bring

  • 3-5 years of relevant sales experience, with a proven track record selling mobile performance advertising to app advertisers or agencies.

  • Experience selling performance-based campaigns, including CPI/CPA models, with familiarity across OEM advertising, ad networks, DSPs, rewarded traffic or other alternative acquisition channels.

  • Evidence of personally sourcing and closing new business.

  • The ability to run the full sales cycle independently, from first contact to commercial negotiation and close.

  • A practical understanding of mobile attribution, MMPs, traffic quality, fraud prevention, and advertiser KPIs such as CPA, ROAS, retention, and LTV.

  • The judgment to qualify opportunities properly and challenge expectations when the commercial or delivery fit is weak.

  • A relevant industry network and the ability to build relationships beyond your existing contacts.

  • A structured approach to prospecting, follow-ups, CRM management, and forecasting.

  • Business-fluent English. Additional European languages are a plus.

Benefits

  • Home Office support for your remote setup.

  • Mentoring sessions to support your professional development.

  • Remote work flexibility based across the European Union.

  • Vouchers and discounts.

  • 24 vacation days per year.

  • High autonomy, zero bureaucracy

  • Direct access to founders and decision-makers

  • Education budget (courses, conferences, certifications)

Baue eine Marke von Anfang an. Mit guten Ideen – und einem Plan dahinter.

Fortisana ist ein wissenschaftlich fundierter All-in-One-Drink für Menschen ab 40, die aktiv bleiben wollen. Das Produkt steht. Wie wir daraus eine unverwechselbare Marke machen, gestalten wir jetzt. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

  • Du übersetzt Strategie in Inhalte. Aus unserer Positionierung entwickelst du Botschaften, Tonalität und Formate für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen und Kaufmotive.

  • Du lernst aus Zahlen. Du wertest Ergebnisse aus, ziehst Schlüsse und priorisierst die nächsten Tests.

  • Du hörst zu. Fragen und Rückmeldungen aus der Community bringst du ins Team zurück, damit wir Marke und Angebot weiterentwickeln.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du denkst in Zielgruppen und Wirkung. Du kannst erklären, wen ein Inhalt erreichen soll und warum du ihn genau so umsetzt.

  • Du hast schon etwas ausprobiert. Zeig uns einen Kanal, eine Kampagne, ein Hochschulprojekt oder ein eigenes Projekt. Entscheidend ist, was du gemacht und gelernt hast.

  • Du verbindest Kreativität mit Analyse. Du liest Zahlen und leitest daraus Entscheidungen ab.

  • Du gehst sorgfältig mit Gesundheitsthemen um. Du machst komplexe Inhalte verständlich, ohne sie zu übertreiben.

  • Du arbeitest AI-native und mit Qualitätsanspruch. Du testest eigenständig neue KI-Tools und kreative Ansätze und integrierst sie sinnvoll in deine Workflows. Dabei prüfst du die Ergebnisse kritisch und hältst unseren Qualitätsstandard bei Inhalt, Gestaltung und Genauigkeit hoch.

Du prägst mit, wie Fortisana aussieht, klingt und sich anfühlt. Dafür bekommst du kreativen Freiraum, Verantwortung und direktes Feedback vom Gründerteam. Der Markt ist voll. Wir wollen auffallen – mit guten Ideen und dem Mut, sie auszuprobieren.

title: Senior KI-Grafikdesigner (m/w/d) – Amazon Produktbilder, Listing-Optimierung & A/B-Testing
description:

Wir haben bereits ein umfangreiches Produktportfolio mit zahlreichen bestehenden Amazon-Listings. Was wir suchen, ist ein absoluter Profi, der unsere Produktbilder auf ein neues Level hebt: noch hochwertiger, noch überzeugender und vor allem noch verkaufsstärker.

Du bekommst bei uns die Möglichkeit, eigenverantwortlich an der visuellen Weiterentwicklung unserer Amazon-Präsenz zu arbeiten, neue Ideen umzusetzen und durch gezielte A/B-Tests herauszufinden, welche Bilder tatsächlich besser performen.

Wir suchen keinen klassischen Allround-Grafikdesigner. Wir suchen jemanden, der Design nicht nur beherrscht, sondern versteht, wie aus großartigen Produktbildern messbare Verkaufserfolge entstehen.

Dafür bieten wir dir ein attraktives Budget, echten Gestaltungsspielraum, eine überdurchschnittliche Vergütung und ein Team, das hervorragende Arbeit zu schätzen weiß.

Aufgaben

  • Optimierung von Perspektive, Bildkomposition, Licht, Schatten, Farben und Produktpräsentation.

Professionelle (KI-) Bildbearbeitung

  • Erstellung realistischer Lifestyle-Bilder und geeigneter Produktumgebungen.

  • Kombination aus KI-Technologien und professioneller Photoshop-Nachbearbeitung.

  • Sicherstellung eines einheitlichen, hochwertigen Markenauftritts.

Überarbeitung bestehender Amazon-Listings

  • Eigenständige Analyse und Optimierung bestehender Produktbildergalerien.

  • Optimierung von Bildreihenfolge, Produktpräsentation und Kaufargumenten.

  • Anpassung der Bilder an unterschiedliche internationale Amazon-Marktplätze.

Deine Herausforderung bei uns

Wir wollen nicht einfach nur schönere Produktbilder. Wir wollen die besten Produktbilder in unserem Wettbewerbsumfeld.

Bei uns erwarten dich keine langweiligen Routineaufgaben und keine endlosen Abstimmungsschleifen.

Du arbeitest mit hochwertigen Produkten, kannst deine Kreativität einbringen und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Amazon-Bilder.

Du analysierst, hinterfragst, experimentierst und optimierst. Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, deine Ideen tatsächlich umzusetzen und anhand konkreter Ergebnisse zu sehen, welchen Unterschied deine Arbeit macht.

Unser Anspruch ist hoch – aber genauso hoch ist unsere Wertschätzung für Menschen, die mit Leidenschaft, Eigeninitiative und echtem Expertenwissen außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse erzielen.

A/B-Testing & Conversion-Optimierung

  • Entwicklung und Durchführung gezielter A/B-Tests für Amazon-Hauptbilder.

  • Erstellung unterschiedlicher Bildvarianten und Nutzung von Amazon „Manage Your Experiments“, sofern verfügbar.

  • Umsetzung erfolgreicher Bildvarianten zur nachhaltigen Performance-Steigerung.

  • Dokumentation der Ergebnisse und Ableitung weiterer Optimierungen.

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im E-Commerce-Grafikdesign mit Schwerpunkt Amazon-Produktbilder und Listing-Optimierung.

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise mit Eigeninitiative, Kreativität und höchsten Qualitätsansprüchen.

Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit Premium-Geschenkartikeln, Produktfotografie, Adobe Bildbearbeitungsprogrammen und Amazon Brand Analytics.

Was für uns zählt: Dein Können, deine nachweisbaren Ergebnisse und ein überzeugendes Portfolio – nicht deine Abschlüsse oder Zertifikate.

Wir suchen einen echten Experten mit höchsten Qualitätsansprüchen, der eigenständig denkt, Verantwortung übernimmt und Produktbilder entwickelt, die nicht nur hervorragend aussehen, sondern nachweislich besser verkaufen.

Das bieten wir dir

Wir sind ein kleines Team mit großen Ambitionen – und möchten, dass du dich bei uns fachlich und persönlich wohlfühlst.

  • Überdurchschnittliche Vergütung: Herausragendes Können verdient eine herausragende Bezahlung. Wir haben ein attraktives Budget und honorieren echte Expertise entsprechend.

  • Attraktive Erfolgsboni: Besondere Leistungen und nachweisbare Erfolge können wir mit zusätzlichen Prämien belohnen.

  • Eigenverantwortung & kreative Freiheit: Deine Ideen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht. Du bekommst Raum, um Neues auszuprobieren, kreative Ansätze umzusetzen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

  • Langfristige Perspektive: Wir haben viele spannende Produkte und ehrgeizige Ziele. Wir suchen jemanden, der gemeinsam mit uns wachsen möchte.

  • Modernste KI-Technologien: Arbeite mit innovativen KI-Tools und professionellen Design-Workflows.

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege: Keine komplizierten Hierarchien – bei uns kannst du Ideen direkt einbringen und schnell umsetzen.

  • Familiäre Atmosphäre: Ein herzliches, motiviertes Team, das zusammenhält, sich gegenseitig unterstützt und Erfolge gemeinsam feiert.

  • Freitags früher Feierabend: Bei uns beginnt das Wochenende schon freitags um 13:30 Uhr!

  • Arbeiten, wo andere Urlaub machen: Unser Standort in Krün liegt mitten in der wunderschönen Alpenregion.

  • Moderner Arbeitsplatz: Höhenverstellbarer Schreibtisch, ergonomische Ausstattung und ein angenehmes Arbeitsumfeld.

  • Alles für deinen Arbeitsalltag: Kostenlose Parkplätze, Kaffee, Tee, Wasser und eine voll ausgestattete Küche.

  • Sei einfach du selbst: Ob Hemd, Bluse oder Jeans und Sneakers – bei uns zählen deine Persönlichkeit, deine Ideen und dein Können, nicht dein Outfit.

Das Wichtigste: Wir suchen nicht den günstigsten Designer, sondern den richtigen Menschen mit außergewöhnlichen Fähigkeiten. Und wir sind bereit, dafür entsprechend zu investieren.

So bewirbst du dich

Du bist ein echter Amazon-Design-Profi und möchtest mit uns zusammenarbeiten? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Bitte sende uns folgende Informationen:

  1. Dein Portfolio: Mindestens 3 Amazon-Listings, die du optimiert hast – idealerweise mit Vorher-Nachher-Beispielen und deinen besten Hauptbildern.

  3. Deine A/B-Testing-Erfahrung: Ein konkretes Beispiel mit Ergebnissen, sofern vorhanden.

  4. Amazon Seller Central: Deine Erfahrung mit dem eigenständigen Hochladen und Verwalten von Produktbildern.

  5. Vergütung & Verfügbarkeit: Dein gewünschter Stundensatz, deine wöchentliche Verfügbarkeit und der geschätzte Zeitaufwand pro Hauptbild.

  6. Deine Herangehensweise: Wie würdest du das Hauptbild einer hochwertigen Grußkarte oder Geschenkbox verkaufsstärker gestalten?

Uns überzeugt nicht die längste Bewerbung, sondern ein herausragendes Portfolio, echte Expertise und deine Leidenschaft für perfekte Produktbilder.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

  • Conversion-Rate-Optimierung

title: OT Network Engineer (m/w/d)
